docs.title: Welcome to Miracle RO
docs.text:
Miracle is a Renewal Ragnarok Online server with high rates, a dedicated Quest Room, custom enchanters, World Boss and Hell Raid events, and daily activities that reward you for simply playing. This wiki explains every custom NPC and system on the server, with prices and item lists taken straight from the server's own scripts.

Server Base / Job EXP 1000x Drops 1000x (equipment 250x, cards 100x) Content up to Episode 21 and Chapter 1 Client 2026-01-07 Weekend bonus Double EXP and drops every Friday 00:00 to Monday 00:00

docs.title: Where to start
docs.text:
• New players

    Claim your freebies, get to the Quest Room and learn the main hubs.

  • Currencies & points

    Mission, Instance, Event, Card and Activity points: how to earn them and where to spend them.

  • Shops

    Quest Shop, Instance Point Merchant, World Boss Merchant, the Mall and more.

  • Enchants

    iRO Enchanter, JRO Enchanter and the wing enchanters, with every possible result.

  • Content

    Hunting Missions, Daily Quests, World Boss, Hell Raid, Mining and the hourly events.

  • Database

    Every item, monster, skill and job, with drops, spawn maps, shops and skill trees.

  • Official content

    95 official instances, the Eden Group, episode quests and official systems.

  • NPC directory

    Every custom NPC with its map and coordinates.

docs.title: The two hubs
docs.text:
Prontera is the main town. Around the fountain you will find the Kafra, Hera the healer, the VIP Admin, the Daily Quest Manager, the World Boss NPC, the Episode Skip NPC and the Quest Area NPC (prontera 149, 194) that warps you to the Quest Room.

The Quest Room (moc_para01) is where most custom NPCs live: the Quest Shop, the enchanters, the point merchants, the Card Trader, Hunting Missions and the gacha machines.

Finding an NPC

Every NPC page lists the map and coordinates. Type /navi <map> <x>/<y> in game to get a navigation arrow.

docs.title: Daily Quests
docs.text:
Location: prontera 154, 198

Register once a day and complete 5 quests, one after another. Each finished quest gives a random reward and a server announcement. Only one account per computer can register each day.

docs.title: Quest types
docs.text:
Each quest is a random type and a random difficulty:

Difficulty Hunting Collecting Instance Easy Kill 100 Bring 200 Clear any 5 instances Medium Kill 200 Bring 5 Clear any 5 instances Hard Kill 300 Bring 1 Clear any 5 instances
  • Hunting asks for one monster from the hunting list below.
  • Collecting asks for one item from the list for that difficulty. The items are taken when you submit.
  • Instance counts any instance you clear (party instances count for the whole party).

docs.title: Episode Skip
docs.text:
Location: prontera 164, 163

Completes the main story of an episode for you, including its key rewards. You must be a 3rd class or higher. Episodes have to be skipped in order from 18 onward.

Skip Ticket Extra requirement Episode 16.1 + 16.2 Episode 16 Clear Ticket #1000282 Episode 17.1 + 17.2 Episode 17 Clear Ticket #1000287 Episode 18 Episode 18 Clear Ticket #1000288 Episode 19 Episode 19 Pass Ticket #1001263 Episode 18 done Episode 20 Episode 20 Clear Ticket #1001214 Episode 19 done, Base Level 215

New accounts get the 16, 17 and 18 tickets with the freebies.

docs.title: Automatic Events
docs.text:
Events start on their own every 30 minutes. When one opens, the server announces it and you have 1 minute to type @eventjoin and pick it. @eventjoin also shows your current Event Points.

Winners earn Event Points, spent at the Event Shop, the Mining Zone tool shop, Hell Raid and the Antiquity Gacha.

docs.title: The events
docs.text: Event How to win Prize Bombring Survive 5 rounds of exploding Bombrings, 30 seconds each, in quiz_02. 20 Event Points to every survivor Dice Stand in one of 4 boxes. A 4-sided die is thrown and the other boxes are kicked out. Last box standing wins. 20 Event Points Poring Catcher Dozens of Porings with fake names spawn. Kill the one named exactly Poring. Kill a wrong one and you are out. 20 Event Points Poring Hunter Score the most points before time runs out: Poring +1, Drops +5, Poporing -10. 20 Event Points Disguise The Disguise Event NPC in the Quest Room (moc_para01 31, 31) turns into a monster. Be the first to type its name in chat. 4 Event Points per round Monster Battle Two monsters fight in poring_w02. Bet 20 Event Points on one at the MVP Bet Girl. 100 Event Points if your monster wins

docs.title: Weekend double rates
docs.text: Every Friday 00:00 to Monday 00:00, Base EXP, Job EXP and drop rates (including cards) are doubled.

docs.title: Battle Rumble
docs.text: A GM-run event at the Novice Magic Tournament Gate (new_1-1). Only Base Level 99 Novices with an empty inventory may enter. You get random rental gear for 30 minutes, then fight to be the last one standing.

You can play 10 times a day per account.

docs.title: Hell Raid
docs.text:
Location: prontera 113, 162

A 10-round party raid in ordeal_3-1.

docs.title: Schedule
docs.text: Registration opens every 3 hours (00:00, 03:00, 06:00, 09:00, 12:00, 15:00, 18:00, 21:00) for 5 minutes. Talk to the Hell Raid Guardian to enter. You cannot join once the raid has started.

docs.title: How a round works
docs.text:
1. 70 monsters spawn around the arena.
  2. When all are dead, a round boss appears 10 seconds later.
  3. Killing the boss mails every player on the map the round reward.
  4. Talk to the Hell Raid Guide within 5 minutes and donate 10 Event Points together (each account can donate once per round) to start the next round. If nobody does, the raid ends.

The raid also ends after 1 hour or when everyone has left.

docs.title: Rules
docs.text:
• No Token Of Siegfried, commands or cash shop
  • No teleport, warp, branches or Ice Wall; nothing is lost on death
  • Bosses have extra HP and damage and only take 1% of your damage
  • One character per computer

Every monster killed on the server adds 1 soul to a shared counter. When it reaches 75,000 souls, any player of Base Level 275 can summon the World Boss at the World Boss NPC.

  1. The boss appears on a random field map, guarded by 7 guardians. Each living guardian gives the boss one of its skills. Kill guardians to strip them away.
  2. The gate opens 5 minutes after the summon. Enter through the World Boss NPC (maximum 100 players, one character per computer).
  3. The boss leaves after 1 hour if it is not defeated.

docs.title: Database
docs.text:
Look up any item, monster, skill, NPC, enchant or job on Miracle. Everything here is read from the server's own databases when the wiki is built, including Miracle's custom items, monsters and jobs, so it matches the game.

  • Items

    Stats, effects, equip jobs, which monsters drop it, which NPCs sell it and which boxes contain it.

  • Monsters

    Stats, element, race and size, drops with their chance on this server, and the maps they spawn on.

  • Skills

    SP cost, cast time, cooldown and range per level, and which jobs learn it.

  • NPCs

    Where every NPC stands, what it sells or trades, which items it gives or takes, its menu and its quests.

  • Enchants

    Enchant systems opened by NPCs and Laphine synthesis and upgrades: costs, enchant chances and rewards.

  • Jobs

    Skill trees with prerequisites, job bonus stats, HP and SP, and base ASPD per weapon.

About drop chances

Chances already include the server's drop rates from conf/battle/drops.conf, the same way the server applies them, and are capped at 100%. Item effects are shown as the server script, so some lines may read like code.

In the Database

Location: moc_para01 42, 38 · Quest Room

Enchant cost 2× Enchant Ticket #1000874 + 10,000,000 Zeny Reset cost 5× Enchant Ticket #1000874 + 5,000,000 Zeny

The JRO Enchanter adds the Japanese server's special enchants to headgear, armor, weapons, shields, garments, shoes and accessories. It replaces the old Aulion and Desmond enchanters.

  • Slots are filled in order: slot 4 first, then slot 3, then slot 2. Each try fills the next empty slot with one random enchant from that slot's list. Every enchant in a list has the same chance.
  • Some slots need the item to be refined first. The Refine column shows the lowest refine for that slot.
  • Slots that are card slots of the item (for example slot 2 of a weapon with 2 card slots) are never enchanted.
  • Reset removes every enchant (cards stay) so you can start again. Refine, grade and random options are kept.
  • Rental items, signed or forged items and equipped items can't be enchanted. Take the item off first.

docs.title: Commands
docs.text:
On top of the standard rAthena player commands, Miracle adds these:

Command What it does @eventjoin Shows your Event Points and lets you join the automatic event that is open right now. @instancepoints Shows how many Instance Points you earned today (daily cap 1,200) and your total. @activity Turns the Activity Points messages on or off. See Gacha Machines. @HourlyBan Opts this character out of Activity Points until you relog. @donate Opens the donation shops (PoD Shop and Cash Shop). @statsview Lists every active bonus on your character (HP/SP %, ATK/MATK %, damage modifiers and more). @dummy Warps you to the Dummy Punching Bags in Prontera. @pvpladder Opens the PvP/GvG ladder menu from anywhere. See PvP & WoE.

Commands are disabled in some places

Hell Raid, the Mining Zone and the World Boss map block most commands and the cash shop.

docs.title: Gepard Shield
docs.text:
Miracle runs Gepard Shield anti-cheat. Gepard identifies each computer, and several rewards are limited per computer rather than per account:

  • Freebies (once per computer)
  • Daily Quest registration (one per computer and IP per day)
  • Instance Points (one claim per computer per instance run)
  • Activity Points (one character per computer)

docs.title: One character per computer
docs.text:
These maps allow only one character per computer. A second one is warped back to Prontera:

  • The World Boss map
  • Hell Raid (ordeal_3-1) and the Battle Rumble arena
  • PvP rooms and the guild_vs arenas

docs.title: Captcha (macro checker)
docs.text: GMs can run a captcha check on any map. Everyone there gets an image with a 6-character code and must type it back within 60 seconds. You get 6 tries. Running out of time or tries bans the account, so answer it even if you are busy.

docs.title: 1. Claim your freebies
docs.text:
Talk to the Kafra Employee in Prontera (prontera 145, 197) and pick Claim Freebies. Each reward can be claimed once per account and once per computer.

FreebiesEquipment FreebiesLimit Break Shadows
  • A random poring costume (top) and a random costume garment, account bound
  • 1,000,000 Zeny
  • 7 days of VIP
  • 2× +9 Weapon Refine Ticket #6228, 5× +9 Armor Refine Ticket #6232
  • 3× Platinum Coin #30005, 100× Bronze Coin #30002
  • Episode skip tickets: Episode 16 Clear Ticket #1000282, Episode 17 Clear Ticket #1000287, Episode 18 Clear Ticket #1000288

Pick one job (Knight, Crusader, Hunter, Wizard, Sage, Blacksmith, Alchemist, Rogue or Monk) and receive a full starter set, all account bound: a +12 enchanted weapon, +11 enchanted armor, garment and shoes, and two enchanted accessories. You can only claim one job's set.

A +10 Limit Break Shadow Earring #1270127 and a +10 Limit Break Shadow Pendant #1270128.

docs.title: 2. Kafra services
docs.text:
The Prontera Kafra (prontera 145, 197) also offers:

Service What it does Save Position Saves you in Prontera. VIP Storage A second storage. Non-VIP players can still take items out, but not put them in. Reset Skill/Stats 5,000 Zeny for skills or stats, 9,000 Zeny for both. No limit. Platinum Skill Gives the quest skills of your job for free. Renter Gives you a cart, falcon, warg, Peco/Dragon or Mado depending on your job. Promotional Code Redeem promo codes from events and social media.

docs.title: 3. Heal and buff for free
docs.text:
Hera (prontera 153, 193) heals you to full and gives Increase AGI and Blessing for 5 minutes. You can also just type a chat message containing heal near her. VIP players get a much bigger package: status cures, AP, food buffs, Assumptio, Impositio, Suffragium, Sacrament and your class Spirit, lasting 30 minutes.

Every other town has a standard Healer NPC as well.

docs.title: 4. Go to the Quest Room
docs.text:
The Quest Area NPC (prontera 149, 194) warps you to moc_para01, where most custom NPCs are. Good first stops:

  • Paradise Merchant for starter weapons and armor, paid in Bronze Coin #30002
  • Hunting Missions to earn Mission Points and coins
  • Quest Shop to see what your coins can buy

docs.title: 5. Skip the episode quests
docs.text: If you are a 3rd class or higher, the Episode Skip NPC completes Episodes 16 to 20 for you with a skip ticket. The freebies include the tickets for 16, 17 and 18.

docs.title: 6. Test your damage
docs.text: The Dummy Punching Bags in south-east Prontera (around 220, 70) let you test your damage. Type @dummy to warp straight to them.

docs.title: VIP
docs.text: Buy VIP from the VIP Account NPC in Prontera (prontera 147, 174). It costs 500 Cash Points per day and you choose how many days. New accounts get 7 days free with the freebies.

docs.title: Benefits
docs.text:
As listed by the VIP NPC:

  • Character slots: 9 → 15
  • Storage: 300 → 600 slots, plus the VIP storage at the Kafra
  • +50% Base EXP, Job EXP and item drop rate
  • No gemstone requirements
  • Bigger and longer buffs from Hera and the Healers

docs.title: Abyss Depth Enchant Manager (Rune Crowns and Dimension Weapons)
docs.text:
In the Database

Every item this enchanter works on, the enchants it adds and the NPC on the map: open its Database entry. Item pages link back here too.

The research team in the Biosphere Abyss Depth lobby crafts Time Dimensions Rune Crowns, refines the rune materials, and enchants Rune Crowns and Dimensions weapons through the enchant window.

Where: /navi ba_chess 28/16 (Enchant Manager). The Rune Crown Manager is at /navi ba_chess 25/19 and the Specimen Refine Manager at /navi ba_chess 22/16.

docs.title: Requirements
docs.text:
• You must have started the Biosphere Abyss Depth quest.
  • Enchant Manager and Rune Crown Manager: at least 500 Depth 2nd floor research reputation.
  • Specimen Refine Manager: the Abyss Researcher quest must be completed.

docs.title: How the enchant window works
docs.text:
Talk to the Enchant Manager and pick "Rune Crown Enchant" or "Dimension Weapon Enchant". A window opens.

  • The item must be in your inventory, not equipped (and not in the equip-switch window).
  • Slots are filled in a fixed order. Random enchant rolls from the list for the next empty slot. Perfect enchant lets you pick a specific enchant for that slot. Upgrade raises an enchant you already have.
  • Every enchant, perfect enchant, upgrade and reset here has a 100% success rate. Refine and cards are never touched.

docs.title: Enchanting
docs.text:
Cost: 100,000 zeny per enchant. Enchanting always succeeds. Refine and cards are kept, and the item never breaks.

  1. The first enchant goes into the 4th slot.
  2. The second enchant goes into the 3rd slot.
  3. After that the item is full; reset it to enchant again.

The possible enchants depend on the item's refine level at the moment you enchant.

docs.title: Removing enchants
docs.text:
Choose "I want to remove option.", then pick the item (it must be equipped).

Cost: 100,000 zeny. Always succeeds; refine and cards are kept.

Option What it does Reset only the 3rd Slot Removes the 3rd-slot enchant and keeps the 4th-slot one. Needs an enchant in the 3rd slot. Reset all Removes both enchants. Needs an enchant in the 4th slot.

docs.title: Azzam the Lucky (Nebula Armor and Signets of Star)
docs.text:
In the Database

Every item this enchanter works on, the enchants it adds and the NPC on the map: open its Database entry. Item pages link back here too.

Two NPCs called Azzam the Lucky stand side by side and enchant the Constellation Tower gear:

  • Azzam the Lucky #1 enchants the Nebula armors.
  • Azzam the Lucky #2 enchants the Signet of Star accessories.

Both always succeed when adding an enchant. The only step that can fail is the Slot 2 upgrade on Signets. Refine, the card in the first slot and the enchant grade are always kept.

docs.title: Devil Enchant Master (Upgrade weapons)
docs.text:
In the Database

Every item this enchanter works on, the enchants it adds and the NPC on the map: open its Database entry. Item pages link back here too.

The Devil Enchant Master adds one high stat enchant to the 4th slot of "Upgrade" weapons, using an Enchant Book.

Where: /navi itemmall 29/71 (Cash Mall)

docs.title: Items it works on
docs.text:
The weapon must be equipped in your right hand:

Upgrade Katar [1] #1292, Upgrade Two-Handed Axe [1] #1394, Upgrade Lance [1] #1491, Upgrade Book [1] #1585, Upgrade Staff [1] #2015, Upgrade Dagger [1] #13071, Upgrade Revolver [1] #13115, Upgrade Mace [1] #16019, Upgrade Bow [1] #18112, Uprage Two-handed Sword [1] #21000

You need 10,000 free weight and a free inventory slot.

docs.title: Enchanting
docs.text:
Choose "I heard that you are the best!", then pick a series.

  • Cost: 1 Enchant Book #6484 per try (used up on success and on failure). No zeny.
  • One enchant only, in the 4th slot. If the weapon already has one, reset it first.
  • Cards are always kept.
  • On failure no enchant is added and the weapon loses a random amount of refine, anywhere from 0 up to all of its refine levels (each amount equally likely). The weapon itself never breaks.

docs.title: Reset
docs.text:
Choose "Please initialize the enchant." with the enchanted weapon equipped.

Cost: 100,000 zeny. Always succeeds. Removes the 4th-slot enchant; refine and cards are kept.

docs.title: Eden Group Equipment (Thorn and BK)
docs.text:
In the Database

Every item this enchanter works on, the enchants it adds and the NPC on the map: open its Database entry. Item pages link back here too.

Two craftsmen in the Eden Group headquarters enchant the Eden Group gear you get from the Eden Group's intermediate missions. Blacksmith Thorn enchants the armor, garment and boots, and Weapons Expert BK upgrades the Eden weapons.

Where: Blacksmith Thorn /navi moc_para01 111/83, Weapons Expert BK /navi moc_para01 112/79

Both work on the item in your inventory. Each upgrade takes the item and gives you a new one, so the new item is always +0 and any card in it is lost. Carry only one copy of the item you want to upgrade: Thorn and BK both refuse if you carry more than one copy of it.

docs.title: Blacksmith Thorn
docs.text: You need the Eden Group Mark to talk to Thorn. Choose Give me new equipment. once during the Eden Group intermediate missions to get a set of Eden Group gear and an Eden weapon for your job.

docs.title: Errand
docs.text:
Each enchant must be paid for with an errand. Choose Personal Request and accept it, then bring:

Your base level Bring Below 80 20 Iron Ore #1002 and 10 Iron #998 80 or higher 20 Used Iron Plate #7319

docs.title: Strengthen Equipment
docs.text:
Once the errand is done (and you are far enough in the intermediate missions), choose Strengthen Equipment and pick one of:

  • Eden Team Manteau II #2571
  • Paradise Uniform IV #15031
  • Eden Team Boots IV #2473

The item gets two random enchants, one in slot 3 and one in slot 4. Each is rolled separately from the same list, so both can be the same. Any enchants the item already had are replaced. It always succeeds.

Enchant Chance (each slot) STR+2 #4701 8.33% AGI+2 #4731 8.33% VIT+2 #4741 8.33% INT+2 #4711 8.33% DEX+2 #4721 8.33% LUK+2 #4751 8.33% DEF+3 #4791 8.33% DEF+6 #4792 8.33% DEF+9 #4793 8.33% MDEF+4 #4787 8.33% MDEF+6 #4788 8.33% MDEF+8 #4789 8.33%

After an enchant you must wait until the next 04:00 server time, then talk to Thorn under Personal Request to clear the timer and take a new errand. Every new enchant replaces the old pair, so this is also the way to re-roll.

docs.title: Weapons Expert BK
docs.text:
BK upgrades one Eden weapon in three steps. Each step unlocks as you progress in the Eden Group intermediate missions, and all of them are free.

Weapons: Eden Slayer III #1197, Eden Saber III #13434, Eden Dagger III #13066, Eden Katar I #1289, Eden Two-Handed Axe I #1391, Eden Spear I #1434, Eden Staff III #1658, Eden Mace III #16014, Eden Bow III #18106, Eden Book I #1583, Eden Guitar I #1931, Eden Tail I #1986, Eden Revolver III #13114, Eden Knuckle I #1831, P.Huuma Suriken I #13310, Eden Group Foxtail Staff III #26101

Step You choose Result 1 The weapon, then physical or magical Slot 4: ATK+3% #4767 (physical) or MATK+3% #4806 (magical) 2 A monster type Slot 3: the card for that type (table below) 3 The weapon Slot 2: a second copy of the same card Type Physical (ATK +3%) Magical (MATK +3%) Brute Goblin Card #4060 Bradium Golem Card #4472 Plant Scorpion Card #4068 Nepenthes Card #4470 Insect Caramel Card #4063 Pinguicula Card #4476 Fish Flora Card #4080 Naga Card #4469 Dragon Earth Petite Card #4118 Draco Egg Card #4471 Increased Heal Archbishop1Lv #4805 Archbishop1Lv #4805

Your choices are saved on your character. Step 3 builds the finished weapon from those choices, whichever Eden weapon you pick. There is no reset: once step 3 is done, BK has nothing more to offer.

In step 2 BK asks which Eden weapon to enhance.

docs.title: El Dicastes Enchanters
docs.text:
In the Database

Every item this enchanter works on, the enchants it adds and the NPC on the map: open its Database entry. Item pages link back here too.

Three cats outside El Dicastes and Kareka inside the city each upgrade one Sapha item in three steps for Proof Of Sapha's Honor #6304.

NPC Item Where Jalapeno Feral Boots #2463 /navi dic_fild01 240/198 Brare Gold Trickle #2843 /navi dic_fild01 251/183 Mancho Feral Tail #2564 /navi dic_fild01 259/172 Kareka Light Of El Discastes #2844 /navi dic_in01 353/37

You need at least 1 Proof Of Sapha's Honor #6304 to talk business, at least 1,000 free weight and room for one more item. The item only has to be in your inventory.

docs.title: How it works
docs.text:
Each upgrade step adds one random enchant. The steps always go in the same order:

Step Cost Slot Can break? 1st upgrade 1 Proof Of Sapha's Honor #6304 Slot 4 No 2nd upgrade 2 Proof Of Sapha's Honor #6304 Slot 3 No 3rd upgrade 3 Proof Of Sapha's Honor #6304 Slot 2 Feral Boots and Feral Tail only

Your progress is saved on your character, not on the item. Every step takes the item from your inventory and gives you a new one with all the enchants you have rolled so far.

Carry exactly one copy

The NPC builds the new item from your character's record, not from the item itself, so it can't tell copies apart. If you carry more than one copy of the item, it refuses to upgrade until you put the extras away.

docs.title: Enchant
docs.text:
1. Choose enchant flush weapon.
  2. The enchant window opens (only if you carry less than 70% of your weight limit). Put the weapon in from your inventory (unequip it first).
  3. Pick an enchant. Every enchant here is selectable (perfect) and always succeeds; you then upgrade it step by step. Refine, cards and the enchant grade are never touched.

docs.title: Garden of Time Vending Machines
docs.text:
In the Database

Four Subspace vending machines in the Garden of Time trade, upgrade and enchant the Manteau of Mystical Beast cloaks, the Circulation of Life cloaks and the Signets of Circulation.

Machine What it does Where #1 Trade windows for energies and consumables /navi t_garden 129/123 #2 Trade windows for the accessories and cloaks, and the cloak upgrade /navi t_garden 132/120 #3 Enchants the Manteau of Mystical Beast cloaks /navi t_garden 135/117 #4 Enchants the Signets and the Circulation of Life cloaks /navi t_garden 138/114

Requirements: the quest Meeting with the Spirit must be complete. The machines are hidden until you walk up to them after that. You also need room for more items (the machines refuse to talk to you when your inventory is too full or too heavy).

docs.title: How it works

docs.title: Grade Enhancement (Sratos and Suribell)
docs.text:
In the Database

Every item this enchanter works on, the enchants it adds and the NPC on the map: open its Database entry. Item pages link back here too.

Grade Enhancement raises the grade of high-end gear one step at a time: no grade, then D, C, B and finally A. Each grade adds a bonus to the item. Both NPCs open the same grade window and run the same Etel exchange.

Where:

  • Sratos: /navi grademk 34/184. The entrance to this room is at /navi prontera 50/293.
  • Suribell: /navi paramk 34/184 (Paramarket)

docs.title: Items it works on
docs.text:
• Weapons of weapon level 5
  • Armor of armor level 2 (any equipment slot)

The item must be refined to at least the level shown below for the next grade.

docs.title: Etel exchange
docs.text:
Choose "Exchange Etel items" to make the materials:

You get Zeny Materials Etel Stone #1000323 100,000 5 Etel Dust #1000322 Blessed Etel Dust #1000337 100,000 5 Etel Dust #1000322, 1 Blacksmith Blessing #6635 Etel Aquamarine #1000325 100,000 3 Etel Stone #1000323, 1 Aquamarine #720 Etel Topaz #1000326 200,000 6 Etel Stone #1000323, 1 Topaz #728 Etel Amethyst #1000327 300,000 10 Etel Stone #1000323, 1 Amethyst #719 Etel Amber #1000328 300,000 15 Etel Stone #1000323, 1 Amber #1000321

docs.title: Upgrading a grade
docs.text:
Choose "Enhance the equipment's grade.", then "I'll still do it!". A window opens; put the item in and pick one of two payment options.

On success the grade goes up by one and the item's refine is reset to +0. Cards, enchants and random options stay.

docs.title: Success chance by refine
docs.text:
Weapons and armor use the same table. A dash means you cannot try at that refine.

Upgrade +9 +10 +11 to +15 +16 to +20 No grade → D 10% 20% 70% 80% D → C - 20% 60% 70% C → B - - 50% 60% B → A - - 40% 50%

docs.title: Cost options
docs.text:
Upgrade Cheap option Safe option No grade → D 1 Etel Aquamarine #1000325 + 175,000z 5 Etel Aquamarine #1000325 + 875,000z D → C 1 Etel Topaz #1000326 + 175,000z 5 Etel Topaz #1000326 + 875,000z C → B 1 Etel Amethyst #1000327 + 175,000z 5 Etel Amethyst #1000327 + 875,000z B → A 2 Etel Amber #1000328 + 175,000z 10 Etel Amber #1000328 + 875,000z
  • Cheap option: if it fails, the item is destroyed.
  • Safe option: if it fails, nothing happens to the item. Only the materials and zeny are used up.

docs.title: Blessed Etel Dust
docs.text:
You can add Blessed Etel Dust #1000337 in the window to raise the chance by 1% per step, up to 10 steps (+10%).

Upgrade Dust per step Dust for +10% No grade → D 1 10 D → C 3 30 C → B 5 50 B → A 7 70

Tip

Successes are announced to the whole server. From C → B upward, failures are announced too.

docs.title: Grading Ticket (Sratos only)
docs.text:
If you carry a Grading Ticket #30055, Sratos shows an extra option, "Enchant with Ticket".

  1. Wear the item. She lists every equipped weapon of weapon level 5 and armor of armor level 2.
  2. Pick one and choose "Use Ticket".
  3. The ticket is used and the item goes straight to grade A, whatever grade it had.

There is no failure chance, no refine requirement, and the refine is kept (unlike a normal upgrade).

Items that are already grade A are not listed.

docs.title: Gray Wolf Equipment (Emmet)
docs.text:
In the Database

Every item this enchanter works on, the enchants it adds and the NPC on the map: open its Database entry. Item pages link back here too.

Emmet in the Gray Wolf village trades Amethyst Fragment #1000405 for the Gray Wolf equipment and enchants it.

Where: /navi wolfvill 164/137

Emmet only offers her services once you are far enough into the Episode 18 main quest. Before that she just asks you to collect Amethyst Fragments.

Menu What it does Exchange Armor Trade window: Gray Wolf equipment for Amethyst Fragment #1000405 Gray Wolf Enchantment Pick Armor, Garment, Shoes, Right(R) Accessory or Left(L) Accessory, then the enchant window opens

docs.title: How it works
docs.text:
1. Choose Gray Wolf Enchantment and the part you want to enchant.
  2. The enchant window opens (only if you carry less than 70% of your weight limit). Put the item in from your inventory (unequip it first). Only the items listed for that part are accepted.
  3. Pay and the next empty slot is enchanted. Every enchant here always succeeds. Refine, cards and the enchant grade are never touched.

Every part has three enchant slots (slot 4, then slot 3, then slot 2). Slot 2 can also be bought as a selectable (perfect) enchant.

docs.title: Hero Ring Enchanter (Morocc)
docs.text:
In the Database

Every item this enchanter works on, the enchants it adds and the NPC on the map: open its Database entry. Item pages link back here too.

Expert Enchanter Byrnes enchants all four slots of the Hero Ring (Warrior's Ring #2981). The Hero Token Exchanger next to him trades Token Of Hero #6684 for the ring.

Where: Byrnes /navi moro_cav 34/65, Hero Token Exchanger /navi moro_cav 32/73

docs.title: Getting the ring
docs.text: Trade 30 Token Of Hero #6684 at the Hero Token Exchanger for one Warrior's Ring #2981.

docs.title: Enchanting
docs.text:
Wear the ring and tell Byrnes whether it is on the left or right. Each enchant is free and always succeeds. Each time you choose the type for the next slot, and the level is random (20% each).

The slots fill in this order: slot 4 → slot 3 → slot 2 → slot 1. Once slot 1 has an enchant the ring is finished.

The ring goes back to your inventory after each enchant. Put it on again before the next one.

docs.title: Reset
docs.text:
Cost: 3 Token Of Hero #6684. Always succeeds and gives back a clean ring with no enchants. The ring must be worn and have at least one enchant.

Tip

Enchanting is free, so the only cost of chasing a perfect ring is 3 Hero Tokens per reset.

docs.title: Honor Token Enhancers (Dylan and Hogar)
docs.text:
In the Database

Every item this enchanter works on, the enchants it adds and the NPC on the map: open its Database entry. Item pages link back here too.

Two black-market craftsmen add stat enchants to robes and accessories in exchange for honor tokens. Dylan works for Honor Token #6919 in the Prontera prison, and Hogar works for Schwarz's Honor Token #25155 in the rebel hideout.

NPC Items Currency Where Dylan Flattery Robe [1] #15146, Invective Robe [1] #15147, Prontera Badge #28356 Honor Token #6919 /navi prt_pri00 61/136 Hogar Agenda Robe [1] #15163, Consultation Robe [1] #15164, Mercenary Ring Type A #28425, Mercenary Ring Type B #28426 Schwarz's Honor Token #25155 /navi rebel_in 90/40

Both need at least 1,000 free weight and room for one more item. The first time you talk to each of them you hear his story, and then you can trade.

docs.title: How it works
docs.text:
• Wear the item. Robes go in the armor slot. The badge and the rings must be worn in the left accessory slot.
  • Each enhancement adds one random enchant: slot 4 first, then slot 3. After two enhancements the item is full.
  • The item is taken off and comes back in your inventory, so put it on again for the next try.
  • Robes keep their refine and card. Rings keep their card.
  • A reset only works on a full item (both slots enchanted).

docs.text:
In the Database

Every item this enchanter works on, the enchants it adds and the NPC on the map: open its Database entry. Item pages link back here too.

The Illusion Enchanter in Prontera adds up to two random enchants to Illusion equipment for Illusion Stone #25271. Illusion equipment itself is made by the exchange NPCs inside (or next to) each Illusion dungeon, listed at the bottom of this page.

Where: /navi prontera 90/115 (near the Town Office)

docs.title: Before you start
docs.text:
• The first time you talk to him he explains his service and asks if you want to join his member list. Answer "Sure!". After that you can use the enchant and reset menus.
  • You need 2,000 free weight and room in your inventory.
  • The item must be equipped. You pick the equipment slot from a menu (right-hand weapon, armor, shoes, garment, right or left accessory, upper headgear, left-hand weapon/shield).
  • Items with random options are refused.
  • There is no refine requirement.

Zeny Success chance 100,000 50% 200,000 60% 300,000 70% 400,000 80% 500,000 90%
  • On success both enchants are removed. Refine and cards stay.
  • On failure the zeny is gone and the item is destroyed, together with its cards and refine.

A failed reset destroys the item along with its cards and refine. The chance of failure is 10% to 50%, depending on the zeny you pay.

docs.text: These NPCs turn a normal item (refined to +9 or higher where shown) plus Illusion Stone #25271 and dungeon materials into its Illusion version. They are barter shops: the new item comes without refine, cards or enchants, so take your cards out first. Where no refine is shown, any refine is accepted.

docs.title: Enchanting
docs.text:
Wear the item and pick its slot (Weapon, Armor, Shoes, Garment, Helm). The weapon must be in your right hand. You need 1,000 free weight.

Cost: 20 Broken Magic Stone #6905 per enchant. It always succeeds. Refine and cards are kept.

Two enchants per item: the 1st goes into slot 4, the 2nd into slot 3. Each time you pick a type (Physical, Magical or Range) and get a random enchant from that list. Every entry in a list has the same chance.

docs.text:
In the Database

Every item this enchanter works on, the enchants it adds and the NPC on the map: open its Database entry. Item pages link back here too.

Lisa, inside Varmundt's mansion (Episode 17.2), installs Automatic Modification Modules into the Automatic equipment set. You choose the module yourself, so every enchant is guaranteed. The NPCs next to her sell the modules and turn Illusion equipment into Automatic equipment.

Where: /navi ba_in01 87/370

The item must be equipped in that slot and you need room in your inventory. There is no refine requirement.

docs.title: Enchanting
docs.text:
1. Pick the equipment menu, then the module grade (Normal, Rare, Unique, Legendary, Epic Grade 1, Epic Grade 2 or Epic Grade 3).
  2. Pick the module. Modules you do not have show as "(Module Amount 0)".

  3. Confirm. Lisa warns that it cannot be reversed.

  4. Cost: 1 module of the chosen type. No zeny.

  5. Success: always succeeds. Refine and cards are kept and the item is never destroyed.
  6. Slots: each item takes up to 3 modules, filling the 4th, 3rd and then 2nd slot. Once the 2nd slot is used the item is "at its maximum capacity".
  7. Each module type has its own limit per item (last column). A module that is not in the item's table is refused ("You can not enchant this module to this automatic equipment").
  8. There is no reset.

docs.title: Malangdo Costume Enchanters
docs.text:
In the Database

Every item this enchanter works on, the enchants it adds and the NPC on the map: open its Database entry. Item pages link back here too.

The Fashion Stone shop in Malangdo turns costume enchant stones into enchants on your costumes. Each stone gives one fixed enchant; there is no random roll except success or failure.

NPC What it does Where Aver De Dosh Headgear costume stones (Upper, Middle, Lower) /navi mal_in01 22/113 Lace La Zard Costume garment stones (1st slot) and Dual stones (2nd slot) /navi mal_in01 20/107 Gregio Grumani Visual effect stones (4th slot) /navi mal_in01 24/121 Designer Heidam Trades costumes for Costume Enchant Stone Boxes /navi mal_in01 20/124

All three enchanters work on the costume you are wearing. Refine and existing enchants in other slots are kept. If the costume is account-bound, it stays account-bound.

docs.title: Aver De Dosh (headgear costumes)
docs.text:
Where: /navi mal_in01 22/113

  • Cost: 1 stone per attempt.
  • Success chance: 50%. On failure the stone is used up and the costume comes back unchanged.
  • On success the new enchant replaces whatever was in that slot before.
Stone type Goes into The costume must cover Upper 1st slot the upper headgear position Middle 2nd slot the middle headgear position Lower 3rd slot the lower headgear position

Which costume he picks

Aver only works on one costume: your upper costume if you wear one, otherwise your middle one, otherwise your lower one. To put a Middle stone on a separate middle costume, take off your upper costume first (and the middle one for a Lower stone).

On failure only the stone is lost; the costume keeps its old enchant.

docs.title: Lace La Zard (costume garments)
docs.text:
Where: /navi mal_in01 20/107

Wear a costume garment and pick one of two services. Both cost 1 stone per attempt and have a 50% success chance.

Service Slot On success On failure Single Enchant 1st slot Enchant added (replaces the old 1st-slot enchant) Stone lost and any 1st-slot enchant is removed Dual Enchant Stone 2nd slot Enchant added (replaces the old 2nd-slot enchant) Stone lost and any 2nd-slot enchant is removed

For Dual stones Lace asks for confirmation if the 2nd slot is already enchanted.

docs.title: Mayomayo (Malangdo weapon enchants)
docs.text:
In the Database

Every item this enchanter works on, the enchants it adds and the NPC on the map: open its Database entry. Item pages link back here too.

Mayomayo adds random enchants to a long list of high-level weapons, paid with Malangdo coins. Enchanting never fails and never touches refine or cards.

Where: /navi malangdo 213/167

docs.title: How it works
docs.text:
• Equip the weapon in your right hand, then pick "Enchant High Ranked Weapon".
  • Choose which coin to pay with. The coin decides the enchant table, and the weapon's price tier decides how many coins you need.
  • The 1st enchant goes into the 4th slot, the 2nd into the 3rd slot. Weapons with 3 card slots only get one enchant.
  • When the slots are full, reset the enchants and start again.
  • Refine and cards are always kept.

docs.title: How these enchants work
docs.text:
Master of Relics and Artifact Crafter work the same way:

  • The item must be in your inventory; you choose it from a list.
  • One attempt costs 2 Mora Coin #6380. Coins and the item are taken before the roll.
  • On success you get the item back as a brand-new copy: refine is reset to +0, any card is gone, and every old enchant is replaced by the new roll. The NPC does not care whether the item was enchanted before.
  • On failure (about 30%) the item is destroyed.
  • Each attempt fills all slots at once (2 or 3 enchants). You cannot keep part of a roll.

Tip

If you carry several copies of the same item, the NPC takes an unrefined, unenchanted copy first. Still, put any copy you want to keep in storage before you start.

docs.title: Artifact Collector (Empowered weapons)
docs.text:
Where: /navi mora 124/82

The Artifact Collector exchanges an enchanted artifact weapon for its Empowered version. There is no fee and no failure chance.

Requirements:

  • The weapon must be equipped.
  • It must be refined to +7 or higher.
  • Its 3rd or 4th slot must hold one of the enchants listed below.
Weapon Needs one of these enchants Becomes Wand Of Affection [2] #1657 MATK+2% #4761, INT+5 #4714, DEX+4 #4723 Empowered Wand Of Affection [1] #1660 Mace Of Judgement [2] #16013 DEX+4 #4723, STR+5 #4704, ATK+3% #4767 Empowered Mace Of Judgement [1] #16018 Golden Rod Staff [2] #2007 MATK+2% #4761, INT+4 #4713 Empowered Golden Rod Staff [1] #2011 Aqua Staff [2] #2008 MATK+2% #4761, INT+4 #4713 Empowered Aqua Staff [1] #2012 Crimson Staff [2] #2009 MATK+2% #4761, INT+4 #4713 Empowered Crimson Staff [1] #2013 Forest Staff [2] #2010 MATK+2% #4761, INT+4 #4713 Empowered Forest Staff [1] #2014

You lose the refine, cards and enchants

You get a plain +0 Empowered weapon with no cards and no enchants. The Collector says so himself. The Empowered weapons can then be enchanted at the Artifact Researcher.

Which rolls qualify

For the staves and the Wand Of Affection [2] #1657, none of the normal enchants qualify, so you need one of the rare jackpot sets (every jackpot set qualifies). That is about 0.28% per attempt for a staff and 0.42% for the wand. The Mace Of Judgement [2] #16013 is much easier: ATK+3% #4767 is one of its normal 4th-slot options, so about 17.81% of attempts qualify.

docs.text:
Attempt Slot What can go wrong 1st enchant 4th slot Always succeeds. 2nd enchant 3rd slot It can fail: you lose the 1st enchant too and the item is left with no enchants. 3rd enchant 2nd slot It can fail (all three enchants removed) or destroy the item. Not available on accessories.

docs.text:

  • Cost: 10 Sentimental Fragment #22687.
  • Always succeeds. All enchants (2nd, 3rd and 4th slot) are removed. The card in the 1st slot and the refine stay.

docs.text:

docs.title: Hot Machine: guaranteed level up
docs.text:

In the Database

Three researchers in the Regenschirm Institute reform Thanos, OS and other weapons and armor, and enchant the Modified OS weapons.

To get in, talk to the Equipment Reform PR Agent in Lighthalzen (/navi lighthalzen 99/156) or in the item mall (/navi itemmall 14/50) and choose Let's go.

docs.title: How reforms work
docs.text:
Pick the reform in the menu, then put the item in the reform window from your inventory (unequip it first). A reform always succeeds and turns the item into a new one. Unless the tables say otherwise, enchants, the enchant grade and random options are kept.

  • Lower mods: cheaper, refine -5 (a +9 item becomes +4).
  • Intermediate mods: more expensive, refine -1 (a +9 item becomes +8).
  • Upper mods: refine +1 for weapons (see the tables for armor).

"No cards" means the item must have no cards in it, or the window refuses it.

docs.title: Rock Ridge Contraband Processor
docs.text:
In the Database

Every item this enchanter works on, the enchants it adds and the NPC on the map: open its Database entry. Item pages link back here too.

The Contraband Processor adds random stat enchants to the "contraband" gear sold in Rock Ridge.

Where: /navi har_in01 17/74 (inside Rock Ridge)

docs.title: Items it works on
docs.text:
You must be wearing the item. Pick the slot (Armor, Garment or right Accessory) in the menu.

Slot Items Max enchants Armor Vigilante Suit #15176, Elemental Robe #15177, Golden Ninja Suit #15178, Mine Worker's Vest #15179, Hippie Clothes #15180 3 Garment Elemental Cape #20820, Golden Scarf #20821, Mine Worker's Backpack #20822 3 Accessory (right slot only) Vigilante Badge #28441, Hippie Feather #28442 2
  • The armor pieces are bought from Howard in the same building for 24 Rock Ridge Coin #25250 each. The garments (3,000,000z) and accessories (1,500,000z) are sold by the Affable Lady next to him.
  • The item must not have a normal card in its 2nd, 3rd or 4th slot. A card in the first slot is fine and is kept.
  • You need at least 10,000 free weight and a free inventory slot.

docs.title: Enchanting
docs.text:
Cost: 2 Rock Ridge Coin #25250 per try (one enchant per try). Enchanting always succeeds and never breaks the item. Refine and the card in the first slot are kept.

Enchants are added one at a time (4th slot first, then 3rd, then 2nd for armor and garments). Once all enchant slots are filled you must reset before enchanting again.

docs.title: Reset
docs.text:
Choose "Reset contraband item Enchantment level." while wearing an enchanted item.

  • Cost: 2 Rock Ridge Coin #25250.
  • Removes all enchants. Refine and the first-slot card are kept.
  • Chance the item is destroyed: 30% for armor and garments, 45% for accessories. A destroyed item is gone for good and the coins are not returned.

Tip

The NPC says it charges "2 Rock Ridge Coins per socket". A reset costs 2 coins in total, no matter how many enchants the item has.

docs.text:
In the Database

Every item this enchanter works on, the enchants it adds and the NPC on the map: open its Database entry. Item pages link back here too.

RS26 is a hologram robot in the Episode 17.1 Rebellion base that installs Modification Modules into the Illusion armor set that Elyumina makes. You pick the module yourself, so every enchant is guaranteed.

Where: /navi sp_cor 106/136

The item must be equipped in that slot. You need 1,000 free weight and room in your inventory. There is no refine requirement.

docs.title: Enchanting
docs.text:
1. Pick the equipment menu, then the module grade (Normal, Rare, Unique or Legendary).
  2. Pick the module from the list. Modules you do not have are greyed out.

  3. RS26 shows how many of that module are already on the item and asks you to confirm.

  4. Cost: 1 module of the chosen type. No zeny.

  5. Success: always succeeds. Refine and cards are kept and the item is never destroyed.
  6. Slots: each item takes up to 3 modules. They fill the 2nd, 3rd and 4th slots in that order. Once the 4th slot is used the item is at its limit.
  7. Each module type has its own limit per item (last column below).
  8. A module that is not in the item's table is refused ("You need to have a module that matches the efficacy").

docs.title: Getting the armor: Elyumina
docs.text:
/navi sp_cor 111/130

Elyumina is hidden until you talk to the Rebellion soldier (after Pure Facts is done), who calls her over. Pick "Request Illusion Armor.", choose a part and a type. docs.title: Slot Enchanters (Seiyablem and Leablem)
docs.text:
In the Database

Every item this enchanter works on, the enchants it adds and the NPC on the map: open its Database entry. Item pages link back here too.

The brothers Seiyablem and Leablem add a card slot to selected weapons and armor. Each NPC has its own item list. You trade the unslotted item plus materials and zeny for the slotted version.

docs.title: How it works (both NPCs)
docs.text:
• Carry the unslotted item in your inventory (it does not need to be equipped).
  • Carry only one copy of it. If you have several, a random one is taken.
  • You pay the zeny and materials whether you succeed or fail.
  • On success you get a brand-new slotted item: +0, no cards. Refine and cards on the old item are lost.
  • On failure the item is destroyed, along with any refine and cards on it.
  • The chance is fixed per item. Refine level and which town you use do not change it.

Tip

Both NPCs hint that the success chance depends on the item's refine and on the town. It does not. Always slot a +0 item with no card, since refine and cards are lost either way.

docs.title: Time Gap Weapons (Kkat)
docs.text:
In the Database

Every item this enchanter works on, the enchants it adds and the NPC on the map: open its Database entry. Item pages link back here too.

Kkat in the second depth of the Varmundt Biosphere crafts Time Gap weapons and enchants them.

Where: /navi bl_depth2 210/264

docs.title: Crafting
docs.text: Craft a Time Gap weapon opens a trade window. Each Time Gap weapon takes a +10 Glacier weapon, a +10 Dim Glacier weapon, a +10 OSAD weapon, a +12 Episode 17.2 weapon and 2,000 elemental gems or crystals. The exact recipe for each weapon is shown in the window. The Dagger and Kurojin come as a box that holds both the (A) and (B) versions.

docs.title: How it works
docs.text:
1. Talk to the NPC and choose Enchantment.
  2. The enchant window opens (only if you carry less than 70% of your weight limit). Put the weapon in from your inventory (unequip it first).
  3. Pick an enchant. Refine, cards and the enchant grade are never touched.

Every enchant here is a selectable (perfect) enchant: you choose it and it always succeeds.

docs.text:
In the Database

Every item this enchanter works on, the enchants it adds and the NPC on the map: open its Database entry. Item pages link back here too.

Two enchant systems in Verus:

  • Mass Charleston robots trade, sell and enchant the Charleston Factory gear (Upgrade Parts and Supplement Parts) and upgrade the Pile Bunker.
  • PLUTO_09 and MARS_01 make and enchant the Excelion Wing and Excelion Suit.

docs.text:
Where: /navi verus04 71/106

Wear the item and choose its slot (Footgear, Garment, Clothes or Accessory). Accessories must be in the right accessory slot.

Cost per try: 100,000 zeny + 1 Charleston Parts #6752 (enchant or reset). Refine and cards are always kept. You need 10,000 free weight.

At +9 or higher the NPC asks which table to use each time you enchant.

Each enchant try has its own risk:

The NPC warns that a failed 2nd enchant resets the refine. It does not: on failure the item comes back exactly as it was (same refine, cards and earlier enchants). Only the materials are lost.

docs.title: Guide
docs.text: The 2nd OS Search is the repeatable follow-up to the OS Occupation operation from the Episode 17.1 story. The Rebellion sends your unit back into the OS facility to clear six sectors of A013 mutants and then put down the S-class mutant Miguel #20346.

docs.title: Entering
docs.text:
• Requirement: you must have finished the OS Occupation operation (talk to Est at /navi sp_cor 163/56 to start it). After that, the Operation Officer appears next to her at /navi sp_cor 160/55. He only shows up after you walk into that spot.
  • Party: you must be in a party. The party leader talks to the Operation Officer and picks Prepare 2nd OS Search, then every member talks to him and picks Enter.
  • Quest: the first time, the Operation Officer gives you More Search Operations. You need this quest active to get the reward at the end. He gives it again on your next visit after you have turned it in.
  • Cooldown: entering gives you Operation Waiting, a daily cooldown that resets at 04:00 server time. Once it has passed, talk to the Operation Officer to clear it.
  • Time limit: the instance lasts 2 hours.

Note

The 2nd OS Search uses the same facility map as OS Occupation, but you start at the other end, in the south-east (1@os_a 335/34).

docs.title: Walkthrough
docs.text:
1. The party leader walks onto the starting point. This starts the search, and the first two groups of mutants spawn at once.
  2. Each group is a mix of A013 - Caput #20348, A013 - Dolor #20349 and A013 - Bellare #20350, labelled CP1 to CP6 by sector. Later groups are larger.
  3. Every 10 seconds an announcement shows how many mutants are left. When the current group is dead the sector is reported secured and the next group spawns further into the facility.
  4. The poison gas cloud near 1@os_a 253/107 is removed when the fifth group (CP5) spawns.
  5. After the sixth group is cleared, CP7 Miguel appears at 1@os_a 205/188.
Group Around Mutants CP1 + CP2 (spawn together) 1@os_a 270/90 and 1@os_a 257/72 9 + 7 CP3 1@os_a 205/82 14 CP4 1@os_a 214/130 15 CP5 1@os_a 250/157 14 CP6 1@os_a 210/186 22 CP7 1@os_a 205/188 Miguel #20346

docs.title: Miguel
docs.text:
• Once Miguel drops to 70% HP, he surrounds himself with 4 Manhole #20351 (7 cells away to the north, south, east and west), and moves them with him every time he walks.
  • From 30% HP he uses 8 Manholes: 4 more are added on the diagonals.
  • The Manholes only move when Miguel moves, so holding him in one spot keeps them in place.

When he dies, the summons are removed and the Operation Officer appears at 1@os_a 187/195.

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
Talk to the Operation Officer inside the instance. Each player with More Search Operations active receives:

Reward Amount Base EXP 150,000 Job EXP 150,000 Mysterious Component #25669 5 Cor Core #25723 1

Talk to him again and pick Go Out to return to sp_cor.

Tip

If you forgot to pick up More Search Operations before entering, you get no reward for the run. Talk to the Operation Officer outside first.

docs.title: Guide
docs.text: Airship Crash is a farming instance. You follow Lydia's group through the crash site, help the wounded, then go down into the cave below to hunt endlessly respawning monsters for Ymir Ore #1000364. With enough ore you can summon the Unidentified Creature #20891. The main rewards are Ymir Fragment #1000363, which are traded at Rusbald.

docs.title: Requirements and entry
docs.text:
Level Base Level 215 or higher Party Required. Only the party leader can create the instance and trigger story events. NPC Dr.Dulaisakstrom at /navi dali02 137/86 Cooldown Once per day. Entering starts the cooldown, which resets at 04:00 server time.

The leader picks Create Airship Crash, then everyone (leader included) picks Enter Airship Crash.

Note

Teleport, Ice Wall and saving are disabled on both instance maps. In the cave, use the Ropes to move around (see below).

docs.title: Walkthrough
docs.text:
1. The crash site

  1. Head south from the entrance to Lydia, Seth, Alice and Roki (around 1@mjo1 233/293). The leader talks to Lydia to play the first scene. The group then moves on.
  2. The leader talks to Lydia again at around 1@mjo1 96/200, then a third time at around 1@mjo1 196/132.
  3. After the third scene, Captain Pei Lu asks for help with the injured. Ten Injured Travelers are scattered around the crash site. Treat one by clicking it and standing still for 3 seconds. The system counts the treated travelers for the whole party.
  4. Once 6 are treated, each player can report to Captain Pei Lu at around 1@mjo1 71/344 for 1 Ymir Fragment #1000363. This reward has its own daily cooldown.

Treat exactly 6

Captain Pei Lu only gives the reward while the party's count is exactly 6. If anyone treats a 7th traveler, nobody can claim it for the rest of the run. Stop at 6 and report.

2. The cave

  1. Take the warp at around 1@mjo1 274/252 down into the cave camp.
  2. The leader talks to the Doctor at the camp and chooses Join the exploration team. This spawns the cave's monsters, which respawn as soon as they die:
    • 50 Rotten Wood #20886 on the crash site map
    • 50 Rotten Wood #20886, 60 Melted Poring #20887, 45 Grave Worm #20888, 60 Brain Sucker #20889 and 60 Moskillro #20890 in the cave
  3. Farm the cave for Ymir Ore #1000364, which drops from all of these monsters.
  4. Ropes are placed all over the cave. Each one can send you back to the camp or to the "unknown creature area" in the north. The Student at the camp marks all 15 rope locations on your minimap.

3. Unidentified Creature (optional boss)

Bring 55 Ymir Ore #1000364 to the Mysterious Ghost at the camp (around 1@mjo2 373/371) and choose Place Ymir Ore. The ore is consumed and the Unidentified Creature #20891 spawns in the northern area (around 1@mjo2 197/354). You can summon it again each time someone has 55 ore.

docs.title: Cave hunting missions
docs.text:
The Researcher at the camp gives repeatable kill missions. Any monster killed in the cave counts:

Mission Kills Reward Unlocks Capture 100 monsters 100 Ymir Fragment #1000363 x2 the 200 mission (first time) Capture 200 monsters 200 Ymir Fragment #1000363 x5 the 350 mission (first time) Capture 350 monsters 350 Ymir Fragment #1000363 x10 —

Only one mission can be active at a time. Talk to the Researcher once it is complete to get the reward automatically.

The Warp Gate next to the arrival point on the crash site takes you back to Dr.Dulaisakstrom in Dali (/navi dali02 136/83).

docs.title: Rewards and exchange
docs.text:
• Ymir Fragment #1000363 from Captain Pei Lu (1 per day) and the Researcher missions (2, 5 or 10).
  • Ymir Ore #1000364 from cave monster drops.
  • Rusbald at /navi dali02 134/86 trades 10 Ymir Ore #1000364 for 1 Ymir Fragment #1000363, and Ymir Fragments for his equipment and random boxes (see the exchange table below).

docs.title: Guide
docs.text: Airship Destruction is an Episode 19 instance. Your party climbs aboard the Isgard airship on a forged ticket, fights through four areas of broken patrol robots and then shuts down the airship's core, Aquila #21531. You pick the difficulty yourself by choosing a seat class at the start.

docs.title: Entering
docs.text:
• Requirement: you must be far enough in the Episode 19 main story to have been sent to destroy the airship. The first time you click the Rope at /navi jor_nest 22/255, you decode Reiji's note, which unlocks the instance.
  • Party: you must be in a party. Any member clicks the Rope and picks Rope to Airship to create the instance, then everyone clicks it again and picks Enter using rope.
  • Cooldown: entering gives you Neutralization of Unfairness, a daily cooldown that resets at 04:00 server time. When it has passed, click the Rope once to clear it.
  • Late joining: you can't enter once the airship has been neutralized (Aquila defeated).
  • Time limit: the instance lasts 1 hour and closes after 5 minutes with nobody inside.

docs.title: Choosing the difficulty
docs.text:
When the party leader steps into the starting area, a Management robot walks up to the party. The leader talks to it:

  • Change seat class sets the difficulty. You can only change it before the run starts.
  • Send out any message starts the run with the current class.
Seat class Difficulty Patrol HP Aquila HP Aquila HP regen Aquila RES / MRES Economy (default) Easy 2,500,000 300,000,000 100,000 per second 0 / 0 Business Medium 4,000,000 500,000,000 1,000,000 per second 100 / 100 First Class Hard 5,000,000 600,000,000 1,000,000 per second 200 / 200

Aquila also takes less damage the higher the class (a damage-reduction buff of level 1, 5 and 8).

docs.title: Walkthrough
docs.text:
The airship has four patrol areas. Each starts when the party leader walks through the portal into it, and the portal onward stays closed ("movement is prohibited in case of battle") until every patrol in the area is dead. An announcement counts down the last 10 patrols.

Area Portal in Easy Medium Hard 2: corridor 1@whl 53/74 10 16 31 3: cargo hold and rest area 1@whl 53/97 40 47 59 4: engine room entrance 1@whl 37/162 9 17 30 5: engine room 1@whl 160/43 40 48 60

The patrols are Broken Gardener Beta #20631, Broken Cleaner #20633, Broken Beta Guards #20639 and Broken Cleaning Robot Ω #20641, plus a few District Inspectors (E-EA2S #20342) that take much less damage than the rest. Every patrol spawns with a random Holy or Shadow element, so check before you pick your element.

After area 5, the portal at 1@whl 160/117 leads to the core room. From then on the very first portal also takes you straight there. The party leader talks to the core at 1@whl 160/166 to start the boss fight.

docs.title: Aquila
docs.text:
Aquila's attacks unlock as you deal damage to it:

Damage dealt Mechanic What to do 5,000,000 Protection process: "Activate automatic protection process" is followed 2 seconds later by Max Pain. Repeats every 150 seconds. Ease off damage when you see the warning. 5,000,000 Berserkaizer (random): Aquila's attack range becomes 8 and it runs away from its target. Click the device at 1@whl 159/173 (2-second cast) to cancel it. 15,000,000 Cleaning robots: 20 Broken cleaning robots spawn around the room. After about 13 seconds they cast Light of Sun, then they self-destruct 2 seconds later. This repeats for the whole fight. They are immune to skills and status effects. Spread out or get clear of them before they blow up. 50,000,000 Yellow ether (random): Aquila uses Unlimit and Light of Sun, and a yellow spot appears at 1@whl 173/161 or 1@whl 146/161. Pull Aquila onto the spot. 2 seconds later the buffs end. 100,000,000 Green ether (random): Aquila gets a level 10 damage-reduction buff and Berserk, and a green spot appears in one of the four corners. Pull Aquila onto the spot. It is teleported somewhere in the room and loses its defence for 5 seconds. Burst it then.

Warning

On Medium and Hard, Aquila regenerates 1,000,000 HP every second. Make sure your party can out-damage this before choosing Business or First Class.

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
When Aquila dies:

  • Medium: a Suspicious Storage Stone #21853 spawns. Hard: a Suspicious Storage Stone #21854 spawns. Break it for extra loot.
  • 10% chance of a relic dropping where Aquila died: Antiquity Issgard (Aquila) #102564 on Easy and Medium, or Antiquity Issgard (Aquila (First Class)) #102565 on Hard.

Then every player clicks the portal in the middle of the room (1@whl 160/160) to collect their personal reward, once per run:

Reward Easy Medium / Hard Snow Flower #1000608 4 9 Snow Flower Ore #1000811 1 2 Isgard reputation +10 +15 Base EXP 10 × 1,605,000 10 × 1,605,000 Job EXP 3,000,000 3,000,000 Bonus at 3,000 Isgard reputation +2 Snow Flower #1000608 +2 Snow Flower #1000608

Click the portal again and choose Exit to return to jor_nest. Leaving gives 40–60 Instance Points (+50 with Charm Of Brightness #30034), within the server's daily Instance Point limit.

Note

Hard (First Class) currently gives the same personal reward as Medium. Its extra value is the Suspicious Storage Stone #21854 and the First Class relic.

docs.title: Guide
docs.text: A short solo instance. Loki and Fenrir's airship is attacked by Wyverns mid-flight. You clear three decks of monsters, then deal with the Wyvern and the captain, who loses control of himself. It is quick, and every floor works the same way: kill everything, then move on.

docs.title: Entering
docs.text:
• Level: 125 or higher.
  • Party: you must be in a party, but only the party leader can enter. Make a one-person party.
  • Entrance: the Dimensional Device at /navi dali02 142/81. Pick Power Up the Device to create the instance, then click the device again and pick Use the Device.
  • Cooldown: the first entry starts the cooldown. For 5 minutes after that you can still go back in (for example after dying). After that you are locked out until the next 04:00 server time. The device says "23 hours", but the real reset is 04:00.

docs.title: Walkthrough
docs.text:
You start on the top deck (1@air1) next to Loki, Fenrir, Iris, Chaos and Captain Ferlock.

  1. Talk to Captain Ferlock. A Wyvern unit attacks and the first floor fills with monsters. A warp opens near the start of the deck that leads below.
  2. Passenger deck: kill all 30 monsters, 15× Beholder #3177 and 15× Rotar Zairo #3175. Every monster on a floor has to die before you can go on.
  3. Lower deck: two warps now lead further down. Kill all 30 monsters there: 15× Gremlin #3176 and 15× Acidus #3179.
  4. Talk to Iris at the engine room entrance (with Chaos). After her scene, the warps up to the second airship map (1@air2) open.
  5. Upper floor: kill all 30 monsters, 15× Beholder #3177 and 15× Acidus #3178. The warp to the deck opens.
  6. Deck: talk to Fenrir. After the scene a Wywern #3180 attacks. Kill it.
  7. Talk to Iris again. Captain Ferlock goes berserk and turns into Captain Ferlock #3181 (3,000,000 HP). Kill him.
  8. About 6 seconds later Chaos and the captain reappear. Talk to Chaos to finish the story.

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
When you finish Chaos's dialogue you get:

  • 100,000 Base EXP and 65,000 Job EXP
  • 20–40 Instance Points (+50 with Charm Of Brightness #30034, within the daily Instance Point limit)

The exit warp on the deck then opens and takes you back to /navi dali02 137/82.

Tip

The EXP and points come from the dialogue with Chaos, not from the exit warp. Do not leave before you talk to him.

docs.text: Bagot Laboratory is a one-time story instance from the Episode 19 main quest (the Intermittent difference step). Bagot uses Juncea as a vessel, and you have to defeat her in his laboratory to move the story on. There is no cooldown and no item reward: the reward is story progress.

docs.title: Entering
docs.text:
• Requirement: you must be on the Intermittent difference step of the Episode 19 main story. At that point Juncea appears at /navi jor_dun03 57/63. Talk to her once to update the quest.
  • Party: you must be in a party, and only the party leader can talk to Juncea. The leader picks Prepare to enter Bagot Laboratory and then Enter Bagot Laboratory.
  • Time limit: the instance lasts 1 hour and closes after 5 minutes with nobody inside.

Warning

Juncea refuses to talk to anyone who is not the party leader, so only the leader can enter through her. Each character has to do this step as party leader (a party of one works).

docs.title: Walkthrough
docs.text:
1. As soon as the party leader arrives, Juncea appears in the middle of the lab at 1@jorlab 58/67.
  2. Talk to her twice. On the second talk she flickers between forms, then turns into Simulation Juncea #21532.
  3. Defeat Simulation Juncea.
  4. Talk to the fallen Juncea. Bagot comments on the result, your main quest moves to the next step, and you are sent to icecastle.

Tip

After you finish the Episode 19 main story, the same lab can be fought again as the daily Simulation Battle from Arolong at /navi jor_nest 66/260.

docs.title: Guide
docs.text: Bakonawa Lake is a three-phase boss fight against the sea serpent Bakonawa, who is trying to swallow the moon. Each phase has its own timer. If a timer runs out, Bakonawa escapes and the party has to start again from the first phase.

docs.title: How to enter
docs.text:
• NPC: Taho, in the Malaya cave scene at /navi ma_scene01 174/179.
  • Level: Base Level 140 or higher.
  • Party: You need a party. The party leader picks "Please weave a rope." to create the instance. Then every member picks "Now I will go down." to enter.
  • Inventory: You need at least 1,000 free weight and some free inventory slots, or Taho refuses to talk to you. The same check applies when you claim the reward at the end.
  • Cooldown: Entering starts a daily cooldown that resets at 04:00 server time. Until it ends, Taho tells you the rope is broken. Once it has passed, talk to Taho once to clear it, then talk to Taho again to enter.
  • Time limit: The instance closes after 2 hours.

Note

Taho also gives you the hunting quest "Get Rid of Bakonawa", which asks you to kill the final form of Bakonawa. You need to finish this quest to get the Ancient Grudge reward at the end. You get the quest again each time you talk to Taho with no cooldown running.

docs.title: Phase 1: Bakonawa surfaces
docs.text:
Inside, talk to Taho near the entrance. When the party leader picks "Let's do it!", Taho pours Albopal into the lake and Bakonawa #2320 rises from the water.

  • You have 10 minutes to kill it. A time warning is announced every minute.
  • Bakonawa heals itself when its HP is below 30%. It also uses Meteor Storm, Sonic Blow, Dark Breath and bleeding attacks.

docs.title: Phase 2: Caldrons and gongs
docs.text:
After the first kill, Bakonawa dives and tries to swallow the moon. An Bakonawa #2321 appears in the middle of the lake. Taho tells you not to fight it. Instead, make noise:

  • Destroy the 2 Caldrons and 2 Gongs (Drum #2328, 200 HP each) on the left and right banks of the lake. Taho announces how many are left.
  • You have 5 minutes. When all four are destroyed, Bakonawa retreats and the next phase starts about 10 seconds later.

docs.title: Phase 3: Enraged Bakonawa
docs.text:
The final form, Bakonawa #2322, comes out of the lake. You have 10 minutes to kill it.

  • Starting 2 minutes into the phase, a wave of Wakwak #2334 ("Bakonawa's Puppet") spawns on the south shore every minute. Each new wave replaces the puppets still alive and is larger than the last: 10, 15, 20, 30, 35, 40, 45 and finally 50. A counter on screen shows how many are left.
  • Bakonawa's final form heals itself below 30% HP. It casts Storm Gust, Lord of Vermilion, Meteor Storm and Water Ball, uses Dragon Fear, and can break your armor and weapon. Expect Reflect Shield too.

When it dies, a Bakonawa's Treasure #2335 appears in the lake. Open it, then go back to Taho at the top of the hill.

docs.title: Bakonawa's Will (all phases)
docs.text: Throughout the fight, about 5 seconds after most time-limit announcements, invisible "Bakonawa's Will" monsters can appear at up to 9 spots around the lake. Some cast Meteor Storm (Monster #2337) and others cast Storm Gust (Hidden Mob #2343). They disappear 50 seconds later. Don't stand in one place around the lake edge for too long.

docs.title: Failing a phase
docs.text: If any timer reaches zero, Bakonawa escapes. Taho reappears near the entrance, and the party leader can pick "Of course! We cannot stand back now!" to start again from Phase 1. You can retry as long as the instance is still open.

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
Reward Who Notes Ancient Grudge #6499 ×5 (×7 with VIP) Each player who finished the hunting quest Talk to Taho after the fight 100,000 Job EXP Same as above 20–40 Instance Points Each player who talks to Taho at the end Random amount. Counts toward the daily 1,200 point cap Treasure box drops Party From Bakonawa's Treasure #2335, see the boss table below

Talking to Taho at the end warps you back out to ma_scene01.

Tip

Make sure everyone is buffed and in position before the leader starts Phase 1. A failure in any phase sends you back to the start, and the final phase gets harder the longer it lasts because the puppet waves keep growing.

Defeat Bakonawa before he eats the moon. Part of the "Bakonawa Extermination" quest.

docs.title: Guide
docs.text: The second floor of Port Malaya's hospital has been taken over by the nightmare spirit Bangungot. Clear his minions ward by ward, fight him in the boss room while he drags the party into the patient wards below, and finish the Pillar of Spirit before it revives him.

docs.title: How to enter
docs.text:
NPC Nurse Maenne in the hospital: /navi ma_dun01 147/10 Level 100+ Party Required. The party leader prepares the second floor, then everyone selects "Enter the second floor." Entry limit Once per day per character; the lockout ends at the next 04:00 server time Time limit 1 hour

First visit vs. later visits

Your first run only counts as "Explore Hospital 2F". From your next day on, every entry also gives the hunting quest "Get Rid of Bangungot from Hospital 2F", which is what pays the reward below.

docs.title: Walkthrough
docs.text:
1. The corridor. Walk forward from the start; a Mangkukulam #2339 appears. Killing it starts a chain through the wards along the corridor: each ward spawns more Mangkukulam (2, 2, 3, 3, then 4), and clearing one starts the next.
  2. The sixth ward. After the fifth ward, a Manananggal #2338 appears in the last ward (around 96/140). Killing it summons Bangungot (Bangungot #2317) in the boss room to the east, and the boss-room doors (around 105/157) open.
  3. Boss room. Fight Bangungot. Entering the boss room starts his pattern:
    • About 55 seconds in, he sends his minions to torment the patients downstairs, and at about 60 seconds the floor of the boss room and the upper wards warps everyone to the lower floor.
    • Downstairs, touching the spot near 118/63 starts the ward event: about 10 seconds later 6 Tiyanak #2340 and Mangkukulam appear in one random patient ward (a patient screams to show which one).
    • Kill all of them to stop the pattern and reopen the way back up. If you are slow, extra Manananggal #2338 spawn in the boss room (at roughly 90, 110 and 130 seconds), and after about 130 seconds the lower floor sends you back up anyway.
    • The pattern starts again each time you walk back into the boss room.
  4. Pillar of Spirit. When Bangungot dies, a Pillar of Spirit (Bangungot #2327) appears in the centre of the boss room (131/157) and heals him. You have about 30 seconds to destroy it; if you fail, Bangungot comes back to life a few seconds later and you have to kill him again.
  5. Exit. Destroying the pillar ends the run. Talk to the Exit NPC that appears at 133/161 to leave.

Tip

Bring area damage for the Tiyanak wave downstairs, and keep burst damage ready for the pillar: it only stays vulnerable for about 30 seconds.

docs.title: Rewards

docs.title: Guide
docs.text: A one-room boss hunt in Malaya: go into the cave and kill Buwaya #2319. The fight runs on timers. Buwaya keeps grabbing people into his treasure box and sending clones after you, so the run is about dealing with those interruptions while you bring the boss down.

docs.title: Entering
docs.text:
• Level: 130 or higher.
  • Party: you must be in a party. The party leader talks to the Guard at /navi ma_fild02 312/317 and picks I'm here to hunt down Buwaya. to open the tunnel.
  • Entrance: walk onto the Cave Entrance at /navi ma_fild02 315/323.
  • Cooldown: entering gives you the Devil in the Cave quest. The cooldown ends at the next 04:00 server time.
  • You cannot change party members or the leader while you are inside the cave.

docs.title: The fight
docs.text:
You start in the west part of the cave. Buwaya #2319 (4,090,365 HP) waits in the middle of the big chamber (around 1@ma_c 97/74). The chamber is full of Seaweed #2331, Buwaya's Egg #2329 and some Slave #2330. Only Buwaya has to die.

Treasure box (every 35 seconds)

  • Buwaya shouts "I will put you in my treasure box!" and light pillars appear around the chamber.
  • About 4 seconds later, everyone within 50 cells of the middle of the chamber is pulled into the treasure box. That is most of the room.
  • Inside the box, every 2 seconds you lose 10% HP and SP and get Bleeding and Poison for 60 seconds. Get out fast.
  • Two captives are inside:
    • Kidnapped People #1 ("Get me outta here!!") spawns two Weakpoint #2333. Kill both (20 HP each) to open the way out. It drops you at a random spot near the middle of the chamber.
    • Kidnapped People #2 ("Tell me.") gives you +45 ATK and +45 MATK for 60 seconds. Grab it before you leave.
  • The box resets every cycle, so you can be caught again.

Clones (about every 105 seconds)

  • About a minute in, Buwaya counts down "This is... MY... Deadly... ATTACK!" and four Buwaya #2332 clones (30,000 HP each) spawn, one in each corner of the chamber.
  • The clones disappear on their own 40 seconds later. If you kill all four sooner, the next set comes about 65 seconds after the last one dies.

Monsters on the way out

Every 60 seconds, 10× Seaweed #2331 and 10× Buwaya's Egg #2329 spawn near the cave entrance (only 1 of each once 30 or more are already there). They pile up if you take a long time, so expect a crowd on the way out.

docs.title: Finishing
docs.text:
When Buwaya dies, the box, the clones and the entrance spawns all stop, and the guard tells you to leave the way you came in. The exit opens near the cave entrance (1@ma_c 28/57). Taking it gives 20–40 Instance Points (+50 with Charm Of Brightness #30034, within the daily Instance Point limit) and returns you to ma_fild02.

docs.text: Canyon Exploration is a short story instance from the Episode 20 main quest. You follow Lehar into the canyon, overhear Bagot and Lasgand plotting, and slip past the guards with the help of a cat. There are no monsters to fight and no item reward: finishing it moves your main quest on to Return to the Ice Castle.

docs.title: Entering
docs.text:
• Requirement: you must be on the Canyon Exploration step of the Episode 20 main story. Walk up to /navi icecastle 202/168 and Lehar appears next to you at icecastle 201/171.
  • Party: you must be in a party, and only the party leader can talk to Lehar. The leader picks Prepare Canyon Exploration and then Enter Canyon Exploration.
  • Time limit: the instance lasts 1 hour and closes after 5 minutes with nobody inside.

Warning

Lehar only lets the party leader in, so each character has to run this step as party leader (a party of one works).

docs.title: Walkthrough
docs.text:
The minimap guide arrow points you to each next stop.

  1. Talk to Lehar at the entrance. She sends you east.
  2. Two Strange Iwin appear as you get close. Talk to the one at 1@20cn1 171/105 to be moved to the second canyon.
  3. Talk to Lehar at 1@20cn2 271/134. You overhear Bagot and Lasgand's conversation. Talk to her again and a cat shows up.
  4. Once the cat has walked over, talk to it. It takes you to the north-west of the canyon.
  5. Talk to Lehar at 1@20cn2 62/258, then to her again at 1@20cn2 64/224 after you have watched the Rgan and the fake Iwin.
  6. You are moved to 1@20cn2 101/95. Talk to the cat at 1@20cn2 107/65. An alarm goes off and the cat runs ahead. Talk to it again at 1@20cn2 96/65 as the Rgan guards arrive.
  7. Head to the south-west corner and talk to Lehar at 1@20cn2 32/22.
  8. Step into the portal at 1@20cn2 33/15. Bagot finds what he was looking for, your quest updates and you are sent back to icecastle.

docs.title: Guide
docs.text: You go back in time to the last day of the Central Laboratory's particle accelerator experiment. You get through the lab doors with the day's access code, then watch the experiment go wrong. Over three rounds the Mother Computer pulls a random boss out of another dimension, and you kill each one to move on. The bosses are random picks from a list of classic MVPs and mini-bosses, so no two runs are the same.

docs.title: Entering
docs.text:
• Level: 135 or higher.
  • Quest: the first time, talk to the Civilization Explorer at /navi verus01 149/155 and agree to help.
  • Party: you must be in a party. The party leader talks to the Civilization Explorer and picks Produce a crack of time. Everyone then enters through the Temporary Dimension-mover at /navi verus01 153/155.
  • Cooldown: entering gives you Trace of Laboratory Access. It ends at the next 04:00 server time. When it has ended, talk to the Civilization Explorer or the device once to clear it.

Warning

The Civilization Explorer warns that taming monsters in here will break the run's progress.

docs.title: Walkthrough
docs.text:
1. Get through the door

  1. The leader talks to the Probationary researcher at the entrance (1@lab 104/34) and agrees to take part. The corridor warps heading west open.
  2. Talk to the Senior researcher (1@lab 45/32). They tell you today's access code.
  3. Enter the code in binary on the 8 switches behind them (Switch 1 to Switch 8, left to right). Then press the Main Switch (1@lab 34/37). The doors north and into the lab open.

Working out the code

The code is (month + day of the month) × 5, using the server date. Write it as an 8-digit binary number. Switch 1 is the leftmost digit, and each 1 means ON. For example, on 5 October the code is (10 + 5) × 5 = 75 = 01001011. That means switches 2, 5, 7 and 8 are ON and the rest are OFF.

2. The experiment

Walk up to the four doctors around the particle accelerator in the middle of the lab (around 1@lab 80/89). Dr. Lona Fresa starts the experiment over the announcements. After a short countdown, an "Unidentified creature" appears in the middle of the accelerator (1@lab 90/88). Kill it and the next round begins on its own.

Round Possible bosses 1 Orc Hero #1087, Maya #1147, Orc Lord #1190, Eddga #1115, Golden Thief Bug #1086, Osiris #1038, Phreeoni #1159, Dracula #1389, Doppelganger #1046, Mistress #1059, Moonlight Flower #1150, Lady Tanee #1688, Baphomet #1039 (6.7% each) 2 Kublin #1980, Pharaoh #1157, Drake #1112, Stormy Knight #1251, Boitata #2068, Lord of the Dead #1373, Leak #2156, Dark Lord #1272, White Lady #1630, Hatii #1252, Ktullanux #1779, Thanatos Phantom #1708 (7.1% each) 3 RSX-0806 #1623, Evil Snake Lord #1418, Turtle General #1312, Atroce #1785, Kiel D-01 #1734, Detardeurus #1719, Gloom Under Night #1768, Scaraba Queen #2087, Valkyrie Randgris #1751, General Daehyun #2253, Dark Guardian Kades #2255, Ifrit #1832, Beelzebub #1874 (6.7% each)

In every round there is also a small chance that a mini-boss comes through instead: Toad #1089, Vagabond Wolf #1092, Vocal #1088, Angeling #1096, Eclipse #1093, Ghostring #1120 or Mastering #1090 (about 2% each, so 13–14% in total).

3. The way out

When the third creature dies, the Mother Computer moves the whole lab into the other dimension and the scientists vanish. A gateway opens at the 3 o'clock side of the lab. Talk to the researcher at the Exit (1@lab 123/88) to leave.
