  • Leaving through the Exit gives 20–40 Instance Points (+50 with Charm Of Brightness #30034, within the daily Instance Point limit) and takes you back to verus01.

docs.title: Guide
docs.text: The robot Charleston 2 has been hacked and taken over the Charleston Factory, and you are brought in to help get it running again. The factory is one big map. You get from task to task by following the announcements and the minimap marks, and the run ends with a fight against the combat unit Charleston 3 #3124.

docs.title: Entering
docs.text:
• Level: 130 or higher.
  • Quest: talk to Charleston at /navi verus04 75/114 and accept. You need her quest active every time you enter. After a clear, talk to her again to take it again ("I'll try again if there's a sliver of hope.").
  • Party: you must be in a party. The party leader uses the Machine at /navi verus04 81/112 and picks Open the dimensional portal. Then everyone picks Enter the Charleston Factory.
  • Cooldown: entering gives you Charleston Factory - Hold. It ends at the next 04:00 server time. The machine says "20 hours", but the real reset is 04:00. When it has ended, click the machine once to clear it.
  • Late joining: you can't enter once the boss is defeated.

Bring an Explosive Powder

Partway through you have to hand over 1× Explosive Powder #6213. Step #3125 in the factory drop it, but it is faster to bring one with you.

Most story steps only move forward when the party leader talks to the NPC.

docs.title: Walkthrough
docs.text:
1. Disarm the four gates

Walk up to Charleston 1 at the entrance. She sends you to Dr. Ve's lab north of Factory Line 3, and a Security Robot appears. Each gate has one guard robot, and when you kill it the gate opens and the next guard spawns somewhere else. The announcements tell you which way to go (southwest, southeast, east, then the centre). After the 4th robot dies, the way to the lab opens.

2. Dr. Ve's lab

The leader walks up to Dr. Ve and agrees to help ("I can help."). Then the leader talks to Charleston 1.

3. Locksteps

Seven Lockstep #3126 spawn around the factory, marked on your minimap. You only need to kill 3 of them. Charleston 1 then calls you back to the lab.

4. Generators

Talk to Charleston 1 again. Three Backup Generators are marked on the minimap. Walk onto all three, in any order. Five Security Robots also spawn around the factory, but you do not have to kill them. When the third generator is on, the power comes back and you are called back to the lab.

Tip

If you lose the minimap marks, Shalosh (1@mcd 77/167) shows them again when you pick I need help.

5. Charleston 2 runs

The leader talks to Charleston 1. Charleston 2 wakes up and runs east. Follow her and talk to her. For about a minute she sends waves of Security Robot #3128 plus one Lockstep #3126 at you, and then 3 Security Robots. Kill those last 3 robots to end the fight, then talk to Charleston 2 again. She heads for the Core to steal Charleston 3.

6. The Core

Go to the Core door in the middle of the factory (1@mcd 132/129). Walking up to Charleston 2 starts a scene of about a minute. Then the leader gives Charleston 1 one Explosive Powder #6213. She blows the door open and the entrance to the Core appears.

7. Boss: Charleston 3

Inside the Core, talk to Charleston 1 to start the last scene (about 1.5 minutes). Charleston 2 climbs into Charleston 3 #3124 (23,671,401 HP) and attacks.

  • Every 10 seconds one Security Robot #3128 spawns next to the boss.
  • Every 30 seconds a ring of 11 Bomb #3161 spawns around the arena. The bombs from the previous ring are removed first.

8. Ending

After the boss dies:

  1. Talk to Charleston 2 in the Core, and once her scene ends, talk to her again. The way out of the Core opens.
  2. Go back to the lab and talk to Charleston 2 there. Wait for the scene with Dr. Ve to finish.
  3. Talk to Dr. Ve twice.
  4. Talk to Shalosh (1@mcd 77/167) and pick I want to go back, then Go back.

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
From Reward Shalosh (leaving the instance) 3× Charleston Parts #6752, 20–40 Instance Points (+50 with Charm Of Brightness #30034, within the daily Instance Point limit) Charleston at verus04 75/114, after each clear 1,500,000 Base EXP and 500,000 Job EXP Main Computer side task (see below) 1,000,000 Base EXP, 300,000 Job EXP and 1× Charleston Parts #6752

Each player has to talk to Shalosh and to Charleston to get their own reward.

docs.title: Side task: Main Computer
docs.text:
Once you have spoken to Dr. Ve, the Main Computer in the lab (1@mcd 109/219) gives a task: kill 50 Step #3125. About 100 Steps and 20 Security Robots roam the factory, and each one respawns 2–3 minutes after it dies. Talk to the computer again to turn the task in. You can do it again after the next 04:00 server time.

docs.title: Guide
docs.text: Confused Snake's Nest is a story instance from the Episode 19 main quest (Chaotic Snake Nest). The upper-class Rgan have suddenly turned violent, and you follow Aurelie, Leon, Voglinde and Miriam through the nest to find out why. Along the way you shut down the injection devices that are mutating the Rgan. There is no item reward: finishing it moves your main quest on to Those Who Vanished.

docs.title: Entering
docs.text:
• Requirement: you must be on the Chaotic Snake Nest step of the Episode 19 main story. Talk to Lehar at /navi jor_que 32/37 to see the blocked entrance scene.
  • Party: you must be in a party. One member talks to Lehar again and picks Yes, signal. to create the instance, then everyone picks I'll go in.
  • Time limit: the instance lasts 1 hour and closes after 5 minutes with nobody inside.

Party members who are on the same story step all get the quest update at the end.

docs.title: Walkthrough
docs.text:
The nest is one big map. Important targets are marked on your minimap as you go.

Area 1: the entrance

  1. Walk up to Aurelie's group at 1@jorchs 261/34. Monsters spawn through the area.
  2. Kill all the Split Rgan #21535 in the area.
  3. Find the two Rgan the Scared at 1@jorchs 249/79 and 1@jorchs 114/20. Each turns into a Frightened Rgan #21534 when you get close. Kill both.
  4. When both tasks are done, the group gathers at 1@jorchs 142/58. Walk up to Horr to continue.

Area 2: the west tunnels

  1. Kill all the Split Rgan in the area.
  2. Find the two tied-up Rgan at 1@jorchs 23/57 and 1@jorchs 21/97 and kill the Frightened Rgan they turn into.
  3. Walk up to Horr at 1@jorchs 112/119. You are ambushed by two Modified Heart Hunter #21536 and two Rgan, and then a second group of five. Kill both groups.
  4. Walk up to Horr again to move on.

Area 3: the first injection device

  1. Clear the Rgan along the path to the east (7 monsters).
  2. Walk up to Voglinde at 1@jorchs 251/171. The injection unit starts.
  3. Step forward to 1@jorchs 243/166. The wall of Rgan in front of you comes to life: kill all 8.
  4. Click the Injection device at 1@jorchs 219/148. Until you do, more mutated Rgan keep spawning nearby every 30 seconds.
  5. Kill the Modified Heart Hunters that come out.

Area 4: two more devices

  1. Monsters spawn around the northern area. Click both Injection devices, at 1@jorchs 191/203 and 1@jorchs 226/244, and kill every monster in the area.
  2. Talk to Aurelie at 1@jorchs 151/179. Click the next Injection device at 1@jorchs 192/206 and kill the monsters it releases.
  3. Talk to Aurelie again. The wall of monsters at 1@jorchs 138/179 attacks: kill all 9.

Area 5: the research devices

  1. Click the Research devices at 1@jorchs 24/142 and 1@jorchs 20/195, and clear the monsters in the area.
  2. Walk up to the Modified Heart Hunter at 1@jorchs 39/251. Three waves attack: 6, then 8, then 12 monsters. One monster in the last wave takes only a tenth of normal damage.
  3. Click the Center door at 1@jorchs 37/274.
  4. Step into the portal at 1@jorchs 36/257. Your quest updates and you are sent to jor_back3.

Tip

Mutated Rgan keep spawning near each injection or research device until it is switched off, so turn off the devices first and then clean up.

docs.title: Guide
docs.text: Constellation Tower is the ruined Endless Tower, now taken over by the constellation Betelguese #20994. Your party climbs up to 75 floors of monster rooms and then chooses how to finish the run: an easy exit through a dimensional gap on floor 25, or the Betelgeuse fight on floor 50 (up to 3 stars) or floor 75 (up to 5 stars). On the Betelgeuse fight you can make the boss stronger at the Altar of Goddess, and the stronger you make him, the more Meteorite materials and treasure boxes you get.

docs.title: Entering
docs.text:
• Getting there: Captain Janssen at /navi alberta 214/77 sails you to the island (e_tower) for 10,000 Zeny. He only takes characters of Base Level 240 or higher. A Huge Vortex at /navi e_tower 30/30 takes you back to Alberta.
  • First visit: walk up to Oscar at /navi e_tower 72/116 and listen in on his talk with Leticia. This starts the Destroyed Tower quest and is needed before he will open the tower.
  • Party: you must be in a party. The party leader talks to Oscar and picks Create Constellation Tower, then every member talks to him again and picks Enter.
  • Cooldown: entering gives you Aftereffects of Tower Entry/Exit, a daily cooldown that resets at 04:00 server time. Once it has passed, talk to Oscar to clear it and you can enter again.
  • Time limit: the instance lasts 1 hour and closes after 5 minutes with nobody inside.
  • Late joining: you can't enter once Betelgeuse is defeated.

docs.title: Climbing the tower
docs.text:
1. The party leader talks to Oscar at the start of the tower (1@ch_t 46/188) to begin the climb. Only party members standing inside the tower at that moment are registered for the run.
  2. The tower is a loop of five rooms. Each new floor fills the current room with 30 to 35 monsters, picked at random from the Constellation Tower monster pool, so every run looks different.
  3. When every monster on the floor is dead, the party leader clicks the portal at the top of the room. Everyone is moved to the next room and the next floor spawns.
  4. Every 5th floor also spawns a random tower MVP in the top-right corner of the fifth room. You do not have to kill it to move on: only the normal monsters count.

Skipping floors

Next to Oscar in the first room is a brazier. The party leader can offer Meteorite Powder #1000372 to it to jump 4 floors ahead and land in the fifth room. The first jump costs 50 dust, and each further jump in the same run costs 25 more (75, 100, ...). You cannot jump past floor 75.

docs.title: Choosing your ending
docs.text:
The portal behaves differently on three floors. On these floors the leader gets the choice straight away, without clearing the room first.

Floor Choice What happens 25 Head into the gap The run ends with the easy Naght Sieger #20996 fight. You cannot come back to the tower. 50 Challenge Betelgeuse Betelgeuse fight with abilities from 0 to 3 stars (max 600%). 75 (automatic) Betelgeuse fight with abilities from 3 to 5 stars (max 1000%).

You can also keep climbing at floors 25 and 50.

docs.title: Floor 25: Naght Sieger
docs.text:
1. Taking the gap brings you to the Altar of Goddess. Here it only works as a healing fountain. Talk to Oscar and he sends you on to Leticia.
  2. The party leader tells Leticia Let's do this! and Naght Sieger #20996 walks in to fight.
  3. Once Naght Sieger drops to 90% HP, he summons 4 Entweihen Crothen #20997 around himself. They vanish after 15 seconds and are summoned again for as long as he is alive.
  4. After he dies, talk to Leticia. Each player gets 1–2 Meteorite Fragment #1000373 and 1 Naght Sieger Soul #1000396.
  5. Talk to her again to leave. Leaving gives 20–40 Instance Points.

docs.title: Floors 50 and 75: the Altar of Goddess
docs.text:
After the portal you arrive at the Altar of Goddess.

  1. The party leader walks up the path to wake the altar, then talks to Oscar twice: once for the story and once to open the way to the top floor.
  2. Before going up, the party leader can use the altar to change Betelgeuse's five sealed abilities. Each ability has a star level, and each star adds to the boss's total power %, which decides your rewards:
Ability What it does % per star HP +300,000,000 max HP per star 15% ATK +5,000 min / +7,000 max ATK and +100 STR/INT per star 20% Recovery Faster HP regeneration and bigger heals when players die 30% Resistance +100 RES and MRES per star 50% Trap Which traps appear and how hard they hit 85% (totals: 85 / 170 / 255 / 340 / 425; a 3-star Trap counts as only 235 on floor 75, although the altar shows 255)

The maximum total is 600% on floor 50 (every ability at 3 stars) and 1000% on floor 75 (every ability at 5 stars).

Altar options (paid in Meteorite Powder #1000372, party leader only):

Option Floor 50 (3-star) Floor 75 (5-star) Reroll all abilities 1 dust, each ability becomes 0–3 stars 20 dust, each ability becomes 3–5 stars Maximize 150 dust, all abilities to 3 stars 150 dust, one chosen ability to 5 stars Seal one ability 300 dust, the chosen ability goes to 0 stars 300 dust, the chosen ability goes to 0 stars

On floor 50 the boss starts fully sealed (0%). On floor 75 every ability starts at a random 3–5 stars.

Lock in your total before going up

Your rewards use the total that the altar last saved, and the altar only saves it when the party leader opens its menu (choosing Quit is enough). On floor 75 the boss already has 3–5 stars everywhere, but if the leader never opens the altar, the run is counted as 0%. Always open the altar once after your last change. Once the Betelgeuse fight has started, the altar can no longer change the stars.

A sealed ability stays at 0 stars: later rerolls and maximizes leave it alone, and the 5-star maximize can't target it.

Going up. When ready, the party leader steps on the switch at the top of the altar area and the whole party is moved to the top floor. This is the moment your reward bonus is decided. Every player gets the bonus that matches the current total: Bonus 1 at 300% or more, Bonus 2 at 600% or more.

docs.title: Betelgeuse fight
docs.text:
The party leader talks to Betelgeuse to start. The fight has three phases, and Betelgeuse is summoned again at full HP at the start of each one:

Phase Ends when What is new 1 Betelgeuse reaches 90% HP Meteor Storm on a 3×3 grid of spots around him, roughly every 10 seconds. HP regeneration. 2 Betelgeuse reaches 60% HP Moving ice traps, Ganbantein on a 5×5 grid around him about every 15 seconds, and 2 Soul of Betelguese #20995 about every 15 seconds. 3 Betelgeuse dies The traps turn into fire traps that knock you back and can kill you outright. Higher ATK.

Mechanics to know:

  • Recovery: Betelgeuse heals 1% + 0.3% per Recovery star of his max HP every 10 seconds. Each time a party member dies he heals five times that amount at once. In practice both only happen in phase 1.
  • Souls: each wave of souls gives Betelgeuse +100 RES and MRES. Every soul you kill takes 50 back off. Kill them quickly.
  • Traps: with Trap at 0–1 stars, 10 traps sweep up and down the arena; at 2 stars, 16 traps sweep left and right; at 3 or more stars, both sets are active. A trap hit costs a share of your max HP: 10% plus the trap bonus in phase 2, 20% plus the trap bonus in phase 3.
  • Phase changes: at each phase change the party is pulled to the centre of the arena while Betelgeuse talks, then he is summoned again.
  • Stay in the arena: if Betelgeuse is pulled out of the arena for about 5 seconds, he and the whole party are warped back to the centre, and he casts Hell Judgement and Earthquake with boosted ATK.
  • Keep the party together: Betelgeuse is immune to damage while the number of players in the boss area does not match the number who started the climb. A member who leaves or disconnects stops the fight.

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
Personal reward. After Betelgeuse dies, every player talks to the Betelgeuse NPC once and receives:

Item Base amount (T = total %) Meteorite Powder #1000372 10 + 0.6 × T Meteorite Fragment #1000373 5 + T ÷ 4 Beteleuse Soul #1000397 T ÷ 100 (max 10)

On top of that:

Bonus Floor 50 Floor 75 Bonus 1 (300%+) +10 dust, +5 fragments, +1 soul +20 dust, +10 fragments, +2 souls Bonus 2 (600%+), replaces Bonus 1 +20 dust, +10 fragments, +2 souls +40 dust, +20 fragments, +4 souls 700%+ — +30 dust, +15 fragments 800%+ — +40 dust, +20 fragments 900%+ — +50 dust, +25 fragments, +1 soul 1000% — +60 dust, +30 fragments, +2 souls

For example, a full 600% run on floor 50 gives 390 dust, 165 fragments and 8 souls each. A full 1000% run on floor 75 gives 830 dust, 365 fragments and 17 souls each.

Treasure boxes. Boxes appear in the arena when Betelgeuse dies. Opening a box drops its items on the ground.

  • Number of stat boxes: total ÷ 50 on floor 50, or total ÷ 50 + total ÷ 100 on floor 75, up to 10. The first five are picked from the Dust boxes, the next five from the Fragment boxes.
Box Contents Dust boxes (5) 5–9 of one of Power Meteorite Powder #1000398, Stamina Meteorite Powder #1000399, Meteorite Powder of Spell #1000402, Agile Meteorite Powder #1000400, Meteorite Powder of Wisdom #1000403 Fragment boxes (5) 2–5 of one of Power Meteorite Fragment #1000442, Stamina Meteorite Fragment #1000443, Meteorite Fragment of Spell #1000446, Agile Meteorite Fragment #1000444, Meteorite Fragment of Wisdom #1000447 Critical box 1 (400%+) 5–9 Lucky Meteorite Powder #1000401 Critical box 2 (600%+ on floor 50, 500%+ on floor 75) 2–5 Lucky Meteorite Fragment #1000445

Each Critical box also rolls for costumes:

Total Floor 50 Floor 75 300%+ 5% Costume Dropping Betelgeuse #400147 10% Costume Dropping Betelgeuse #400147 400%+ 5% Costume Black Dragon Wig #400148 15% Costume Black Dragon Wig #400148 600%+ 5% Costume Black Thunder #400149 20% Costume Black Thunder #400149 800%+ — 25% one of the three costumes 1000% — 30% one of the three costumes

Leaving. The exit portal in the arena gives Instance Points equal to half the total % (10 points if the total was 0%), within the server's daily Instance Point limit. Charm Of Brightness #30034 adds 50 points.

Tip

Spend your Meteorite materials at the exchange machine next to Oscar on the island. It only appears for you after you have finished the Destroyed Tower story, which happens the first time you beat Betelgeuse and talk to him afterwards.

docs.title: Guide
docs.text: In Cor Memorial you help the Rebellion collect battle data on Elyumina's creations. Your party activates four trap boxes around Cor, defeats the illusion monsters that come out of each, and then fights her prototype EL1-A17T #20340 in the barracks.

docs.title: Entering
docs.text:
• Story run: the first time, Cor Memorial is part of the Episode 17.1 story. Elena Volkova at /navi sp_cor 180/169 sends you in to capture Elyumina. Only the party leader can create and enter this version from her.
  • Repeatable run: once you have finished the Pure Facts story quest, talk to the Rebellion soldier at /navi sp_cor 113/130. The first time, a short scene with Elyumina plays.
  • Party: you must be in a party. The party leader picks Ready to create the instance, then everyone picks Enter.
  • Cooldown: entering gives you Pure Backstab (Standby), a daily cooldown that resets at 04:00 server time. Once it has passed, talk to the Rebellion soldier to clear it.
  • Time limit: the instance lasts 2 hours.

docs.title: Walkthrough (repeatable run)
docs.text:
Warning

The party leader must be the first to walk up to Elena. The instance only switches to the repeatable version when the leader steps next to her. If someone else talks to her first, the story version starts instead and the repeatable boxes do not appear.

  1. Inside, the party leader walks up to Elena Volkova at the start (1@cor 180/169) and talks to her. Elyumina gives the briefing and marks the four trap boxes on everyone's minimap.
  2. Visit the four boxes in any order. Touch a box to set it off: a group of Elyumina's monsters spawns around it.
  3. Kill the whole group. The box is then cleared and its mark on the minimap disappears.
  4. When all four boxes are cleared, Elyumina appears in the barracks at 1@cor 172/223. Talk to her and choose Go in. to open the portal next to her.
  5. The first player through the portal starts the boss fight with EL1-A17T #20340 at 1@cor 137/221.
Box Location Monsters 1 1@cor 222/236 6 E-EA1L #20341, 3 E-13EN0 #20343, 4 Heart Hunter Bellare #20355 2 1@cor 220/170 6 E-EA2S #20342, 3 E-13EN0 #20343, 3 High Hunter Bellare #20356 3 1@cor 160/119 6 E-EA1L #20341, 3 E-13EN0 #20343, 3 Heart Hunter Bellare #20355 4 1@cor 140/79 6 E-EA2S #20342, 3 E-13EN0 #20343, 3 High Hunter Bellare #20356

docs.title: Traps
docs.text:
While a box's monsters are alive, a trap keeps reappearing on top of the box (every 10 seconds or so):

  • Biological Battery (boxes 1 and 3): stepping on it summons a Bio Battery #20345 that blows itself up. A few seconds later a Reinforced Energy orb appears next to the box. Click it for +20 to all stats for 30 seconds.
  • Chemical Poison (boxes 2 and 4): stepping on it summons a Chemical Poison #20344, which turns into a poison cloud.

docs.title: EL1-A17T
docs.text:
• The arena is closed off by barricades.
  • Every 30 seconds Elyumina warns that the boss "is starting to spread something", and a new Biological Battery or Chemical Poison trap appears at one of 11 spots in the arena. The traps work the same way as at the boxes, and a battery you trigger here also spawns a Reinforced Energy orb for the stat boost.
  • When the boss dies, every trap and leftover monster is removed and Elena Volkova appears at 1@cor 138/221.

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
Talk to Elena Volkova after the fight. Each player gets this once per run, and is then sent back to sp_cor:

docs.title: Guide
docs.text: Help Missing the cat clean Malangdo's culverts. Drains open one after another across the map, each one guarded by deep-sea monsters; someone has to reach the drain and "clean" it before it overflows with seaweed. Survive all ten drains and a Coelacanth boss rises from the abyss. There is a normal mode (level 90+) and a hard mode (level 140+).

docs.title: How to enter
docs.text:
NPC Missing, the Cleaner in Malangdo: /navi mal_in01 160/34 Level 90+ (hard mode: 140+) Party Required. The party leader creates the instance by answering "Aragam insulted me." Required item Every player needs a Sea God's Call #6436 in their inventory to talk to Missing Cooldown 1 hour per character, starting when you enter Time limit 1 hour

The first time, talk Missing through his story to receive the password memo.

docs.title: Choosing the mode
docs.text:
Inside, the party leader talks to Missing at the start:

  • "I'm pretty good at delivering bread." starts normal mode on the first map.
  • "I know how to fight." starts hard mode (leader must be level 140+). Missing opens a gate to the east; players of level 140+ who step in go to the hard map, everyone else is sent to the normal map instead.

Then walk east and talk to Missing again to start cleaning.

Warning

In hard mode, party members below level 140 cannot reach the hard map. Bring a party where everyone is 140+.

docs.title: How the cleaning works
docs.text:
Normal Hard Drains in total 10 10 Possible drain spots 6 10 New drain every 50 seconds 40 seconds Time to clean a drain 10-second cast 15-second cast Drain overflows after about 50 seconds about 40 seconds Monsters per drain 1~3 of each of six deep-sea monsters 2~3 of each of six deep-sea monsters
  1. A new drain opens at a random spot (5 seconds of warning first). It is surrounded by fresh monsters.
  2. Any player can click the drain to clean it. The cleaner casts for 10 seconds (15 in hard mode); once the cast finishes the drain is closed safely.
  3. If nobody cleans it in time, the drain closes on its own, its monsters vanish, and a Contaminated Seaweed (Seaweed #2191) grows at the starting area.
  4. Seaweed is counted each time the fifth to tenth drains open, and once more at the end. If 6 or more seaweeds are alive at any check, Missing calls the run a failure; talk to him to restart the cleaning.

Tip

Seaweeds can be killed. If you miss drains, go back and kill seaweeds before the next check to stay under 6.

docs.title: The Coelacanth
docs.text:
About 20 seconds after the tenth drain, if fewer than 6 seaweeds remain, a Coelacanth appears somewhere on the map (50/50 which one):

Mode Possible bosses Normal Weird Coelacanth #2188 or Gloomy Coelacanth #2187 Hard Mutant Coelacanth #2189 or Violent Coelacanth #2190

Killing it opens the exit and drops 10 random items on the floor near the start:

docs.title: Guide
docs.text: Climb the tower where the Magic Swordman Thanatos holds back Demon Morocc. You go through three maps: help the wounded, fight waves of Evil Shadow #2939, break the Magic Seals Morocc is pulling towards himself, and finally, with Loki's help, defeat the demon-blessed Lord Knight Evil Fanatics #2942. A treasure box with an Evil Slayer weapon waits at the end.

docs.title: Entering
docs.text:
All three NPCs stand together in dali02:

  1. Every member talks to Historian Shep at /navi dali02 134/119 and volunteers. This gives you Explore the tower, which lets you enter for the next 1 hour 30 minutes.
  2. The party leader talks to Magic Scholar Artie at /navi dali02 137/121 to activate the device.

  3. Everyone enters through the Dimensional Device at /navi dali02 141/120.

  4. Level: 130 or higher.

  5. Party: required. The leader makes all the key story choices.
  6. Re-entry: you can go back in through the device until you leave the first room with Assassin Dewey. After that you cannot get back in. Nobody can enter once the boss is defeated.

docs.title: Cooldown and EXP reward
docs.text:
You get your EXP when you talk to Historian Shep after the run, and that is also when the cooldown starts. It ends at the next 04:00 server time. How much EXP you get depends on how far you got:

How far you got Reward from Historian Shep Cleared the tower 450,000 Base EXP and 450,000 Job EXP Broke the Magic Seals and followed Lucile upstairs, but did not finish 300,000 Base EXP and 300,000 Job EXP Got past the first stairs (moved on with Assassin Louie), but did not break the seals 200,000 Base EXP and 200,000 Job EXP Did not get that far, gave up, or let the 1h30 entry window run out No EXP, but the cooldown still starts

If you volunteered but want to back out before entering, Shep has a Cancel my reservation option.

docs.title: Walkthrough
docs.text:
1. The infirmary (1@tnm1)

  1. A short scene plays when you arrive. Then the leader talks to Officer Heim.
  2. Healer Fama hands out a Medical Cure Box #7641, one at a time. Take a box to an Injured Soldier, use it (a 10-second progress bar), then go back to Fama for another one. Heal all 7 soldiers.
  3. The leader talks to Lucile for the next scene. Then talk to Assassin Dewey and pick Move now to go to the stairs. (After this you can no longer re-enter.)

2. The stairs

27 Evil Shadow #2939 spawn in waves over about 40 seconds, 9 of each of the three kinds. The hunting task Dewey gave you asks for 7 of each kind (21 in total). When it is done, talk to Assassin Louie at the end of the stairs to move on.

3. The second stairs

  1. The leader talks to Lucile and picks Can I help?. This costs the leader 30% HP and starts a 40-second progress bar. Do not cancel it.
  2. 16 Evil Shadows appear around Huey. Kill them all, then talk to Huey and pick Move immediately to go up to the battlefield (1@tnm2).

4. Thanatos against Demon Morocc: the Magic Seals

The leader talks to Lucile. After a short exchange, Demon Morocc calls in five Magic Seal #2938, one from each direction (north, north-west, south-west, south-east and north-east).

  • Each seal has 3,000,000 HP and moves one step closer to the centre about every 35 seconds. It keeps the damage you have done to it, and every time it moves, 4 Evil Shadows spawn next to it.
  • Every 20 seconds, lines of Flamecross #2960 burst out along the five paths for a few seconds. Do not stand on the paths when that happens.
  • Destroy all five seals. If they are not all dead after about 3 minutes, Thanatos blasts the field and every seal starts again from the edge with full HP. Seals you have already destroyed still count, so you only have to finish the rest.

When the fifth seal falls, Thanatos banishes Morocc. Talk to Lucile and pick Follow to go to the top floor (1@tnm3).

5. The Young Girl

  1. 12 Evil Shadows attack a Young Girl. Kill them, then the leader talks to her (Where are they?) and a warp opens.
  2. 18 more Evil Shadows spawn on the next section. When they are dead she shows you the way underground.
  3. Walking up to the Evil Shadow at the next corner spawns 5 more. Kill them to open the warp to the boss room.

6. Boss: the Lord Knight

  • Walking near the Demonic Shade at the boss room entrance spawns about 33 Evil Shadows across the room. This step is optional, so you can go around it.
  • Talk to Loki next to the Morocc Lord Knight. After the scene everyone is moved to 1@tnm3 136/62.

docs.text: Drift Ice Zone is a story instance from the Episode 20 main quest (An Unexpected Reunion). Past a shaky wall in the maze you find a frozen zone full of Rgan and Jormungandr's guardians, and at the end of it an unexpected meeting with Lasgand, Salekgandh and Bagot. There is no item reward: finishing it moves your main quest on.

docs.title: Entering
docs.text:
• Requirement: you must be on the Where the maze ends / An Unexpected Reunion step of the Episode 20 main story. Walk to /navi jor_maze 140/68 and a Shaky Wall appears at jor_maze 140/72. Examine it once to find the traces on the floor.
  • Party: you must be in a party. The party leader clicks the Shaky Wall again and picks Create device, then everyone picks Go inside.
  • Time limit: the instance lasts 1 hour and closes after 5 minutes with nobody inside.

Every party member who is on this story step gets the quest update at the end.

docs.title: Walkthrough
docs.text:
A minimap guide arrow points you to each next stop.

  1. Party leader: talk to the Rgan Bishop at 1@twsd 314/94. Two Heart Hunter #21994 attack. When they are dead, the Jormungand Guardians come to life: kill the Jormungandr Guardian #21991 and Jormungandr Guardian #21992.
  2. Talk to the Rgan Shaman at 1@twsd 319/100. Two Rgan Warlock #21993 attack. Kill them.
  3. Take the portal at 1@twsd 294/115. On the other side, 4 Rgan Warlocks attack. Kill them all to open the way north.
  4. Take the portal at 1@twsd 220/154 and go to the Rgan Bishop at 1@twsd 163/190. Talk to him: two Rgan Warlocks attack, then two Jormungandr Guardians, then two more Rgan Warlocks further north.
  5. Talk to Lehar at 1@twsd 162/245 and take the portal at 1@twsd 164/260.
  6. Three Rgan Warlocks attack on the way west. Kill them, then go to Salekgandh at 1@twsd 48/326.
  7. Talk to Salekgandh: 5 Heart Hunters attack. Talk to him again after they are dead: 3 Rgan Warlocks attack.
  8. Talk to Bagot at 1@twsd 46/328 once the fighting is over, then to Lehar at 1@twsd 58/327.
  9. A portal opens at 1@twsd 56/315. Step in to finish. Your quest updates and you are sent to jor_back1.

Tip

Every step waits until all monsters of the current group are dead, so check the corners before moving on if the next NPC does not respond.

docs.text: Eclage Interior is a short story instance from the Eclage main quest (Episode 14.2). You are sent into the Orb's lighting room in the heart of Eclage, where suspicious creatures have broken in, and it ends with the betrayal that leads into the next part of the story.

docs.title: Entering
docs.text:
• Requirement: you must be on the Orb's lighting room step of the Eclage main quest.
  • Party: you must be in a party, and only the party leader can go in. The leader talks to the Chief of Staff at /navi ecl_hub01 132/12 and picks Enter it. to create the instance, then clicks the door (It is closed shut.) next to him at /navi ecl_hub01 130/15.
  • Time limit: you have to go through the door within 20 minutes of talking to the Chief of Staff, and the instance itself closes after 20 minutes.

Warning

Both the Chief of Staff and the door only respond to the party leader. Each character has to do this step as party leader (a party of one works).

docs.title: Walkthrough
docs.text:
1. Walk towards the four Suspicious Creatures near the entrance. When you get close they attack: kill all four Incarnation of Morocc #2375.
  2. An alarm goes off in the lighting room and more creatures appear further in. Walk up to them and eight Incarnation of Morocc #2376 attack. Kill them all.
  3. Shenime appears at 1@ecl 58/69. Talk to her. She drains 99% of your HP and blinds you for 60 seconds, then sends you to the next room.
  4. Talk to Avant at 1@ecl 148/97.
  5. You are moved to the room with Loki and Nydhog. Talk to Hisie at 1@ecl 144/27. She heals you, your quest moves on to Betrayal, and you are sent to ecl_in03.

Leaving through Hisie gives 20–40 Instance Points (+50 with Charm Of Brightness #30034), within the server's daily Instance Point limit.

Tip

Heal up before you talk to Shenime: you arrive in the next room with 1% HP and blinded.

docs.title: Guide
docs.text: Edda Bio is Miracle's own take on the Biolab: a long run through the Rekenber laboratory in eight rooms, ending with the Nameless Swordsman in the lower lab. Every player gets one random Edda weapon from the treasure box, a weapon box, Somatology materials and Instance Points. The materials are spent at the Edda enchanter in Juno.

docs.title: Entering
docs.text:
• NPC: Sierra at /navi yuno 216/345.
  • Party: the party leader picks create; then everyone picks enter.
  • Level: the script has no level check.
  • Cooldown: entering starts the Road of Battle quest, which ends at the next 04:00 server time.
  • Time limit: 1 hour.
  • Late joining: you can't enter once the boss is defeated.

docs.title: Walkthrough
docs.text:
Each room spawns its monsters when you step into it, and the whole party is moved to the next room as soon as the last one dies. If you get left behind, the Sierra standing in each cleared room sends you on to the next one.

Room Monsters to kill 1 None. The party leader talks to Sierra next to the entrance to start. 2 14: Rekenber Senior Guard #20541, Rekenber Guard #20542, Regenschirm Scientists 3 25: the same three plus Nameless Acolyte #20538 4 21: Rekenber Guards, Senior Guards and Regenschirm Scientists 5 25: Rekenber Guards, Senior Guards, Scientists and Nameless Acolytes 6 See below 7 33: Nameless Swordsman #20537, Nameless Merchant #20539, Acolytes, Guards and Scientists 8 17: Guards, Senior Guards, Scientists and Nameless Swordsmen

Room 6, the four switches

  1. Entering the room spawns 6 Rekenber Guards and seals one passage. Kill them to reopen it.
  2. There are four switch areas in the room. Walking into each one spawns 11 monsters (5 Rekenber Guards, 5 Nameless Swordsmen, 1 Rekenber Senior Guard) and seals its exits until they are all dead.
  3. When all four switch groups are cleared, the party moves to room 7.

Room 8 to the boss

Room 8 does not move you on by itself. After clearing it, talk to Sierra in the room to go down to the lower lab.

Boss: Nameless Swordsman #20536

Walk to Sierra in the middle of the lower lab and talk to her to start the fight. The whole party is pulled to her, the door behind you closes and the Nameless Swordsman appears just south of her. Then, in a loop:

  1. Over about 8 seconds, walls rise to form four pens around the middle of the room, and one extra monster appears in each pen.
  2. 5 seconds later, if the boss is still alive, the pen monsters vanish and the whole party is pulled back to the middle.
  3. The walls drop, and 5 seconds later the cycle starts again.

Fight in the open corridor between the pens so the walls do not lock you away from the boss.

docs.text:
When the boss dies, a treasure box appears south of Sierra and Sierra comes back.

Source Reward (each player) Treasure box 1 random Edda weapon (38 possible weapons), once per character per instance (relogging does not give another) Sierra 9 Somatology Research Document #25786 and 15 Somatology Experimental Fragment #25787 Sierra 100-200 Somatology Research Document #25786 and the same amount of Somatology Experimental Fragment #25787 Sierra 1 Ancient Heros Weapon Box #23806 Sierra 20-40 Instance Points (up to the daily cap of 1,200 points)

Open the box first

Talking to Sierra gives her rewards and immediately sends you back to Juno. Open the treasure box before you talk to her, or you lose the weapon.

docs.text:

Every player must meet the chosen mode's level to enter, and nobody can enter once Nacht Sieger is defeated.

docs.title: Guide
docs.text: Faceworm's Nest is a time attack instance with five stages. Your party follows Chaos and Iris through the forest and kills four Dark Faceworms and then the Faceworm Queen. Each boss leaves a treasure chest with a Gigant Snake Skin #20717 cape. The faster you open the chest after the stage starts, the better the refine and enchants on the cape.

docs.title: How to enter
docs.text:
• Where: the Dimensional Gap, /navi dali 80/60.
  • Level: Base Level 140 or higher.
  • Party: You need a party, even if you go alone. The party leader talks to the Magic Scholar (dali 80/60) and picks "Reserve Faceworm's Nest". Then everyone enters through the Interdimensional Device next to him (/navi dali 72/55).
  • Cooldown: Entering starts a daily cooldown that resets at 04:00 server time ("Faceworm's Nest after-effects"). After it ends, talk to the Magic Scholar or the device once to clear it.
  • The Old Sign at /navi dali 83/67 shows the server's best clear time and the size of the party that set it.

docs.title: Stage 1: The forest path
docs.text:
The party leader talks to Chaos. After a short conversation the time attack starts and Faceworm #2528 spawn along the forest path. There are (number of players in the instance + 1) × 11 of them in total, and the announcer counts down how many are left.

When fewer than 3 Faceworms remain, the rest disappear and a Dark Faceworm #2530 spawns in the east, near 145/74.

docs.title: Dark Faceworm mechanics
docs.text:
All four Dark Faceworms share the same basics:

  • HP scales with the party: 5,200,000 minus 200,000 for each player fewer than 13 who is in the instance, with a minimum of 1,500,000. A solo player faces 2,800,000 HP.
  • Stage 1: Eggs. The boss lays 2 or 4 Faceworm Egg #2540 around itself. It lays 4 when it is low on HP. After 12 seconds it absorbs every egg still standing and heals, and more eggs heal it for much more. Break eggs as soon as they appear.
  • Stage 2: Water Balls. Invisible helpers spawn around the boss and cast Water Ball. They disappear after 20 seconds.
  • Stage 3: Venom Bugs. The boss fills a square around itself with Venom Bug #2531, which self-destruct, and heals a random amount each time.
  • Stage 4: Venom Fog. Invisible helpers cast Venom Fog around the boss for 30 seconds at a time. The whole stage 4 area also has extra venom fog spots until the boss dies.

When a Dark Faceworm dies, a treasure chest appears and a portal opens to the next area.

docs.title: Stages 2 to 4
docs.text:
Stage Start Boss spawns near 2 Leader talks to Chaos after taking the portal at 149/92 161/272 (south of the hill) 3 Leader talks to Chaos after the portal at 139/100 278/308 (narrow canyon in the north-east) 4 Walk into the area just past the portal at 248/185 214/108 (west)

Each stage first spawns a new wave of (players + 1) × 11 Faceworms, and the boss appears when fewer than 3 remain.

docs.title: Stage 5: Faceworm Queen
docs.text:
Take the portal at 204/122 and walk to the large puddle. After a cutscene with Chaos, the Faceworm Queen #2529 crawls out of the nest at 213/153.

  • HP: 52,000,000 minus 2,000,000 for each player fewer than 13 in the instance, with a minimum of 15,000,000. A solo player faces 28,000,000 HP.
  • Element changes: About every 25 seconds she may shed her skin and change form: Yellow Faceworm Queen #2535 (wind), Green Faceworm Queen #2533 (earth), Blue Faceworm Queen #2534 (water) or back to normal. Watch the announcement and switch to the right element.
  • Adds: Depending on her remaining HP, she uses the same tricks as the Dark Faceworms: eggs that heal her (up to 1,000,000 per player for 4 eggs), Water Ball helpers, Venom Bug grids that also heal her, and Venom Fog. Below 10,000,000 HP she combines two of these at once.
  • Stay near the nest: Keep her inside the nest area (roughly 190–230 / 135–175). If she leaves it you get a warning, and then she turns into the Red Faceworm Queen #2532 for 15 seconds.
  • Burst damage triggers rage: If the party deals more than (players + 7) × 400,000 damage within one cycle (about 20 seconds), she recovers 80% of that damage and turns into the Red Faceworm Queen with higher attack.
  • Chaos helps: While she has more than 7,000,000 HP, Chaos sometimes shouts "Lure it to the north/south/east/west!" and appears at that edge of the nest for 15 seconds. Pull the Queen next to him and step on his spot. He hits her for up to (players + 7) × 250,000 damage. His hit cannot take her below 5,000,000 HP.

When she dies, the final chest appears. Talk to Chaos (step near 212/156) and then use the Dimensional Device to leave.

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
Stage chests (Dark Faceworms): Each chest drops one Gigant Snake Skin #20717. It is either the unslotted cape or the slotted version Gigant Snake Skin [1] #20718. The slotted chance grows with each stage: 5%, 10%, 15% and 20%.

  • The timer for each chest starts when that stage starts. Open it within 2 minutes for the best result: refine +2 to +6. Each 15 seconds after that lowers the range, down to +0 to +4.
  • It can also roll up to three random stat enchants (STR/AGI/VIT/INT/DEX/LUK +1 to +5, plus a rare Special stat enchant). Faster clears raise the chance of getting enchants.

Final chest (Faceworm Queen): Drops two capes, each with a 60% chance to be slotted.

  • Open it within 4 minutes 30 seconds of the Queen's stage starting for refine +4 to +11. Each 15 seconds later lowers the range, down to +1 to +8.
  • Enchants can go up to +7 per stat.
  • Opening it records your clear time on the Old Sign. If you beat the record, it is announced to the whole server.

Merchant Prince's Boxes: When the final chest is opened, each of 27 hidden boxes around the map has a 50% chance to appear. Each box drops:

  • 1–7 jewels
  • One quest item: Old Ring #6650, Rusty Bracalet #6651, Old Photo Album #6652, Old Pill #6653 or Old Scroll #22507
  • 60% chance of Old Crown #6648
  • 30% chance of Gold Bullion #7228
  • 10% chance of Silver Bullion #7229

Instance Points: 20–40 when you leave through the Dimensional Device. This counts toward the daily 1,200 point cap.

docs.title: Payon side quests
docs.text:
Four NPCs in Payon take the quest items from the boxes. Each turn-in gives 70,000 Base EXP and 55,000 Job EXP. Each NPC can be done once a day (resets at 04:00 server time), and you need Base Level 140.

Tip

  • Stepping near a Suspicious Mound spawns 1–3 Faceworm Larva #2541.
  • Hidden toxic spots on the path to stages 2 and 3 release 25–50 Venom Bugs.
  • Greatest General #1277, Beetle King #1494 and Savage #1166 roam the whole map.
  • Clear quickly but carefully. The chest timers keep running while you fight trash.

docs.title: Guide
docs.text: Fall of Glast Heim (shown in game as Fogh_Normal / Fogh_Hard) follows Oscar through the cursed castle while time keeps looping. You clear four rooms of cursed servants and knights, then fight the Cursed King. The materials you bring back buy and enchant King Schmidt's armor, manteau and insignias next to the entrance.

docs.title: Entering
docs.text:
• NPC: Oscar at /navi glast_01 241/290.
  • Modes: Normal or Hard, picked in Oscar's first menu. A party can only have one of them open at a time.
  • Party: the party leader picks the mode and Create; everyone then talks to Oscar, picks the same mode and Enter.
  • Level: the script has no level check.
  • Cooldown: Normal and Hard have separate cooldowns. Each starts when you enter and ends at the next 04:00 server time.
  • Time limit: 1 hour.
  • Late joining: you can't enter once the Cursed King is defeated.
Normal Hard Knights Mad Knight #20388, Cursed Knight #20390 Mad Knight #20389, Cursed Knight #20391 Boss Cursed King #20386 Cursed King #20387 Reward 3 Curse Eroded Crystal #25739, 10 Instance Points 6 Curse Eroded Gemstone #25740, 20-40 Instance Points

docs.title: Walkthrough
docs.text:
Every room is started by walking up to its trigger (Oscar, or a spot near the entrance in room 1). Once the counted monsters are dead, Oscar announces it and the party is moved to the next room 5 seconds later.

Every room also spawns 20 "cursed flame" (Thorn of Magic #1960). They do not count toward clearing the room; Oscar warns that they are the most troublesome monsters here, so avoid them rather than fight them.

Room Kill to continue 1 20 Fallen Maid #20392 2 23 Mad Knights and 2 Dark Guard #20394 3 30 Cursed Knights 4 15 Cursed Knights and 15 Mad Knights

Boss: the Cursed King

After room 4 the party is moved to the throne room. Walk up to Oscar: he gathers time energy for 10 seconds, pulls the whole party to him and the Cursed King appears just north. When it dies, Oscar comes back.

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text: Talk to Oscar after the boss dies. He gives the reward in the table above (each player) and sends you back to glast_01. Instance Points count toward the daily cap of 1,200.

docs.title: Guide
docs.text: The Farm Lost in Time is a short daily instance in Varmundt's Mansion (Episode 17.2). The clumsy automatic doll Silk leads your party through six Pitaya habitats. You "play with" each group of Pitayas, then lure out and defeat Boss Meow. Pitaya tails you collect along the way are turned in for Barmil Tickets.

docs.title: How to enter
docs.text:
• NPC: Luina, in front of the farming facility at /navi ba_maison 311/206.
  • Level: Base Level 150 or higher.
  • Story: You must have reached the Episode 17.2 main quest point where you can visit the farm. Talk to Luina twice to finish her introduction ("Keeping Breeding Ground").
  • Party: You need a party, even for one person. The party leader picks "Create Farm Lost in Time". Then everyone picks "Enter the dungeon.".
  • Cooldown: Entering starts a daily cooldown that resets at 04:00 server time ("Daily farm experience - Standby"). Talk to Luina once after it ends to clear it.
  • Inventory: You need room for 20 Barmil Tickets.

Note

Entering also gives you the "Tail Collection" quest. While it is active, every Pitaya you defeat in the farm has a 15% chance to drop a Pitaya tail matching its colour. Any tails still in your inventory are taken away the next time you talk to Luina, so turn them in before you leave.

docs.title: Walkthrough
docs.text:
All Silk conversations must be done by the party leader.

  1. Start area. The leader walks to the start line near 161/40. A Wooden Box (Silk hiding) appears. The leader talks to it and 7 Pitayas pounce. Defeat them all, then talk to Silk.
  2. Second habitat. Everyone is moved to 218/149. The leader talks to Silk. She scatters food, and 7 more Pitayas come out. Clear them and talk to Silk again.
  3. Sand playground. Everyone is moved to 86/101. Same as before: talk, clear, talk. Silk counts down how many are left.
  4. Oasis. Everyone is moved to 226/256. Talk, clear, talk.
  5. Sleepy area. Everyone is moved to 242/117. Talk, clear, talk.
  6. Last habitat. Everyone is moved to 116/165. Talk, clear, talk. Silk then marks two Big Meows on the minimap, at 38/253 (west) and 287/253 (east).

docs.title: The trap path
docs.text:
Pick one of the two Big Meows and walk up to it. This spawns a Big Meow and arms 5 trap spots along the path from that side to the boss nest at the top of the map.

  • Walking over each trap spot releases a group of 5 Pitayas. One spot on the west path releases 10.
  • You must set off all 5 traps and defeat every Pitaya from them, plus the Big Meow. After that, the Wooden Box at the nest (161/315) is ready.

docs.title: Boss Meow
docs.text:
The leader talks to the Wooden Box at 161/315. Pitaya Boss #20659 appears together with 17 Pitayas of every colour.

  • More trap spots on both sides of the nest (around 129–135/317 and 195–201/317) release 5 extra Pitayas each when someone steps on them.
  • The adds are not removed when Boss Meow dies. Clean them up or ignore them.

After Boss Meow is defeated, the leader talks to the Wooden Box, then to Silk. After that, every player talks to Silk to turn in their tails and leave.

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
Silk takes all your Pitaya tails (Red Pitaya Tail #1000093, Yellow Pitaya Tail #1000094, Blue Pitaya Tail #1000095, Green Pitaya Tail #1000096, Purple Pitaya Tail #1000097) and pays in Barmil Ticket #1000103:

Tails turned in Barmil Tickets Fewer than 20 2 20 or more 4 Bonus: you have a Boss Pitaya Tail #1000098 +2

Leaving through Silk also gives 20–40 Instance Points, which count toward the daily 1,200 cap.

First clear bonus: After your first run, talk to Luina outside to finish "It's Boss Meow!". You get 20 Barmil Tickets and 3,094,009 Base EXP.

Tip

  • Tails only drop while the "Tail Collection" quest is active, so make sure every member entered through Luina.
  • Collecting 20 or more tails doubles your ticket reward, so kill every Pitaya you see, including the Boss Meow adds.

docs.title: Guide
docs.text: Professor Bernhard sends you back in time to Glast Heim, to the battle between Fenrith Fenrir and the Valkyrie Sarah Irene. The story follows Fenrir across the old castle grounds. Your real goal is to collect Fragments of Gigantes from the Ancient Gigantes on the map. The professor's assistant uses them to give you and enchant Sarah's Earrings.

docs.title: How to enter
docs.text:
• NPC: Professor Bernhard in the Dimensional Gap, /navi dali02 97/142. The Dimensional Device is right next to him at /navi dali02 99/148.
  • Level: Base Level 145 or higher.
  • Party: The party leader talks to Bernhard and answers "Yes" to create the instance. Then everyone enters through the Dimensional Device.
  • Reporting back: After every run, talk to Bernhard again. Until you do, the device will not let you back in. Reporting back starts a daily cooldown ("Go back to Professor Bernhard") that resets at 04:00 server time. He says a week in his dialogue, but the cooldown is one day.

docs.title: Walkthrough
docs.text:
1. The entrance. Walk toward Fenrir near 360/295. Nine Mutant Galion #3198 ambush you while Fenrir channels a spell for 10 seconds, then her lightning wipes them out. After the conversation, take the warp at 352/279 into Glast Heim.

2. South courtyard. Find Fenrir at 216/48. This starts a 5 minute timer and marks 47/270 on your minimap. It also wakes up the six Ancient Gigantes around the map (see below).

3. Fenrir's chamber (west). The party leader must reach 47/270 before the 5 minutes run out. The party is then moved into the chamber. Walk in to spawn two Gigantes #3191. Waves of Mutant Galion #3198 and Wicked Mutant Dragon #3199 keep pouring in while Fenrir uses the Sentinel Breeze. Kill both Gigantes, or hold out for 5 waves until Fenrir finishes them. Everyone in the room is then sent to 105/369.

4. North path. Walk east to Fenrir at 133/365. This starts another 5 minute timer and marks 199/237. The party leader steps on the warp at 199/237. That moves everyone in the instance to the castle stairs. Then the leader takes the warp at 199/294 into the final room.

5. Final room: Sarah Irene. Walking in spawns Sarah Irene #3190 together with pairs of Large Gigantes #3194 and Large Gigantes #3195. More Large Gigantes keep arriving during the fight, up to four at a time.

  • Fenrir fights Sarah with a series of big spells. Each spell sets Sarah's HP to a fixed fraction of her maximum, so damage you deal to Sarah in between does not carry over. Spend that time killing the Large Gigantes.
  • About 4 minutes 13 seconds into the fight, Fenrir announces that Sarah is in critical condition and drops her to 100 HP. Finish her quickly. About 30 seconds later the fight ends either way.

6. Escape. After the cutscene, everyone in the final room is moved outside to 197/221, next to Fenrir. Sarah's wrath begins almost immediately:

  • Groups of Large Gigantes spawn all over Glast Heim in five waves.
  • Then 14 hidden blast zones activate across the map. Walking into one kills you instantly.
  • Run back to the entrance. The party leader steps on the warp at 351/269, which brings everyone back to 349/282.

Talk to Fenrith Fenrir at 359/294 for your reward. Then leave through the warp at 376/303.

Missing a timer

If the leader does not reach the chamber (step 3) within 5 minutes, Fenrir handles it alone and the story jumps to step 4. If the castle timer in step 4 also runs out, Fenrir takes the Sentinel Breeze herself and the escape (step 6) starts immediately. Either way you can still finish the run. You just skip those fights.

docs.title: Fragments of Gigantes
docs.text:
Six dormant Ancient Gigantes become active once you reach Fenrir in the south courtyard (step 2). Walk up to one to wake an Ancient Gigantes #3196 with two Ancient Medium Gigantes #3193. Each Ancient Gigantes drops a Fragments Of Gigan #6803.

Location 290/147 (east) 300/248 (east) 292/344 (north-east) 107/147 (west) 98/248 (west) 107/344 (north-west)

Stone Gargoyle statues near them turn into Mutant Gargoyle #3197 when you step next to them. Wicked Chimera #3200 roam the east side of the map from the start.

Tip

The 5 minute timer from step 2 is short. Decide before you start whether your party hunts the Ancient Gigantes first or follows Fenrir. Skipping the chamber still lets you finish the run.

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
Reward From Yggdrasil Berry #607 ×1 and Yggdrasil Seed #608 ×1 Fenrith Fenrir at the end of the escape, once per run 20–40 Instance Points Same, counts toward the daily 1,200 cap Fragments Of Gigan #6803 Ancient Gigantes Sarah's Left Earring #28310 or Sarah's Right Earring #28311 Professor Bernhard, the first time you report back (one per character)

The left earring lets you use Heal Lv1 and the right earring lets you use Teleport Lv1.

docs.title: Sarah's Earrings: Chief Assistant
docs.text:
The Chief Assistant stands at /navi dali02 93/146. He only talks to characters who already got their first earring from Bernhard.

  • Buy another earring: 1 Fragments Of Gigan #6803 for either the left or the right earring.
  • Enchant: 4 Fragments per attempt. The earring must be equipped, and it can have 2 enchants. First pick which accessory slot it is worn in, then pick a category:
Category Possible results, in order CRI or Critical Fatal 1, Fatal 2, CRI 2, CRI 3, CRI 4, Fatal 3 Expert Archer or Bleed Expert Archer 1, Expert Archer 2, Parrying 1, Parrying 2, Parrying 3, Expert Archer 3 Conservation or MATK Economy 1, Economy 2, MATK +3%, MATK +4%, Economy 3, MATK +5% Delay Attack or Delay Skill Attack Delay 1, Attack Delay 2, Skill Delay 1, Skill Delay 2, Skill Delay 3, Attack Delay 3
  • Earring in the left accessory slot: only the first 4 results of the category can roll, about 20% each. About 19% of attempts fail.
  • Earring in the right accessory slot: all 6 results can roll, about 10% each, including the best two. About 39% of attempts fail.
  • Reset enchants: 1 Fragment returns a clean earring.

Warning

A failed enchant destroys the earring, including any enchant it already had. Keep a spare Fragment to buy a new one.

docs.text: A farming instance that is only open on Fridays. You kill undead in a copy of Geffen's dungeon to collect Crafted Stone #25235. You then spend the stones on Marry Jay's accessory enchants, or feed them to a sculpture to try to wake the Lich Lord #3658. There is no story and no end: you farm until the 2-hour instance timer runs out.

docs.title: Entering
docs.text:
• Day: Friday only (00:00 to 23:59 server time). On other days, Marry Jay just tells you the opening hours.
  • Level: 130 or higher.
  • Party: you must be in a party. The party leader talks to Marry Jay at /navi gef_tower 57/170 and picks Prepare Friday Memorial. Then everyone picks Enter Friday Memorial.
  • Cooldown: entering gives you Time to Rest. It ends at the next 04:00 server time.

docs.title: Difficulty
docs.text:
Inside, the party leader talks to Marry Jay at the entrance and picks a difficulty. This decides which version of every monster spawns:

Difficulty Requirement Monsters Lv 130–199 Leader level 130+ Nightmare #3660, Jakk #3662, Ghoul #3664, Drainliar #3666; boss Lich Lord #3658 Lv 200+ Leader level 200+ Nightmare #3661, Jakk #3663, Ghoul #3665, Drainliar #3667; boss Lich Lord #3659

The harder mode also gives more stones from each chest (see below).

About 7 seconds after the choice, the map fills with 20 Nightmare, 30 Jakk, 30 Ghoul and 20 Drainliar. Every monster you kill comes back 10 seconds later, so the map never runs dry.

Warning

Monsters only count when they are killed normally. Taming or otherwise "processing" them does not add to the kill count.

docs.title: Getting Crafted Stones
docs.text:
Source Lv 130–199 Lv 200+ The Stranger's body (1@md_gef 183/222), Investigate the body (once per run) 5–7 stones 7–9 stones Treasure chest, appears every 100 kills 5–7 stones 7–9 stones
  • An announcement tells you when a chest appears. Chests take turns between the four corners of the map (212/212, 190/56, 49/57, 44/211).
  • Each chest disappears after 3 minutes if nobody opens it.
  • The stones drop on the ground, so loot them quickly.

docs.title: Summoning the Lich Lord
docs.text:
Once the party has killed 100 monsters, the Bizzare Sculpture at 1@md_gef 199/73 can be used. Put 10× Crafted Stone #25235 into it:

  • 10% chance: the Lord of the Dead wakes and Lich Lord #3658 (or Lich Lord #3659 on Lv 200+) spawns at 210/110. This can happen only once per run.
  • 90% chance: nothing happens. The stones are used up and the sculpture is gone for 5 minutes.

docs.title: Accessory enchants (Amateur Collector)
docs.text:
The Amateur Collector next to Marry Jay (/navi gef_tower 57/167) enchants or resets an equipped accessory. Each try costs 10× Crafted Stone #25235 and 100,000 Zeny. You need at least 10,000 free weight.

  • Enchanting removes any random options on the accessory.
  • Only accessories on her list can be enchanted. If an accessory is not on it, she will not take it.

Normal accessories: one enchant in the 4th slot, and it always works. Possible results:

Enchant Chance each STR, INT, DEX, AGI or VIT +2 / +3 / +4 3.26% HP +200, HP +400, DEF +6, DEF +12, SP +50, SP +100, MDEF +2, MDEF +4 3.26% Max HP +1%, Max HP +2%, Max SP +1%, ATK +1%, MATK +1% 2.17% Sharp 2, Sharp 3, Fatal, Fatal 1, Expert Archer 1, Spell 3, Spell 4, Archbishop 1, Archbishop 2, Fighting Spirit 3, Fighting Spirit 4 1.09% Sharp 4, Fatal 2, Spell 5, Fighting Spirit 5 0.54%

Royal Guardian Ring [1] #28483: two enchants. You pick Physical, Magical or Ranged each time. The first enchant goes in the 4th slot (stats), the second in the 3rd slot. Both always work.

Type 4th slot (first enchant) 3rd slot (second enchant) Physical STR, AGI or VIT: +3 / +4 at 13.3% each, +5 / +6 at 2.7%, +7 at 1.3% Fighting Spirit 3–7, Sharp 1–5, ATK (Atk 1, ATK +2%, ATK +3%), Attack Speed 1–2 Magical INT, DEX or VIT: +3 / +4 at 13.3% each, +5 / +6 at 2.7%, +7 at 1.3% Spell 3–7, Max SP +1%, Archbishop 1–4, MATK +1/2/3%, MATK 1–2 Ranged AGI, DEX or LUK: +3 / +4 at 13.3% each, +5 / +6 at 2.7%, +7 at 1.3% Fatal, Fatal 1–4, Sharp 1–5, Expert Archer 1–3, Attack Speed 1–2

For the 3rd slot, the lowest grades are the most common (about 13% each) and the top grades are the rarest (about 2%).

Reset: removes the enchants (both of them on the Royal Guardian Ring). It works about 80% of the time on the Royal Guardian Ring and about 20% on other accessories.

Danger

If a reset fails, the accessory is destroyed.

docs.title: Guide
docs.text: A solo instance set in the past: you travel back to Geffen during its famous Magic Tournament, qualify by beating a Desert Wolf, then fight your way through thirteen one-on-one matches against Geffen's mages, ending with the blue wizard Fenrir. Every match you win pays Geffen Magic Tournament Coins, which buy equipment from the Coin Operator.

docs.title: How to enter
docs.text:
NPC Emmitt White in the Dimensional Gap: /navi dali 98/141 Portal Dimensional Device next to him: /navi dali 100/147 Level 90+ Party Solo: you must be the leader of a party with no other members Cooldown 23 hours per character, counted from when you enter Time limit 2 hours

Talk to Emmitt White to create the instance, then use the Dimensional Device to enter.

docs.title: Walkthrough
docs.text:
1. Arrival. You appear in festival Geffen. Walk south to the fountain area; the announcer tells everyone to register there.
  2. Qualifying test. Talk to the Receptionist (around 122/58) and choose "How do I Register?". A Desert Wolf #1106 appears and you have 60 seconds to kill it. If you fail, talk to her again; you can retry as often as you like.
  3. Registration. Talk to the Receptionist once more after passing. A portal opens to the south (around 120/34) that leads into the arena.
  4. The matches. Step up to the Academy Master in the arena to start. Each match is one-on-one:
    • 3 minutes per match (5 minutes for the final).
    • If time runs out, the judges always give the win to your opponent.
    • If you die, you have 10 seconds to be revived or the match is lost.
    • Between matches, talk to the Tournament Healer for a full HP/SP heal, then to the Tournament Guide to collect your coins and begin the next match.

docs.title: Guide
docs.text: Geffen Night Arena is a solo boss-rush tournament. You face up to 10 rounds of Midnight duelists, one at a time, each with a 60-second time limit. The tournament ends at your first failure, or when you beat the champion in round 10, and the reward depends on how far you got.

docs.title: Requirements and entry
docs.text:
Level Base Level 210 or higher Party You must be the leader of a party with only yourself in it. The portal refuses you if anyone else has joined the party. NPC Greedy Looking Man at /navi geffen_in 82/62 Entrance Portal at /navi dali02 79/60 Cooldown Once per day. Entering starts the cooldown, which resets at 04:00 server time. Time limit The instance closes 60 minutes after it is created.
  1. Talk to the Greedy Looking Man in Geffen and agree to join the tournament. This creates the arena.
  2. Talk to him again and choose Yes to be sent to the arena entrance in the Dimensional Gap (dali02).
  3. Step into the Portal to enter.

docs.title: How the tournament works
docs.text:
1. Inside, talk to the Greedy Looking Man (around 1@ge_sn 111/62) to start the next round.
  2. Your opponent is announced and walks into the ring, and a 5-second countdown starts. The opponent appears around 10 seconds after you talk to him.
  3. You have 60 seconds to kill the opponent.
    • If you win, talk to the Greedy Looking Man again to start the next round.
    • If time runs out, the opponent disappears and the tournament is over.
  4. Rounds 1 to 9 draw a random opponent from: Midnight Archi #20856, Midnight Dio Anemos #20857, Midnight Geffen Thief #20858, Midnight Geffen Thug #20859, Midnight Geffen Gangster #20860, Midnight Pa - Monk #20861, Midnight Ordre #20862, Midnight Blut Hase #20863, Midnight Kuro Akuma #20864, Midnight Ipodus #20865, Midnight Rechenier #20866, Midnight Odorico #20867, Midnight Jew #20868, Midnight D.Y. #20869, Midnight Fei Kanabian #20870
  5. Round 10 is always Midnight Fenrir #20872. Beating him completes the tournament.
  6. When the tournament is over (either way), talk to the Greedy Looking Man to collect your reward. You are then sent back to dali02.

You also get 20 to 40 Instance Points when you collect the reward.

Spend the coins and certificates at the Reward Geffen Night Arena vending machine at /navi dali02 85/70. It has a default, special and card shop, plus an enchant option.

Instance Points

Instance Points can be earned once per device for each instance run, up to 1200 per account per day. A rented Charm Of Brightness #30034 adds 50 points per claim. Use @instancepoints to see your total.

docs.title: Guide
docs.text: Ghost Palace replays the fall of Sakray, the royal guard who became bound to the Magic Sword Tartanos. You move through five floors of a haunted palace and clear waves of cursed monsters on each one. At the end you can trade your Gray Shard #6672 to the King's ghost for Thanos weapons and Gray armor.

docs.title: Entering
docs.text:
• Level: 120 or higher.
  • Party: you must be in a party. The party leader talks to the Unpleasant Royal Guard at /navi dali02 43/129 and agrees to help, which creates the instance.
  • Entrance: the Interdimensional Device next to him at /navi dali02 40/134.
  • Cooldown: entering gives you the Cursed Swordman quest. The cooldown does not run for a set number of hours: it ends at the next 04:00 server time. When it has ended, talk to the Royal Guard or the device once to clear the quest, then you can go in again.

docs.title: Walkthrough
docs.text:
Each floor opens once its waves are cleared. A yellow announcement says when the next floor's passage is open. On some waves the next one starts when only one monster is left, so you do not always have to kill the last one.

1st floor: the throne room

  1. Talk to the King at the entrance. When his dialogue ends, monsters attack the castle.
  2. Clear three waves of Cursed Soldier #2948 and Cursed Sentinel #2949.
  3. The passage to the 2nd floor opens at the top of the room.

2nd floor: the princess's chamber

  1. Talk to the Lurid Royal Guard next to Princess Tiara.
  2. Clear three waves of Broken Mind #2950, Floating Word #2951 and Like Love #2952.
  3. The passage to the 3rd floor opens.

3rd floor: the trap

  1. Talk to the King, who accuses the guard of treason. A short scene with Tartanos follows.
  2. Kill the first two waves of Cursed Memory #2953, Colorless Vow #2954 and Old Friendship #2955.
  3. The passage to the 4th floor opens. At the same moment about 30 more of these monsters spawn all over the floor. You do not need to kill them: head for the 4th floor portal at 1@spa 54/28.

4th floor: the massacre

  1. Clear two waves of Sweet Slaughter #2956 and Cursed Sentinel #2949.
  2. Talk to the Lurid Royal Guard among the corpses of the King and his soldiers.
  3. The Visiting Prince turns into Torturous Redeemer #2959, which spawns with one more Sweet Slaughter #2956. Kill both and the passage to the 5th floor opens. The leftover monsters on the 3rd floor are removed.

5th floor: Tiara

  1. Talk to Princess Tiara.
  2. Clear three waves of Forgotten Name #2957, Colorless Vow #2954 and Fatal Days #2958.
  3. After the last wave a short cutscene plays, then Sakray appears. Talk to him.
  4. When the voices stop (about 30 seconds), the Way out of Palace portal and the King (the exchange NPC) appear near 1@spa 210/28.

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
Each player gets their reward when they walk into the Way out of Palace portal, which takes them back to dali02.

Clear Reward First clear ever (per character) 900,000 Base EXP, 500,000 Job EXP and 2× Gray Shard #6672 Every later clear 1× Gray Shard #6672 Every clear 20–40 Instance Points (+50 with Charm Of Brightness #30034), within the server's daily Instance Point limit

Tip

Talk to the King before you step into the exit portal. He only stands inside the instance, so this is your only chance to trade shards for gear.

docs.title: Guide
docs.text: Glastheim Challenge Mode sends the party into a corrupted Old Glast Heim to purify phantoms with Oscar. The party is split in two to clear both wings, then fights a phantom of Amdarais or Himmelmez that has to be kept inside a magic circle. The leader picks a stage from 1 to 10: higher stages give a tougher boss and a much bigger treasure box of Temporal materials.

docs.title: Entering
docs.text:
• NPC: Glastheim Challenge Mode Administrator at /navi glast_01 143/288.
  • Party: needed. The party leader picks create; then everyone picks enter.
  • Level: the script has no level check.
  • Cooldown: entering starts the Glast Heim Challenge Mode quest, which ends at the next 04:00 server time.
  • Time limit: 30 minutes, and the instance closes after 5 minutes with nobody inside.

docs.title: Stages
docs.text:
Inside, the party leader talks to Oscar at the entrance and picks a Contaminated Magic Stage. The stages you can pick depend on how many times you, the leader, have cleared Challenge Mode:

Leader's clears Stages available 0-9 1 10-19 1-2 20-29 1-3 ... one more stage per 10 clears 90 or more 1-10 Stage Boss Max HP 1 600,000,000 2 750,000,000 3 900,000,000 4 1,050,000,000 5 1,200,000,000 6 1,350,000,000 7 1,500,000,000 8 1,650,000,000 9 1,800,000,000 10 2,000,000,000

Everyone inside the instance when the leader claims the reward from Oscar gets the clear counted.

docs.title: Walkthrough
docs.text:
1. Purify both wings

After the leader confirms the stage, the party is split as evenly as possible between the left and right wings. Each wing spawns 50 phantoms: 10 each of Mutating White Knight #20574, Mutating Khalitzburg #20576, Cursed Raydric #20577 and Mutating Raydric Archer #20578, and 20 Cursed Butler #20579. A counter announces how many are left on each side.

When one wing is cleared, a warp opens there that leads toward the other wing, so that group can go help.

2. Meet Oscar at the centre

When both wings are cleared, the warp to the central area opens. Go north ("12 o'clock") and find Oscar. A Phantom Corruption Root #20575 also spawns next to him. The leader talks to Oscar and picks Transform: he walks north and opens the passage to the boss room.

3. Boss: the Phantom of Dark Dhalis

In the boss room the leader talks to Oscar again and picks We're ready. The boss appears in the central magic circle and, 6 seconds later, everyone on the map is pulled into the room. The boss is:

  • Phantom Amdarais #20573 (about 90% of runs), or
  • Phantom Himmelmez #20572 (about 10%).

Keep it in the circle. Every 10 seconds the script checks whether the boss is inside the central magic circle. If it is outside on three checks in a row (about 30 seconds), the purification fails: the boss vanishes without a reward. Oscar reappears, and the leader can talk to him to summon it again.

Every 5 seconds the boss uses one of these:

Attack What happens Wide-range Curse Meteor Storms run outward along the four diagonals from the boss Cross Earthquake ("!!") Heaven's Drive spreads outward in a cross and diagonals around the boss Rage Blast A shorter burst of Heaven's Drive all around the boss Cross Firewall ("!!") Fire Walls run out along the four diagonals Random warp Sometimes nothing; otherwise each player has about a 35% chance to be teleported to a random spot on the map Dark Judgment ("!!") 16 Contaminated Bone Thorns appear in a 4x4 grid over the room and cast Dark Grand Cross six times between 15 and 24 seconds later, then vanish. The boss's other attacks pause meanwhile.

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
When the boss dies, a treasure box and Oscar appear in the boss room.

Treasure box. The first player to click it opens it and the loot drops on the ground around it. Amounts are random, roughly in these ranges:

Stage Sealed Temporal Circlet #25864 Temporal Gemstone #25865 Temporal Spell #25866 Temporal Fragment #25867 1 3-5 - - 6-15 2 3-6 - - 7-20 3 3-7 1-3 - 10-25 4 4-8 1-4 - 12-30 5 5-9 1-4 1-3 15-30 6 6-10 1-5 3-7 17-30 7 6-10 2-5 5-11 18-30 8 6-10 2-6 8-16 19-30 9 8-10 2-6 11-22 20-30 10 8-10 2-7 14-28 22-30

Oscar. Only the party leader can talk to him. This counts the clear for the leader and opens the Exit.

Exit. Each player who uses it returns to glast_01 and earns Instance Points: 20 per stage of the Contaminated Magic Stage fought this run (20 for stage 1, up to 200 for stage 10). Instance Points count toward the daily cap of 1,200.

docs.title: Guide
docs.text: A story instance from the Edda series. You walk into the Pope's dream in Rachel and follow her and her brother Luwmin through three dream areas, fighting temple guards and devotees along the way. The Pope fights at your side as a mercenary. It is effectively solo: only a party leader can step through the dream portal.

docs.title: How to enter
docs.text:
NPC High Priestess Niren in Rachel: /navi rachel 174/138 Portal Dream (next to Niren): /navi rachel 176/145 Level 80+ Party You must be a party leader (a party of one is enough). Only party leaders can use the Dream portal Cooldown Once per day ("Time to Rest"): after entering you must wait until the next 04:00 server time Time limit 2 hours

The first time, talk through Niren's introduction. Then talk to her again to create the dream and use the Dream portal to go in.

docs.title: Difficulty
docs.text:
The difficulty is set by the level of the player who starts the dream (first talks to the Pope inside):

Mode Leader level Monsters Final fight Hunting quest given on entry Casual below 130 Lv 80 ~ 90 versions Enraged Luwmin #3516 Defeat Enraged Luwmin #3516 Hard 130+ Lv 130 ~ 141 versions Enraged Luwmin #3524, then Vision of Ktullanux #3526 Defeat Vision of Ktullanux #3526

The Pope joins you as a mercenary for 30 minutes at the start of each big fight. In hard mode she is the "Casual Pope" mercenary (Casual Pope #3569), in casual mode the "Official Pope" (Official Pope #3570). She leaves when the fight ends.

docs.title: Walkthrough
docs.text:
Dream 1: the temple

  1. Talk to the Pope at the start and follow her through the portal that opens.
  2. Walk up to the Pope further along, then talk to her again in the hall (around 100/98). After a long scene she joins you and the fight starts in three waves: 11 Temple Guard #3510, then 15 Enraged Devotees, then a Enraged High Priest #3514. Each wave appears when the previous one is dead.
  3. Follow the Pope south, watch the scene with Luwmin, and take the portal at the bottom of the map.

Dream 2: the escape

  1. Follow the Pope and Luwmin. Stepping on certain spots along the route (the game points you to them) brings out the next group of guards: Temple Guard #3510, Enraged Devotees and Enraged Dog #3513. Kill each group to move on.
  2. The area ends with another Enraged High Priest #3514 near 57/80.
  3. Follow the strange copy of the Pope to the portal at 130/22.

Dream 3: the cold

  1. Talk to the Pope at 45/66. Enraged Luwmin #3516 appears with six Frozen Hearts (Frozen Heart #3515). Only Luwmin has to die; the Frozen Hearts are removed with him.
  2. Hard mode only: after Luwmin, Vision of Ktullanux #3526 appears with eleven Frozen Hearts. Again only the boss needs to die.
  3. Talk to the Pope (57/68) to finish. An exit appears to the east (79/67) that returns you to Rachel.

docs.title: The Old Doll and rewards
docs.text:
• Each of the three dreams can drop an Old Doll #25087 on the floor as a glowing light: after the High Priest in dreams 1 and 2 (1 in 3 chance each), and after Luwmin in dream 3 (always, if you have none yet). Step on the light to pick it up.
  • At the end, talking to the Pope with the doll in your inventory exchanges it for 350,000 base EXP, 350,000 job EXP and 2 Fragment of Dreams #25088.
  • Back in Rachel, talk to Niren with the hunting quest done for another 126,000 base EXP and 90,000 job EXP.

Match the leader's mode

The hunting quest is given according to your own level (Luwmin below 130, Ktullanux at 130+), but the monsters follow the leader's level. A level 130+ player in a casual run never meets Ktullanux, and a lower-level player in a hard run fights the hard Luwmin, so neither can complete their quest that run.

Tip

Only the first player who talks to the Pope at the end gets the doll reward, so make sure that player is the one carrying the Old Doll #25087.
