docs.title: Guide
docs.text:
The Hall of Life is the second prison of the Garden of Time. Inside waits the Dimensional Criminal Rigel, a doppelganger that stole the body of the Constellation of Life. You fight it twice, and the difficulty is set by a barrier level from 1 to 20 that is stored on your Constellation's Protection #420231. Each clear lets you either raise your barrier level or claim the weekly reward for the level you just cleared. Higher levels give more Circulation of Life #1001456, Fruit of Birth #1001457, Fruit of Extinction #1001458 and, from level 6 on, rarer materials.

The prison is entered with a Hall of Life Key #1001415, which you get from the other prison, the Lake of Fire, once per day.

docs.title: Entering
docs.text:
Unlocking the prisons (one time)

  1. Reach Base Level 250. The Garden of Time (t_garden) is reached through the Dimensional barrier at /navi xmas_fild01 158/246 in the Lutie field; below level 250 the garden sends you back out.
  2. Talk to Oscar at /navi t_garden 119/46 and eavesdrop on his talk with Leticia and Rigel. This starts the Garden of Time story and the Watching Rigel quest.
  3. Walk to /navi t_garden 166/217 and talk to Rigel. He tells you to register on the prison access list.
  4. Talk to the Sealing Spirit Stone at /navi t_garden 166/235 and put your hand on it. You are registered and the two Dimensional Prison gates appear: Lake of Fire on the left (/navi t_garden 158/235) and Hall of Life on the right (/navi t_garden 173/235).

Getting the Constellation's Protection

Talk to the Sealing Spirit Stone again and pick Reissue of the Constellation's protection. If you have no Constellation's Protection #420231 in your inventory or equipped, you get a new one at barrier level 1. It is a lower headgear. The stone only hands one out when you have none, and a reissued one always starts at level 1, so do not throw your old one away.

The Spirit Stone also has an in-game guide (prisoners, barriers, traps, sanctuary, the "other world") that matches the mechanics below.

Every entry

Requirement Details Party Needed. The party leader clicks the Hall of Life gate first and picks Get permission to the Hall of Life; then everyone clicks it again and picks Enter. Blessing Every player must have the Constellation's Protection #420231 equipped to enter. Key Every player needs one Hall of Life Key #1001415. It is used up when you enter. Cooldown 1 hour from the moment you enter (Take a break). The gate refuses you until it has passed, even if your party's instance is still open. Time limit The instance closes after 60 minutes. Weekly reward One claim per account per week. Entering after you claimed is still allowed, you just cannot claim again.

You cannot re-enter a running Hall of Life

The 1-hour cooldown starts the moment you walk in. If you leave, die and get sent out, or disconnect, the gate will not let you back in until the hour has passed. Because of the party check described below, losing a member usually means the run is lost.

docs.title: The barrier level
docs.text:
Your barrier level is the number stored on your Constellation's Protection #420231 (levels 1 to 20). When the fight starts the party leader talks to the criminal and chooses Release Level N Barrier, where N can be anything from 1 up to the leader's own barrier level. Everyone's reward and level-up afterwards is based on the level the leader picked, but a clear only counts up to one level above your own blessing. A level-3 player who clears level 10 is treated as having cleared level 4.

How to raise your level

After the second Rigel dies, a portal appears in the middle of the room. Each player talks to it on their own (with the blessing equipped) and picks one of these:

Choice What happens Increase challenge level Your blessing is replaced with one at the new level (see table). You get no reward from this run. Receive rewards You get the reward for the level that was cleared. This uses your weekly claim. I'll think about it Nothing yet; you can talk to the portal again before leaving. Cleared level compared with your blessing Raise to Cleared level is higher than yours Your level + 1 (a clear counts at most one level above yours) Cleared level is equal to yours Your level + 1 (up to 20) Cleared level is lower than yours Cannot raise; you can only claim the reward

So a player at level 3 who clears level 10 with a level-10 leader goes up to level 4, not 10.

Only players who were inside count

The portal only accepts characters who were inside when the leader released the barrier. A player who walks in after the fight started (or after the clear) gets nothing from the portal.

How you lose a level

Every time you enter, you are marked as "in a correction". Raising your level or claiming the reward removes that mark, and so does talking to the portal after a clear when you have already claimed this week. If it is still there the next time you click the gate (you failed, timed out, or left without choosing), Rigel lowers your barrier level by 1 instead of letting you in. Click the gate again to actually enter. At level 1 nothing is lowered.

Claiming locks your level for the week

After you claim, your level cannot be raised until the weekly reset on Monday at 04:00 server time. Claiming no longer lowers your level on the next entry. On later clears that week, still talk to the portal so the clear is counted and your level is kept.

A simple weekly plan: raise your level with every clear up to the level you want, and claim on your last clear of the week.

docs.title: What the level changes
docs.text:
Both Rigels get stronger with every level:

Stat Bonus per barrier level Max HP, 1st Rigel 450,000,000 + 50,000,000 per level (level 1: 500M, level 13: 1.1B, level 20: 1.45B) Max HP, 2nd Rigel 100,000,000 + 50,000,000 per level (level 1: 150M, level 13: 750M, level 20: 1.1B) RES and MRES +200 STR, AGI, VIT +10 INT, DEX, LUK +20 ATK and MATK +3,000 (capped at 65,000)

The level also sets these mechanics:

Barrier level HP regen every 5 s Damage reduction buff Field skill level Seed traps per volley Sanctuary cycle 1-5 4% 20% 2 up to 2 15 s 6-9 5% 30% 3 up to 3 15 s 10-14 5% 40% 4 up to 5 10 s 15-17 7% 50% 5 up to 6 10 s 18-20 10% 60% 5 up to 7 7 s Barrier level 1-2 3-5 6-8 9-11 12-14 15-17 18-20 Rigel's Illusions in the other world 4 6 8 10 12 14 16

While Rigel is groggy (see the other world below) it takes 4,100% minus 200% per barrier level of normal damage: 3,900% at level 1, 2,100% at level 10, 1,500% at level 13 and 100% (no bonus) at level 20.

Moving purple traps also hit for 20% of your Max HP per barrier level, so from level 5 up a purple trap is practically lethal.

docs.title: Walkthrough
docs.text:
You enter at the south of a square hall. The criminal stands in the middle.

Before you start

  • Get every party member inside first. When the leader starts the fight, the script remembers how many players are on the map. Whenever that number changes (someone leaves, disconnects, or a late member walks in), Rigel becomes immune to damage until it matches again.
  • The leader equips the Constellation's Protection #420231, talks to the criminal in the middle and chooses the barrier level.

Phase 1: Dimensional Criminal Rigel (Rigel #22175)

After a short speech the first Rigel appears. During the whole fight:

  • Regeneration: every 5 seconds it heals the percentage of its Max HP shown in the table above. Your damage must out-pace this.
  • Self-cleanse: every 6 seconds it removes the status effects on itself.
  • Seed traps: every 5 seconds, if players are within 10 cells, it drops seed traps on random nearby players.
  • Field skills: in a loop, blue Mana Barrier markers appear on the floor (either scattered across the hall, or in five rows), flash, and then one of these goes off: Aimed Shower, Blazing Eruption, or Block Seal followed by Block Explosion at the four points around the centre. Step out of marked areas.
  • Death check: while any party member is dead, Rigel is immune ("an infinite amount of power is granted"). Revive fallen members quickly.

Moving traps. Shortly after the fight begins, gates start patrolling back and forth across the hall:

Time after start Traps 10 s 4 purple traps along the outer edge (they move faster) 18 s, 26 s, 34 s, 42 s, 50 s 4 green traps each, closer to the centre each time 58 s 2 more green traps
  • Purple trap: knocks you back and deals 20% of your Max HP per barrier level.
  • Green trap: knocks you back, heals Rigel by 10% of its Max HP and adds +3,000 ATK/MATK to it (up to 65,000). These bonuses stack every time anyone touches one.

Nets. At 26 seconds four Manhole #20582 (15,000,000 HP each) appear around the middle. Every 10 seconds they use Wide Leash to pull players in, then are replaced by fresh ones.

The other world. Also at 26 seconds, a portal opens on the north side of the hall (around the middle of the north wall). It leads to an alternate Hall of Life in a separate part of the map with Rigel's Illusions (Rigel's Illusion #22176): one in each corner plus extra ones depending on the level (table above). In there, Mana Barrier markers appear in a 5x5 grid followed by Frost Field or Lightning Judgement.

  • While the portal is open Rigel heals an extra 3% of Max HP every 5 seconds, plus 3% more for every player who is inside the other world. Send only a few strong, mobile players.
  • When the last illusion dies: all moving traps vanish, Rigel's ATK/MATK goes back to normal (removing all trap bonuses), it becomes groggy for 10 seconds, takes the multiplied damage described above, and stops regenerating, dispelling and planting seeds during that time. A return portal appears in the other world.
  • The trap cycle then starts over (purple traps after 10 s, portal again at 26 s, and so on).

The rhythm of phase 1 is: clear the illusions, burst Rigel during the 10-second groggy window, repeat.

Phase 2: Criminal Rigel (Rigel #22174)

When the first Rigel dies, everyone alive is pulled to the centre and the second Rigel spawns with less HP (see above). Regeneration, self-cleanse, seed traps, field skills, the death check and the player-count check all continue, the nets come back straight away, and new moving traps no longer spawn.

  • Sanctuary: every cycle (15, 10 or 7 seconds depending on level) Rigel marks a 13x13 sanctuary around itself. While Rigel stands within 6 cells of the centre of its latest sanctuary it takes no damage. Pull or lure it at least 7 cells away, then deal damage until the next sanctuary appears under it.

Tip

Traps that were already walking when the first Rigel died are not removed when phase 2 starts, and green ones still heal and empower the new Rigel. Killing the remaining Rigel's Illusions clears them and makes Rigel groggy, but it also restarts the trap cycle.

Finish. When the second Rigel dies, the reward portal appears in the middle of the hall. Talk to it with the blessing equipped to raise your level or claim your reward, as described above. The portal also offers Return to Garden.

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
The reward is for the barrier level the leader picked (at most one above your own), given once per account per week (resets Monday 04:00). The claim also gives Instance Points: 40-60 at level 1, plus 5 per level above 1 (level 10: 85-105, level 20: 135-155).

Level Circulation of Life #1001456 Fruit of Birth #1001457 Fruit of Extinction #1001458 Truth of Life #1001459 Light of Life #1001460 Genesis of Life #1001601 Faint Magical Rune Stone #1001593 1 15 - - - - - - 2 23 8 8 - - - - 3 32 15 15 - - - - 4 41 20 20 - - - - 5 52 25 25 - - - - 6 58 27 27 5 - - - 7 61 30 30 12 - - - 8 68 34 34 20 5 - - 9 78 38 38 22 6 1 3 10 87 43 43 24 8 3 5 11 98 48 48 26 9 5 6 12 111 54 54 29 10 7 9 13 125 60 60 32 11 8 10

All amounts are guaranteed; there is no random roll.

Rewards are only defined up to level 13; clears at level 14 to 20 give the level 13 rewards.

docs.title: Tips
docs.text:
• Your weekly loop needs one Hall of Life Key #1001415 per entry, and the Lake of Fire gives one per day. Do not waste keys on runs your party cannot finish.
  • Bring everyone in before the leader starts, and keep everyone alive and inside: a dead or missing member makes Rigel immune.
  • Avoid the green traps. Each touch heals Rigel 10% and stacks +3,000 ATK/MATK until the illusions are cleared.
  • Keep the number of players going through the north portal small; each one adds 3% healing every 5 seconds.
  • Save burst skills for the 10-second groggy window after the illusions die.

docs.title: Guide
docs.text: Heart Hunter War Base 1 is the Rebellion's assault on the Heart Hunter base in the Terra Gloria main quest. You follow Julian through three security lines, blowing up the barricades with gunpowder, then survive an encounter with Ebel until Julian can stop her. It is a one-time story step: after you clear it, Julian sends you to Heart Hunter War Base 2 instead.

docs.title: Entering
docs.text:
• Quest: you must have reached the Heart Hunter base step of the Terra Gloria main quest.
  • Briefing: talk to Julian at /navi ein_fild04 281/337 to get the Heart Hunter Base occupation quest. You need a party to talk to him.
  • Create: the party leader talks to Julian again and picks I'm ready.
  • Enter: everyone talks to the Striker Unit Commander at /navi ein_fild04 275/342.
  • Cooldown: entering starts Base maintenance, which ends at the next 04:00 server time.
  • Time limit: 1 hour.

Tip

Which base Julian opens depends on the party leader's story progress, and the commander sends you to the base that matches your own progress. Party up with players at the same step, or the commander cannot find your instance.

docs.title: Walkthrough
docs.text:
Robot turrets

The robots along each security line hit anyone who walks next to them for 40% of their Max HP. Wait for Julian to disable them.

Start. Walk forward from the entrance. Julian gives a short speech, the Rebellion soldiers move out, and 24 Heart Hunter Guard #3627 appear in the yard ahead.

Section 1

  1. Walk up to Julian at the first barricade (around 105, 50). He warns about the security system and a Pile of gunpowder appears to the north-west (around 58, 90).
  2. Click the pile. 5 Antique Gunpowder #25154 drop on the ground next to it; pick them up. The alarm sounds and about 9 seconds later 24 more Heart Hunter Guards arrive near the barricade.
  3. Give the gunpowder to Julian. He blows up the barricade, which also kills all the guards in the section, and disables the robots in the gap.

Section 2

  1. Walk through to Julian at the second barricade (around 140, 50). He sends you north to check for threats.
  2. Push the Suspicious instrument (around 150, 119). 16 Heart Hunter Guards spawn around it. Each guard you kill has a 5% chance to call an Upgraded Heart Hunter #3626. A counter shows how many are left.
  3. When they are all dead, go back to Julian. He blows up the second barricade.

Section 3

  1. Walk on to Julian at the last barricade (around 238, 39). He has run out of gunpowder, and 18 Heart Hunter Guards attack.
  2. Find the Pile of gunpowder to the west (around 163, 58) and click it for 5 more Antique Gunpowder #25154.
  3. Give the gunpowder to Julian. He opens the last barricade.

Ebel

Walk east to the communication room (around 310, 47). After a long conversation, Heart Hunter Ebel #3628 appears. You do not have to kill her: hold out for about 30 seconds until Julian fires his paralyzing shot and she is removed. Warps at the room's exits push you back if you try to run.

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
Talk to Julian afterwards. If this is your first clear (your Heart Hunter Base occupation quest is still open), you get 10 Schwarz's Honor Token #25155, the quest completes and your story moves on. Julian then sends you back to ein_fild04.

[Walkthrough conversion] Require Terra Gloria main quest.

docs.title: Guide
docs.text: After the Heart Hunter base falls in the Terra Gloria main quest, Julian turns its outer grounds into a training course. In this repeatable version you play the attackers: fight through two defended sections and a robot maze, then spar with Ebel. Each clear gives Instance Points.

docs.title: Entering
docs.text:
• Quest: clear Heart Hunter War Base 1 first.
  • Party: needed. The party leader talks to Julian at /navi ein_fild04 281/337 and agrees to examine the training ground, which creates the instance.
  • Enter: everyone talks to the Striker Unit Commander at /navi ein_fild04 275/342.
  • Cooldown: entering starts Base maintenance, which ends at the next 04:00 server time.
  • Time limit: 1 hour.

Tip

Julian opens Base 1 or Base 2 depending on the party leader's story progress, and the commander sends each player to the base matching their own progress. Everyone in the party needs to be past Base 1.

docs.title: Walkthrough
docs.text:
Robot turrets

The robots in the security lines and the maze hit anyone who walks next to them for 40% of their Max HP.

Start. The party leader talks to Julian at the entrance. If you answer that it is your first visit he explains the training at length; otherwise he keeps it short.

Section 1. 21 Heart Hunter Guard #3627 defend the yard. Each kill has a 5% chance to call an Upgraded Heart Hunter #3626. A counter shows how many are left. When they are all dead, walk north to the first security line (around 31, 211): it shuts down and the passage opens.

Section 2. Walk on to Julian (around 31, 233). After his speech, 24 Heart Hunter Guards defend the next yard, this time with a 10% chance per kill to call an Upgraded Heart Hunter. Clearing them shuts down the second security line.

Section 3: the maze.

  1. Talk to Julian (around 56, 283), then push the red button on the SWT_8309 robot next to him.
  2. The robots turn the area into a maze with one of six random layouts, and 40 Heart Hunter Guards defend it.
  3. You only need to bring the defence down to 20 or fewer: the rest are removed, Julian announces that the defence failed, and the door to the boss room opens.

Boss: Ebel. Go through the door, then the party leader talks to Julian and starts the test. After some dialogue the room's automatic defence robots switch on and Heart Hunter Ebel #3628 attacks. Kill her; the robots shut down again.

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
After the closing dialogue (about 40 seconds), a warp opens up the stairs behind Julian. Walking into it gives each player 20-40 Instance Points (up to the daily cap of 1,200) and returns you to ein_fild04.

docs.text: Hey! Sweety is a daily from Episode 17.2. Sweety, the battle-hungry automaton in the unofficial lounge, wants a rematch, and Manager Beta Almond lets you fight him in the twilight garden. Two daily quests are attached: beat Sweety, and collect broken doll cores in the garden. Both pay Barmil Ticket #1000103 and EXP.

docs.title: Entering
docs.text:
Unlocking (one time)

  1. Finish the Episode 17.2 main story up to the unofficial lounge.
  2. Talk to Manager Beta Almond at /navi ba_in01 28/255, then to Sweety next to her at /navi ba_in01 32/250 (Conversation with Sweetie).

Every day

  1. Talk to Sweety and pick Apply for battle, then I can. This gives the hunting quest Hey! Sweetie (defeat Sweety #20642 once).
  2. Talk to Almond. While your hunting quest is open she lets you create and enter the instance. If your core collection is not on cooldown she also gives you the Core collection quest.

  3. You need a party. The party leader picks Create, then everyone picks Enter.

  4. Cooldowns: each daily quest has its own cooldown that ends at the next 04:00 server time. The instance itself has no cooldown, but Almond only lets you in while Hey! Sweetie is open.

  5. Inventory: Almond and Sweety refuse to talk if you are carrying too much.
  6. Time limit: 1 hour.

docs.title: Walkthrough
docs.text:
1. You arrive in the lounge corridor. When the party leader steps forward from the entrance, Sweety and Almond appear, a passage to the twilight garden opens at the west end, and 16 monsters spawn in the garden: 11 Heart Hunter Skirmisher #20681 and 5 Heart Hunter Commander #20699.
  2. Optional, for the core quest: go into the garden. The Heart Hunters there drop Core of a Broken Doll #1000226 (50% each while you have Core collection). There are also 9 broken Manager Beta bodies lying around the garden; clicking one gives a core 60% of the time. Each body can only be searched once per instance, by anyone.
  3. Talk to Sweety and pick Let's go! to start the fight. Defeat Sweety #20642.
  4. Talk to Almond and pick Let's wrap up. to return to the lounge.

Tip

The garden only has 16 monsters and 9 bodies per run, so 10 cores is not guaranteed in one visit. Bodies already searched by a party member are empty for everyone.

docs.text: The Hidden Flower Garden is the story instance of Episode 17.2 that introduces the automatic dolls' secret garden behind Varmundt's Mansion. It is mostly a guided tour with conversations, plus one short fight. Clearing it gives you Security Clearance, which unlocks the daily Security Area 1 and Security Area 2.

docs.title: How to enter
docs.text:
• Where: Walk up to the security perimeter at /navi ba_maison 120/320 in Varmundt's Mansion. The hidden Flower Garden Manager appears.
  • Story: You need to have started the Episode 17.2 main story.
  • Party: You need a party, and only the party leader can talk to the manager. Pick "Authenticate Identity" to create the instance. Then talk to the manager again and pick "Enter".
  • The manager only offers this story version until you have finished it once. After that, she offers the Security Areas instead.

docs.title: Walkthrough
docs.text:
1. Control screen. Inside, touch the screen of the device (56/278). It may take a few tries ("Try entering a different pattern"). An automatic doll boots up and asks you to act as a temporary administrator, then asks you to name her. She guides you from here on.
  2. The garden tour. Follow the doll and talk to her and the other dolls along the way. She takes you past the carrot fields, a wandering Pitaya keeper and the dolls' workplaces. The instance moves you from area to area as the story goes on.
  3. Intruder alert. At the third area (around 201/287), follow the doll. The security system detects you and sends 3 Surveillance Dolls (Alicel #1739). Defeat all three, then talk to the doll again. Ask your questions until "Guide me to the security area." appears.
  4. Sigma. You are moved to the security area entrance (85/106). The doll leads you to Sigma, who looks just like Varmundt. Talk through the whole conversation and answer his questions. At the end, another Red Pepper doll cuts in and shuts the area down.
  5. Reward. Talk to Sigma one last time to finish the quest and leave.

You are returned to ba_maison 136/309.

docs.title: Guide
docs.text: The High Priest's Villa is a one-time story instance from the Episode 18 main quest. With Miriam and the guide Ira you search the villa of Yus Amal, find the keys to its locked rooms, beat Schulang the Traitor, and finally face the Twisted God. Clearing it advances the main quest; there is no item reward. The repeatable version is Villa of Deception.

docs.title: Entering
docs.text:
• Quest: only at the matching step of the Episode 18 main quest. Ira appears at /navi oz_dun01 219/117 when you reach it.
  • Party: the party leader picks Apply for 'High Priest's Villa'; then everyone picks Enter.
  • Cooldown: none.
  • Time limit: 1 hour.

Most steps inside only react to the party leader.

docs.title: Walkthrough
docs.text:
1. Ground floor

  1. The party leader talks to Miriam at the entrance and listens to her and Ira. Talk to her again: she goes to question one employee and asks you to find another.
  2. Talk to the Villa Employee to the west and ask about Amal. Then return to Miriam.
  3. Two disguised Heart Hunter #21312 attack. Kill them.
  4. Back at the entrance, the party leader talks to Miriam again. 12 more Heart Hunters attack along the hall. When they are dead Miriam walks north up the central stairs; follow her and talk to her at the top.

2. The keys

  1. Miriam heads east and 11 Heart Hunters appear along the west corridor. Kill them all to find the Silver Key at the north end of the corridor.
  2. Use the Silver Key on the Locked Door on the west side. Kill the 3 Heart Hunters in the room, then pick up the Gold Key.
  3. Talk to Miriam in the east wing, then talk to the Villa Employees in the east room.
  4. Open the Locked Door to the central room with the key. 11 Heart Hunters spawn around it; kill them all.

3. The garden

  1. Click both Brilliant Articles on either side of the ornate door to the north, then go through the door.
  2. Five devices are spread across the garden. Only one of them, chosen at random, opens the way: use them (5 seconds each) until the right one works.
  3. Go through the Elegant Door to the north.

4. Schulang

The party leader talks to Schulang. He attacks together with two Heart Hunters: kill Schulang #21314 and both guards. The way into the last room opens.

5. The Twisted God

The party leader talks to Yus Amal. After the revelation, Twisted God Freyja #21315 appears together with a resurrected Schulang, who immediately drops Cane of Evil Eye on four spots south of the throne, where you are standing. Only the Twisted God has to die; the resurrected Schulang disappears with it.

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
Talk to Miriam in the boss room afterwards to advance the Episode 18 main quest. The exit NPC next to her takes you back to oz_dun01.

docs.text: The Horror Toy Factory is a Christmas-themed instance in Lutie with four parts. You sneak through the factory dressed as a Christmas Cookie, question the workers, chase down the plant manager Antonio, and then fight the doll Celine Kimi and her Phantom.

docs.title: How to enter
docs.text:
• NPC: Catherine Jet Johnson, /navi xmas 237/303. The Factory Dimension Telep portal next to her (/navi xmas 233/305) is the entrance.
  • Level: Base Level 140 or higher.
  • First time: Talk to Catherine and go through her story to accept the quest "Skull-faced Girl". Talk to her again to finish it. After that she offers the instance.
  • Party: You need a party. The party leader picks "Unlock Horror Toy Factory". Then every member enters through the portal.
  • Cooldown: Entering starts a daily cooldown that resets at 04:00 server time ("Trail of Toy Factory"). When it ends, talk to Catherine or the portal once to clear it.
  • You can't talk to these NPCs while you are transformed.

docs.title: Factory No.1: Disguise and clear the line
docs.text:
1. The party leader talks to Catherine inside. Pick the story option or "I know your situation. Let's start quickly!".
  2. Three Employees' Uniform Boxes appear. Using one turns you into a Christmas Cookie #1246 for 3 minutes.
  3. The factory floor fills with Vicious Cookie #2989 and Evil Dwelling Box #2991, 67 in total. Kill them until fewer than 30 remain.
  4. Alarm zones cover Factory No.1. If you walk into one while not disguised as a Cookie, 4–6 Corrupt Cruiser #2990 spawn around you. A triggered zone resets after 45 seconds. The zones switch off once the line is cleared.

When enough monsters are dead, the line coordinator (a Cookie NPC) appears at 71/129:

  • The party leader, still disguised as a Cookie, talks to him. This unlocks a box next to him at 65/127.
  • Use that box while you are a Cookie to turn into a Myst Case #1249 for 3 minutes. Only a Myst Case can use the warps at 76/129 and at the end of the conveyor (179/129) into Factory No.2.
  • If someone talks to the coordinator without the Cookie disguise, 11 guards spawn and he disappears for 60 seconds.

docs.title: Factory No.2: Ask the workers
docs.text:
1. The party leader talks to Catherine at 185/100. A new Uniform Box appears next to her, which gives a 5 minute Cookie disguise. Malicious Baby Ghost #2993, Evil Dwelling Box #2991, Abandoned Teddy Bear #2995 and Creepy Demon #2992 spawn around the area.
  2. 10 Workers appear around the factory. Talk to each one while disguised as a Cookie and pick "Do you know about the doll maker?". Each worker shares a piece of Kimi's story and then disappears.
  3. If you talk to a worker without the disguise, they call 21 guards. That worker still counts as done.
  4. When all 10 are done, the line shuts down and the warp at 130/178 to the lounge opens.

docs.title: Factory No.3: Catch Antonio
docs.text:
Walk toward the Captured Santa (around 131/208) to start a cutscene. Afterwards:

  • Large groups of Dancing Marionette #2994, Decorated Evil Tree #2987, Abandoned Teddy Bear #2995, Creepy Demon #2992 and Malicious Baby Ghost #2993 spawn in the west hall and the north-east room.
  • Wicked Vice Plant Manage #2988 (Antonio) spawns hidden among them. There is a 70% chance he is in the west hall and a 30% chance he is in the north-east room. Find him and kill him.

Killing Antonio removes the remaining monsters and opens the way to the boss through the warp at 152/208.

docs.title: Final boss: Celine Kimi and Kimi's Phantom
docs.text:
Walk up to Kimi (around 222/183) to trigger the cutscene. Then Celine Kimi #2996 and Kimi's Phantom #2997 spawn together, each with 20,000,000 HP.

  • Keep their HP even. Every 10 seconds, if one of them has more than 100,000 HP more than the other, the healthier one heals both of them: they are set to its HP plus half the difference. Split your damage evenly and kill them together.
  • Keep Kimi in her room. If Celine Kimi is pulled outside her area (roughly 211–241 / 166–201), the fight resets and both disappear. Walk back to her spot to start again at full HP.
  • Hell's inferno: Every 10 seconds she may either shoot lines of fire in four directions or set up to 21 fire spots around herself (Hell Burning from invisible helpers). Move out of the fire.
  • Both bosses also use Dark Strike, Dark Thunder, Pulse Strike, Max Pain and wide Sleep, Stone and Soul Drain attacks.

When both are dead, the warp at 205/159 opens to the emergency exit.

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
Ten Packaged Presents appear by the exit. Anyone can open them. Every present drops 2–8 Bloody Coin #7642 plus a chance at:

Item Chance per present that can drop it Gift Box #644 85% Old Blue Box #603 60% Old Purple Box #617 40% Old Card Album #616 30% Gold Bullion #7228 30% Mystical Card Album #12246 20% Silver Bullion #7229 15% Closed Mind Box #22534 10% Old Parasol [3] #13442, Shadow Walk [1] #2486, Red Lantern [1] #2976, Hurt Mind [1] #2977, Kind Heart [1] #2978, Lush Rose [1] #18848 5% (each from one specific present)

Walk to Catherine near the exit, then use the exit portal at 218/150 and pick "Go outside". You receive 20–40 Instance Points, which count toward the daily 1,200 cap, and you are warped back to Lutie.

Tip

  • Cookie disguises only last 3 minutes (5 minutes from the Factory No.2 box). Re-use a Uniform Box before talking to the coordinator or the workers.
  • Bring your Bloody Coins to the merchants next to Catherine in Lutie: Billy The Golden Hands (xmas 240/291), Vagrant Cain (xmas 240/297) and Black Beard Joe (xmas 240/294).

docs.title: Guide
docs.text: Immortal is the Episode 20 daily boss instance. The party removes the seal on Lasgand #21981 and fights him while his untouchable Demigod Lasgand #21979 (the "Vision of Lasgand") roams the arena. The whole fight is about keeping Lasgand far away from his Vision and keeping everyone alive.

docs.title: Requirements and entry
docs.text:
Level Base Level 215 or higher Prerequisite Episode 20 main quest completed Party Required. The party leader creates the instance and starts the fight. NPC Branches of the World Tree at /navi jor_twig 114/147 Modes Immortal (normal) and Immortal (Hard) Cooldown One entry per day across both modes. Entering starts the cooldown, which resets at 04:00 server time. Time limit 30 minutes

The leader talks to the Branches of the World Tree and picks Create Immortal or Create Immortal (Hard). Everyone then talks to it again and picks Enter.

docs.title: The fight
docs.text:
1. The leader talks to the sealed Lasgand in the middle of the room and picks Remove the seal and attack.
  2. Lasgand #21981 spawns in the centre. His Vision spawns at a random spot to the west, east or south.
  3. The Vision cannot be damaged or killed and is immune to status effects. Ignore it and keep away from it.

Distance is everything. Every few seconds the script checks how far Lasgand is from his Vision:

  • The closer they are, the less damage Lasgand takes (damage reduction ranges from very high when they are together to much lower when they are far apart).
  • The Vision visibly grows as it gets closer to Lasgand and shrinks as it moves away, so you can judge the distance from its size.
  • Pull Lasgand away from the Vision and keep the fight there.

Lasgand's extra attacks (every 4 seconds, picked at random):

Attack Normal Hard Meteor Storm in a 3x3 grid around him 15% 40% Heaven's Drive in a 3x3 grid around him 45% 40% Cloud Kill 25% 5% Nothing 15% 15%

When Lasgand and the Vision are more than 8 cells apart, his Meteor and Heaven's Drive attacks also hit points along the line between him and the Vision. Cloud Kill is cast along that line too. Don't stand between the two.

The Vision's attacks (every 2 seconds): Heaven's Drive in a 3x3 grid around itself (55%) or Storm Gust (25%, level 1 in Normal and level 10 in Hard).

Nobody may die

Every 2 seconds the script checks the party. If any member is dead, or the party no longer has the same number of members as when the seal was removed, Lasgand becomes invincible and the message "There is a death in the party" appears. He stays invincible until everyone is alive again. Resurrect fallen members right away, and don't invite, kick or let anyone leave the party during the fight.

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
When Lasgand dies, a Suspicious Storage Box #22004 (Normal) or EP20_MD_BOX2 #22005 (Hard) appears, along with Nyar at the north side of the room. Each player credited with the Lasgand kill talks to Nyar for:

Reward Normal Hard Pure Magical Crystal #1001249 1–2 1–2 Antiquity box Antiquity Issgard (Ultimate Lasgand) #102567 Antiquity Issgard (Ultimate Lasgand (Hard)) #102568 Base / Job EXP 34,152,989 / 5,567,916 34,152,989 / 5,567,916 White Cat Alliance reputation +20 +20 Instance Points 40–60 60–80

Afterwards, pick Go outside to return to jor_twig.

Instance Points

Instance Points can be earned once per device for each instance run, up to 1200 per account per day. A rented Charm Of Brightness #30034 adds 50 points per claim. Use @instancepoints to see your total.

docs.text: A 50-floor climb under the sunken Paros Lighthouse. Each floor is a small room: kill everything in it and a portal opens to the next. Every tenth floor holds an "Infinite" MVP and a treasure chest full of Broken Magic Stone #6905, the currency for the Infinity weapons sold outside. A harder mode adds random mini-bosses and better chests.

docs.title: How to enter
docs.text: NPC Reckless Explorer in the Comodo field: /navi cmd_fild07 63/275 Portal Temporary Entrance: /navi cmd_fild07 54/280 Level 100+ Party Required. A party member asks the Reckless Explorer to prepare Infinite Space, then everyone uses the Temporary Entrance Prerequisite Hear the Reckless Explorer's story once ("Fallen Paros Lighthouse") Cooldown 3 hours per character, starting when you enter Time limit 1 hour

docs.title: Choosing the mode
docs.text:
Inside, the party leader talks to the Reckless Explorer at the start (42/8):

Normal Hard Choice "I want to proceed normally" "I want to proceed with something difficult" Extra mini-boss on a normal floor - 10% chance per floor Floor bosses call for help - Yes, every 5 seconds while alive Shining Poring chance 1% 2% Chest: Broken Magic Stone #6905 3 ~ 10 6 ~ 22 Chest: Infinity weapons - 1% for each of the 10 weapons

The first floor's monsters appear as soon as the mode is chosen.

docs.title: Climbing the floors
docs.text:
1. Kill every monster on the floor. Five seconds after the last one dies, a portal opens.
  2. Step through the portal: the next floor's monsters spawn when the first player arrives.
  3. Floors 1 ~ 49 use upgraded versions of familiar field monsters (Poring #3384 on floor 1, getting stronger up to Dryad #3420 near the top).
  4. Hard mode: each normal floor has a 10% chance to add one of Infinite Toad #3421, Infinite Vagabond Wolf #3422, Infinite Vocal #3423, Infinite Eclipse #3424 or Infinite Chimera #3425 (never the same one twice in a row). It must die too.

Shining Poring

Every wave and every kill has a small chance (1%, or 2% in hard mode) to spawn a Shining Poring #3494 somewhere on the current floor. It vanishes after 20 seconds, so drop everything and hunt it.

docs.title: Boss floors
docs.text:
Floor Boss Escort 10 Infinite Eddga #3426 5 helpers 20 Infinite Osiris #3427 7 helpers 30 Infinite Phreeoni #3428 7 helpers 40 Infinite Orc Hero #3429 6 helpers 50 Infinite Tao Gunka #3430 6 helpers

In hard mode, starting 10 seconds after it appears, each boss calls in another group of 3 ~ 5 monsters every 5 seconds for as long as it lives, so kill it fast.

When a boss floor is cleared, a treasure chest appears. Only the party leader can open it; the contents drop on the floor around it (see the mode table above). The hard-mode weapons are the Infinity weapons: Infinity Whip [1] #1994, Infinity Violin [1] #1938, Infinity Shuriken [1] #13323, Infinity Pistol [1] #13126, Infinity Dagger [1] #28703, Infinity Two-Handed Staff [1] #2024, Infinity Mace [1] #16038, Infinity Two-Handed Sword [1] #21014, Infinity Axe [1] #28105 and Infinity Bow [1] #18128.

docs.title: Finishing
docs.text:
After floor 50, talk to the Reckless Explorer who appears at the end (366/392). She sends you back to cmd_fild07 and gives 50 ~ 100 Instance Points on Normal or 70 ~ 120 on Hard (see Instance Points).

Warning

The instance only lasts one hour. A party that cannot clear 50 floors in time gets the floor-10/20/30/40 chests but not the Instance Points at the end.

docs.title: Spending Broken Magic Stones
docs.text:
Back outside, the Artifact Appraiser (/navi cmd_fild07 57/275) sells each Infinity weapon or armor for 50 Broken Magic Stone #6905, and the Artifact Enhancer next to her (/navi cmd_fild07 60/275) uses them to enchant that equipment.

docs.text: Isle of Bios is a short three-island memorial dungeon from the Morocc storyline. You clear two islands of corrupted monsters, then survive three waves and a boss fight against Reaper Yanku #3029 on the final island.

docs.title: Requirements and entry
docs.text:
Level Base Level 160 or higher Party Required (a party of 1 is enough). Only the party leader can create the dungeon. Prerequisite Talk to Wandering Old Man at /navi moro_cav 45/60 once to unlock access. Entrance Yellow Seed at /navi moro_cav 50/64 Cooldown One run per day. The lockout resets daily at 04:00 server time.

The leader talks to the Yellow Seed and picks Create Memorial dungeon, then everyone talks to it again and picks Enter Isle of Bios.

Re-entering

For the first 5 minutes after your first entry you can still re-enter (for example after a disconnect). After those 5 minutes, or once you have claimed the reward, the Seed refuses entry until the daily reset. The NPC text says "23 hours", but the lockout actually ends at the next 04:00 reset.

docs.title: Walkthrough
docs.text:
Island 1

  1. Walk up to Vrid and Zeith near the entrance. A short cutscene plays where Grim Reaper Ankou reveals himself.
  2. Kill every monster on the island: Corrupt Orc Baby #3010, Corrupt Baby Desert Wol #3011 and Corrupt Familiar #3012. The system announces when 10, 5 and 1 monsters are left.
  3. When the island is clear, the exit portal on the east side (3 o'clock) opens. It takes you to Island 2.

Island 2

  1. Same as Island 1, with stronger monsters: Corrupt Orc Warrior #3013, Corrupt Desert Wolf #3014 and Corrupt Phen #3015.
  2. Clear them all to open the east exit to Island 3.

Island 3: the Grim Reaper

  1. Walk up to Vrid and Zeith. Ankou appears, freezes your friends and casts a Storm Gust. Every party member within about 30 cells is frozen for 17.5 seconds.
  2. Three waves spawn one after another in the area north of the NPCs, 27 monsters each. The next wave only appears once the previous one is dead:
    1. Corrupt Orc Zombie #3016
    2. Corrupt Verit #3017
    3. Corrupt Megalodon #3018
  3. After the third wave, Reaper Yanku #3029 spawns in the middle of the arena. Kill him to free Vrid and Zeith.

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
When Ankou is dead, each party member talks to Vrid to claim their reward and is then warped back to Morocc Cave:

Reward Amount Token Of Hero #6684 1 Instance Points 20 to 40 (random)

Reaper Yanku #3029 also always drops a Prize Of Hero #22537 on the ground when it dies, so loot it before talking to Vrid. The box gives one random reward; open the item to see what's inside.

Instance Points

Instance Points can be earned once per device for each instance run, up to 1200 per account per day. A rented Charm Of Brightness #30034 adds 50 points per claim. Use @instancepoints to see your total.

Tip

Stay out of the arena until the whole party is ready. The freeze hits everyone close to the NPCs, and the first wave spawns right when it ends.

docs.text: Iwin Patrol is the Episode 19 daily of the Eagle Patrol in Isgard's Ice Castle. You do not fight anything required: you walk the patrol route with four Iwin soldiers across the Frozen Scale area, passing five checkpoints, and get a big chunk of EXP, Snow Flower #1000608 and Isgard reputation at the end.

docs.title: Entering
docs.text:
• Unlock: at the matching step of the Episode 19 main quest, talk to the Captain of Patrol at /navi icecastle 23/115 and sign the papers to become an honorary member of the Eagle Patrol.
  • Party: needed, even if you go alone. The party leader talks to the Captain and picks Report the number of patrols to create the instance; everyone then picks I will go on patrol.
  • Cooldown: the reward starts [Standby] Patrol with Irwin, which ends at the next 04:00 server time. While it runs you can still join a party's patrol, but you get no reward.
  • Time limit: 1 hour.
  • Inventory: the Captain refuses to talk if you are carrying too much.

Do not abandon a patrol

Entering marks you as "on patrol". If you talk to the Captain again before finishing (for example after leaving the instance), he cancels it and puts you on the daily cooldown with no reward.

docs.title: Walkthrough
docs.text:
1. Start the patrol. Talk to the Guard Captain next to the entrance. He leaves, and the four Iwin soldiers set off on the patrol route, chatting as they go.

2. Walk with the patrol. Five invisible checkpoints lie along the route. Each one only counts for you after the patrol has reached that part of the route, and they must be passed in order:

Checkpoint Around (x, y) Counts once the patrol has passed 1 279, 80 311, 94 2 131, 110 115, 77 3 145, 306 150, 281 4 240, 373 215, 354 5 264, 310 244, 343

The easiest way is simply to stay with the soldiers until the end. If you run ahead, a checkpoint you cross too early does not count and you have to come back to it.

3. Report in. When the patrol nears the end, the Guardmaster appears at the end of the route (around 301, 315). Wait until the soldiers announce their arrival, then talk to him.

One Shining Seaweed, one Ice Gangu and one Ice Straw roam the area. They are not part of the patrol.

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
The Guardmaster rewards each player who passed all five checkpoints:

Reward Amount Base EXP 52,243,795 Job EXP 3,000,000 Snow Flower #1000608 2, or 3 with maximum (3,000) Isgard reputation Isgard reputation +5

He then offers to take you back to the Ice Castle. Exit warps also stand at the entrance and at two points along the route.

docs.title: Side quest: Do not Feed Wildlife
docs.text:
If you have this Ice Castle daily, ten patches of Something (dirt) along the route can be searched. Each search is 50% plain dirt, 10% five bugs that attack you, and 40% a Monster's Feed #528, which completes the step; bring it to Supply Officer Gorir. A searched patch comes back after 30 seconds.

docs.text: The Lake of Fire is the first prison of the Garden of Time. One of the four Divine Beasts, the former guards of the prison, is held here. It starts out completely invulnerable: you have to lure it over seven barriers spread around the lava lake to strip its defence, then kill it. Every player who finishes gets that season's Energy, a stack of Dimensional Crystal Fragment #1001414 and the Hall of Life Key #1001415 needed to enter the Hall of Life.

docs.title: Entering
docs.text:
Unlocking the prisons (one time)

  1. Reach Base Level 250 and enter the Garden of Time through the Dimensional barrier at /navi xmas_fild01 158/246 (Lutie field).
  2. Talk to Oscar at /navi t_garden 119/46 to start the Garden of Time story.
  3. Talk to Rigel at /navi t_garden 166/217, then register at the Sealing Spirit Stone at /navi t_garden 166/235.

Every entry

Requirement Details Gate Dimensional Prison (left gate) at /navi t_garden 158/235 Party Needed. The party leader clicks the gate first and picks Get permission to the Lake of Fire; then everyone clicks it and picks Enter. Cooldown Once per day. Entering starts the cooldown, which ends at the next 04:00 server time. Time limit The instance closes after 60 minutes. Inventory You need some free inventory space and weight, or the gate refuses you.

Everyone in before the fight starts

The cooldown starts as soon as you enter, so you cannot come back in after leaving. Your reward depends on a hunting quest that is given when you arrive at the entrance, and only until the leader wakes the beast. A player who enters after that does not get the quest and receives no reward.

docs.title: The four Divine Beasts
docs.text:
Each instance picks one beast at random:

Beast Field skill in the final phase Energy reward Spring Divine Beast Aimed Shower Energy of Spring #1001440 Summer Divine Beast Block Seal followed by Block Explosion Energy of Summer #1001441 Autumn Divine Beast Blazing Eruption Energy of Autumn #1001442 Winter Divine Beast Frost Field Energy of Winter #1001443

docs.title: Walkthrough
docs.text:
1. Wake the beast

You arrive at the west end of the lake. The beast is sleeping next to the entrance. Once everyone has arrived, the party leader talks to it and picks I wish to receive the Hall of Life key. After a short speech it spawns as a monster.

2. Lure it over the seven barriers

At first the beast takes no damage at all. Seven Mana Storm barriers are placed around the lake:

Barrier Coordinates (x, y) 1 24, 154 2 95, 182 3 51, 93 4 93, 58 5 129, 58 6 94, 35 7 43, 35

The barriers trigger when the beast walks onto them, so have it chase someone across each one. The order does not matter. Each barrier disappears once used, briefly stuns the beast, and lowers its defence:

Barriers triggered Damage the beast takes 0 0% 1 5% 2 10% 3 20% 4 30% 5 40% 6 50% 7 100%, final phase starts

While you kite it, invisible bombs keep spawning within 8 cells of the beast (five at a time, about every 3 seconds) and self-destruct. Keep moving and do not let the party bunch up next to it.

3. Final phase

After the seventh barrier the beast teleports to the east side of the lake (176, 163) and every living party member is pulled there with it. The bombs stop, it now takes full damage, and it starts its field skill in a loop:

  • Spring, Summer and Autumn: blue Mana Barrier markers appear at random spots within 10 cells of the beast, flash, and then the beast's skill (table above) goes off at four points 10 cells diagonally around it.
  • Winter: a 5x5 grid of markers appears around a spot near the beast, then Frost Field goes off from its centre.

Step out of the marked area when the markers flash.

4. Leave

When the beast dies, a portal appears just north of that spot (176, 166). Talk to it to get your reward and return to the Garden of Time.

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
Each player who completed the hunting quest for the beast (it counts the kill) receives, from the exit portal:

Item Amount Energy of the beast's season (Energy of Spring #1001440, Energy of Summer #1001441, Energy of Autumn #1001442 or Energy of Winter #1001443) 5 Dimensional Crystal Fragment #1001414 10 Hall of Life Key #1001415 1 Instance Points 40-60 (random)

The key is consumed when you enter the Hall of Life, so one Lake of Fire per day means one Hall of Life entry per day.

docs.text: The Last Room is a short instance behind a sealed door underground. You follow Verity's group into an abandoned facility, survive its automated defense protocols, and confront the mysterious machine T_W_O in the Mother Room.

docs.title: How to enter
docs.text:
• NPC: Mark, /navi un_myst 163/38.
  • Level: Base Level 150 or higher.
  • Party: You need a party. The party leader picks "Open door.". Then everyone picks "Go in.".
  • Cooldown: Entering starts a daily cooldown that resets at 04:00 server time ("Final Room"). Talk to Mark once after it ends to clear it.
  • On your first entry you also get the hunting quest "Final Room", which asks you to defeat T_W_O.

docs.title: Step 1: First protocol
docs.text:
1. The party leader talks to Verity near the entrance. She suddenly feels ill, and Tamarin stays behind with her.
  2. Walk through the door at 140/45. The facility wakes up ("Intruder detected"), and the first protocol starts:
    • 24 Machine Component #3251 / Machine Component #3252 spawn along the corridor, from the entrance up toward 67/97.
    • One System message #3253 spawns somewhere in the western area (around 30–70 / 33–73).
    • If the protocol is still running after 5 minutes, another 24 Machine Components spawn, and again at 10 minutes.
  3. The step ends when every monster of the protocol is dead, including that one System message. Then Tamarin appears at 67/97.

Tip

Do not forget the lone System message in the west. The protocol does not end while it is alive, and the extra waves keep coming.

docs.title: Step 2: Zone 2
docs.text:
The party leader talks to Tamarin. He tells you Verity ran ahead, and the warp at 100/121 opens to Zone 2.

  • The floor of Zone 2 has 15 cracks. Stepping on one sets off an alarm, and 3 Machine Components spawn in the south-east part of the zone.
  • Follow the path to Verity at 224/29 and pick "Go inside." to enter the Mother Room.

docs.title: Step 3: Mother Room, T_W_O
docs.text:
Talk to Verity inside the Mother Room. A few seconds later the final protocol starts and T_W_O #3254 appears.

  • T_W_O uses Piercing Attack, Silence Attack, Critical Wounds, and wide Sleep, Stone and Soul Drain.
  • At 30 seconds, then 1:30, 2:30 and 3:30 into the fight, 4 System messages spawn around the room. They cast Heal on allies whose HP is below 50%, including T_W_O. Kill them as soon as they appear (they only have 100 HP).

When T_W_O dies, the remaining System messages disappear and Verity comes back to her senses.

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• T_W_O's boss drops (see below).
  • Talking to Verity after the fight gives 20–40 Instance Points, which count toward the daily 1,200 cap. She also warps you out to un_bunker 299/162.

docs.text: Mistwood Maze (the Hazy Forest) is the maze of warps between Bifrost and Mora. Most of the paths are blocked at the start. Each one opens when you chop down the garden tree that guards it, and you can only chop a tree after you kill the gardener who owns it. When every path is open, you clear the Gardeners' Tree at the end and walk out onto the second Bifrost field. The maze is also where the Wandering Guardian quest takes place, which pays out Loki's Muffler #2568 and Pendant Of Guardian #2858.

docs.title: Requirements and entry
docs.text:
Party Required. Only the party leader can register the party. Registration Laphine Soldier at /navi bif_fild01 158/340 Entrance Log Tunnel at /navi bif_fild01 161/355 Time limit 2 hours from creation Cooldown 2 hours 30 minutes, starting when you enter

The leader talks to the Laphine Soldier and picks Venture into the Hazy Forest. Then everyone uses the Log Tunnel next to him and picks Enter the tunnel.

Cooldown

The 2h30m lockout starts the first time you enter the maze. While the leader's lockout is running, the soldier refuses to register a new maze. Members on cooldown can still join a maze someone else created.

docs.title: Walkthrough
docs.text:
How the maze works

  • The forest is full of Miming #2137, Pom Spider #2132, Angra Mantis #2133, Parus #2134 and Little Fatum #2136. A replacement spawns somewhere on the map each time one dies. You will also run into 15 Nydhoggur Memory #2138, which do not respawn.
  • Each garden has a Garden Tree. Clicking it and picking Chop down the garden tree. opens a warp path that was closed. If the tree's gardener is still alive, the tree will not fall, and a voice complains on the map instead.
  • Gardeners are named monsters. They do not always stand next to their tree, so you may have to hunt for them first.

Garden trees

Garden tree Gardener to kill first Gardener spawns near Tom's Garden Tree (247/123) Tom, a Little Fatum #2136 249/120 Tomba's Garden Tree (225/98) Tomba, a Little Fatum #2136 200/64 Remi's Garden Tree (159/184) Remi the Tired, a Miming #2137 154/184 Tired Rem's Garden Tree (61/39) Rem the Gardener, a Little Fatum #2136 101/107 Ron's Garden Tree (230/179) Ron the Gardener, a Parus #2134 227/178 Rover's Garden Tree (285/225) Rover the Strutter, a Parus #2134 304/237 Mona's Garden Tree (161/316) Mona the Seedseeker, a Angra Mantis #2133 239/253 Namon's Garden Tree (204/299) Brave Namon, a Parus #2134 89/173 Sad Neoron's Garden Tree (221/236) Sad Neoron, a Miming #2137 143/265 Spyder's Garden Tree (206/200) Spyder the Eight-Legged, a Pom Spider #2132 209/200 Tito's Garden Tree (95/287) Tito the Flipper, a Angra Mantis #2133 264/291 Pumba's Garden Tree (324/325) Diligent Pumba, a Parus #2134 309/165 Tete's Garden Tree (280/344) Carefree Tete, a Little Fatum #2136 277/343

All coordinates are on the instance map. The Forest Whisper announces each tree as it falls, and after Rem's and Spyder's trees it hints at the next part of the forest.

The Gardeners' Tree (exit)

The last tree is at 345/186.   2. Find and kill the Wandering Purple Dragon. A voice asks for help, and a Collapsed Girl and Loki appear at 183/304.
  3. Talk to Loki there. The quest becomes Wandering Protector.
  4. Leave the forest and go to Mora. Talk to the Flower Smelling Lady at /navi mora 46/152, then to the Sharp Eyed Man next to her at /navi mora 48/152.

The Sharp Eyed Man checks your weight before handing out the reward. Free up some space (at least 1,000 weight) before you talk to him.

docs.title: Guide
docs.text: Morse's Cave (the "Red Flower") is the follow-up to Isle of Bios. The party tracks the weakened Demon God Morocc into his lair, holds off his army in three timed survival rooms, and finally fights the Morocc Necromancer #3000.

docs.title: Requirements and entry
docs.text:
Level Base Level 160 or higher Prerequisite Clear Isle of Bios and claim the reward from Vrid at least once. Party Required. Only the party leader can open the dungeon. Open the dungeon Senior Tracker at /navi moro_cav 61/69 (party leader) Entrance Red Flower at /navi moro_cav 57/69 Cooldown One run per day. Resets daily at 04:00 server time, counted from the moment you report back to the Senior Tracker.

The leader talks to the Senior Tracker and answers Yes to open the Red Flower. Everyone then enters through the Red Flower next to him.

You only get one entry

Entering the Red Flower starts the "Pursuing Hiding Morocc" quest, and the Red Flower stays closed to you while that quest is active. If you die, disconnect or fail, you cannot go back in. Report to the Senior Tracker, then wait for the next daily reset.

docs.title: Walkthrough
docs.text:
1. The entrance

Walking in wakes Morocc up and 9 Morocc's Ghoul #3001 spawn along the corridor. Kill them all. Grim Reaper Ankou then appears, and after his speech three portals open that lead to Morocc's chamber.

2. Weakened Morocc

Step into the chamber to trigger a cutscene, after which Weakened Morocc #2998 spawns. Kill it. Morocc talks some more and then four portals open around the chamber.

Note

Only the party leader can use these portals (and the ones later in the dungeon). When the leader steps in, the whole party is teleported and split between the next rooms.

3. The split rooms (left and right)

The party is split between two rooms. In each room Morocc freezes you for a few seconds, then waves keep spawning for 3 minutes:

  • 4 Morocc's Ghoul #3001 at the start and then about every 20 seconds
  • one Morocc's Archer Skeleton #3003 each at around 2:40 and 2:50

At the 3-minute mark the script counts the monsters still alive in each room. If 20 or more are left in a room, the run fails: Ankou appears and the portals send everyone to Prontera. Otherwise the remaining monsters vanish and new portals open. The leader steps in and the party regroups in the next room.

4. The lower-left room

This works the same way, also for 3 minutes, but each wave adds more Morocc's Archer Skeleton #3003 and Morocc's Verit #3005 to the 4 Ghouls. The same rule applies: 20 or more monsters alive at the end means failure. If you survive, the leader takes the portal to the final room.

5. Morocc Necromancer

  1. Morocc hands the fight over to his Necromancer. The first form, Morocc Necromancer #2999, spawns. Kill it.
  2. The second form, Morocc Necromancer #3000, appears in the same spot and keeps summoning adds about every 7 seconds. The fewer adds are alive, the bigger the wave. It stops summoning while 40 or more are alive. Waves mix Morocc's Ghoul #3001, Morocc's Archer Skeleton #3003, Morocc's Wraith #3004, Morocc's Verit #3005 and Morocc's Lude #3006.
  3. Many waves also bring a Morocc's Osiris #3002 that drops poison clouds where it stands every few seconds. Kill Osiris quickly or move away from it.
  4. When the Necromancer dies, all remaining adds vanish, Ankou has a last word and an exit portal opens in the middle of the room.

Healing mechanic

Every 30 seconds, if the second-form Necromancer is below 3,000,000 HP, it is healed back to exactly 3,000,000 HP. Bring it down to around 3M, then burst it down from there before the next heal.

docs.text:

Reporting to the Senior Tracker after a run is required either way. It closes your current quest and starts the daily cooldown.

Instance Points

Instance Points can be earned once per device for each instance run, up to 1200 per account per day. A rented Charm Of Brightness #30034 adds 50 points per claim. Use @instancepoints to see your total.

docs.title: Guide
docs.text: Nest of Twigs is a short story memorial from the Episode 20 main quest. You follow Lehar through the ice and twigs to find Leon and Aurelie. Twice on the way, Jormungandr Guardians block the path and you have to clear them.

docs.title: Requirements and entry
docs.text:
Quest Episode 20 main story, at the step Branch's Nest NPC Lehar at /navi jor_twice 164/244 Party Required. Talk to Lehar as party leader; a one-person party is fine. Time limit 20 minutes

Talk to Lehar and pick Ready to explore Nest of Twigs to create the memorial, then talk to her again and pick Enter Nest of Twigs.

docs.title: Walkthrough
docs.text:
1. As soon as the party leader steps onto the starting area, Lehar appears next to you. Talk to her. She casts Increase AGI (level 10, 4 minutes) on you and starts walking west.
  2. Follow her. She stops in front of three Jormungandr Guardians (66/181). Talk to her again and the guardians become real monsters. Each one has only 10 HP, so a single hit kills it. Kill all three.
  3. Talk to Lehar. She buffs you with Increase AGI again and leads you south-east to another group of three guardians (135/65). Talk to her, kill them the same way, then talk to her once more.
  4. Lehar walks north to where Leon, Aurelie and the White Cat are waiting (119/149). The party leader talks to Leon twice to finish the conversation.

At the end of the conversation you are sent back to /navi jor_safty1 331/150.

Note

Only the party leader can move the story forward (talking to Lehar and starting the talk with Leon). Lehar does not move while you are fighting. She waits until you talk to her again.

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
You get these from Leon the first time you finish, while your quest is at the Branch's Nest step:

Reward Amount Sacred Cat Whiskers #1001217 10 Base EXP 136,611,959 Job EXP 22,271,670 White Cat Alliance reputation +70

Your quest then moves on to Beyond the Iceberg, Beyond the Ice Sea. Running the memorial again later gives no reward.

Tip

Leon checks your inventory before the final talk. If you are carrying too many items, he refuses to continue, so clear some space before you go in.

docs.title: Guide
docs.text: Nidhoggur's Nest is the classic two-floor memorial dungeon behind the Yggdrasil Gatekeeper in Nidhoggur's Dungeon. On the first floor you have 30 minutes to kill Nidhoggur's twelve guardians. On the second floor you fight Nidhoggur's Shadow #2022, who keeps dragging the whole party into trapped side rooms.

docs.title: Requirements and entry
docs.text:
Level Base Level 70 or higher Party At least 2 members. Only the party leader can create the dungeon. Prerequisite The Nidhoggur's Nest access quest (see below) Entrance Yggdrasil Gatekeeper at /navi nyd_dun02 100/201 Time limit 4 hours Cooldown Until 04:00 server time, 3 days after you enter. A separate 4-hour play-time timer also runs.

Once you have access, the leader talks to the Gatekeeper and picks Please allow me to enter., then everyone talks to the Gatekeeper and picks I want to go in.

Cooldown

Both timers start on your first entry. While the leader's timers are running, the Gatekeeper will not open a new nest. During the 3-day lockout you can only re-enter the nest you entered; you cannot join a different one.

docs.title: Access quest
docs.text:
Before you can enter, you have to research the Gatekeeper. This quest follows on from the Rune-Midgarts Expedition storyline, and the Laphine and Sapha NPCs only understand you while you wear the Ring of the Ancient Wise King #2782.

  1. Walk up to the Yggdrasil Gatekeeper at /navi nyd_dun02 100/201 and look at it closely. It pushes you back.
  2. Report the strange gate to Hibba Agip at /navi mid_campin 90/121. He sends you to Historian Magnifier at /navi mid_camp 271/299.
  3. Magnifier sends you to his assistant Naomi at /navi prt_in 171/94. Help her, then go back to Magnifier and say you have read all the stories.
  4. With the ring equipped, ask about the cave to the north. Either ask a soldier in Splendide (/navi splendide 198/178 or /navi splendide 240/164) and then Commander Lebiordirr at /navi spl_in01 109/60, or ask the Laphine Prisoner at /navi man_in01 291/62 and then Neat Etorr at /navi man_in01 311/57.
  5. Report to Magnifier again, then to Hibba Agip. He asks you to pick a tribe to ask for help: Laphine or Sapha.
  6. Laphine: talk to Commander Lebiordirr, then twice to Aide Arioss at /navi spl_in01 104/56. Sapha: talk to Neat Etorr, then twice to the Laphine Prisoner.
  7. Go back to the Gatekeeper and use the Guardian's spell. From now on it lets you in.

docs.title: Walkthrough
docs.text:
1st floor: the guardians (30 minutes)

The floor is full of Ancient Tree #2019, Rhyncho #2020, Phylla #2021, Aqua Elemental #2016 and Dark Pinguicula #2015. A replacement spawns each time one dies.

  1. The party leader talks to the Murdered Yggdrasilid at 213/277 and agrees to help (Leave it to us.). This starts a 30-minute timer.
  2. Twelve Nidhoggur's Guardians spawn around 200-255/200-280: six Rhyncho #2020 and six Phylla #2021. Kill all twelve.
  3. When the last guardian dies, a warp to the second floor opens at 195/320.

Time limit

The World Tree warns you at 15, 20 and 25 minutes. If the guardians are still alive after 30 minutes, everyone on the floor is sent out to /navi mid_camp 310/150.

2nd floor: Nidhoggur's Shadow

The second floor has Rhyncho #2020, Phylla #2021, Dark Shadow #2023 and Dark Pinguicula #2015, which respawn.

  1. Walk north. Stepping on the glowing spot around 199/178 teleports you to 199/255.
  2. When the party leader walks into the area around 199/268, Nidhoggur's Shadow #2022 spawns at 199/327.

  3. Every 3 minutes the Shadow pulls the whole party into one of four side rooms, chosen at random. Each room has a trap on its landing spot that is active for 10 seconds:

    Room Trap effect Red Loses 50% and then another 30% of max HP, plus Bleeding for 60 seconds White Loses 50% HP, plus Freeze for 20 seconds Yellow Loses 50% SP, plus Sleep for 20 seconds and Confusion for 60 seconds Green Loses 50% HP and 50% SP, plus Poison for 60 seconds

  4. Each room holds five Nidhoggur's Guardians (three Rhyncho #2020, two Phylla #2021). While they are alive, the room's exits just loop you back to the landing spot. Kill all five to open the way back to the Shadow. The next pull comes 3 minutes later.

  5. If you do not clear the room within 3 minutes, its guardians vanish and the party is pulled into another random room.
  6. Kill Nidhoggur's Shadow. World Tree Yggdrasil appears at 202/324.

Tip

Bring Green Potions, Panacea or status recovery. Every room trap inflicts a status effect, and the pulls keep coming every 3 minutes until the Shadow is dead.

You are then warped to /navi nyd_dun02 98/196. 1,500,000 Base / 350,000 Job EXP and 10 Splendide Coin #6081 Each player, after a clear Report to Commander Lebiordirr, then talk to Aide Arioss. 1,500,000 Base / 350,000 Job EXP and 10 Manuk Coin #6080 Each player, after a clear (instead of the row above) Report to Neat Etorr.

Leaving through World Tree Yggdrasil unlocks the report again, so you can collect it once after every clear. You can pick either NPC each time, whichever tribe you sided with during the access quest. Wear the Ring of the Ancient Wise King #2782 when you report.

docs.title: Guide
docs.text: You join the White Wings guild on a trip into a time loop to find their former master Newoz. The instance is one long map of about twenty small rooms. Each room is a fight followed by a story scene, and the run ends with Awakened Ferre #3073. You trade the Jitterbug's Tooth #6719 you collect here to Mingmin for random gear.

docs.title: Entering
docs.text:
• Level: 120 or higher.
  • Quest: talk to Roel at /navi moc_para01 26/95 and accept his request. You have to do this before every run: Runane only opens the portal while Roel's quest is active.
  • Party: you must be in a party. The party leader talks to Runane at /navi moc_para01 29/95 and picks Open the dimensional portal. Then everyone picks Enter Nightmarish Jitterbug from Runane.
  • Cooldown: entering gives you the Nightmarish Jitterbug: Waiting quest. The cooldown ends at the next 04:00 server time. Runane's dialogue says "20 hours" and "23 hours", but the real reset is 04:00. When the cooldown is over, talk to Runane once to clear it.

docs.title: How a room works
docs.text:
1. The party leader talks to the NPC that starts the scene in the current room (usually Newoz). Partway through the scene, the door to the next room opens and that room's monsters spawn: mostly Ferre #3069 and its stronger variants (Ferre #3070, Ferre #3071, Ferre #3072).
  2. Go through and kill every monster in the new room.
  3. About 1.5 seconds after the last one dies, the White Wings members appear there for the next scene.

Only the party leader can move the story forward. Other members can talk to the NPCs but nothing happens.

Hurry

Once the leader has finished the story once, the leader gets a Hurry option on each story NPC. It skips the dialogue and opens the next room straight away.

docs.title: Boss: Awakened Ferre
docs.text:
After room 22 is cleared, the leader talks to Newoz in the boss room. Ferre awakens as Awakened Ferre #3073 and brings 12 Ferre with her (4 of each of the first three kinds). Once the fight starts, the door from room 22 closes, so anyone left behind cannot come in.

  • Every 30 seconds a Storm Gust effect lands on the boss. Every party member within 10 cells of the middle of the room is frozen for 15 seconds, every time. Fight away from the centre or have a way to cure Freeze.
  • Only Awakened Ferre has to die. When she is dead, the leader talks to Newoz again to open the portal to the exit room.

Warning

The portal from the boss room to the exit does not take dead players with it. Get resurrected before you use it.

docs.title: Guide
docs.text: Octopus Cave is a light-hearted Malangdo memorial. A perverted octopus has been grabbing at the Starfish lady, so you cut off its four legs in the four wings of its cave and then skewer the Giant Octopus #2194 itself.

docs.title: Requirements and entry
docs.text:
Party Required. Only the party leader can open the cave. Required item A rented Octopus Hunting Skewer #6442, needed by every member who enters NPC Starfish at /navi mal_dun01 151/235 Entrance Weird Entrance at /navi mal_dun01 153/237 Time limit 1 hour Cooldown 1 hour, starting when you enter. While it runs you can only re-enter the cave you entered, not a new one.

The leader talks to the Starfish and picks Ask to open the gate. Then everyone uses the Weird Entrance and picks Go in.

Bring the skewer

Both the Starfish and the Weird Entrance check for a rental Octopus Hunting Skewer #6442. Anyone without one is turned away at the entrance. The skewer comes from the Octopus Hstick Box #16765 (23 hours), Octopus Hstick Box2 #16766 (3 days) or Octopus Hstick Box3 #16767 (7 days).

docs.title: Walkthrough
docs.text:
The four legs

  1. When you step forward from the entrance (199/99), the octopus taunts you. Four Octopus Leg #2193 spawn, one at the far end of each wing of the cave:

    Leg Location Octopus Leg #1 West wing, 20/114 Octopus Leg #2 North-west wing, 88/190 Octopus Leg #3 North-east wing, 307/215 Octopus Leg #4 East wing, 372/131

  2. The paths to each leg are lined with Octopus #2192 henchmen, Hydra #1068 and Stapo #1784. A few spots along the way set off extra ambushes when you walk over them, including one with Deep Sea Marse #2175 squids.

  3. When you get close to a leg, it calls for help, and two more groups of henchmen spawn 5 seconds later. A warp back to the central hall (198/99) opens once all of that leg's henchmen are dead, or 30 seconds after you reach the leg, whichever comes first.
  4. The doors in the central hall connect all four wings, so you can split the party up and take the legs in parallel.

The Giant Octopus

  1. When the fourth leg dies, the whole party is pulled back to the central hall and a warp to the boss room opens at 198/116.
  2. The Giant Octopus #2194 (named Disgusting Octopus) waits at 199/188. Every 10 seconds it summons either one Octopus Leg #2193 or five Octopus #2192 around itself, up to 100 adds at a time.
  3. Kill the octopus. Its leftover adds disappear and two exits open, at 190/208 and 198/82.

Tip

The boss keeps adding monsters every 10 seconds for as long as it is alive. Focus it down instead of clearing every add.

docs.title: Guide
docs.text: Travel back to the night Glast Heim fell. Himelmez has come for the piece of Ymir's Heart, and you fight through the castle grounds, kill the Corrupted Soul #2475, hunt the two Commanders of Destruction on the second floor and finally put down the cursed knight Amdarais #2476. On Miracle there are two difficulties: Normal and Hard (shown as Old Glast Heim Advanced). Hard uses much stronger monsters and pays Contaminated Magic #6755 instead of Coagulated Spell #6608.

docs.title: Entering
docs.text:
Talk to Hugin at /navi glast_01 204/273. The first time, agree to help him. Then pick a mode:

Mode Level Extra requirement Cooldown quest Normal 130+ None Trace of Time Travel (Normal) Hard (Old Glast Heim Advanced) 160+ You must have cleared Normal once and left through Hugin at the end Trace of Time Travel (Hard)
  • Party: you must be in a party. The party leader picks the mode and Generate Time Gap. Everyone then picks the same mode and Enter. Each member must meet that mode's requirements.
  • Cooldown: each mode has its own cooldown, so you can run Normal and Hard on the same day. Each one ends at the next 04:00 server time. When it has ended, talk to Hugin once to clear it.
  • Talking to Hugin also gives you the Corrupted Soul Hunt quest for the first boss. You need it for the first reward.

docs.title: Fast mode
docs.text: If the party leader has finished the Normal story at least once (they have Time Conqueror), Varmundt at the entrance offers Omit moderately. This also works in Hard mode. This skips the three courtyard sectors: after a short scene, a blue gate takes you straight to the first boss. The Commanders also show up more often in fast mode (see below).

docs.title: Walkthrough
docs.text:
Castle grounds (1@gl_k)

  1. The leader talks to Varmundt at the entrance, then to Heinrich in the hall full of knights. A long scene follows (about 2.5 minutes). When it ends, the knights turn and are wiped out, and a portal opens to the west.
  2. Sector 1 (west): 51 monsters. Once 36 are dead, the rest vanish. The leader then talks to Altar boy Domun (1@gl_k 17/51).
  3. Sector 2 (east): 69 monsters. Once 57 are dead, the rest vanish. The leader talks to Holgren the Destroyer (1@gl_k 291/145). Dead bodies lying around this sector each release 3–7 Maggot #2467 when you walk past.
  4. Sector 3 (north-west): 100 monsters. Once 86 are dead, the rest vanish and Himelmez waits for you north of the castle.
  5. Walk up to Himelmez (1@gl_k 150/257). After the scene, the Corrupted Soul spawns. Kill it and the 2nd floor entrance opens at the 12 o'clock end of the courtyard.

Talk to Varmundt after the first boss

Every player should talk to Varmundt next to the first boss after it dies. He gives the first reward and the Amdarais Hunt quest. Without that quest, Hugin will not give you the final reward.

Second floor (2@gl_k)

  1. Walk into the hall where Heinrich and Varmundt stand. A portal opens to the west.
  2. West wing: walking into each of the 7 marked spots spawns 5 monsters (a Palace Guard, an Archer, an Abysmal Knight, a Khalitzburg and a Bloody Knight). The spots refill over time. Every kill has a 1 in 50 chance (1 in 10 in fast mode) to call the 1st Commander of Destruction. Kill the Commander to open the east wing.
  3. East wing: the same, with 44 fixed monsters plus 7 spots. Kill the 2nd Commander of Destruction to open the portal at the end of the central corridor.
  4. Walk up the corridor. Decomposed bodies along the way release 3–7 Maggots when you get close.

Final boss: Amdarais

Walk up to Himelmez. Gerhalt turns into Amdarais #2476 (Amdarias #3150 on Hard).

Every 30 seconds the game announces Amdarais's HP. Then for 10 seconds one or two Varmundt's Ghosts appear in the corners of the room. Stand within 2 cells of a ghost to get its buff for 30 seconds. Six adds also join the fight, and they vanish when the next 30-second cycle starts.

docs.title: Guide
docs.text: Relive the memory of the orc Kruger as he tries to stop the Orc Shaman Cargalache. The run has two floors: on the first you hunt down Enchanted Orcs to unseal four zones, on the second the party leader lights braziers in order while the party fights three mini-bosses and finally the Shaman herself.

docs.title: How to enter
docs.text:
NPC Dimensional Gorge Piece (a statue) in the Geffen field: /navi gef_fild10 242/202 Level 30 ~ 80 Party At least 2 members. The party leader reserves the dungeon, then everyone selects "Enter" Cooldown 2 hours per character, starting when you enter Time limit 1 hour

The Mad Scientist standing next to the statue only gives story dialogue; he is not needed to enter.

docs.title: Floor 1: the four sealed zones
docs.text:
1. Talk to Kruger at the starting point. He explains the plan over about a minute of messages.
  2. When the mission starts, the floor fills with endlessly respawning Orc Warrior #1023, Desert Wolf #1106 and Orc Archer #1189 (plus Anopheles #1627 from the start). A minute after you talked to Kruger, the first Enchanted Orc (an Orc Warrior with a special name) appears around 140/86.

  3. Each Enchanted Orc you kill opens a portal to the next zone and spawns the next Enchanted Orc:

    Kill the Enchanted Orc near Portal that opens Next Enchanted Orc near 140/86 168/125 106/108 106/108 89/94 35/43 35/43 38/105 22/180 22/180 21/189, to floor 2 (none)

  4. Killing the last Enchanted Orc removes all the respawning monsters on floor 1.

Be sneaky

Every normal orc you kill is replaced, and most replacements are High Orcs placed at the last path (around 22/182), the same spot you need to reach for the floor 2 portal. Rarely, killing orcs also calls 20 Stalactic Golem #1278 into that area. Only kill what blocks your way.

docs.title: Floor 2: the braziers
docs.text:
1. Talk to Kruger again at the start. After about 24 seconds the mission begins and Orc Skeleton #1152, Orc Zombie #1153, Orc Archer #1189 and Anopheles #1627 start respawning.
  2. Only the party leader can light a brazier (a 5-second progress bar). There are three sets of four, and each set must be lit in order; the next brazier only becomes active after the previous one is lit.

  3. Lighting the last brazier of a set spawns a mini-boss. Killing it opens the portal to the next area:

    Brazier set Mini-boss Portal after the kill 26/164, 55/155, 108/146, 98/171 Orc Elite Guard #1981 at 109/156 48/100 35/92, 32/70, 70/31, 84/51 Orc Bowman #1982 at 67/64 101/55 142/145, 162/134, 144/117, 136/98 Orc Undead #1983 at 152/147 167/104

  4. After the third mini-boss, Shaman Cargalache (Orc Lady #1984) appears at the altar (185/8) together with an Orc Hero #1087. Killing the Shaman clears the floor's respawning monsters, reveals Kruger's body at 172/13 and opens a portal at 182/8 back to gef_fild10.

Tip

As on floor 1, the respawning orcs on floor 2 gather at the Shaman's altar, and very rarely 30 Wraith #1475 are summoned there. After each mini-boss dies, another copy of it respawns near the area's entrance about 10 seconds later, so move on quickly.
