docs.title: Guide
docs.text: OS Occupation is the story memorial that follows Old Memories in Episode 17.1. You join Est's rebel squad as call sign Echo and storm the OS facility. You hold the gas-filled entrance, follow the missing Alpha team's trail through two outposts, and face the mutant waiting at the end.

docs.title: Requirements and entry
docs.text:
Quest Finish Old Memories, then take OS Occupation from Est NPC Est at /navi sp_cor 163/56 Party Required. Only the party leader can prepare the memorial. Time limit 2 hours

Est is hidden until you have finished Old Memories. Walk up to her spot in Cor and she appears. Talk to her once to get the OS Occupation quest. Then the leader talks to her again and picks Prepare for OS Occupation., and everyone picks Enter.

docs.title: Walkthrough
docs.text:
1. Holding the entrance

  1. The memorial starts when the party leader steps forward from the landing point (30/352). The rebel squad and Est appear, and poison gas lingers around the entrance.
  2. While Est talks on the radio, up to 12 incomplete mutants (A013 - Caput #20348, A013 - Dolor #20349 and A013 - Bellare #20350) spawn around the entrance, one every 10 seconds. Fight them off.
  3. When Est calls for Echo, click the radio next to her (29/360) and send any reply. Do it a second time when she asks you to check Alpha's coordinates.
  4. Foxtrot's artillery wipes out every mutant and the gas around the entrance. Est then sends you the coordinates of Alpha's last contact.

2. Following Alpha's trail

  1. Go to the radio at 52/177 and report that there is only a radio, no trace of Alpha. Eight mutants spawn along 63/214-242.
  2. Kill them all. The map announces how many survivors are left every 10 seconds. When it says Intermediate point secured., a marker appears at 84/256. Step on it.
  3. Thirteen more mutants spawn along the road around 126-174/266, plus another gas cloud. Clear them and step on the marker at 163/266.
  4. Fifteen mutants spawn around 132-151/196-243. Clear them and step on the marker at 138/174.

3. The last point

  1. A mutant marked ???? (a Miguel G. #20347) appears at 161/178. It spawns with only 5% of its HP, so it goes down quickly.
  2. When it dies, Est and the fallen Miguel appear at 165/176. Talk to Est to finish the story.

docs.text:

Reward Amount Damaged Weapon #25668 1 Cor Core #25723 5 Base / Job EXP 300,000 / 300,000

Est then sends you back to /navi sp_cor 162/63. The quest is completed, so the reward is one-time.

Tip

After the story, the Operation Officer next to Est in Cor opens the repeatable version of this map, 2nd OS Search.

docs.text: Oz Labyrinth (the Maze of Oz) is a short story memorial from the Episode 18 main quest Gray Children. Miriam and her companions guide you through the ash-covered tunnels below the fields near Rachel. There are only a few small fights on the way, and the run ends when you climb out on the far side of the canyon.

docs.title: Requirements and entry
docs.text:
Quest Episode 18 main story, at Gray Children (14) or (16) NPC Merchant (Disguised Miriam) at /navi ra_fild10 179/176 Party Required. Miriam only lets the party leader in, so this is effectively a solo memorial; use a one-person party. Time limit 1 hour

On your first talk at Gray Children (14), Miriam moves your quest on to Gray Children (16). Talk to her again, pick Open the door., then talk once more and pick Enter.

docs.title: Walkthrough
docs.text:
1. Talk to Miriam at the entrance (282/175). She warns you about the lava ash and tells you to head north.
  2. Talk to Miriam again at 271/272, then at the bridge (241/272). She crosses the bridge first. Follow her west.
  3. At the far end of the bridge (157/272), talk to Miriam. Two Ash Toad #21295 attack. Kill both. Maram joins the group and tells you to keep heading down to the fork in the road.
  4. Talk to Maram at 98/172. A scream rings out, and Maram and Miriam run ahead to 68/165.
  5. Talk to Maram there. A Ash Toad #21295 and a Rakehand #21296 attack Imril. Kill both to save him.
  6. Follow the path north. When you reach 58/256, Maram appears at 44/255. Talk to her, then follow the road down to 21/189.
  7. Talk to Maram at 21/189. Your quest moves on to Gray Children (17) and the Rope next to her (28/190) unlocks. Climb it to come out at /navi gw_fild01 275/337.

Note

Several hidden spots along the route (eight in total) each spawn one Ash Toad #21295 and one Rakehand #21296 the first time someone walks over them. They are optional fights.

Tip

The Rope at the entrance (284/164) takes you back up to /navi ra_fild10 173/176 if you need to leave early.

docs.text: A short, beginner-friendly party instance. You follow Emily into the Porings' hideout, push through three areas of "Enriched" Porings, beat three bosses, and Emily hands out the loot at the end.

docs.title: How to enter
docs.text:
NPC Emily, Prontera field: /navi prt_fild05 145/235 Level 30 ~ 70 (Emily turns away anyone outside that range) Party Required. The party leader creates the entrance, then everyone talks to Emily again to enter Prerequisite Talk through Emily's "Contract with Emily" dialogue once (it completes on the spot) Cooldown Once per day per character ("Recovering Fatigue"): after entering you must wait until the next 04:00 server time Time limit 1 hour

Note

Taming or otherwise "processing" monsters inside does not count as normal progress, and any transformation you already have is removed when you go in.

docs.title: Walkthrough
docs.text:
1. Start. Walk onto the spot next to Emily at the entrance. After a short conversation the first barrier of rope posts disappears.
  2. First area. The map fills with Enriched Poring #3815, Enriched Drops #3813, Enriched Poporing #3814 and Enriched Marin #3816. Once only 3 of them are left the rest vanish and Hugh Goldling #3811 appears at around 132/103. Killing it opens the next barrier (after about 6 seconds).
  3. Second area. A new wave of the same Porings spawns along the eastern and northern paths. When 4 or fewer are left, the rest vanish and Huge Amering #3812 appears near 42/173. Killing it opens the last barrier.
  4. Third area. A long line of Enriched Marin #3816 blocks the north path. Thin them down to 4 or fewer and King Poring #3810 shows up near 182/194 together with 10 fast, aggressive Porings.
  5. Finish. Kill King Poring and Emily appears near 199/186. Talk to her to claim your reward; she warps you back to prt_fild05.

docs.title: Blue Light Columns
docs.text: Three columns of blue light stand in the village (around 117/108, 37/165 and 175/199). Stepping on one turns you into a Hill Wind #1629 for 60 seconds and gives a short 30-second power-up. Emily points them out before the first boss, so use them before the boss fights.

Each attempt costs 50 Jellopy #909 and 20,000 zeny, and 30% of attempts destroy the vegetable. She can also reset an enchanted vegetable for the same price and the same 30% risk.

docs.title: Guide
docs.text: Regenschirm is the Episode 17.1 story memorial in which the rebels take back the Regenschirm laboratory under Lighthalzen. You fight through the guarded lobby, clear the poison gas from the lab wings, rescue the detained researchers and finally face the specimen held in the Central Room.

docs.title: Requirements and entry
docs.text:
Quest Reclaim Regenschirm (Episode 17.1 main story) NPC Rekenber Guard Oscar at /navi lighthalzen 55/278 Party Required. Only the party leader can create the memorial. Time limit 2 hours

The leader talks to Oscar and picks Create 'Regenschirm', then everyone talks to him and picks Enter 'Regenschirm'.

docs.title: Walkthrough
docs.text:
1. The lobby

  1. Talk to Aas at 131/58. She stays behind to hack the security system and sends you into the hall (127/67).
  2. A large group of Heart Hunter Guard #3627 is spread over the lobby, the stairs and the two side rooms. Two spots near the lower door and the stairs (94/68 and 95/93) spawn extra Special Guard #3622 when you walk over them.
  3. Kill every Heart Hunter Guard. An Access Controller appears at 60/138. Talk to it to hear Aas over the intercom.
  4. Talk to the Researcher next to it (59/132). He unlocks the door to the hallway.

2. The poison gas

  1. Opening the door releases more guards and three clusters of Poisonous Gas (Fatal Pompom #20352): one in the west wing, one in the east wing and one in the north wing. Each wing's doors stay locked ("Access Denied") until that wing's gas is gone.
  2. Clear the west gas first. Est appears behind the door at 36/211. Talk to her, then use the Access Controller at 26/219 to call Aas.
  3. Clear the east gas. The four lab doors along 214-216 (at y 44, 76, 108 and 136) now open. Rescue the three Detained Researchers at 235/143, 237/108 and 237/71 by talking to each one.
  4. Talk to Aas at 235/44. She will not continue until all three researchers have been rescued. She opens the way to the Central Room.

The north wing (doors at 186-188/216) only holds research reports to read. It is optional. The Scattered Documents at 241/51 start a side quest.

3. The Central Room

  1. Click the Central Room device at 125/157. Aas, Est and Goni gather there. Talk to Aas twice, then pick Enter. to go inside (126/164).

  2. Click the Restrained Specimen at 125/188. Then use the four Control Devices to release its gravity restraints. They must be pressed in this order, each with the right button:

    Order Control Device Button 1 Blue device, 144/180 Blue 2 Red device, 108/168 Red 3 White device, 114/191 Yellow 4 Yellow device, 143/168 White

    A wrong button, or a device used out of order, only makes the specimen cry out. Nothing is reset, so you can simply try again.

  3. When the last restraint is released, the specimen breaks free as the Failed Specimen (a Sorrow Crob #20353). Kill it.

  4. Talk to Aas at 127/164 and choose where to go: Einbroch (/navi einbroch 301/324) or Lighthalzen (/navi lighthalzen 54/272).

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text: Talking to Aas at the end completes Reclaim Regenschirm. The memorial gives no items or Instance Points. Since Oscar only lets you in while the quest is active, it can only be done once.

docs.text: Ritual of Blessing is a short story memorial from the Episode 16.1 royal family storyline. You attend the ritual that blesses the new representative of the seven royal families. Heart Hunter intruders crash the ceremony, and you help the royal families drive them out.

docs.title: Requirements and entry

Quest Attend the Ritual (Episode 16.1 main story) NPC Mage Nillem at /navi prt_lib 91/85 Entrance Room of Consciousness portal at /navi prt_lib 88/90 Party Required. Only the party leader can create and enter, so this is a solo memorial; use a one-person party. Time limit 1 hour

Talk to Nillem as party leader and pick Enter now. The portal next to him becomes visible. Click it and pick Enter.

docs.title: Walkthrough
docs.text:
1. You arrive at the back of the hall (101/12). Walk north to the ceremony at the front of the hall.
  2. When you reach the royal families near 107/77, Kronecker G. Heine begins the ceremony. Watch the scene. Just before the blessing is finished, an intruder attacks and Peter Heine falls.
  3. The intruder calls in more of his group. Three Suspicious Intruder #3454 attack around 98-107/73-83. Each has 10,000 HP. While you fight, the other intruders duel the royal family members around the hall.
  4. Some of the royals help you if you talk to them:
    • Jurgen Wigner casts Increase AGI on you.
    • Isaac Wigner casts Blessing on you.
    • Catherine D. Geoborg heals you.
    • Nyhill M. Heine heals you and casts Kyrie Eleison when you stand next to him.
  5. When all three intruders are dead, the rest of them flee. Talk to Kronecker G. Heine at 101/93 to finish the story.

After that, the warp at the entrance (101/10) takes you back to /navi prt_lib 88/80. It stays closed until you have spoken to Kronecker.

docs.text: Room of Consciousness takes you into the Past Memories of the Royal Family, sealed under Prontera Castle. Alongside Fenrir and Iris you fight skeleton waves and the Renovated Amdarais #3448, then try to take the piece of Ymir's Heart back from Bijou #3450. You run it once during the Episode 16.1 story. After the story, Friedrich S. Heine offers it as a daily quest.

docs.title: Requirements and entry
docs.text:
Story run At the quest Once More! (Episode 16.1 main story) Daily run Finish the Episode 16.1 story, then take Hope You Cannot Let Go from Friedrich S. Heine at /navi prt_cas_q 21/83 NPC Nillem at /navi prt_lib_q 91/85 Entrance Swaying Space at /navi prt_lib_q 88/90 Party Required. Only the party leader can create and enter, so this is a solo memorial; use a one-person party. Time limit 1 hour Cooldown Daily. After you hand in the daily quest, you cannot take it again until 04:00 server time.

Talk to Nillem as party leader. On the daily run, pick Connect to the Room of Consciousness, then Connect now. The Swaying Space appears next to him. Click it and pick Enter.

docs.title: Walkthrough
docs.text:
1. Skeleton waves

  1. Talk to Fenrir at the entrance (103/40), then walk north and talk to Iris at 100/94.
  2. Two waves of seven skeletons spawn in the hall, one after the other: three Enchanted Skeleton #3446, two Enchanted Soldier Skele #3447 and two Enchanted Archer Skelet #3445 each. The second wave appears a few seconds after the first is cleared.

2. Renovated Amdarais

  1. Talk to Iris at 103/85. The Renovated Amdarais #3448 (10,000,000 HP) attacks.
  2. A few seconds after you first damage the boss, Fenrir and Iris take up position at one of four random spots in the hall, and Fenrir shouts "Lure it to where I am!" Pull the boss into Fenrir. When it touches her, Iris throws her amulet at it, and about 10 seconds later Fenrir hits it for 700,000 to 1,300,000 damage.
  3. After each hit, Fenrir and Iris leave and reappear at another random spot about 25 seconds later. Keep luring the boss into them until it dies.

3. Bijou

  1. Talk to Iris at 100/90. Bijou #3450 appears. This first encounter is scripted: as soon as you damage her, she backs off.
  2. Talk to Fenrir at 103/90. Bijou (10,000,000 HP) comes back for the real fight. Fenrir and Iris use the same trick as against Amdarais, so lure Bijou into Fenrir for the big hits.
  3. When Bijou dies, the party leader talks to Iris at 100/95. You are sent back to /navi prt_lib_q 88/83.

Tip

Fenrir's hit deals 700,000 to 1,300,000 damage, so a 10,000,000 HP boss takes at least 8 hits if you do no damage yourself. Keep your own damage on the boss while you pull it towards her.

docs.text:
Sanctuary Purification is the daily Episode 18 instance that takes place in the same temple district as Wolves Gathering Place. It has two raids, which you can take separately or together:

  • Raid on the defected temple guards: clear the renegade guards from four zones of the temple square (first map).
  • Raid on the Heart Hunters: clear the Heart Hunters from the temple vaults and reset the vault security codes (second map).

docs.title: Requirements and entry
docs.text:
Level Base Level 170 or higher Prerequisite Clear the Episode 18 story instance Wolves Gathering Place. Party Required. The party leader creates the instance and triggers every encounter. NPC Priest in Rachel, /navi rachel 167/244 (she appears after you talk to the Ordinary Person next to her) Cooldown Once per day. Entering starts the cooldown, which resets at 04:00 server time.
  1. Talk to the Priest and choose which raid(s) to accept: Since we're doing it, let's do both., Raid on the defected temple guards. or Raid on the Heart Hunters.
  2. Talk to her again. The leader picks Alright. I'll send the signal. to create the instance, and everyone picks I'll proceed. to enter.

Note

You can only get credit for a raid you accepted before finishing it. Both raids can be completed in the same run.

docs.title: Part 1: Temple square (defected temple guards)
docs.text:
1. The leader walks forward from the entrance to meet the temple guards. This starts the raid.
  2. The square is split into 4 zones by walls. In each zone, Temple Guard NPCs stand at set points. When the leader walks up to one, it turns hostile: a group of Traditional Temple Guard #21311 spawns around it, along with more Temple Guard #21310 / Traditional Temple Guard #21311 (random) at nearby spots.
  3. Kill everything from that group. The next guard is then revealed and a system message says whether enemies remain in the zone. Each zone has 2 or 3 groups. When a zone is cleared, the passage to the next zone opens.
  4. After all 4 zones are cleared, gather at the temple entrance. The leader talks to the Temple Guard in front of the temple (around 1@nyr 119/175), which opens the portal to the vaults.
  5. Each player who walks through that portal is credited with the guard raid.

docs.title: Part 2: The vaults (Heart Hunters)
docs.text:
1. Walk forward from the arrival point. A Temple Guard tells everyone today's 4-digit security code. It is random each run. If you forget it, talk to the Temple Guard at around 2@nyr 35/187 again.
  2. The leader walks up to each Heart Hunter NPC in turn to start a fight against Heart Hunter #21312. The vaults have three storage rooms. For each one:
    • clear the corridor groups, then the storage room itself;
    • the leader steps out through the storage exit, then enters the security code at the Security Device to reset that storage.
  3. After the third storage, clear the centre group. The path north to the storage room opens.
  4. In the storage room the leader steps into the middle to trigger the final fight: 8 Resonators (Heart Hunter #21312) and one Heart Hunter #21313.
  5. Afterwards, the leader enters the code at the last Security Device (around 2@nyr 124/138), the guards gather near the exit, and the leader walks up to them to finish.
  6. Leave through the exit in the north-east (around 2@nyr 203/220). Each player who uses this exit after the final scene is credited with the Heart Hunter raid and returned to Rachel.

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
Return to the Priest in Rachel and talk to her to turn in your completed raids:

Completed raid Reward Raid on the defected temple guards Amethyst Fragment #1000405 x2 Raid on the Heart Hunters Amethyst Fragment #1000405 x2 Turning in (once, either or both) 20 to 40 Instance Points (random)

Rewards are given per player, so every party member should accept the raids and turn them in.

Instance Points

Instance Points can be earned once per device for each instance run, up to 1200 per account per day. A rented Charm Of Brightness #30034 adds 50 points per claim. Use @instancepoints to see your total.

[Walkthrough conversion] "Wolves Gathering Place" is a part of the Episode 18 main quest. Sanctuary Purification is a daily quest.

docs.title: Guide
docs.text: Part 1 of the Heroes' Trail story. Adventurer Leon sends you through a dimensional rift into the past, where you witness how young Sara Irene came to believe her father killed her mother. The run is a chase across one large map: clear each group of Payon guards to open the path to wherever Sara ran next, then face Doyen Irene himself.

docs.title: How to enter
docs.text: NPC Adventurer Leon in the Dimensional Gap: /navi dali 130/107 Portal Dimensional Device: /navi dali 139/118 Level 99+ Party Required. The party leader boots up the device, then everyone uses it to enter Prerequisite Talk to Adventurer Leon first (he accepts you on the first visit; repeat runs need his OK again, see below) Cooldown Once per day per character: after entering you must wait until the next 04:00 server time Time limit 1 hour

docs.title: Walkthrough
docs.text:
Only the party leader can advance the story by talking to Sara and Doyen Irene.

  1. The girl. Talk to the girl at the start (around 260/156). After the scene a portal opens to the west (240/145).
  2. Escape with Sara. Talk to Sara (107/325) and choose "Escape with Sara." Payon guards flood the area: 1st Payon Soldier #2543 and 1st Guard Dog #2545. Every guard in the wave must die before the next portal opens.

  3. The chase. Each time a wave is cleared, Sara runs off again and a portal opens towards her; the minimap marks where to go. The next waves mix in 2nd Payon Soldier #2544 and 2nd Guard Dog #2546.

    Wave Area Next portal 1 West village (around 107/325 down to 206/251) 208/250 2 North-east (around 230/311 down to 220/203) 226/190 3 South (around 255/91 across to 81/67) 166/67 4 Centre 155/180

  4. Doyen Irene. Talk to Sara (152/233). Eight guards attack first; when they are down, Doyen Irene #2542 draws his blade and fights you himself.

  5. The truth. After Doyen Irene falls, talk to him (156/236). Follow the marked portal (88/188) to find Sara (39/142), talk to her, then take the exit at 16/143 back to the Dimensional Gap.

Tip

The guards of a wave are spread over a large area. If the portal does not open, someone has missed a few guards further along the path.

To repeat the story: after reporting, talk to Leon again once your cooldown has ended and agree to relive the past. Leon must be asked again before every repeat run, and the EXP is only given if you leave through the exit portal at the end.

docs.title: Guide
docs.text: Also called the Sealed Shrine. The party descends under St. Capitolina Abbey to stop the Great Demon Baphomet from breaking free. Floor 1 is a scavenger hunt against a timer; floor 2 is the fight against an invincible Baphomet that can only be hurt while a magical seal is weakening him.

docs.title: How to enter
docs.text:
NPC Friar Patrick at St. Capitolina Abbey: /navi monk_test 309/146 Level 75+ Party At least 2 members. The party leader asks Friar Patrick to open the seal Entering Everyone then touches the Grave of Baphomet next to him (/navi monk_test 306/151) Cooldown 12 hours per character ("The Curse of Baphomet"), starting when you enter Time limit 2 hours

Warning

Friar Patrick warns that some protective skills, such as Safety Wall and Assumptio, are blocked by the seal inside. Any Token of Apostle you carry is taken away when you touch the Grave of Baphomet.

docs.title: Floor 1: gathering the keys
docs.text:
1. The hero's grave. Go to the gravestone at the north (around 141/221) and choose "Waited for me?".
  2. Pendant of Spirit. Thirteen gravestones are scattered across the floor. Search them: twelve of the thirteen hold a Pendant of Spirit #6003 (one is randomly empty). Only one pendant can be taken per run.
  3. Wake the hero. The party leader, carrying the pendant, touches the north gravestone again. The Ancient Hero's Soul appears at the fire altar in the center (176/119).
  4. Start the trial. Talk to the Ancient Hero's Soul and ask all three questions (Essence of Fire, Token of Apostle, what to do) before choosing "I am ready." When the leader does this:
    • 12 Bobbing Torches light up around the floor.
    • 15 Apostles of Baphomet spawn at random spots. Each one gives a Token of Apostle #6002 to whoever kills it.
    • A timer starts (see below).
  5. Collect the Essence of Fire. Only the party leader can take a Essence of Fire #6001 from a torch. Anyone else who touches a torch loses half their HP.
  6. Open the gate. The leader brings at least 10 Essence of Fire and 1 Token of Apostle to the Ancient Hero's Soul, then talks to him once more. The gate to the Main Altar opens in the south-east corner (281/12).
  7. Go down. Each player needs their own Token of Apostle to use the gate; it is used up on the way through.

The floor 1 timer

From the moment the leader starts the trial, the Ancient Hero's Soul warns you at 30 and 40 minutes, and at about 51 minutes the seal is announced as failed. At about 58 minutes everyone still in the instance is thrown out to the abbey. Make sure every party member has a Token of Apostle before the Apostles run out.

docs.title: Floor 2: sealing Baphomet
docs.text:
1. Walking in triggers Baphomet's warnings. Three spots around the Main Altar (left 50/67, right 109/67, bottom 79/39) are traps: stepping on one spawns 16 Apostles of Baphomet (Flame Skull #1869, Wraith Dead #1291, Mini Demon #1292, Evil Druid #1117, Khalitzburg #1132 and a Banshee #1867). These traps re-arm every 5 minutes during the Baphomet fight.
  2. The party leader touches The Main Altar (79/65). About 17 seconds later Unsealed Baphomet #1929 appears on the altar.

  3. Baphomet keeps himself invincible. Five Magical Seals surround the altar; only one is active at a time:

    Seal Location Center (Main Altar) 79/81 2 o'clock 123/109 4 o'clock 123/22 8 o'clock 35/21 10 o'clock 35/109

    The center seal activates first; after that a random seal is announced roughly every 70 seconds. 4. Touching the active seal removes Baphomet's invincibility, but only if Baphomet is within 10 cells of that seal. The player who touches it loses half their HP and is turned to stone for 20 seconds, and cannot use another seal for 3 minutes (trying anyway costs half your HP and a 30-second petrify). 5. Seals only work for 1 hour after Baphomet appears. After that he can no longer be made vulnerable. 6. When Baphomet dies the Ancient Hero's Soul appears at the altar (80/63). Talk to him to leave.

Tip

The tank should drag Baphomet to the announced seal while a different player (not the one who touched the last seal) waits next to it. Rotate the seal duty so nobody is on the 3-minute lockout when the next seal lights up.

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 10 Instance Points for each player who leaves through the Ancient Hero's Soul (see Instance Points).
  • Baphomet's drops, including the Cursed Baphomet Doll #6004.

docs.text:

Material Amount Cursed Baphomet Doll #6004 1 Majestic Goat #2256 1 Crystal of Darkness #7799 30 Fragment of Darkness #7798 50 Zeny 990,000 (you need slightly more than this on hand)

Seal away the Great Demon Baphomet.

docs.text: Sealed OS is the Episode 17.1 story memorial for the quest Old Memories. You sneak into the sealed OS mine near Einbroch, only to find Ridsh, Dien and Cotnes already inside. You team up with them to break through the facility's devices and follow the railway to its end.

docs.title: Requirements and entry
docs.text:
Quest Old Memories (Episode 17.1 main story), after scouting the mine for the Rebellion Crew NPC Rebellion Crew at /navi ein_fild03 278/269 Party Required. Only the party leader can open the gate. Time limit 2 hours

The leader talks to the Rebellion Crew and picks Open the gate., then everyone talks to him and picks Go inside.

docs.title: Walkthrough
docs.text:
1. The party leader talks to Ridsh at the landing point (188/45). Dien and Cotnes show up, and the exits behind you are blown shut.
  2. Mutants jump the group. Dien and Cotnes hold one side while you kill a Dolor #20361 and a Twin Caput #20365.
  3. When both are dead, a Suspicious Device appears at 212/41. Click it and pick Crush it. Ridsh tells you to follow the railroad tracks.
  4. Further along the tracks (around 112/108), Dangerous-Looking Devices at 115/112, 115/126 and 115/144 push you back whenever you walk into them. Break the three Thick Wires at 137/107, 137/123 and 137/139. Each wire shuts down one device.
  5. When all three wires are cut, keep following the tracks to the locked gate near 114/217. Talk to Dien or Cotnes there. They suggest going around the door to the right.
  6. Talk to Ridsh at 146/221. Est turns up, and after some arguing the road opens.
  7. Follow the railway north to the end (259/360). Seven trap spots along the way each spawn two Heart Hunter mutants (Heart Hunter Bellare #20355, Heart Hunter Sanare #20357, Dolor #20361, Venenum #20363 or Twin Caput #20365) the first time someone walks over them.
  8. Talk to Dien at 259/360 to finish the story. She sends you back to /navi ein_fild03 258/267.

docs.text: Security Area 1 is the normal daily mode of the Flower Garden's security zone in Varmundt's Mansion (Episode 17.2). The Red Pepper doll Lambda wants to "evaluate" the garden's security, so your party fights through four zones of automatic dolls and plants and then defeats Kappa. Security Area 2 is the harder version on the same map.

docs.title: How to enter
docs.text:
• Where: Walk up to the security perimeter at /navi ba_maison 120/320. The Flower Garden Manager appears.
  • Requirement: Finish the Hidden Flower Garden story instance first ("Security Clearance").
  • Level: Base Level 150 or higher.
  • Party: The party leader picks "Identity Authentication" and then "1st Security Zone.". Then everyone picks "Enter Zone" and "1st Security Zone.".
  • Cooldown: Entering starts a daily cooldown that resets at 04:00 server time ("Security Clearance - Waiting"). It is shared with Security Area 2. After it ends, talk to the manager once to clear it.

docs.title: Walkthrough
docs.text:
The run starts when the party leader steps onto the entrance point. An automatic doll arrives with a warning from Sigma, and Lambda's security test begins.

Zone Monsters Exit warp 1. Entrance 16 80/196 2. North garden 21 174/229 3. East garden 28 254/212 4. Far east garden 31 297/264 (to the boss room)

Each zone is filled with Flower Garden Watchers: Assistant Bot #20622, Dry Rafflesia #20624 and Special Alnoldi #20626. The next zone spawns when someone takes the warp into it. Every monster in a zone must die before its exit warp activates.

docs.title: Boss: Kappa
docs.text:
After zone 4, Kappa opens her room. Take the warp at 297/264, walk up to Kappa, and the party leader talks to her. Red Pepper #20620 then attacks.

  • Energy shield: When she appears, and again at 80%, 60%, 40% and 20% of her HP, she summons 4 Guardian Parts #20679 in the corners of the room. She also raises a strong damage-reducing shield.
  • Every Guardian Part you destroy weakens the shield. Destroy all 4 to remove it completely.
  • If parts are still standing after 40 seconds, they disappear and Kappa keeps whatever shield she has left. Split up and break the parts quickly.

When Kappa falls, a warp opens to Sigma, who waits at 85/77.

docs.text: Security Area 2 is the hard daily mode of the Flower Garden's security zone in Varmundt's Mansion (Episode 17.2). It uses the same map and layout as Security Area 1, but every zone is filled with stronger Senior monsters, and the final boss is Lambda herself. It also pays extra rewards.

docs.title: How to enter
docs.text:
• Where: Walk up to the security perimeter at /navi ba_maison 120/320. The Flower Garden Manager appears.
  • Requirement: Finish the Hidden Flower Garden story instance first ("Security Clearance").
  • Level: Base Level 180 or higher.
  • Party: The party leader picks "Identity Authentication" and then "2nd Security Zone.". Then everyone picks "Enter Zone" and "2nd Security Zone.".
  • Cooldown: Entering starts a daily cooldown that resets at 04:00 server time ("Security Clearance - Waiting"). It is shared with Security Area 1. After it ends, talk to the manager once to clear it.

docs.title: Walkthrough
docs.text:

The zones are filled with Senior Assistant Bot #20623, Senior Dry Rafflesia #20625 and Senior Special Alnoldi #20627. The next zone spawns when someone takes the warp into it. Every monster in a zone must die before its exit warp activates.

docs.title: Boss: Lambda
docs.text:
After zone 4, Lambda invites you to her room. Take the warp at 297/264, walk up to Lambda, and the party leader talks to her. Senior Red Pepper #20621 then attacks.

  • Energy shield: When she appears, and again at 80%, 60%, 40% and 20% of her HP, she summons 4 Guardian Parts #20679 in the corners of the room. She also raises a strong damage-reducing shield.
  • Every Guardian Part you destroy weakens the shield. Destroy all 4 to remove it completely.
  • If parts are still standing after 40 seconds, they disappear and Lambda keeps whatever shield she has left.

When Lambda falls, a warp opens to Sigma, who waits at 85/77.

docs.text: Separated Sanctuary is a boss memorial from the Episode 20 main quest. Nyar has sealed Lasgand away in a separated space, and Aurelie sends you in to drain his power before he fully absorbs a fragment of Ymir's Heart. The whole memorial is one fight against Demigod Lasgand #21979.

docs.title: Requirements and entry
docs.text:
Quest Separate Sanctuary (Episode 20 main story) NPC Aurelie at /navi jor_twig 138/152 Party Required. Only the party leader can open the connection. Time limit 30 minutes

The leader talks to Aurelie and picks Yes! Connect with 'Separated Sanctuary'!, then everyone picks Please let me enter 'Separated Sanctuary'!

docs.title: Walkthrough
docs.text:
1. The party leader talks to the illusion of Aurelie at 99/67. She warns that killing Lasgand will probably be difficult.
  2. The party leader talks to Lasgand at 94/84. He breaks loose, and Demigod Lasgand #21979 (62,647,916 HP) appears at 96/80.
  3. Defeat him. The whole party is moved to 96/66, and three of Nyar's alter egos appear around the spot where he fell.
  4. Talk to Aurelie at 99/67 to finish. She sends you back to /navi jor_twig 136/150.

30-minute limit

The memorial closes 30 minutes after it is created. Make sure the party is ready and can bring Lasgand down within that time before the leader opens it.

Your quest then moves on to The Immortal. Aurelie tells you to take the fragment to the Ice Castle. Aurelie only opens the connection while you are at the Separate Sanctuary step, so this is a one-time run.

docs.text: Simulation Battle is the repeatable Episode 19 rematch against Juncea. Bagot's laboratory has been turned into a training room where you fight a simulated copy of her, Simulation Juncea #21533, once per cooldown.

docs.title: Requirements and entry
docs.text:
NPC Arolong, Nest of Jormungandr: /navi jor_nest 66/260 Prerequisite Episode 19 main story completed (Arolong will not talk to you before then) Party Required. Only the party leader can create the instance; any member can then enter it Time limit 60 minutes (closes after 5 minutes with nobody inside) Cooldown Once per day, starting when you hand in the battle to Arolong. Resets at 04:00 server time.
  1. The party leader talks to Arolong, answers Lift, and picks Prepare to enter Bagot's lab.
  2. Everyone talks to Arolong again and picks Enter Bagot's Lab. Entering adds the Simulation Battle quest to your log.
  3. You arrive in the laboratory (1@jorlab).

Note

Arolong also needs room for one more item in your inventory before he opens the menu.

docs.title: Walkthrough
docs.text:
1. Walk up to the Summon Device in the middle of the laboratory. Only the party leader can start it.
  2. Confirm twice and the device summons Simulation Juncea #21533 at its location.
  3. Kill her. When she dies, the Summon Device reappears.
  4. Each party member talks to the Summon Device and chooses Yes to collect the reward and get sent back to the Nest of Jormungandr (jor_nest 63/257).
  5. Talk to Arolong to hand in the Simulation Battle quest. This gives the turn-in reward and starts the daily cooldown.

If your inventory is full the Summon Device refuses to hand out the Antiquity box but does not send you out, so free a slot and click it again.

Arolong only accepts the quest once Juncea has been defeated. If you leave early, you can go back in and try again.

docs.text: A fortress floating above invaded Prontera keeps spawning undead. Scientist Doyeon opens a warp into it, and your party has to fight through the fortress and destroy the golem Stefan.J.E.Wolf. Along the way you can collect keys that open side rooms with treasure and two optional bosses.

docs.title: How to enter
docs.text:
• NPC: Scientist Doyeon in invaded Prontera, /navi prt_q 249/79. The Fortress Entry Warp Portal is next to her at /navi prt_q 243/75.
  • Level: Base Level 145 or higher. You also need some free inventory space to talk to Doyeon.
  • Party: The party leader talks to Doyeon and picks "Enter the Sky Fortress." (later runs: "Yes"). Then everyone steps into the portal.
  • Cooldown: After your first run, talk to Doyeon again to report. This completes the quest and starts a cooldown that ends at 04:00 server time three days later ("Attack Sky Fortress Invading Prontera"). The first time you report, you also get a 1-hour Sky Fortress Ticket #14505.
  • Skipping the cooldown: With a Sky Fortress Ticket (Sky Fortress Ticket #14505 or Sky Fortress Ticket #14506), the leader can pick "Show the -Dungeon Pass-" to open the fortress during the cooldown. Members use "Put the - Dungeon Pass - near to the warp" at the portal. A second portal in the Dimensional Gap (/navi dali02 115/61) also takes ticket holders in. Entering with a ticket does not change your cooldown, and the ticket is not used up.

docs.title: Step 1: The courtyard
docs.text:
You arrive at the fortress gate. Walk forward a few steps and Stefan.J.E.Wolf #3484 appears. Once his HP drops below 19,000,000, he retreats, and the fortress sends three waves of 8 Immortal Zombie Soldier #3476. The last wave includes a Sky Fortress Key Keeper #3478.

When the waves are cleared, walk up to Stefan at 64/67. He leaves, and the rest of the fortress opens:

  • the stairs at 73/71, which lead to the upper floor
  • the warp at 93/77 to the east wing (210/96)
  • the warp at 190/54 in the east wing, which leads to Stefan's room (the final boss)
  • six Deactivated Warps to the side rooms

Walking into the corridors and the east wing triggers groups of Immortal Fortress Legio #3477, Immortal Zombie Assault #3479 and Immortal Cursed Zombie #3480. Each group has a 20% chance to include another Key Keeper.

docs.title: Keys and side rooms (optional)
docs.text:
Every Sky Fortress Key Keeper #3478 drops a Sky Fortress Key #6960. Use a key on a Deactivated Warp to activate it. Each warp leads to one of six rooms, and the warp-to-room order is shuffled every run.

Room What happens Reward 4 Shadow rooms 10 Immortal Nightmare Shado #3481 or Immortal Angry Shadow #3482 spawn. Kill them all A Sky Fortress Gold Treasure (party leader opens) Cursed Knight room Several Immortal Death Shadow #3483 spawn and a treasure box appears The leader opens the box to summon Immortal Cursed Knight #3474 Wind Ghost room Several Immortal Death Shadow #3483 spawn and a test tube appears The leader examines it to summon Immortal Wind Ghost #3475

The Gold Treasure gives the party leader one item:

Item Chance Elunium #985 32% Oridecon #984 32% Yggdrasil Seed #608 20% Yggdrasil Berry #607 10% Old Card Album #616 5% Mystical Card Album #12246 1%

docs.title: Final boss: Stefan.J.E.Wolf
docs.text:
Take the warp at 190/54 and walk toward the center of the room. Stefan.J.E.Wolf #3473 awakens with 20,000,000 HP.

  • Between 14,000,000 and 6,000,000 HP: Immortal Zombie Soldier #3476 keep spawning in groups of 3, up to 8 at a time.
  • Below 5,000,000 HP: Those adds disappear. Pairs of Cursed Soldier of Bijou #3485 spawn every 8 seconds.
  • Ground-shaking zones (below 5,000,000 HP): Every 6 seconds, several spots around the room shake with a 4-second warning bar. Then each spot becomes deadly for a moment, and anyone standing in it dies instantly. Move as soon as a warning appears under you.

When Stefan dies, the remaining adds vanish and the Sky Fortress Escape Warp appears in the middle of the room.

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• Boss drops from Stefan and the optional bosses.
  • Gold Treasures from the side rooms (see above).
  • 20–40 Instance Points when you leave through the Escape Warp. This counts toward the daily 1,200 cap. The warp takes you back to where you entered (Prontera or the Dimensional Gap).

docs.text: Sticky Sea is the Episode 20 snail pit reached through Cocopo. You first visit it during the Copo's Secret Base side story; afterwards it becomes the repeatable daily quest Escargo!, where you clear waves of Tasty Snail #22000 and kill the Fallen Angel Slug #21982 at the bottom.

docs.title: Requirements and entry
docs.text:
Daily quest NPC Laraha, Ice Castle: /navi icecastle 67/218 Instance NPC Cocopo: /navi jor_back4 101/265 Prerequisite Finish the Copo's Secret Base side story and report back to Laraha Party Required. Only the party leader can create the instance Time limit 30 minutes (closes after 5 minutes with nobody inside) Cooldown Once per day (Escargot! - Wait), starting when you claim the reward. Resets at 04:00 server time.
  1. Talk to Laraha and pick Escargo! to receive the quest. She sends you to Cocopo.
  2. The party leader talks to Cocopo and picks Look at the entrance to the pit. to create the instance.
  3. Everyone picks Enter the pit. to go in. Cocopo only shows this menu while you have the Escargo! quest active.

docs.title: Walkthrough
docs.text:
The pit is a single long path. Each step starts when the party leader talks to the Cocopo NPC waiting at the end of the previous one; the next Cocopo only appears once every snail of the current wave is dead.

Every member should talk to Rorohu at the entrance, not just the leader. Talking to him updates your Escargo! quest to the boss-kill stage. Until the leader has started step 1 and your quest is at that stage, the invisible tiles past the entrance send you back to the start.

The map is also full of roaming Cocopo #21995. They are not part of the run: every one you kill is immediately replaced by a new one, so ignore them unless you are working on Laraha's separate Dangerous! daily.

docs.text: The Temple of the Demon God is the Episode 14.3 finale: your party storms Morroc's temple, defeats his two apostles, kills the ice and fire guardians Brinaranea and Muspellskoll, then faces Morroc in three forms. It is long and mechanic-heavy; most of the bosses punish burst damage with heals.

docs.title: Requirements and entry
docs.text:
Quest NPC Commander Hibba Agip: /navi moro_vol 108/88 Instance NPCs Guardian Nidhogg (create) /navi moro_cav 41/73, Yggdrasil Lookalike (enter) /navi moro_cav 45/75 Level Base level 160 or higher Prerequisite Finish the Morse's Cave part of Episode 14.3 Party Required. The party leader creates the instance and must carry the Demon God Subjugation quest Time limit 60 minutes (closes after 5 minutes with nobody inside) Cooldown Once per day (Caged God), starting when you enter the temple. Resets at 04:00 server time. While it runs you can only re-enter the same temple, not a new one.
  1. Talk to Commander Hibba Agip to accept Demon God Subjugation (kill Despair God Morroc).
  2. The party leader talks to Guardian Nidhogg and picks Enter now. to create the temple.
  3. Everyone clicks the Yggdrasil Lookalike next to her and picks Enter.

docs.title: Walkthrough
docs.text:
Almost every step is started by the party leader, and the leader needs the Demon God Subjugation quest still unfinished for the NPCs to react.

The temple is also patrolled by Mana of White #3101 and its red and yellow counterparts. They respawn 5 seconds after dying anywhere on the map and are not needed for anything.

docs.title: 1. The Apostles
docs.text:
1. The leader talks to Demon God's Apostle Ahat (1@eom 101/43). This gives the leader the Qualifications of the Guests quest and warps the party back to the entrance.
  2. Demon God's Apostle Aha #3105 and Demon God's Apostle Shn #3106 (5,000,000 HP each) appear, each with four Incarnation of Morocc #1918 / Incarnation of Morocc #1921.
  3. Kill all ten. Ahat and Shnaim always drop Heart of Soul #6713 and Sheena's Soul #6714 for players with Qualifications of the Guests.
  4. Once all ten are dead the two Empty Soul Globes (98/56 and 104/56) activate. The leader must click each one while holding the matching soul. When both globes are filled, the gate to the central hall opens at 101/58.

docs.title: 2. Central hall
docs.text:
The leader talks to the Strange Boy (100/122). After the dialogue with Loki and Nidhogg, the gate to the ice area opens at 91/120.

A Nidhogg NPC (94/120) stays in the hall. The party leader can talk to her to summon Guardian's Alter Ego #3087 as a mercenary for 30 minutes. This puts the Guardian's Blessing quest on you, and you cannot summon her again for 3 hours. You cannot use her if you already have a mercenary out.

docs.title: 3. Ice area: Brinaranea
docs.text:
Entering the ice gate gives you Temple of the Demon God Phase 1 (kill Brinaranea).

  • Pick up the eight Cold Mana Crystalline spread around the ice area. Each gives one Last Year's Frost #22566. You need them in the fire area, so collect them all.
  • Groups of Frost Spider #3088 spawn as you walk through.
  • Walking near Brinaranea (38/129) starts the fight with Brinaranea #3091.

Boss mechanics (checked every 3 seconds):

Trigger What happens She loses more than 2,000,000 HP between two checks She casts a full heal on herself ("She's regenerated herself perfectly") HP reaches about 70M, 60M or 50M She calls 5 Frost Spider #3088 around herself and casts Wide Freeze HP below 22,200,000 Rows of Ice Mines march across the room around her Every ~10 seconds One random combo: Wide Freeze + Thunderstorm corners, Wide Freeze + Jupiter Thunder on her target, Wide Freeze + Lord of Vermilion + expanding Thunderstorms, or three self Heals

When she dies a warp back to the central hall appears at 67/149. Talk to the Nidhogg at 59/147 or step on that warp to hand in Phase 1 for 1,000,000 Base / 500,000 Job EXP.

docs.title: 4. Fire area: Muspellskoll
docs.text:
Back in the hall, the leader talks to Morroc (100/122) to open the fire gate at 104/120. Entering it gives Temple of the Demon God Phase 2. Stepping inside spawns nine Frenzied Kasa #3089 and Muspellskoll #3092.

  • Two Flowing Lava pools sit at 154/119 and 182/129. Standing in the lava zones near them drains 3% HP. Click a pool with a Last Year's Frost #22566 to harden it for 2 minutes; this removes its damage zones and stops Muspellskoll from healing at it.
  • At the start of the fight, and again when its HP passes 45M, 40M, 36M and 30M, Muspellskoll runs to the lava pools and heals itself 9 times at each pool that is not frozen, casts Reflect Shield and calls more Frenzied Kasa.
  • If it loses more than 1,000,000 HP within one 3-second check it casts Meteor Storm and heals itself 36 times.
  • Every ~10 seconds it uses one combo: Fire Storm + Sightrasher, Fire Storm + four Fire Pillars, Fire Storm + Flame Cross + four Meteor Storms, or it summons two Mad Salamander #3090.

When it dies a warp back appears at 147/156. Talk to the Nidhogg at 151/155 or use that warp to hand in Phase 2 for 1,000,000 Base / 500,000 Job EXP.

Tip

Freeze both lava pools right before each heal threshold. Each freeze lasts 2 minutes and costs one Frost Crystal, so you only have eight for the whole fight.

docs.title: 5. Final room: Morroc
docs.text:
In the hall, the party leader walks up to the Strange Young Man (98/123). After a short scene the gate to the final room opens at 98/127. Walking up to Morroc there (101/194) starts the last fight.

Phase 1, Demigod. Demigod #3096 appears with a Meteor Storm. Every 6 seconds the script compares its HP: if it lost more than 1,000,000 HP since the last check, it regenerates three times the amount above 200,000 (up to 80,000,000 HP) and casts Heal. Every ~10 seconds it uses a combo of Wide Web, Fire Storm, Lord of Vermilion, Thunderstorm rings or Meteor Storms, sometimes ending in Reflect Shield.

Phase 2, the two Morrocs. When Demigod drops below 40,000,000 HP it moves to 101/207 and Morroc of the Genesis #3098 appears at 114/198, constantly healing Demigod. When Morroc of the Genesis falls below 2,200,000 HP, Morroc of the Sabbath #3099 appears at 86/199.

  • If one of them dies while the other lives, the survivor's HP is set to 3,000,000 (Genesis) or 1,000,000 (Sabbath).
  • Once both are dead, Demigod returns to the centre for phase 3.

Warning

Do not hit Demigod during phase 2. When phase 3 starts, its HP is raised by ten times the damage it took during phase 2 (up to 80,000,000).

Phase 3, Demigod again. Same skills and regeneration rule as phase 1. Below 30,000,000 HP it keeps calling groups of four Frenzied Kasa #3089 around itself.

Despair God. When Demigod dies, Despair God Morroc #3097 spawns at 101/194 about 12 seconds later and attacks with Wide Web, Fire Storm, Wide Freeze and Flame Cross combos. Killing it completes Demon God Subjugation.

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
From Reward Who Ice and fire Nidhogg 1,000,000 Base / 500,000 Job EXP for each phase quest Each player holding the phase quest Nidhogg in the final room (103/194) 20-40 Instance Points, then warp to moro_vol 91/87 Each player who talks to her Commander Hibba Agip (first clear) Expedition Award Box #22567, Darklord Soulpiece #6715, 1,000,000 Base / 500,000 Job EXP Each player who completed the quest Commander Hibba Agip (repeat clears) Expedition Award Box #22567, 1,000,000 Base / 500,000 Job EXP Each player who completed the quest

The Caged God cooldown already started when you entered; reporting to Hibba Agip does not restart it. When it runs out, talk to him again to clear it, then accept Demon God Subjugation again.

docs.title: Guide
docs.text: Thanatos Tower is a custom multi-floor instance. A central hub connects to the tower's floors, and each floor has to be cleared to open the warp to the next one. Each floor ends with one of Thanatos's guardians, and the run finishes with Thanatos himself at the top.

docs.title: Requirements and entry
docs.text:
Level Base Level 180 or higher Party Required. Only the party leader can create the instance, and only the leader can trigger events inside. Entrance Thanatos Tower Entry at /navi thana_step 154/367 Cooldown Once per day per character. Entering starts the cooldown, which resets at 04:00 server time.

The leader picks Generate Thanatos Tower (and is sent in right away). The rest of the party picks Enter Thanatos Tower.

Note

Teleport, Ice Wall and saving are disabled on every tower floor. The system announces how many monsters are left on the current floor after each kill.

docs.title: Walkthrough
docs.text:
The first map is a hub. Each time a floor is cleared, a new pair of warps opens in the hub: one leads to the next floor, the other brings you back.

# Floor Trigger Monsters to clear Floor guardian 1 Observation floor (from the hub's first warp) Leader walks up to the Guardian at around 2@thts 57/171 37 Observation #20800 — 2 Next floor Opens when floor 1 is cleared 20 Divine Punisher #20789 Thanatos' Despair #20797 3 Next floor Opens when the guardian dies 25 Smile Giver #20791 Thanatos' Sorrow #20798 4 Next floor Opens when the guardian dies 25 Pray Giver #20790 Thanatos' Anguish #20799 5 Next floor Opens when the guardian dies 45 Empathizer #20787 / Happiness Giver #20788 Thanatos' Hatred #20796 6 Seal room Opens when the guardian dies 15 (3 each of the five floor monsters) 4 guardians (see below) 7 Thanatos's chamber Opens when the 4 guardians die — Thanatos #20784 or Broken Thanatos #20785

Each guardian spawns as soon as the last monster on its floor dies.

Seal room. After the 15 monsters die, four ancient devices light up in the middle of the room. The leader activates each one. Every device summons a guardian: one Thanatos' Sorrow #20798 and three Thanatos' Anguish #20799. When all four are dead, the warp to Thanatos's chamber opens.

Note

The devices mention keys, and some guardian-shaped NPCs let the leader collect fragments (Fragment of Despair #7439, Fragment of Misery #7437, Fragment of Agony #7436, Fragment of Hatred #7438). The devices do not check or take these items, so you can activate them without any keys.

Thanatos. The leader walks up to the dormant guardian in the chamber (around 8@thts 135/139). After a short awakening, either Thanatos #20784 or Broken Thanatos #20785 spawns (random). While he is alive, two groups of adds spawn in the north-east part of the room 50 seconds after the fight starts, and again 50 seconds after any of those adds dies:

  • 2 Anger of Thanatos #20792
  • 4 of one random type: Horror of Thanatos #20793, Resentment of Thanatos #20794 or Regret of Thanatos #20795

Killing Thanatos stops the adds and makes the Reward NPC appear.

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
Each player talks to the Reward NPC (around 8@thts 140/131) and picks one option. You are then warped to Prontera.

Option Guaranteed Also Reward Option 1 Piece of Sin #1000257 x10, Antiquity Thanatos Tower (Memory of Thanatos) #102572 x1 — Reward Option 2 Fragment of Good Will #1000263 x10, Antiquity Thanatos Tower (Memory of Thanatos) #102572 x1 20 to 40 Instance Points

With either option there is also a 1% chance of one random bonus item from this list:

  • Drooping Thanatos's Dolor [1] #400023
  • Thanatos's Maero Mask #436000
  • Thanatos's Despero Mask #436001
  • Thanatos's Odium Mask #436002
  • Magic Swordsman Thanatos's Sword [1] #480136
  • Thanatos's Necklace #490099

Warning

Only Reward Option 2 gives Instance Points.

Instance Points

Instance Points can be earned once per device for each instance run, up to 1200 per account per day. A rented Charm Of Brightness #30034 adds 50 points per claim. Use @instancepoints to see your total.

docs.text: Thor Military Base is a story instance from the Episode 18 main quest. You sneak into the Thor army camp with Maram, break through four locked barricades while avoiding watchtowers, and gather documents for Miriam. It can only be done once, at the right point of the main story.

docs.title: Requirements and entry
docs.text:
NPC Maram: /navi que_thr 133/53 Prerequisite Episode 18 main quest, at the step where Maram asks you to infiltrate the base Party Required. Only the party leader can create the instance; party members can enter it Equipment Mini Elly #400127 (received at the start of Episode 18), worn on the upper head for the final step Time limit 60 minutes (closes after 5 minutes with nobody inside) Repeatable No, Maram only opens the base while you are on this story step
  1. Talk to Maram. The party leader picks Apply for entry to Thor Military Base.
  2. Everyone talks to Maram again and picks Enter Thor Military Base.

docs.title: Walkthrough
docs.text: The camp is patrolled by 18 Base Soldier #21309 and 18 Temple Guard #21310 placed at random.

docs.title: Watchtowers
docs.text: There are 17 Watchtowers spread through the base. Anyone who comes within 7 cells of a tower sets off an alarm, and 3 Base Soldier #21309 plus 3 Temple Guard #21310 spawn next to it. This happens every time someone walks into range, and being hidden does not stop it. Give the towers a wide berth.

docs.title: Lock Devices
docs.text:
Four barricades block the path. Click any Lock Device of a barricade and wait out the 10 second progress bar to remove the whole barricade.

Barricade Location 1 1@tcamp 138/216 2 1@tcamp 136/145 3 1@tcamp 223/109 4 1@tcamp 80/99

docs.title: Documents and Miriam
docs.text:
Opening the fourth barricade reveals five Piles of documents in the west part of the base, at 32/100, 49/123, 29/86, 60/122 and 31/84. Each pile gives every player one Document Files #1000409.

  1. Collect all 5 Document Files #1000409.
  2. Put on Mini Elly #400127 and talk to Miriam (34/100). She takes the 5 files and the story moves on.
  3. Talk to Maram next to her (32/102) to finish and get warped to wolfvill 162/154.

Tip

Only one player needs to hand the files to Miriam. After that, every party member who is on this step of the main quest gets the reward from Maram.

docs.text: Tomb of Remorse (also called "Tomb of Confession" in its announcements) is a short three-area instance. You lay the restless dead of Princess Tiara's castle to rest, defeat Princess Tiara #20893 and finish with Magic Swordsman Sakray #20892. Its main reward is Minneas #1000367, earned from four quests reported to the Repentant Marquis at the end.

docs.title: Requirements and entry
docs.text:
Level Base Level 220 or higher Party Required. Only the party leader can create the instance and trigger the boss events. NPC Princess Tiara at /navi dali02 78/116 Cooldown Once per day. Entering starts the cooldown, which resets at 04:00 server time.

The leader picks Create Tomb of Remorse, then everyone picks Enter Tomb of Remorse. Entering also gives you any of the four instance quests (see Rewards) that you don't already have and that aren't on cooldown.

docs.title: Walkthrough
docs.text:
Area 1: The hall

  • An Undead Noble #20899 waits north of the entrance with 12 Undead Servant #20900. Only the Noble has to die. Killing it opens a warp portal in the north (around 1@spa2 51/259).
  • Pick up the memory fragments in this area before you leave (see Rewards).

Area 2: Tiara's chamber

  • 30 undead spawn: Undead Archer #20896, Undead Wizard #20897 and Undead Magician #20898. Kill them all.
  • Princess Tiara #20893 then appears. Kill her, staying close together: party members need to be nearby to get credit for the "Tears of Sorrow" quest.
  • Sakurai appears. The leader talks to him to play a short scene with Himmelz. A portal then opens in the upper left of the area (around 1@spa2 210/254).

Area 3: The castle grounds

  • 30 more undead spawn across the area: Undead Knight #20894, Undead Soldier #20895, Undead Archer #20896 and Undead Wizard #20897. Kill them all to open the portal in the centre (around 1@spa2 57/41).
  • In the last room, the leader talks to Sakurai to summon Magic Swordsman Sakray #20892.
  • Once Sakray dies, the Repentant Marquis and the exit portal appear.

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
Talk to the Repentant Marquis (around 1@spa2 211/81) to turn in your quests:

Quest (menu option) Requirement Reward Cooldown after turn-in Severing Fate Kill Magic Swordsman Sakray #20892 10 times (counts across runs) Minneas #1000367 x10 Until the next 04:00 reset Tears of Sorrow Kill Princess Tiara #20893 8 times (counts across runs) Minneas #1000367 x8 Until the next 04:00 reset Shattered Memories The party collects all 5 Memory Fragments in this run Minneas #1000367 x1 Until the next 04:00 reset Shattered Past The party finds the special Memory Fragment near Princess Tiara's memory Minneas #1000367 x1 Until the next 04:00 reset

Memory Fragment locations:

  • Shattered Memories (5): 1@spa2 74/211, 1@spa2 83/255 (area 1) and 1@spa2 215/245, 1@spa2 230/252, 1@spa2 201/254 (area 2)
  • Shattered Past (1): 1@spa2 28/226 (area 1). Clicking it plays a short memory of Princess Tiara.

Each fragment can be clicked only once per run, by anyone in the party, and counts for the whole party. Every member can then claim the two fragment quests.

Leaving through the exit portal next to the Marquis gives 20 to 40 Instance Points and warps you to Prontera, so claim your quest rewards first.

Exchange: spend Minneas #1000367 at the Marquis of Remorse at /navi dali02 78/112. He offers jewel, weapon and reform-material exchanges, plus the Thanatos helmet enchant.

Instance Points

Instance Points can be earned once per device for each instance run, up to 1200 per account per day. A rented Charm Of Brightness #30034 adds 50 points per claim. Use @instancepoints to see your total.

docs.text: Twilight Garden is a one-time story instance from the Episode 17.2 main quest (Pest Extermination). With Est and Almond you fight through the Heart Hunters in the garden and take down Sweety. The same maps are reused by the daily Hey! Sweety instance, which is entered separately.

docs.title: Requirements and entry
docs.text:

docs.title: Walkthrough
docs.text:
The early steps only react to the party leader; later NPCs can be clicked by anyone.

  1. Entrance. The leader steps forward to make Est appear, then talks to her. Five Heart Hunters show up to the south-east. When the leader walks up to them, 6 Heart Hunter Skirmisher #20681 attack. Kill them all.
  2. Second ambush. The leader talks to Est again (119/299). Five more Heart Hunter Skirmisher #20681 spawn around 210/283. Kill them.
  3. Meet Almond. Est and Almond wait at 202/274. Talk to Est, then to Almond, who walks ahead to 245/248.
  4. The Repeater. Talk to Almond again: 4 Heart Hunter Skirmisher #20681 spawn at 247/207. Kill them, then talk to the Intruder (242/206) to spawn 2 Heart Hunter Commander #20699. Kill both.
  5. To the rebels. Talk to Almond. She walks east to 327/189. Talk to her again and follow her to the rebel standoff near 326/158; walking up to it moves the scene along and the Intruder appears at 333/141. Talk to it.
  6. Regroup. Talk to Almond once more and follow her to 261/87, where Est is waiting at 257/84. Talk to Est to open the way to Sweety.
  7. Path to the warp. Head to the warp at 33/224. Three ambush points on the way (around 67/195, 78/204 and 61/214) each spawn 3 Heart Hunter Commander #20699 when you walk past.
  8. Sweety. The warp takes you to 1@bamq 103/39. Walk up to the Intruder at 125/39 and Sweety #20642 (500,000 HP) attacks. Killing it completes Pest Extermination.
  9. Take the exit warp at 101/39 (leads to ba_maison 33/220) and report back to Est.

docs.text: Villa of Deception is a repeatable Episode 18 instance in Grey Wolf Village. The party fights through the villa's corridor, central hall and garden, then defeats Schulang #21316 and finally Twisted God Freyja #21317 in the basement. It has a Normal and an Advanced (hard) mode.

docs.title: Requirements and entry
docs.text:
Normal Advanced Level 170+ 200+ Cost to create Free 1 Villa Basement Key #1000471 (taken from the party leader) Party Required, leader creates Required, leader creates
  • NPC: Aira at /navi wolfvill 79/260. She appears once you have progressed far enough in the Episode 18 main quest.
  • Cooldown: entering either mode starts a shared cooldown that resets at 04:00 server time. When it is over, talk to Aira once to clear it before entering again.

The leader picks Create Villa of Deception (or Create Villa of Deception Advanced, which only shows up while the leader has a Villa Basement Key). Then everyone picks Entry and the mode.

docs.title: Mode differences
docs.text: Normal Advanced Monsters Goddess Guardian #21318, Cottage Keeper #21319 Goddess Guardian #21377, Cottage Keeper #21378 Bosses Schulang #21316, Twisted God Freyja #21317 Schulang #21360, Twisted God Freyja #21361 Monsters to kill in the hall (stage 2) 35 70 Monsters to kill in the garden (stage 3) 35 80 Plague zones in the garden (before food) 16 48 Wandering magic circles in the final room 2 4

docs.title: Walkthrough
docs.text:
Stage 1: Corridor of souls

  • The corridor is full of monsters, and Death-shaped traps patrol the row in front of the hall door. Touching a trap pushes you back and deals 50% of your Max HP.
  • To open the hall, two players must free the souls (wisps) at the two ends of the hallway, at 1@advs 67/182 and 1@advs 180/182, within 3 seconds of each other. If only one is freed in time, both reset.
  • Once both are freed, the remaining corridor monsters vanish and the door to the hall opens.

Stage 2: The hall

  • Monsters keep spawning until the stage total is reached. A counter announces how many are left.
  • Four food tables are in the hall. Eating takes 4 seconds and gives you a random ailment (Confusion, Curse, Blind, Poison or Silence) for 30 seconds. Every 2 dishes eaten removes one Plague zone from the next stage, down to a minimum of 3.
  • Kill every monster to open the warp to the garden. The warp drops you at a random spot in the garden.

Tip

The food is worth it, especially in Advanced: the garden starts with 48 Plague zones.

Stage 3: The garden

  • Plague of Corruption #20846 zones appear at random spots in the garden and are reshuffled to new random spots every 10 seconds. Avoid standing in them.
  • Kill the stage's monster total to open the way to the next room.

Stage 4: Schulang

  • The leader talks to Schulang at the end of the room. Schulang #21316 spawns (Normal) or Schulang #21360 (Advanced), together with one Cottage Keeper #21319.
  • Schulang repeatedly casts Thunder Storm in a grid of five columns, sweeping row by row. One random column is left untouched each cycle. Stand in that column to dodge the storm.
  • Killing Schulang opens the warp to the final room.

Stage 5: Twisted God Freyja

  • The leader clicks the spot under the chandelier at the top of the room. Twisted God Freyja then spawns.
  • Freyja takes less damage the farther she is from the chandelier (around 1@advs 124/356). Pull her as close to it as you can.
  • Magic circles wander around the room. Stepping on one costs 10% HP and warps you all the way back to the Stage 1 corridor.
  • Four yellow magic stones on the sides of the room can stop the circles. Using one drains 2 to 20% of your HP and SP (it can kill you). If you survive, all circles stop moving for 10 seconds. A stone can be used again 20 seconds later.

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
When Freyja dies, a glowing box appears under the chandelier. Each player opens it once for:

Reward Amount Amethyst Fragment #1000405 8 (10 with 5000 Grey Wolf Village reputation) Villa Basement Key #1000471 1, 10% chance (needed to open Advanced mode) Instance Points 20 to 40 (random) on Normal, 40 to 60 on Advanced, given when you choose Exit

Both modes give the same box rewards.

Instance Points

Instance Points can be earned once per device for each instance run, up to 1200 per account per day. A rented Charm Of Brightness #30034 adds 50 points per claim. Use @instancepoints to see your total.

The function to drop an item with random option is defined in re/other/glocal_npc2.txt Notes: Some of the setting can be modified in 'Optional settings'. The monster inside the hard mode are using relieve level 10 (-99% damages). Change it if you think the player damage are too low, this level is a workaround but the damages on the mobs are lower in hard mode than in normal on official. The level is 9 on official.

docs.text: Water Garden is the Episode 17.2 instance at the Ba Maison docks. The party clears five garden areas tended by broken gardener bots, each with its own trap, and ends with a fight against Silva Papilia #20667 (Normal) or Gran Papilia #20668 (Hard).

docs.title: Requirements and entry
docs.text:
Normal Hard Level — Base Level 180+ (party leader) Story progress Progress in the Episode 17.2 Water Garden story Leader must also have completed "Completion of the Antidote" Party Required, leader creates Required, leader creates
  • NPC: Harad at /navi ba_maison 238/44.
  • Cooldown: entering starts a "Water Garden - Waiting" cooldown that resets at 04:00 server time. Talk to Harad after it expires to clear it.

The leader picks Create Water Garden or Create Water Garden Hard. Everyone then picks Garden Entrance and the matching mode.

Note

The mode is locked in when the party leader steps onto the entrance area inside the instance. The leader must go in first, before anyone uses the warp into the gardens.

docs.title: Walkthrough
docs.text:
Area 1: Meteor garden

  • Take the warp east of the entrance and talk to the Gardener at around 1@ghg 216/58 to start.
  • The area clears once fewer than 2 of its monsters are left. The rest vanish automatically.
  • Trap: every ~24 seconds the whole party is teleported to one of eight spots in the garden. 2 seconds later a warning appears, and 2 seconds after that Papilas cast Meteor Storm on all eight spots, including the one you were sent to. Move away from your landing spot right after the teleport.

Area 2: Heaven's Drive board

  • Take the warp to the next garden and talk to the Gardener at around 1@ghg 316/69.
  • Again the area clears once fewer than 2 monsters are left.
  • Trap: every ~27 seconds, three Papilas appear on the 6x6 board. About 5 seconds later each one fires Heaven's Drive in lines spreading 5, 10, 15 and 20 cells outward:
    • red Papila Ruba #20673: in a cross (+)
    • blue Papila Cae #20676: in a diagonal (X)
  • Stand off those lines, or kill a Papila before it casts to cancel its pattern.

Area 3: Ambush corridor

  • Warp north and walk past the Gardener at around 1@ghg 341/143 to start the area.
  • Follow the long corridor west and back east. Hidden spots along the way spawn ambush groups. You don't have to kill them.
  • At the end, talk to the Gardener at around 1@ghg 344/173 (5-second progress bar). This opens the warp to the maze.

Note

Characters in Hiding/Cloaking do not trigger the corridor spots.

Area 4: Maze

  • The warp drops you at a random spot in the maze.
  • Only two monsters are required: the red Papila Ruba #20671 (around 1@ghg 278/241) and the blue Papila Cae #20674 (around 1@ghg 278/301). In Hard mode these are the Senior versions. All other monsters in the maze are optional.
  • Killing both opens the warp to the final garden.
  • One of four Gardeners in the maze (chosen at random) hands out a Gardener's Cookie #1000099 if you are on the daily quest "Searching for Gardener" (see Rewards).

Area 5: Silva Papilia

  • Talk to Velkina at around 1@ghg 186/287 to summon the boss.
  • Every cycle, a red Papila Ruba and a blue Papila Cae spawn in the centre, and one red and one blue pillar light up for 15 seconds. Lead each Papila into the light of the pillar with its own colour and it dies instantly.
  • When the pillars go out, everyone is pulled to the centre and loses 50% of their current Max HP (this cannot kill you; it leaves at least 1 HP). A second later everyone is thrown to a random edge of the arena (north, south, east or west). Heal up right after the pull.
  • The cycle repeats every ~18 seconds until the boss dies.

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• Talk to Velkina after the boss dies. She warps you out and gives 20 to 40 Instance Points on Normal or 40 to 60 on Hard.
  • Daily quest "Searching for Gardener" from Seihyu at /navi ba_maison 239/47: accept it before your run, get the Gardener's Cookie #1000099 from the gardener in the maze, then hand it in for Barmil Ticket #1000103 x4 and 800,000 Base / 500,000 Job EXP.

Instance Points can be earned once per device for each instance run, up to 1200 per account per day. A rented Charm Of Brightness #30034 adds 50 points per claim. Use @instancepoints to see your total.

docs.text: Wave Mode is Zonda's tower-defence style instance. Monsters walk along a fixed path toward an exit, and your party has to kill them before they get through. There are two versions, Forest and Sky, created from the same NPC. There is no final wave: the run lasts until 20 monsters escape or the instance time runs out.

docs.title: Requirements and entry
docs.text:
NPC Zonda Rep (Belka): /navi prontera 146/75, /navi payon 166/98, /navi moc_para01 45/89, /navi morocc 168/271 Level No requirement Party Required. Only the party leader can request an instance Time limit 60 minutes (closes after 5 minutes with nobody inside) Cooldown None; you can request a new instance as soon as the old one is gone
  1. The party leader talks to the Zonda Rep, picks Request entry., chooses Forest or Sky and signs.
  2. Everyone picks Enter Wave Mode - Forest or Enter Wave Mode - Sky.

The Zonda Rep remembers where you entered from. When the run is over, the exit warp sends you back to that spot.

docs.title: Common rules
docs.text:
• A new wave starts every 24 seconds, whether or not the previous one is dead.
  • Monsters walk the path and do not stop to fight unless the wave is aggressive (see Sky below).
  • Every monster that reaches the end of the path counts as escaped. At 20 escapes the challenge fails, waves stop, an exit warp opens, and the instance is destroyed 30 seconds later.

Tip

Escapes never reset, so a leak in an early wave still counts at wave 40. Area skills along the path are the main tool; monsters ignore players and keep walking.

docs.title: Wave Mode - Forest
docs.text:
Map 1@def01. The run starts as soon as the first player arrives at the entrance: there are about 20 seconds of announcements, then a 3-2-1 countdown. Monsters enter at the top of the bridge and walk straight down to its other end.

  • Normal waves spawn 24 monsters, one every 0.3 seconds.
  • Every 5th wave is a champion wave with 5 champion monsters side by side.
  • The monster list repeats every 70 waves (wave 71 is Porings again).

docs.text:
Map 1@def02. Step on the warp at the entrance to start; after a short delay the 3-2-1 countdown begins. Monsters run a winding path around the map and finish back next to the entrance.

  • Normal waves spawn 15 monsters at half-second intervals. Every other monster is aggressive and will attack players; the others only walk.
  • Each normal wave also sends out 2 friendly Mercenary #3086 that walk the path in the opposite direction and fight the invaders. They disappear after 45 seconds.
  • Every 5th wave is a treasure wave: no monsters, just Treasure #3075 boxes scattered over the map. The first treasure wave has 1 box, each one after adds another up to a maximum of 5. The boxes roll a dice countdown and self-destruct about 19 seconds after appearing, so break them fast.

docs.title: Guide
docs.text: A weekend-only training ground. You pick a level bracket, then farm endlessly respawning Familiars, Skeletons and Zombies for experience, while hunting for treasure chests full of EXP elixirs.

docs.title: How to enter
docs.text:
NPC Marry Jae in Archer Village: /navi pay_arche 44/124 Open Saturday 00:00 ~ Sunday 23:59 (server time) only Level 60+ Party Required, but a party of one is fine. The party leader prepares the dungeon Re-entry After your first entry you may re-enter for 1 hour; after that you must wait until the next 04:00 server time Time limit 1 hour

Note

Taming monsters inside does not count as a kill.

docs.title: Choosing the difficulty
docs.text:
Inside, the party leader talks to Marry Jae at the entrance and picks a bracket. The leader's own base level must reach the bracket's minimum. The bracket sets which monsters spawn:

Bracket Familiar Skeleton Zombie Lv 60 ~ 79 Familiar #3643 Skeleton #3637 Zombie #3649 Lv 80 ~ 99 Familiar #3644 Skeleton #3638 Zombie #3650 Lv 100 ~ 119 Familiar #3645 Skeleton #3639 Zombie #3651 Lv 120 ~ 139 Familiar #3646 Skeleton #3640 Zombie #3652 Lv 140 ~ 159 Familiar #3647 Skeleton #3641 Zombie #3653 Lv 160+ Familiar #3648 Skeleton #3642 Zombie #3654

Once chosen, Marry Jae leaves and about 95 monsters (37 Familiars, 27 Skeletons, 31 Zombies) fill the map. The bracket cannot be changed for that instance.

docs.title: Farming and treasure chests
docs.text:
• Every monster you kill respawns somewhere random on the map 10 seconds later, so the map never empties.
  • Each kill has a 1% chance to make a treasure chest appear. The whole map is told when it happens. The chests appear in turn at four spots: 99/172, 235/60, 53/267 and 238/252.
  • A chest disappears after 3 minutes. Opening it drops 3 elixirs on the ground, each randomly a Minor Growth Elixir #23142 or a Minor Job Elixir #23143.
Elixir Effect Minor Growth Elixir #23142 15,000 base EXP below level 100, 1,500 base EXP at level 100+ Minor Job Elixir #23143 15,000 job EXP below level 100, 1,500 job EXP at level 100+

docs.title: Gift Supplies Clerk
docs.text: Next to Marry Jae (/navi pay_arche 44/121). For 60,000 zeny she packs 5 Minor Growth Elixir #23142 into a Minor Growth Elixir Box #23144, or 5 Minor Job Elixir #23143 into a Minor Job Elixir Box #23145.

docs.text: The Central Room of Werner's laboratory is part of the Terra Gloria (Episode 16.2) story. You visit it once during the main quest, then come back for the repeatable daily Sweeping the remnants, where you fight through the lab's guards and security devices to kill the Pet Child #3621.

docs.title: Requirements and entry
docs.text:
Instance NPC Rookie: /navi slabw01 236/91 (entrance gate next to him at 246/88) Daily quest NPC Rookie: /navi que_swat 150/58 Prerequisite Story run: Terra Gloria main quest at the Central Room step. Daily: Terra Gloria main quest finished Party Required. Only the party leader can create the instance Time limit 60 minutes (closes after 5 minutes with nobody inside) Cooldown Daily quest: once per day (Sweeping the remnants (Standby)), starting when you hand it in. Resets at 04:00 server time.

Daily run:

  1. Talk to the Rookie in que_swat, choose About the monster in the central room and accept Sweeping the remnants (kill one Pet Child).
  2. Go to the Rookie in slabw01. The party leader (with the quest active) picks Enter now. to create the instance.
  3. Click the Central Room gate next to him and pick Go in.

Party members with the daily quest active talk to the Rookie after the leader has created the instance; the gate then appears for them. Click it and pick Go in.

docs.title: Walkthrough (daily)
docs.text: The run is a chain of rooms. Doors open when the party leader solves the Security devices.

docs.title: Security devices
docs.text:
Each device shows one of the sample names in red and in blue and you must pick the correct colour. The rule from the samples on display: change red to blue, and blue to red.

Sample Correct answer Purity, Eternity, Dawn the blue option Rose, Contradiction, Joy, Sea, Way back home, Loneliness, Glow, Twilight the red option

A wrong answer resets both devices of that pair, so you have to solve them again. Only the party leader can use the devices.

docs.title: Room 1
docs.text:
When the leader steps off the entrance, four Guards appear along the hallway. Walking within 4 cells of one triggers an ambush of Special Guard #3622:

Guard Ambush 188/58 3 near it, plus 3 more further up the hall 189/117 3 near it, plus 6 more in two groups further up 171/167 1; killing it activates Security device L-01 (155/191) 206/167 3; killing them activates Security device R-01 (220/191)

Solve both devices to open the warp at 187/170.

docs.title: Room 2
docs.text:
Three more Guards appear:

Guard Ambush 70/38 3 33/52 3; killing them activates Security device L-02 (22/61) 111/52 3; killing them activates Security device R-02 (122/61)

Solving both opens the warp at 71/77 and the Central Entrance door.

docs.title: Central Room
docs.text:
When the leader steps on the Central Entrance (54/146) they choose:

  • Proceed with the story. Replays the scene with Eisen Werner and Seyren. Afterwards the room resets and the party is sent back outside the door, so you can then choose the battle.
  • Proceed with the battle. The leader walks up to the Pet Child; after about 15 seconds the magic field activates and Pet Child #3621 spawns.

Other party members who step on the door just go inside. Killing the Pet Child completes Sweeping the remnants and opens the Emergency exit at 55/150, which leads to que_swat 155/58.

docs.title: Story run
docs.text: During the main quest the same rooms are used, but Eisen Werner talks to you at each stage instead of the guard ambushes, and the leader still has to solve the four Security devices. At the end, talking to Eisen Werner in the central room gives the party leader Blessing Star #25179 and Small Leather Bag #23087, 20-40 Instance Points, and a warp to que_swat 155/50.

docs.title: Rewards (daily)
docs.text:
Hand in Sweeping the remnants to the Rookie in que_swat:

Reward Amount Schwarz's Honor Token #25155 3 Base EXP 200,000 Job EXP 200,000

[Walkthrough conversion] Require Terra Gloria main quest. Note: For now there are 2 instances (officially one) to avoid exploit, the warp entry being the same. The first (main quest) is a solo instance and the 2nd (daily) a a party instance. The instance is a basic version, KRO added Seyren boss fight in the next updates.
