docs.title: Guide
docs.text: Wolfchev's Laboratory is the hidden experiment wing of the Lighthalzen Bio Lab. Your party fights through three security labs full of Desert Wolf #2242 and then faces one randomly chosen transcendent experiment, one of the thirteen Bio Lab heroes. Killing all thirteen over several runs earns a reward from Wolfchev himself.

docs.title: Requirements and entry
docs.text:
NPCs Researcher (create) /navi lhz_dun04 151/276, Laboratory Entrance (enter) /navi lhz_dun04 147/279 Getting there Take the warp at lhz_dun03 239/78 down to the 4th floor Party Required. Only the party leader can create the instance Time limit 4 hours (closes after 5 minutes with nobody inside) Cooldown Once per day (Laboratory Restricted Access), starting when you enter. Resets at 04:00 server time.
  1. Talk to the Researcher once to receive the thirteen [Rest] boss quests (one per experiment).
  2. The party leader talks to the Researcher again, picks Going into the laboratory and creates the instance.
  3. Everyone clicks the Laboratory Entrance and picks Go inside. This starts your personal daily cooldown.

Note

When your cooldown has expired, click the Laboratory Entrance once to clear it, then click again to enter. The leader cannot create a new instance while still on cooldown. The Researcher, the Entrance and Wolfchev all want at least 1,000 free weight before they talk to you.

docs.title: Lab No.1: emergency valves
docs.text:
A few seconds after you arrive the security system releases 10-15 Desert Wolf #2242. Kill them all to stop the system. Then:

  1. The party leader reads the Manual Sheet (1@lhz 39/168). It gives one random procedure for either the left or the right valve.
  2. The leader turns that valve (left 41/172, right 52/172) exactly as written: four turns in total.
Manual says Valve Turns Clockwise twice, Counterclockwise once, Clockwise once Left CW, CW, CCW, CW Clockwise once, Counterclockwise twice, Clockwise once Left CW, CCW, CCW, CW Clockwise once, Counterclockwise once, Clockwise twice Left CW, CCW, CW, CW Counterclockwise twice, Clockwise once, Counterclockwise once Right CCW, CCW, CW, CCW Counterclockwise once, Clockwise twice, Counterclockwise once Right CCW, CW, CW, CCW Counterclockwise once, Clockwise once, Counterclockwise twice Right CCW, CW, CCW, CCW

A wrong sequence does nothing and you have to read the manual again (which may give a new procedure). The right sequence opens the door to Lab No.2 at 45/173.

docs.title: Lab No.2: pipe pressure
docs.text:
Stepping in starts the security system and the pipe alarms.

  • Monster waves: Starving Lab animals (Desert Wolf #2242) arrive in waves at about 0:08 (10), 5:08 (20), 10:08 (16), 15:08 (19) and 20:08 (20).
  • Pipe pressure: roughly every 3 minutes one or more Valves light up around the room, each with 5 Desert Wolf #2243. The party leader must click any lit valve and finish a 20 second progress bar within 63 seconds, or a pipe explodes.
  • Three pipe explosions freeze the system: after a 10 second warning, everyone in Lab No.2 is thrown out to lhz_dun04.

The moment every spawned animal in Lab No.2 is dead, the security system stops, no more waves or pipe alarms come, and the door to Lab No.3 opens at 151/64.

Tip

You do not have to survive all five waves. Clear the first wave quickly and the lab is done before the second one arrives. Keep the leader free to run to the valves.

docs.title: Lab No.3: animal pens
docs.text: Five waves of mixed Desert Wolf #2242 and Desert Wolf #2243 spawn in the pens around 83/58: the first at 0:12 (10 animals), then every 3 minutes with 1-5 animals per spawn point. As in Lab No.2, the door to Lab No.4 (83/62) opens as soon as every spawned animal is dead.

docs.title: Lab No.4: the experiment
docs.text:
After about 17 seconds of whispers, one random experiment out of thirteen wakes up from its tube:

Lord Knight Seyren #1646 Sniper Cecil #1650 Stalker Gertie #2239 Assassin Cross Eremes #1647 Gypsy Trentini #2241 Champion Chen #2238 Clown Alphoccio #2240 Creator Flamel #2236 Paladin Randel #2235 Professor Celia #2237 High Wizard Kathryne #1651 High Priest Margaretha #1649 Whitesmith Howard #1648

Killing it completes that experiment's [Rest] quest and makes Wolfchev appear at 137/156.

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
Talk to Wolfchev after the boss dies:

  • Not all thirteen [Rest] quests done yet: leave with 20-40 Instance Points and a warp to lhz_dun04 147/273.
  • All thirteen done: Wolfchev removes the quests and gives one random reward below. Accept the quests again from the Researcher (Going into the laboratory, then Why not) to start a new collection.
Reward Chance Salvage Cape #2582 8.3% Ancient Gold Ornament [1] #18570 8.3% Gigantic Lance #1490 8.3% Bloody Cross #16017 8.3% Guillotine Katar [1] #1291 8.3% Cold Magic Book [2] #1584 8.3% Chills Of Death #6471 x10 8.3% Blood Thirst #6470 x10 8.3% Warrior's Will #6469 x10 8.3% Chills Of Death #6471 x20 8.3% Blood Thirst #6470 x20 8.3% Warrior's Will #6469 x20 8.7%

Tip

The boss is random each run, so finishing all thirteen usually takes many more than thirteen runs. Each player's quests are tracked separately, so party members can be at different points in their collection.

Defeat Wolfchev's human experimentations.

docs.title: Guide
docs.text: Wolves Gathering Place is a one-time story instance from the Episode 18 main quest ("Wolf Among Sheep"). You follow Miriam, Suad and Lamacus's group through a riot in the temple district and the temple vaults beneath it, fighting the temple guards and Heart Hunters behind the unrest. It gives no item rewards. Clearing it advances the main quest and unlocks the daily Sanctuary Purification instance.

docs.title: Requirements and entry
docs.text:
Level Base Level 170 or higher Quest Episode 18 main quest, at the "Rebellion (3)" step Party Required. Only the party leader can create the instance and advance the story. Entrance Ordinary Person in Rachel, /navi rachel 169/245

The leader talks to the Ordinary Person (Suad and Miriam appear next to her) and picks Yes, go ahead and send the signal. to create the instance. Everyone then talks to her again and picks Let's enter quickly.

Note

Almost every story trigger in this instance only responds to the party leader. Other members can follow along and fight, but the leader has to do the talking.

docs.title: Walkthrough
docs.text:
The instance uses navigation markers, so the next destination is usually pointed out for you.

  1. The square. Walk up to Miriam near the entrance, then follow the group to Suad (around 1@nyr 125/41). The leader talks to her, and the group heads for the temple. Take the warp in the north-east (around 1@nyr 179/168) to enter the temple.
  2. Temple entrance. Walk up to Miriam, then the leader talks to the Temple Guard next to her. Five Temple Guard #21310 attack. Kill them.
  3. First corridor. Follow the corridor south to Miriam and Lamacus. The leader talks to Lamacus. Five more Temple Guard #21310 attack.
  4. The next room. Follow the warps onward. The leader talks to Lamacus again, then kills another five Temple Guard #21310.
  5. The vault corridor. In the eastern room, the leader talks to Lamacus a third time. Five Temple Guard #21310 spawn, and when they die the vault unlocks.
  6. The vault. Go to Miriam in the centre room and the leader talks to her to watch the scene with Bagot and Schulang.
  7. Heart Hunters revealed. Go north to Miriam (around 2@nyr 118/199). After the conversation, 3 Heart Hunter #21308 and 5 Temple Guard #21310 attack together. Kill them, then talk to Miriam again.
  8. Back to the surface. Follow the warps out of the vault area to the north-east exit (around 2@nyr 203/220). The last warp takes you back to the temple square on the first map.
  9. The riot. Walk into the square to trigger the crowd scene, then the leader talks to Miriam and afterwards to Suad. Ten Heart Hunter #21308 attack. Kill them all.
  10. Wrap-up. The leader talks to Miriam once more to finish the story, then leave through the exit in the south-west of the square (around 1@nyr 43/26). It returns you to Rachel.

Tip

Your main quest step is only updated when you walk through the exit after the final talk with Miriam. Don't leave any other way, or your quest won't move on to "Wolf Among Sheep (2)".

docs.title: After clearing
docs.text:
Completing the instance unlocks the Priest next to the Ordinary Person in Rachel, who offers the repeatable daily instance Sanctuary Purification.

docs.title: Story Path
docs.text:
Follow these pages in order to play through Miracle's episode storylines without getting lost. Each page lists what you need before you start, then every story step: who to talk to, where to find them with /navi, and what to do. It also lists the rewards and what finishing the episode unlocks.

Order Episode Level Story instances 1 13.1: Ash Vacuum 70+ 2 14.3: Dimensional Travel 140+ (160 for the finale) Isle of Bios, Morse's Cave, Temple of the Demon God 3 15.1: Phantasmagorika 140+ 4 15.2: Memory Records 140+ Last Room 5 16.1: Banquet for Heroes 100+ Ritual of Blessing, Room of Consciousness 6 16.2: Terra Gloria 100+ Heart Hunter War Base, Werner Laboratory 7 17.1: Illusion 100+ Regenschirm, Sealed OS, Cor Memorial 8 17.2: Sage's Legacy 130+ Twilight Garden 9 18: Direction of Prayer 170+ Wolves Gathering Place, Oz Labyrinth, High Priest's Villa, Thor Military Base 10 19: Issgard, Land of Snow Flowers 200+ Iwin Patrol, Bagot Laboratory, Confused Snake's Nest, Airship Destruction 11 20: Immortals 215+ Canyon Exploration, Drift Ice Zone, Nest of Twigs, Separated Sanctuary, Immortal 12 21: Age of Heroes 230+ Gimli Infiltration, Mysterious Ghost Ship, Final Battle, Secret Altar, Silent Sanctuary 13 Chapter 1: Call of the World Tree 200+ Ominous Dark Whisper

Short on time?

The Episode Skip NPC can complete some episodes for you. Each episode page says what the skip covers and what it leaves out.

docs.title: Chapter 1: Call of the World Tree
docs.text:
Dimensional rifts are opening all over the world, and the World Tree is calling adventurers to Ashridge, a village on its branches. From there you explore the Twisted Land of Darkness, help a plague-stricken Geffen in the second world, track the Immortal Legion into the Dark Whisper, meet the gray valkyries of Brimir and find a cure in Muspelheim, before you join Est to infiltrate the Dark Whisper itself.

  • Level: Base Level 200 or higher.
  • Starts at: the Small Ash Tree outside Prontera, /navi prt_fild05 353/252, or the one outside Payon, /navi pay_fild01 308/341.
  • Main hub: Ashridge (ygg_edge and its fruit rooms ygg_fruit), with Old Geffen (ch1_geffen and its interiors ch1_gef_in) as the second base.

docs.title: Before you start
docs.text:
• Base Level 200. The Small Ash Tree only checks your level. You do not need to finish Episode 21 first.
  • 5 Dragon Scales. Debris asks for 5 Dragon Scale #1036 early in the story (step 13).
  • A party for Ominous Dark Whisper at the end of the story. The party leader creates it.
  • Getting around. Ashridge has fixed doors into its fruit rooms: the Sour Fruit (ygg_edge 164/140, Lapine Shasha), the Long Fruit (ygg_edge 150/127, Debris), the Fresh Fruit (ygg_edge 72/154, Assistant Baily), the Inn (ygg_edge 88/184) and the Shops (ygg_edge 139/211). Naviel (/navi ygg_edge 167/182) marks any of them on your mini-map. The Land of Darkness gate is at ygg_edge 31/117. From the Twisted Land of Darkness, the red gates lead to Hem Field (ygg_roots 157/242), the Unknown Ruins (ygg_roots 34/126) and Muspelheim (ygg_roots 343/252, too hot until step 62). Old Geffen is through the west edge of Hem Field (hem_fild 31/193).

docs.title: Part 1: Call of the World Tree
docs.text:
1. Click the Small Ash Tree at /navi prt_fild05 353/252 (or /navi pay_fild01 308/341). Lapine Lara invites you to Ashridge and sends you there. Quest: Call of The World Tree (1).
  2. Talk to the Lapine Messenger (/navi ygg_edge 253/246). She sends you to the Sour Fruit room. Quest: Call of The World Tree (2).
  3. Talk to Lapine Shasha in the Sour Fruit room (/navi ygg_fruit 80/122). Quest: Call of The World Tree (3).
  4. Talk to Maysel next to her (/navi ygg_fruit 82/120). Quest: Twisted Land of Darkness.

docs.title: Part 2: The Twisted Land of Darkness
docs.text:
1. Take the Land of Darkness gate (ygg_edge 31/117). Walk over the three Investigation Points in order: /navi ygg_roots 334/138, /navi ygg_roots 299/59 and /navi ygg_roots 186/117. Quest: Regeneration (every step of this part uses this title).
  2. Click the Source of Sound (/navi ygg_roots 167/135), then talk to Yvain next to it (ygg_roots 166/135) and pick Lift the roots.
  3. Talk to Magi at /navi ygg_roots 153/203, then Magi at /navi ygg_roots 161/237.
  4. Take the Hem Field gate (ygg_roots 157/242) and talk to the Investigator at /navi hem_fild 208/22. Go back to Magi (/navi ygg_roots 161/237).
  5. Talk to the Investigator at /navi ygg_roots 112/246, then Mark at /navi ygg_roots 39/268, Tamarin at /navi ygg_roots 91/149 and Tamarin at /navi ygg_roots 40/129.
  6. Take the Unknown Ruins gate (ygg_roots 34/126) and talk to Alf (/navi uknw_ruin 244/239). Go back to Tamarin (/navi ygg_roots 40/129).
  7. Talk to the Investigator at /navi ygg_roots 204/178, the Investigator at /navi ygg_roots 297/200 and Mark at /navi ygg_roots 338/243. Quest: To Ashridge.

docs.title: Part 3: Fire resistance
docs.text:
1. Talk to Lapine Shasha (/navi ygg_fruit 80/122). Debris needs material for a heat resistance potion. Quest: Fire Resistance Material.
  2. Bring 5 Dragon Scale #1036 to Debris in the Long Fruit room (/navi ygg_fruit 71/78). He sends you to the second world's Geffen. Quest: To Fallen Geffen.

docs.title: Part 4: The second world's Geffen
docs.text:
1. Walk to /navi ygg_roots 164/231. Ascetic Jeon appears there. Talk to him. Quest: Parallel World Geffen (every step up to step 18 uses this title).
  2. In Hem Field, step on /navi hem_fild 102/161. You join the meeting in ch1_sf03. Talk to Reno (ch1_sf03 190/257) and pick Then, I'll go to Geffen. The exit at ch1_sf03 174/246 takes you back to Hem Field.
  3. Enter Old Geffen through hem_fild 31/193. Walk to /navi ch1_geffen 190/123 and talk to the Geffen Resident there twice.
  4. Talk to the Geffen Resident at /navi ch1_geffen 149/55. Pick I'll go to the Geffen Tower.
  5. Step on /navi ch1_geffen 120/115 at the Geffen Tower. Talk to Charles (ch1_geffen 120/115), then Clover (ch1_geffen 122/118), then Ascetic Jeon (ch1_geffen 117/117). He sends you to the clinic.

docs.title: Part 5: The clinic
docs.text:
1. Enter the clinic (door at ch1_geffen 172/174) and talk to Doctor Neumann (/navi ch1_gef_in 70/64). He asks you to check the patients in the back rooms. Quest: Clinic Patients Examination (five of them).

  2. Visit the five patients, in any order:

    • Coughing Patient, /navi ch1_gef_in 109/39.
    • Bath Craved Patient, /navi ch1_gef_in 104/33. Fetch a towel from the Clinic Volunteer (/navi ch1_gef_in 115/40) and bring it back. Quest: Warm Towel.
    • Skinny Patient, /navi ch1_gef_in 65/112. Ask the Clinic Volunteer at /navi ch1_gef_in 113/102 for food, bring it back, and report the symptoms to Doctor Neumann at /navi ch1_gef_in 81/74. Quests: Request for Extra Rations, Extra Rations, Reporting Patients Symptoms.
    • Young Patient, /navi ch1_gef_in 108/106. Ask the Clinic Volunteer at ch1_gef_in 113/102, then go back to the patient. Quests: Sweet Food in a Dream, Sweet Food in Reality.
    • Elderly Patient, /navi ch1_gef_in 105/104.

    Once all of them are done, you are pointed to Einhar. Quest: Soren Syndrome Information. 21. Talk to Einhar (/navi ch1_gef_in 75/58) and ask about all three topics. Quests: Visiting the Acolyte's Clinic and Visiting the Wizard's Clinic. 22. Talk to Gregor in the Acolyte's Clinic (door at ch1_geffen 98/141, /navi ch1_gef_in 29/174) and Einhar in the Mage's Clinic (door at ch1_geffen 73/194, /navi ch1_gef_in 70/170). Quest: Research Clue. 23. Go to the city hall (door at ch1_geffen 102/197) and talk to Gregor (/navi ch1_gef_in 179/193). He wants three blood samples. Quests: Collecting Patient's Blood, Collecting Non-Infected Blood, Collecting Recovered Patient's Blood. 24. Collect them in any order: - Talk to Doctor Neumann at /navi ch1_gef_in 81/74, then the Patient in Care next to him (ch1_gef_in 79/73). - Talk to Aire in the street (/navi ch1_geffen 180/147). - Talk to Dapan (door at ch1_geffen 43/85, /navi ch1_gef_in 75/143). 25. Hand each sample to Einhar (/navi ch1_gef_in 183/194) or Gregor (ch1_gef_in 179/193) in the city hall. Once all three are in, talk to Gregor. Quests: Research's Conclusion, then What Dr.Neumann Doesn't Know. 26. Step on Doctor Neumann's house at /navi ch1_geffen 176/66. Go inside (door at ch1_geffen 182/59) and talk to Gregor (/navi ch1_gef_in 111/169), then Einhar further in (/navi ch1_gef_in 144/171). Quests: What Dr.Neumann is Hiding, Something that Dr.Neumann is Hiding, then To The Clinic. 27. Walk to /navi ch1_geffen 169/171 outside the clinic and talk to Ascetic Jeon (ch1_geffen 167/173). He has found a way through the barrier underground. Quest: Between Civilization and Barbarism. 28. Step on ch1_geffen 120/115 again and talk to Clover (ch1_geffen 122/118).

docs.title: Part 6: The decayed Verus
docs.text:
1. The warp at ch1_geffen 120/123 now takes you to the decayed Verus (hem_dun01). Talk to Charles (/navi hem_dun01 25/116).
  2. Step on /navi hem_dun01 85/139. In ch1_sf03, talk to Clover (ch1_sf03 264/171), Sua (ch1_sf03 265/173) and Parsifal (ch1_sf03 261/175). The exit at ch1_sf03 271/189 takes you back.
  3. Step on /navi hem_dun01 182/199. In ch1_sf03, talk to Charles (ch1_sf03 107/173), Clover (ch1_sf03 116/181), Parsifal (ch1_sf03 111/181) and Ascetic Jeon (ch1_sf03 114/183). The exit at ch1_sf03 103/169 takes you back.
  4. Walk to /navi hem_dun01 220/210 and talk to Charles (hem_dun01 221/209). He takes you inside the Dark Whisper (ch1_dw). Quest: Sky Fortress' Dark Whisper.
  5. Talk to Ascetic Jeon (ch1_dw 260/295). Take the warp at ch1_dw 259/352 and talk to Clover (ch1_dw 269/67). He sends you to look for samples.
  6. Find both, in any order:
    • The Advanced Devices past the warp at ch1_dw 256/69. Only the one at ch1_dw 217/87 holds a sample; the others (217/96, 192/84, 210/90) are empty.
    • The three Immortal Corps past the warp at ch1_dw 275/69, at ch1_dw 340/85, 340/82 and 340/78. Searching each one spawns a monster. After all three you get the sample.
  7. Bring the samples to Ascetic Jeon (ch1_dw 264/66). You are sent back to hem_dun01 226/212.
  8. Step on hem_dun01 182/199 again and talk to Clover (ch1_sf03 108/171).
  9. Go back to Old Geffen, step on ch1_geffen 120/115 and talk to Clover (ch1_geffen 122/118). Quest: Plague's Essence.
  10. In the city hall, talk to Einhar (/navi ch1_gef_in 173/186), then Ascetic Jeon (ch1_gef_in 175/188). Quest: Plague's Identity.

docs.title: Part 7: Under the clinic
docs.text:
1. Talk to the Wandering Patient in the clinic (/navi ch1_gef_in 75/66). Quest: The Locked Door, Opened.
  2. Take the door at ch1_gef_in 52/65 and step on /navi ch1_gef_in 26/70. Go down the stairs at ch1_gef_in 25/64 and click the Doorway (/navi ch1_gef_in 26/34). Quests: Art of Eavesdropping, then Urgent Rescue.
  3. Step on the door at /navi ch1_gef_in 29/22 and talk with Einhar. Then step into the portal that opens at ch1_gef_in 29/29. It drops you in Ashridge.
  4. Go to the Inn (door at ygg_edge 88/184) and talk to Ascetic Jeon (/navi ygg_fruit 40/72).
  5. Go back to the clinic basement and through ch1_gef_in 29/22, then take the corpse room door at ch1_gef_in 67/29 into ch1_que01. Quest: Disturbing Traces.
  6. Follow the trail: Gregor (ch1_que01 141/114), Ascetic Jeon (/navi ch1_que01 126/57), Ascetic Jeon (/navi ch1_que01 51/46), then Einhar (/navi ch1_que01 67/128). Quests: Ominous Traces, Unsettling Traces, What's at the Traces' End, then Searching for a Better Solution.
  7. Take the warp at ch1_que01 130/119 back and talk to Maxim (/navi ch1_gef_in 69/33). Quest: To Ashridge.

docs.title: Part 8: The Illusion Book
docs.text:
1. Talk to Professor Telcos (/navi ygg_edge 209/209). Click the Illusion Book next to him (ygg_edge 211/211) to enter the record (ch1_vrgef2). Quest: Fantasy Series Exploration.
  2. Follow Ziegler: step near /navi ch1_vrgef2 139/199, then /navi ch1_vrgef2 190/137, then /navi ch1_vrgef2 50/93, and talk to him each time. Quests: Matthias Ziegler, We Met Again., We Met Once Again.
  3. Talk to Ziegler in the room at /navi ch1_vrgef1 66/137. Examine the Bed (75/140), Water Container (62/140), Clock (62/145), Desk (76/144), Wardrobe (77/137), Barrels (63/137) and Shelf (67/145). On the objects that ask, keep examining and only pick Call Ziegler when you reach something odd. Then talk to Ziegler and leave. Quests: Explore? Observe?, then See You Outside.
  4. Talk to Ziegler at ch1_vrgef2 50/93, step on /navi ch1_vrgef1 138/146 to watch a scene, then talk to Ziegler at /navi ch1_vrgef2 173/64. Quests: Farewell Without Promise, Unwanted Witness, then Completed Fantasy Series Exploration.
  5. Report to Professor Telcos (/navi ygg_edge 209/209). Quest: Truth About The Doctor.

docs.title: Part 9: The doctor and the nurse
docs.text:
1. In the city hall, step on ch1_gef_in 182/182 and talk to Maxim (/navi ch1_gef_in 172/187). Quests: What Kind of Person is The Doctor? 1, 2 and 3.
  2. Ask the three Geffen Residents at /navi ch1_geffen 183/161, /navi ch1_geffen 61/92 and /navi ch1_geffen 129/197, then report to Maxim. Quests: Truth About The Doctor, then The Epidemic, Doctor, and Nurse.

  3. In Doctor Neumann's house, the door at ch1_gef_in 138/162 is now open. Talk to Nurse Margot (/navi ch1_gef_in 142/143) four times. Then:

    • Click the Water Kettle (/navi ch1_gef_in 104/173) and talk to Nurse Margot twice.
    • Click Neumann's Record (/navi ch1_gef_in 112/175) and pick Lift the mattress, then talk to Nurse Margot.

    Quests: The Doctor and Nurse's Story, then Cure Creation's Hope. 54. Talk to Assistant Baily in the Fresh Fruit room (/navi ygg_fruit 103/73), Nurse Margot (ch1_gef_in 142/143) and Assistant Baily next to her (ch1_gef_in 140/141). Back in Ashridge, click Baily's Shelf (/navi ygg_fruit 109/76) and pick Place the special blood sample. Quest: To Brimir.

docs.title: Part 10: Brimir
docs.text:
1. Take the Unknown Ruins gate (ygg_roots 34/126). Elise Isha and Maura wait by the entrance (/navi uknw_ruin 256/238). Talk to either one. You are taken to Brimir (ch1_sf02).
  2. Talk to Elise Isha (ch1_sf02 185/40), One (ch1_sf02 184/41), Elise Isha again and Zero (ch1_sf02 189/44). Quests: The Gray Valkyrie, Land Without Divinity, Remaining Valkyries, then Brimir Exploration.

  3. Explore three places in the Unknown Ruins, in any order. Each one has an NPC to click (Enter.) that takes you to a part of Brimir, where a flower-shaped NPC (its name shows only as symbols) waits:

    • Dry Branch at /navi uknw_ruin 149/150, flower at ch1_sf02 114/46. Talk to it twice. Quest: Meaning of God's Love.
    • Broken Branch at /navi uknw_ruin 252/59, flower at ch1_sf02 111/271. Quests: Alice's Ears and Severed World.
    • Rotten Branch at /navi uknw_ruin 93/174, flower at ch1_sf02 45/54. Quest: Flow of Time.

    Quest when all three are done: To The Plaza. 58. Click One at /navi uknw_ruin 160/160 to reach the plaza, then talk to One (ch1_sf02 160/160). Hunt: 10 Shadow Jailers and bring 5 Broken Petal #1001976. Shadow Jailers live in uknw_ruin and uknw_ruin2. Quest: What They Want. 59. Report to One. Then visit the three flowers again, in this order: ch1_sf02 114/46 (through uknw_ruin 149/150), ch1_sf02 111/271 (through uknw_ruin 252/59) and ch1_sf02 45/54 (through uknw_ruin 93/174). Quests: Before The Flower Blooms (1), (2) and (3), then Colorful Flowers. 60. Talk to One at the plaza (ch1_sf02 160/160). Quest: Return to Ashridge.

docs.title: Part 11: Muspelheim
docs.text:
1. Talk to Lapine Shasha (/navi ygg_fruit 80/122) twice. Quests: Bad News, then Good News.
  2. Talk to Debris (/navi ygg_fruit 71/78). His potion lets you into Muspelheim now. Quest: Land of Fire.
  3. Take the Muspelheim gate (ygg_roots 343/252) and walk over the Survey Point (/navi mu_fild01 95/154). Talk to Chez inside (ch1_sf01 190/214). Quest: Cool Headed and Warm Feet (every step up to step 66 uses this title).
  4. Visit these three in this order. Each one in Muspelheim Field takes you inside, where you talk to them again:
    • Harban at /navi mu_fild01 151/221, then Harban at ch1_sf01 55/214.
    • Tamarin at /navi mu_fild01 222/244, then Tamarin at ch1_sf01 265/226.
    • Yuvilus at /navi mu_fild01 198/186, then Yuvilus at ch1_sf01 110/227 (pick Talk about the energy fusion).
  5. Collect Hal from the eight Workers in order: /navi mu_fild01 237/299, 220/313, 166/370, 134/311, 126/306, 35/194, 91/196 and 121/236.
  6. Talk to Yuvilus (ch1_sf01 110/227), then Harban (ch1_sf01 120/224, pick Show the blemished Hal), then Yuvilus again. The special Hal can make the cure. Quest: Cure Creation.

docs.title: Part 12: The cure
docs.text:
1. Talk to Assistant Baily (/navi ygg_fruit 103/73, pick Show the special Hal), Maxim in the city hall (/navi ch1_gef_in 172/187), Nurse Margot (/navi ch1_gef_in 142/143) and Maxim in her room (ch1_gef_in 139/142). Read Maxim's Journals in the city hall (/navi ch1_gef_in 175/187) and report to Maxim (ch1_gef_in 139/142). Quests: Distribution of the Cure 1, 2 and 3.
  2. Give the cure to the Weak Patient (/navi ch1_gef_in 61/76), the Skinny Patient (/navi ch1_gef_in 107/33) and the Drowsy Patient (/navi ch1_gef_in 110/102) in the clinic.
  3. Talk to Maxim in the city hall (/navi ch1_gef_in 172/187) twice. Quest: Destroying the Sky Fortress.

docs.title: Part 13: The Dark Whisper
docs.text:
1. In the decayed Verus, walk to /navi hem_dun01 207/246 and talk to Est (hem_dun01 209/248). Quest: Disgusting Place's Infiltration.
  2. Make a party and talk to Est again to create and enter Ominous Dark Whisper. Inside, the party leader talks to Est to start. Stay close to her to keep the infected disguise, clear the infected and defeat the Immortal Monarch. Talk to Est at the end. Quests: Battle With The Dark Whisper, then Return to The Village.
  3. Talk to Lapine Shasha (/navi ygg_fruit 80/122). Chapter 1 is complete. Quest: Summoned By The Magic Professor.
  4. Talk to the Wizard Professor at /navi hem_dun01 205/248 (step on hem_dun01 207/246 to make him appear). From now on he runs Simulated Dark Whisper.

What the story unlocks

  • After step 38: the optional side quest Clover's Dilemma. Talk to Clover at the Geffen Tower (ch1_geffen 122/118), Sua (ch1_sf03 265/173, through hem_dun01 85/139), Ascetic Jeon (ch1_geffen 167/173), Sua again and Clover again. It gives 10 Root Gold Coin #1001972, 65,304,744 Base EXP and 4,000,000 Job EXP and opens two dailies:
    • Saving Lives Comes First from Clover (ch1_geffen 122/118): defeat 300 monsters in the decayed Verus (hem_dun01). Reward: 10 Root Gold Coin #1001972, 208,473,000 Base EXP and 145,403,733 Job EXP.
    • Divine's Prescription from Ascetic Jeon (ch1_geffen 117/117): he gives you 5 Purification Amulet #1001973 (and 32,652,372 Base EXP, 2,000,000 Job EXP). Hand one to each Verus Believer at hem_dun01 61/197, 139/134, 76/120, 151/247 and 215/202, then report back for 5 Root Gold Coin #1001972.
  • After step 60: three Brimir dailies, from the valkyries who now stand where the flowers were:
    • Formal Grave from Two (ch1_sf02 114/46): 50 Tulips, 50 Calendulas and 20 Gray Petal #1001975. Reward: 10 Root Gold Coin #1001972, 82,232,200 Base EXP, 5,724,800 Job EXP.
    • Cat in a Separate Dimension from Three (ch1_sf02 111/271): 20 Nyaise. Reward: 5 Root Gold Coin #1001972, 16,364,720 Base EXP, 11,449,600 Job EXP.
    • Remove Them Too from Four (ch1_sf02 45/54): 10 Shadow Jailers. Reward: 5 Root Gold Coin #1001972, 8,528,760 Base EXP, 5,955,240 Job EXP.
  • After step 73: Simulated Dark Whisper from the Wizard Professor (hem_dun01 205/248). You can enter once every three days (the wait ends at 4:00). Level 1 is open to everyone. Clearing your highest unlocked level unlocks the next one, up to level 5, and levels 2 to 5 need Base Level 265. A clear gives 10 Root Gold Coin #1001972, plus Immortal Magic Box #104006 at level 2, Superior Immortal Magic Box #104007 at level 3, Supreme Immortal Magic Box #104008 at level 4 and Extra Superior Immortal Magic Box #104009 at level 5.

All dailies in this chapter reset at 4:00.

docs.title: After the story
docs.text:
• Ashridge shops. In the Shops room (door at ygg_edge 139/211), the Gold Root Coin Exchanger (/navi ygg_fruit 165/126) opens a store for Mana Ring #1001996 and other materials, and Hotbear Mur (/navi ygg_fruit 168/124) sells Entwined equipment and Dimensional World Shoes and enchants Entwined armor, manteaus and boots and Dimensional footgear.
  • Twisted Land of Darkness from Yvain (/navi ygg_edge 178/185): talk to the Investigator at /navi ygg_roots 280/99, the Investigator at /navi ygg_roots 208/95 and the Researcher at /navi ygg_roots 120/170, then report back for 10 Root Gold Coin #1001972. Yvain then gives the daily Help Us! Doctor!: talk to the Investigators scattered around ygg_roots until one of them (10% chance each time) has what you need. An Investigator you have checked disappears for a minute. Reward: 5 Root Gold Coin #1001972.
  • Something To Do from Yuvilus (ch1_sf01 110/227): talk to Harban (ch1_sf01 120/224) and back to Yuvilus for 10 Root Gold Coin #1001972. Yuvilus then gives four dailies, each worth 5 Root Gold Coin #1001972: Hal Gathering (10 Hal #1001977), Is it edible?? (20 Volcano Clams), Is this important? (20 Firafflesia) and Tricked by a bug!!! (20 Fireloops).
  • Hazy Gate from Rubiel (/navi ygg_edge 175/186): click the Recon Point at /navi hem_fild 180/263 and talk to Rubiel inside (ch1_sf03 122/255). This opens two hunting areas off Hem Field:
    • At Base Level 230, Minuel (/navi hem_fild 329/191) gives a one-hour dimensional magic resistance buff for 20 Mana Ring #1001996. With it, the Dimensional Boundary at hem_fild 334/188 takes you to the northern or southern area of hem_dun02.
    • At Base Level 260, Rubiel (ch1_sf03 122/255) gives a one-hour buff for 45 Mana Ring #1001996. With it, the Dimensional Boundaries at hem_fild 133/337 and hem_fild 231/299 lead to the Corrupted Geffenia (ch1_gfn03 and ch1_gfn01).
  • Zero Cell, below.

docs.title: Zero Cell extension
docs.text:
Ruined Verus (ch1fild1) hides an abandoned homunculus laboratory. Newt sends you into its four sectors, and Bitoli in Ashridge crafts and enchants Rune Crowns.

Unlocking it. You need Chapter 1 complete, Hazy Gate done and Base Level 260.

  1. In Ashridge, walk to /navi ygg_edge 173/185. Robin appears. Talk to him. Quest: Abandoned Laboratory Zero Cell (every step up to step 4 uses this title).
  2. Go to the Twisted Land of Darkness and take the passage at ygg_roots 151/345 into Ruined Verus. Walk to /navi ch1fild1 168/38 and talk to Newt.
  3. Talk to Robin at /navi ch1fild1 101/84.
  4. Talk to Robin at /navi ch1fild1 25/132, next to the scattered documents.
  5. Talk to Robin at ch1fild1 101/84 twice. Quest: Abandoned Laboratory Cleanup.
  6. Talk to Newt next to him (/navi ch1fild1 106/84). Quest: Laboratory Entry.

Entering the sectors. Newt (ch1fild1 106/84) sends you to the east or west section of a sector. You need a protective buff that lasts one hour. Newt sells it for Root Gold Coin #1001972:

Sector Map Base Level Buff cost Lux ch1zero1 260 50 Root Gold Coin #1001972 Nox ch1zero2 260 50 Root Gold Coin #1001972 Vita ch1zero3 270 70 Root Gold Coin #1001972 Arc ch1zero4 270 70 Root Gold Coin #1001972

The exit of every sector leads back to ch1fild1 104/26.

Repeatable quests. Robin (ch1fild1 101/84) gives one cleanup quest per sector. Defeat the listed number of monsters in that sector and report back to him. Each cleanup can be done once a day: after you hand it in, it opens again at 04:00 server time. There are no weekly quests.

Quest Base Level Hunt Reward Zero Cell Lux Cleanup 260 300 monsters in ch1zero1 15 Root Gold Coin #1001972, 1 Tangled Singularity #105161 Zero Cell Nox Cleanup 260 300 monsters in ch1zero2 15 Root Gold Coin #1001972, 1 Tangled Singularity #105161 Zero Cell Vita Cleanup 270 100 monsters in ch1zero3 20 Root Gold Coin #1001972, 1 Boundary Singularity #105162 Zero Cell Arc Cleanup 270 100 monsters in ch1zero4 20 Root Gold Coin #1001972, 1 Boundary Singularity #105162

Rune Crown enchant. Bitoli in the Shops room (/navi ygg_fruit 162/126) talks to you once you have finished Zero Cell Lux Cleanup. He sells Magic Tuning Formulas, and at Base Level 265 he also crafts Rune Crowns (one shop per class group) and enchants them. The enchant works on every Time Dimensions Rune Crown and Frontier Rune Crown. Slots are filled in the order 3, 2, 1:

Slot Cost Possible enchants 3 500,000 Zeny, 10 Boundary Magic Powder #1001997, 2 Abyss Magic Rune #1001555 STR, INT, VIT or LUK +1 to +5 2 1,500,000 Zeny, 3 Boundary Magic Stone #1001998, 3 Rune of Chaotic Magic Power #1002012, 1 Rune of Heterogeneous Magic Power #1002015 Time Dimension Jewel, Lv 1 to 3 1 100,000,000 Zeny, 85 Rune of Heterogeneous Magic Power #1002015, 100 Essence of Chaotic Magic Power #1002013 Your choice of Acute, Mettle, Tenacity, Master Archer, Magic Essence, Spell, Adamantine, Affection, Fierce Attack or Great Craftsman Jewel Lv 1

Slot 1 has no random roll: you pick the jewel. A reset always succeeds and costs 1,000,000 Zeny, 5 Zelunium #25731, 5 Shadowdecon #25729 and 15 Mana Ring #1001996.

docs.title: Episode 13.1: Ash Vacuum
docs.text:
The Three Kingdoms Alliance has found a dimensional rift in the Sograt Desert near Morocc. Through it lies the Ash Vacuum, the "other world" of Splendide and Manuk, where the Midgard Expedition has set up camp (mid_camp). This episode takes you from the recruiters in Rune-Midgarts through the rift, settles you in at the Expedition Camp, and then sends you after the lost expedition report and the Dandelion agent Rayan Moore.

  • Level: Base Level 70 or higher to pass through the rift.
  • Starts at: the Recruiter in Prontera Castle, /navi prt_cas 207/165.

docs.title: Before you start
docs.text:
• Base Level 70. The Izlude Promotional Staff checks it during the first chapter. If you take the Cat Paw shortcut instead, Agent Geck checks it too.
  • Items for chapter 1: 300 Jellopy #909, 1 Emerald #721 and 1 Ruby #723.
  • Zeny (shortcut only): 50,000 zeny if you pay the Cat Paw Agent instead of doing chapter 1.
  • Several camp NPCs refuse to talk to you if you are close to your weight limit. The camp guide Marian wants at least 1,000 free weight. Empty your bag before you start.
  • Chapters 3 and 4 need you to have entered the Ash Vacuum through either chapter 1 or the shortcut. The expedition commander (chapter 3) also wants you to have helped around the camp first. Finishing chapter 2 is enough for that.

Shortcut: the Cat Paw route

If you don't want to do the recruitment chain, talk to the Cat Paw Agent (Agent Geck) on the Eden Group's second floor (/navi moc_para01 44/19) at Base Level 70 or higher. Choose "Why don't you collect it yourself?", then "I also want to go and help the merchants.", sign with any text and pay 50,000 zeny. He sends you to the rift field. Talk to the small Cat at /navi moc_fild20 368/197 to climb the wall, then to Tat at /navi moc_fild22b 182/179 to cross to the camp. This counts as having entered the Ash Vacuum for every later chapter, but you skip chapter 1's EXP.

docs.title: Chapter 1: Onward to the Other World
docs.text:
Every step in this chapter appears in your quest log as Onward to the Other World.

  1. Recruiter, Prontera Castle, /navi prt_cas 207/165. Choose "Yes, I am interested." He sends you to Aldebaran.
  2. Promotional Staff, Aldebaran, /navi aldebaran 127/138. Choose "I have something for you."
  3. Talk to the same Promotional Staff again with 300 Jellopy #909. They are taken from you.
  4. Promotional Staff, Geffen, /navi geffen 90/67. Choose "The Staff in Aldebaran sent me."
  5. Talk to him again with 1 Emerald #721. It is taken from you.
  6. Talk to him again with 1 Ruby #723. It is taken from you.
  7. Promotional Staff, Izlude, /navi izlude 102/171. Choose "I have something for you." If you are below Base Level 70 he turns you away. Come back at 70.
  8. Go back to the Recruiter at /navi prt_cas 207/165 and choose "Ash-Vacuum?". You receive 66,000 Base / 21,000 Job EXP, and he sends you to Lighthalzen.
  9. The Guide at /navi lighthalzen 220/292 points you to the Rekenber building. Go to Sikaiz, /navi lhz_in01 132/259, and talk to him three times, picking "Sure." and "The three kingdoms..." when they come up.
  10. Alliance Manager, Prontera Castle, /navi prt_cas 19/98. Pass on Sikaiz's message.
  11. Go back to Sikaiz twice. The second time he sends you to Rachel.
  12. Alliance Manager, Cheshrumnir (Rachel temple), /navi ra_temple 119/113. Deliver the message.
  13. Go back to Sikaiz twice. The second time, type your character's name exactly to register.
  14. Officer A or Officer B, in the banquet hall downstairs, /navi lhz_in01 32/22. Talk twice.
  15. Go to the Time-Space Gap in the Sograt Desert. Either walk to the Rift Guard at /navi moc_fild20 349/179 and ask to enter, or ask the guard at /navi lhz_in01 130/232 to send you there. Then talk to Munkenro, the new head of the Alliance, at /navi moc_fild22b 230/197.
  16. The test. Talk to Munkenro again and choose "Ready!!". 80 hostile Allied Soldiers (Lv 61, using Mobster #1851 stats) spawn across the field and attack. Kill 40 of them and the attack is called off. Then report back to Munkenro. You receive 66,000 Base / 21,000 Job EXP and the quest completes.
  17. Talk to Munkenro once more and choose "Yes, of course!" to go to the Midgard Expedition Camp (mid_camp).

The test is shared and timed

Only one test can run on the field at a time. If someone else's is running, Munkenro asks you to come back later. The attack lasts 15 minutes from the moment it starts. Kill your 40 soldiers and report to Munkenro before the 15 minutes run out. If the timer expires first, you fail and have to start the test again.

From now on you can return to the rift from Morocc: the Time-Space Gap Guard at /navi moc_ruins 137/89 sends you to the rift field, and Munkenro sends you on to the camp.

docs.title: Chapter 2: New Surroundings (camp introduction)
docs.text:
This chapter introduces the camp. You need it, or other camp quests, before chapter 3 opens.

  1. Marian, /navi mid_camp 222/283. Answer either way. You receive a Chocolate Pie #12322. Quest log: New Surroundings.
  2. Instructor Lugen, /navi mid_camp 261/284. Choose "Yes."
  3. Receptionist Brink, inside the camp building, /navi mid_campin 106/122. Choose "I am here to register." You receive a Chocolate Pie.
  4. Instructor Lugen again. You receive a Chocolate Pie and New Surroundings completes.
  5. Diego, beside the broken tent, /navi mid_camp 266/263. Choose "Help him." Quest log: Repairing the Tent. He wants 20 Ordinary Branch #6042 and 20 Strong Vine #6041:
    • Branches come from the five Trees on spl_fild02 (for example /navi spl_fild02 348/76, 232/145, 380/197, 304/151, 183/235). Each click has a small chance to give one, so keep clicking.
    • Strong Vines drop from Nepenthes #1988.
  6. Bring both to Diego.
  7. Click the first Post at /navi mid_camp 267/263. Keep choosing "Tie it with the vines." until it holds, then choose "Knot it."
  8. Do the same on the second Post at /navi mid_camp 267/258.
  9. Talk to Diego. You receive 5 Chocolate Pies and he sends you into the camp building.
  10. Step on the spot where you arrive, then talk to Lucas, /navi mid_campin 295/128. Choose "Dangerous way?" You receive a Chocolate Pie.
  11. Instructor Lugen. Quest log: Delivering Supplies.
  12. Marian. You receive 3 Supply Box #6045. If you lose boxes later, Marian replaces them.
  13. Instructor Lugen, then Jan at /navi mid_camp 160/298. He takes 1 Supply Box.
  14. Instructor Lugen, then Gerard at /navi mid_camp 30/168. He takes 1 Supply Box.
  15. Instructor Lugen, then Alberto on the Manuk field at /navi man_fild01 80/248. He takes the last box.
  16. Instructor Lugen twice. On the second visit choose "Help." You receive a Letter from Lugen #6043. Quest log: To My Friend.
  17. Otto, /navi mid_camp 123/290. You receive a Letter from Otto #6044 and a Chocolate Pie.
  18. Take Otto's letter back to Instructor Lugen. You receive 100,000 Base / 10,000 Job EXP, an Old Purple Box #617 and 5 Chocolate Pies.

Jan, Gerard and Alberto each also give you a Chocolate Pie when they take a box.

docs.title: Chapter 3: Report from the New World
docs.text:
1. Hibba Agip, the expedition commander, inside the camp building, /navi mid_campin 90/121. Quest log: Call from the commander.
  2. Staff Officer Abidal, next to him, /navi mid_campin 94/118. Accept the mission with "Yes." Quest log: Commander's Duty.
  3. Hibba Agip. You receive an Expedition Report #11012. Quest log: Report to Midgard.
  4. Expedition Messenger, just inside the camp entrance, /navi mid_camp 206/286. Whether you choose "Give the report." or "Protect the report.", the messengers are ambushed and the report is scattered. Quest log: Report to the continent - Accident!
  5. Hibba Agip, then Staff Officer Abidal. Quest log: Report to the continent - Location of reports.
  6. Collect Part of a Report #6040. Pages come from two sources:
    • Special monsters on four fields: Luciola Vespa #1994 and Pinguicula #1995 on spl_fild02, Luciola Vespa #1994, Cornus #1992 and Naga #1993 on spl_fild03, Nepenthes #1988 and Hillthrion #1989 on man_fild01, Centipede #1987 and Tatacho #1986 on man_fild03. Each kill of one of these quest spawns gives one page. They respawn every 10 minutes.
    • The four Expedition Scouts (/navi man_fild01 315/95, /navi man_fild03 202/251, /navi spl_fild02 295/368, /navi spl_fild03 172/71). Choose "Ask about search results." to get 0, 2, 3 or 5 pages. You can ask once every 30 minutes.
  7. Hand pages to Abidal 10 at a time ("Submit found pages."). Each batch of 10 either restores a new volume, duplicates one you already have, or fails, at random. You need Vol 1 to Vol 4 (Expedition Report Vol1 #11013 to Expedition Report Vol4 #11016). Expect to need well over 40 pages.
  8. When you hold all four volumes, choose "Check the report's restoration status." Abidal binds them into a new Expedition Report. Quest log: Report to the continent - Success to restore!
  9. Hibba Agip gives you 3 Expedition Reports. Quest log: Report to the continent - Report to the continent.
  10. Deliver one report to each official, in any order:
    • Laur, Prontera Castle, /navi prt_cas 108/265
    • Nuria, Cheshrumnir in Rachel, /navi ra_temple 122/174
    • Gerhart, Lighthalzen (Rekenber building), /navi lhz_in01 110/174
  11. Return to Hibba Agip. You receive 300,000 Base EXP and 3 First Aid Kit #12110, and the quest completes.

Lost a report?

If you lose the restored reports before delivering all three, Hibba Agip hands out a fresh set when you talk to him.

docs.title: Chapter 4: Pursuing Rayan Moore
docs.text:
Every step in this chapter appears in your quest log as Pursuing Rayan Moore.

  1. Pursuit Party Leader (Echinacea), in the camp building, /navi mid_campin 68/185. She assigns you to Mr. Kidd.
  2. Mr. Kidd, by the gate, /navi mid_camp 199/311. Choose "Echinacea...", then "No, I don't mind at all." He sends you to Morocc. If you answer "Yes." instead, Echinacea scolds you and you have to go back to Kidd.
  3. In Morocc, walk onto the tavern entrance next to the boy at /navi morocc 43/108. Talk to the Bar Master at /navi que_job01 82/95 and choose "About the mission".
  4. Pass the door at /navi que_job01 80/77 and enter the room at /navi que_job01 51/44. You get 4 minutes inside, and only one player can be inside at a time. Talk to Rin: choose "Mr. Kidd sent me.", then talk again.
  5. Rin sends you southwest of Hugel. Click the Heap of Earth at /navi hu_fild04 235/103 and choose "Take a careful look." You get a Crystal Of Feardom #6027.
  6. Go back to Rin (same room). She gives you the Morocc Tracing Log #6029.
  7. Bring the crystal and the log to Mr. Kidd. You receive 20,000 Base / 1,000 Job EXP.
  8. Talk to Mr. Kidd again to be sent to Rin's last location. Kill the 5 Dandelion Member #1985, then search the Corpse at /navi que_dan01 49/36 and choose "Check his pockets." to get a Sealed Scroll #6028. After 5 minutes you are pulled back to camp automatically. Only one player can be inside at a time.
  9. Back at camp, talk to Mr. Kidd. He sends you to Echinacea for a scholar.
  10. Pursuit Party Leader: choose "Who?". She sends you to Defaria.
  11. Defaria, /navi mid_camp 256/272. Choose "Got it." Bring him 30 Holy Water #523, 30 Rune of Darkness #7511, 30 Bloody Rune #7563 and the Sealed Scroll.
  12. Talk to Defaria again. You get the Unsealed Magic Spell #14595.
  13. Show it to Mr. Kidd, then use the Unsealed Magic Spell. It teleports you to yuno_fild09. Walk into the hidden basement at /navi yuno_fild09 234/133 and step onto the side door. You overhear Rayan and are sent back to your save point.
  14. Mr. Kidd, then go back to the basement door and choose "Enter." Talk to the Man at /navi que_dan02 115/53 (Rayan). You are sent back to your save point again.
  15. Mr. Kidd. He gives you the Crystal of Feardom and the Morocc Tracing Log again for Rin.
  16. Back in the Morocc tavern, enter the room at /navi que_job01 51/44 (4-minute limit again). Talk to Rin while she questions Rayan, then talk to her again. She gives you a pattern number. Write it down: it is one of SDHF92F-SDF, VWNM94GVWN90 or CM3-TRDFGHE0.
  17. Pursuit Party Leader: type the pattern number exactly. If you forget it, Rin repeats it.
  18. Talk to the Pursuit Party Leader until she says the trace is ready. It can take a few tries.
  19. Manager, at the building with the mana detector south of the camp, /navi mid_camp 191/206.
  20. Pursuit Party Leader once more. You receive 120,000 Base / 20,000 Job EXP and an Old Purple Box #617, and the quest completes.

Optional epilogue

Talk to the Pursuit Party Leader again and choose "Something is bothering me..." to start a short follow-up (Case closed?). Defaria wants 20 Potato #516 and 30 Log #7201, then you carry Yam #549 between Defaria, Mr. Kidd and the Pursuit Party Leader. It ends with 5 Sweet Potato #633 from Defaria.

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
Chapter Reward Onward to the Other World 66,000 Base / 21,000 Job EXP (Recruiter) + 66,000 Base / 21,000 Job EXP (Munkenro) New Surroundings 100,000 Base / 10,000 Job EXP, Old Purple Box #617, about 15 Chocolate Pie #12322 along the way Report from the New World 300,000 Base EXP, 3 First Aid Kit #12110 Pursuing Rayan Moore 20,000 Base / 1,000 Job EXP + 120,000 Base / 20,000 Job EXP, Old Purple Box #617

Finishing chapter 1 (or the Cat Paw shortcut) opens the Ash Vacuum fields (Splendide and Manuk) and the Expedition Camp. Reaching the Ash Vacuum is also a requirement of later episodes, such as the Episode 16.1 quests.

docs.title: After the story
docs.text:
Other Ash Vacuum quests in the same script:

  • Attitude to the New: the Monster Scholar (/navi mid_camp 188/254) and the Botanist (/navi mid_camp 240/270).
  • The Tripartite Union's Feud: Ryosen, Hue and Hansenne around the camp, and the Research Official at /navi mid_campin 376/120.
  • Part Time Work: Breeder Taab, /navi mid_camp 143/306.
  • Cat Paw Trading Post: the Cat Paw Agent, /navi mid_camp 62/125.

docs.title: Episode 14.3: Dimensional Travel
docs.text:
Demon God Morocc has fled into the Flame Basin (moro_vol), a burning world inside the Dimensional Crack. The Midgard Alliance, the Laphine of Eclage and the Dicastes have set up a joint camp there. In this episode you follow the adventurer Tamarin into the Basin, help the camp's researchers, open the cave in the central hill (moro_cav), and lead the final assault on the Temple of the Demon God.

  • Level: Base Level 140 to start; Base Level 160 for the cave instances and the final chapter.
  • Starts at: a pile of rags in Morocc, /navi morocc 138/238.

docs.title: Before you start
docs.text:
• Base Level 140 to start Dimensional Travel. Base Level 160 for Isle of Bios, Morse's Cave, Commander Hibba Agip's mission and the Temple of the Demon God.
  • Bring 1 Monster's Feed #528 for the very first step.
  • Chapter 3 is done in parties. Isle of Bios, Morse's Cave and the Temple of the Demon God are opened by a party leader.
  • Several NPCs refuse to talk to you if your bag is too full. Free some weight and slots first.

docs.title: Chapter 1: Dimensional Travel
docs.text:
1. Piled Rags, Morocc, /navi morocc 138/238. Choose "Remove it.", then "Shake the rags." Quest log: Dimensional Travel.
  2. Talk to the rags again with a Monster's Feed #528 and choose "Give Monster's Feed." The man underneath is Tamarin.
  3. Keep talking. Choose "Tell him the place.", then "Accompany him."
  4. Tamarin, at the oasis by the northwestern sphinx, /navi moc_ruins 106/140. Choose "I'm listening.", then "Tell him you want to tag along."
  5. Tamarin, at the Dimensional Crack, /navi dali 112/69.
  6. Find the Sand Mound on the second floor, /navi dali02 90/62, and choose "Enter." You arrive in the Flame Basin and Dimensional Travel completes.

Getting back to the Basin

Once you have reached the Basin, the Sand Mound at /navi moro_vol 137/136 takes you back to dali02, and the dali02 mound sends you in again. Once you have spoken to Tamarin inside the Basin (the first step of chapter 2), the Interdimensional Device in Eclage (/navi ecl_in01 38/98) also takes you to the camp. The Eclage Teleporter at /navi moro_vol 91/105 takes you back to Eclage.

docs.title: Chapter 2: Specimen Collection and Antidote
docs.text:
1. Tamarin, /navi moro_vol 132/140. Quest log: Specimen Collection.
  2. Barget Tiblack, /navi moro_vol 142/131. He wants you to investigate 20 Fire Pit #3026 and bring 50 Burning Bug Skin #6689, which drop from Fire Bug #3027.
  3. Bring both to Barget Tiblack.
  4. Tamarin, /navi moro_vol 132/140. Hunt 25 Sonia #3028 and collect 25 Yummy Stem #6690.
  5. Meet Tamarin by the big rock in the centre, /navi moro_vol 198/179.
  6. Barget Tiblack, with the 25 stems still in your bag. He tells you about the noxious gas from the central rock. Quest log: Antidote.
  7. Instructor Rugen, at the camp clinic, /navi moro_vol 105/71. Choose "Talk to him.", then "Give Sonia stems." He takes the 25 stems.
  8. Intoxicated Patient, /navi moro_vol 104/70.
  9. Instructor Rugen again. He gives you a report for Dr. Tiblack.
  10. Barget Tiblack. You receive 1,500,000 Job EXP and the Antidote quest completes.
  11. Tamarin at the central rock, /navi moro_vol 198/179. Choose "Enter." to go into the cave (moro_cav).

50 or 25 Sonias?

Barget's dialogue asks for 50 Sonias, but the quest only needs 25 Sonia kills and 25 Yummy Stems.

docs.title: Chapter 3: Hunting Morocc
docs.text:
All three of these are party instances inside moro_cav, and each needs Base Level 160.

  1. Isle of Bios: the Yellow Seed at /navi moro_cav 50/64 (the Wandering Old Man at /navi moro_cav 45/60 explains it). Clear it and talk to Vrid at the end. You receive a Token Of Hero #6684, and clearing it once unlocks Morse's Cave.
  2. Morse's Cave: the party leader talks to the Senior Tracker (/navi moro_cav 61/69). Everyone enters through the Red Flower (/navi moro_cav 57/69). Quest log: Pursuing Hiding Morocc.
  3. Come out and report to the Senior Tracker. If you defeated the Morocc Necromancer #3000 you also get a Token Of Hero #6684. Reporting is what unlocks the commander's mission, even if Morocc got away.
  4. Commander Hibba Agip, at the Alliance camp, /navi moro_vol 108/88. Choose "I'll do it." Quest log: Demon God Subjugation.

docs.title: Chapter 4: Temple of the Demon God
docs.text:
1. With your party, the leader talks to Guardian Nidhogg at /navi moro_cav 41/73 to open the Temple of the Demon God. Members enter through the Yggdrasil Lookalike tree at /navi moro_cav 45/75. Everyone who enters needs the Demon God Subjugation quest.
  2. Defeat Despair God Morroc #3097 inside the temple.
  3. Talk to Guardian Nidhogg or the tree again. Quest log: Fall of the False God.
  4. Report to Commander Hibba Agip, /navi moro_vol 108/88. On your first clear you receive an Expedition Award Box #22567, a Darklord Soulpiece #6715 and 1,000,000 Base / 500,000 Job EXP. Quest log: Caged God.
  5. Bring the Darklord Soulpiece to Guardian Nidhogg at the Laphine camp, /navi moro_vol 94/110, and choose "Give the Soul Shard." She announces your victory, and the whole server gets +10% Base, Job and quest EXP for about one hour. If that bonus is already running, she asks you to come back later and keeps nothing.

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
Step Reward Antidote (Barget Tiblack) 1,500,000 Job EXP Isle of Bios Token Of Hero #6684 Morse's Cave (boss killed) Token Of Hero #6684 First Temple clear (Hibba Agip) Expedition Award Box #22567, Darklord Soulpiece #6715, 1,000,000 Base / 500,000 Job EXP Darklord Soulpiece (Nidhogg) Server-wide +10% EXP for about 1 hour

The story opens the Flame Basin, the moro_cav cave and three instances: Isle of Bios, Morse's Cave and the Temple of the Demon God.

docs.title: After the story
docs.text:
• Temple of the Demon God, repeatable: after the daily wait (Caged God, resets at 04:00 server time), Hibba Agip gives you the subjugation quest again. Each later clear pays an Expedition Award Box and 1,000,000 Base / 500,000 Job EXP.
  • Camp dailies (each once a day; the cooldown resets at 04:00 server time):
    • Instructor Igrid, /navi moro_vol 111/87 (Base 140+): kill Blazing Morocc Reincarna #3039, Distorted Morocc Reincar #3040 and Freezing Morocc Reincarn #3041 for 1,000,000 Base / 800,000 Job EXP.
    • Adjutant Abidal, /navi moro_vol 110/90 (Base 160+, during Demon God Subjugation): kill Brinaranea #3091 and Muspellskoll #3092 in the temple for an Expedition Award Box.
    • Hishieh (/navi moro_vol 95/108) and the Magic Scholar (/navi moro_vol 98/107): mana and orb tasks for players who finished the Eclage (Episode 14.2) storyline.
    • Jeruth Hesranta, /navi moro_vol 136/84 (Base 140-160): Bradium box collection for players who did the Episode 13.3 Dicastes quests.
  • Flaming Basin and Doom Prayers: a separate Base 150+ quest line starting at the Base Investigator, /navi moro_vol 131/103.

Coming from Episode 14.2?

If you finished the Eclage storyline, talk to Hishieh and the Magic Scholar (Avant) at the Laphine camp once. That closes the 14.2 thread and unlocks their dailies.

docs.title: Episode 15.1: Phantasmagorika
docs.text:
Rekenber has found ancient ruins at the end of a tunnel in Juperos and named them Phantasmagorika (the Verus maps). The Eden Group joins the dig through the Atnad Excavation Team, led by the stubborn archaeologist Ian Atnad, whose estranged daughter Arquien runs the Eden Group. This episode gets you registered as an excavator, earns Ian's trust and ends when he grants you access to the closed areas, which is where Episode 15.2 begins.

  • Level: Base Level 140 or higher.
  • Starts at: the Eden Group headquarters in Morocc (moc_para01). Phantasmagorika Spokespersons in Prontera (/navi prontera 121/77), Morocc, Payon, Geffen and Alberta advertise the dig.

docs.title: Before you start
docs.text:
• Base Level 140.
  • Eden Group membership. You must carry an Eden Group Mark #6219, which you get by joining the Eden Group.
  • For the delicacy step, bring 2 Meat #517, 1 Banana #513 and 1 Mora Mandar #11520. Mora Mandar drops from Pom Spider #2132. You also need about 10 Empty Bottle #713.
  • Most excavation NPCs refuse to talk to you if your bag is too full.

docs.title: Chapter 1: Joining the Atnad Excavation Team
docs.text:
1. Enter the Eden Group building at Base Level 140+ with your Eden Group Mark. Secretary Lime Evenor greets you at the door, or you can find her at /navi moc_para01 38/175. Quest log: Eden Group Leader.
  2. Commander Arquien, the Eden Group captain, in the far-left office on the second floor, /navi moc_para01 133/170. Talk through her explanation, choosing "Please continue." and "Yes". Quest log: Artnard Excavation Team 1.
  3. Lime Evenor, in the central room, /navi moc_para01 174/165, with Archaeologist Aures and Luke Lapez. Quest log: Artnard Excavation Team 2.
  4. Travel to Phantasmagorika:
    • Go to the Juperos entrance on yuno_fild07 (the Excavator Guide is at /navi yuno_fild07 211/179).
    • Inside Juperos, follow the Rekenber Guards east and then south to the hidden gate at /navi juperos_01 242/91.
    • Walk through ver_eju and the tunnel to arrive in verus04.
  5. Receptionist Nara, /navi verus04 182/168. Choose "I'm from the Eden Group." You receive 300,000 Base / 300,000 Job EXP. Quest log: Registered Excavator (completed).

docs.title: Chapter 2: Proving yourself to Dr. Atnad
docs.text:
1. Archaeologist Aures (/navi verus04 141/193) or Ian Atnad (/navi verus04 144/193). Choose "I came to help." or "Just here to help."
  2. Ian Atnad gives you Core Collection: bring 20 Operation Control Device #6749. While the quest is active, Recon Robot #3154, Repair Robot #3155 and Exploration Rover #3156 in the plaza further inside drop them at a 50% rate.
  3. Bring the 20 devices to Ian Atnad. You receive 750,000 Base / 500,000 Job EXP. Quest log: Assisting the Excavation Team.
  4. Archaeologist Aures sends you to a young machinist. Quest log: Young Blood?
  5. Machinist Lloyd, /navi verus03 103/177. Quest log: Bottling the Energy. Bring him 10 Cohesive Energy #6756: click the glowing Machine Remnants on verus03 (for example /navi verus03 127/145, 84/152, 104/181, 204/202). Each one takes an Empty Bottle #713 and gives one Cohesive Energy, then disappears for 30 seconds.
  6. Bring the 10 Cohesive Energy to Lloyd. Quest log: Good News!
  7. Archaeologist Aures. You receive a Daily Report He And His Team #6748. Quest log: Turning In Excavation Report.
  8. Commander Louis, /navi verus04 179/165. Choose "Report excavation results." You receive 300,000 Base / 300,000 Job EXP. Quest log: Artnard's Summon.

docs.title: Chapter 3: The Last Exploration
docs.text:
1. Ian Atnad wants a "delicacy that is simple to eat yet juicy and refreshing". Quest log: In Search of a Delicacy.
  2. Luke Lapez, /navi verus03 107/177. Quest log: Count On Me.
  3. Bring Luke Lapez 2 Meat #517, 1 Mora Mandar #11520 and 1 Banana #513. He makes a Beef Toast #11519. Quest log: Delicacy for Him.
  4. Give the Beef Toast to Ian Atnad. Quest log: Last Exploration.
  5. Talk to Ian Atnad again and choose "Converse" (not "About the excavation project"). Choose "What about the Last Exploration!", then "I have no choice."
  6. Choose "Converse" once more. Ian grants your team access to the closed areas. Quest log: Access Permitted and Explore Research facilities.

The story continues directly in Episode 15.2.

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text: Step Reward Register with Nara 300,000 Base / 300,000 Job EXP Core Collection (Ian) 750,000 Base / 500,000 Job EXP Excavation report (Louis) 300,000 Base / 300,000 Job EXP Access Permitted Entry to verus01 and verus02 through the Access Controllers on verus03

docs.title: After the story
docs.text:
Once you are a registered excavator you can repeat these jobs, each once a day (the cooldown resets at 04:00 server time):

  • Passage Cleaning: Manager Michelle (/navi ver_eju 114/40) or Commander Louis. Clear monsters in the tunnel for 1,500,000 Base / 1,000,000 Job EXP.
  • Eliminating Risks: Commander Louis. Clear monsters in the plaza for 1,500,000 Base / 1,000,000 Job EXP.
  • Core Collection: Ian Atnad ("About the excavation project"). 20 Operation Control Devices for 1,500,000 Base / 1,000,000 Job EXP.
  • New Power Source: Machinist Lloyd. 10 Cohesive Energy for 150,000 Base / 1,000,000 Job EXP.
  • Excavation report: Archaeologist Aures hands out a new report after the Core Collection or New Power Source daily. Commander Louis pays 300,000 Base / 300,000 Job EXP for it.

Side quests in the same area:

  • To Phantasmagorika!: Guide Elisha at /navi yuno_fild07 216/157 and Leitner in the Rekenber building (/navi lhz_in01 75/209). It registers you for Elisha's lift straight to verus04 and continues in 15.2 as Vestige.
  • Police quests (Police Chief Kesler, /navi verus04 133/212) and the Wandering Bard (/navi verus03 129/21).

docs.title: Episode 15.2: Memory Records
docs.text:
With access to the closed areas of Phantasmagorika, the Atnad Excavation Team finds Memory Records: recordings left by the people who lived in the ruins. Ian Atnad and his daughter Arquien work through them together, until Rekenber's own Chief Secretary arrives asking that their contents be kept quiet. The episode ends with a meeting at Rekenber Corporation Headquarters in Lighthalzen.

  • Level: Base Level 140 or higher (it continues straight on from Episode 15.1).
  • Starts at: Phantasmagorika, verus03, the moment you finish Episode 15.1.

docs.title: Before you start
docs.text:
• Finish Episode 15.1, through the Access Permitted / Explore Research facilities quest from Ian Atnad. That permit is what lets the Access Controllers on verus03 let you through to verus01 and verus02.
  • Keep some bag space free. The record NPCs refuse to talk to you if your bag is too full.
  • Plan for several days of real time. One step needs several Memory Record plays, and each kind of play can only be done once a day (the cooldown resets at 04:00 server time).

docs.title: Chapter 1: The Mysterious Piece
docs.text:
1. Go to the Research facilities: take the north-east exit of verus03 at /navi verus03 169/259 into verus02. Search a pile of Strewn paper (for example /navi verus02 60/30, 178/32, 102/135, 155/64) and choose "Check adequately." You find a The Memory Recorder #6757. Quest log: Mysterious Piece.
  2. Show it to Ian Atnad, /navi verus04 144/193. Keep the Memory Record. Quest log: Record Player.
  3. Go back to the Eden Group and talk to Commander Arquien (Nile), /navi moc_para01 133/170, twice, with the Memory Record in your bag. Quest log: Piece of Memory Record.
  4. Collect 5 Memory Records from the Strewn paper piles in verus02. Each pile gives one, then disappears for a minute.
  5. Commander Arquien has moved to the excavation camp, /navi verus04 172/149. Give her the 5 Memory Records. Quest log: Play Memory Record.
  6. Click the Record player next to her, /navi verus04 170/150, and listen.
  7. Commander Arquien. Choose "What just happened..". You receive 750,000 Base / 500,000 Job EXP. Quest log: Report Memory Record.

docs.title: Chapter 2: The Laboratories
docs.text:
1. Ian Atnad, /navi verus04 144/193. Quest log: Memory Records of the Laboratories.
  2. Go to the laboratories: take the north-west exit of verus03 at /navi verus03 52/254 into verus01, then ask Verity at /navi verus01 123/181 to take you down to the underground bunker ("Yes").
  3. In un_bunker, search the glowing spots (Boxes, Under desks, Machine Remains, Thickets, Organized food trays, Document piles; for example /navi un_bunker 382/335, 87/167, 316/243, 50/292, 245/360) until you have 5 Experimental Dong Memory Record #6824. The exit back to verus01 is at /navi un_bunker 98/85.
  4. Commander Arquien, /navi verus04 172/149. She takes the 5 records.
  5. Play them on the Record player, /navi verus04 170/150. You receive a Record Fragment #22691.
  6. Commander Arquien. Choose "Show piece." You receive 750,000 Base / 500,000 Job EXP. Quest log: Report Memory Record Content. Her Memory Record dailies are now open.

docs.title: Chapter 3: Rekenber's Visit
docs.text:
1. Play Memory Records for Arquien. Talk to her and choose "Research facilities Memory Records". Accept, collect 5 Memory Records from the Strewn paper in verus02, hand them in, and play them on the Record player. Each play gives 1,500,000 Base / 1,000,000 Job EXP and starts a daily cooldown that resets at 04:00 server time (One Memory a Day). "Laboratories Memory Records" works the same way, with 5 Laboratory Memory Records from un_bunker, on its own daily cooldown (One Memory a Day 2).
  2. After four Research facilities plays, play one more record of either kind. At the end of that play Arquien notices a visitor at the excavation team's tent.
  3. Ian Atnad, /navi verus04 144/193. Choose "Is there something wrong?" Rekenber's Chief Secretary asks you all to meet at Rekenber Corporation Headquarters.
  4. Go to the Rekenber building in Lighthalzen. The Rekenber Guard at /navi lhz_in01 277/234 lets members of the Atnad team through.
  5. Rekenber Chairman, /navi lhz_in01 270/257. Choose "What did you say?" and "What do you mean family's destruction?"
  6. Ian Atnad (/navi lhz_in01 272/255) or Commander Arquien (/navi lhz_in01 272/251). Choose "Should the table be turned over?"
  7. Chief Secretary Tatio, /navi lhz_in01 267/257. You receive 4,500,000 Base / 3,000,000 Job EXP, and the Phantasmagorika main quest ends.

Only Research facilities plays raise the counter

The visit in step 2 only happens after four Research facilities Memory Record plays. Laboratory plays do not count towards those four. Once you have done four Research plays, the next play of either kind triggers the visit.

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
Step Reward First Memory Record (Arquien) 750,000 Base / 500,000 Job EXP Laboratory records (Arquien) 750,000 Base / 500,000 Job EXP, Record Fragment #22691 Each daily Memory Record play 1,500,000 Base / 1,000,000 Job EXP Meeting at Rekenber (Tatio) 4,500,000 Base / 3,000,000 Job EXP

Finishing the story opens verus01, verus02 and the underground bunker, plus Arquien's two Memory Record dailies.

docs.title: After the story
docs.text:
• Memory Record dailies (Commander Arquien): keep playing Research facilities and Laboratory records for EXP. A Laboratory play also gives you a Record Fragment if you don't already carry one.
  • Bunker memories: the Mysterious Device at /navi un_bunker 103/95 sends you into the bunker's past (un_bk_q) for its daily quests (Help Her, Air Purifier, Grape Harvest, Subdue Hysterical Patients, Daily Necessities Transport).
  • Vestige: the third part of To Phantasmagorika!. It starts with Du at /navi verus01 221/65 and leads Tamarin's party through the bunker to the Last Room instance (Base 150+). After that, Verity at /navi verus01 123/181 can use a Gravity Safety Device #6828 to take you straight to its entrance.
  • Krotzel's Request: Krotzel at /navi verus02 79/31.
  • The Episode 15.1 excavation dailies (Passage Cleaning, Eliminating Risks, Core Collection, New Power Source) stay available.

docs.title: Episode 16.1: Banquet for Heroes
docs.text:
The heroes who returned from the Morocc expedition are invited to a royal banquet in Prontera Castle. The party ends with a surprise attack during the blessing ritual, and you are sent back through the royal family's memories to find out who stole a piece of Ymir's Heart. The whole episode happens in Prontera: the castle (prt_cas), the guest wing (prt_cas_q), the Royal Library (prt_lib), and a "past" version of the city (prt_q).

Level: Base Level 100 or higher. Starts at: any Royal Messenger (main one in Prontera, /navi prontera 121/72).

docs.title: Before you start
docs.text:
Requirement Details Base Level 100 or higher (the Royal Messenger checks this). Previous story You must have finished the New World access quest: either Onward to the New World or the Cat Paw Agent route. Without it the messenger only says he is looking for heroes. Inventory Keep some free weight. Several NPCs refuse to talk if you are close to overweight. Party The two story instances are solo, but you must be in a party and be its leader to create them. Make a one-person party before you go to the library.

Episode Skip NPC

The custom Episode Skip NPC in Prontera (/navi prontera 164/163) can skip 16.1 and 16.2 together for one Episode 16 Clear Ticket #1000282. You must be a 3rd class. The skip puts 16.1 at the "To the Past" stage, marks 16.2 as finished, and gives some of the story items. It does not give the story EXP.

The Royal Messenger stands in many towns, and all of them do the same thing:

Town Location Prontera /navi prontera 121/72 Rachel /navi rachel 119/131 Al De Baran /navi aldebaran 159/113 Alberta /navi alberta 119/59 Veins /navi veins 200/108 Geffen /navi geffen 123/68 Payon /navi payon 168/65 Morroc /navi morocc 152/97 Juno /navi yuno 162/132 Lighthalzen /navi lighthalzen 152/100

docs.title: Chapter 1: The invitation
docs.text:
1. Royal Messenger (any town above). He gives you a Banquet Invitation Letter #6933 and offers to send you to the castle gate right away. Quest: Invitation to Royal Banquet.
  2. Enter Prontera Castle. When you step into the hall, Chamberlain Bell appears (/navi prt_cas 217/150) and leads you down the left corridor. Follow him to the guest wing (the warp at /navi prt_cas 152/163 takes you to prt_cas_q). From there, take the door at /navi prt_cas_q 130/8 into your own guest room.
  3. Chamberlain Bell in your guest room (/navi prt_cas_q 26/30). He takes the invitation and explains that you are a special guest and an observer for the ritual. Before the ritual you are expected to greet all the noble families. Quest: Socializing Starts from an Eye Contact.

docs.title: Chapter 2: Greet the seven families
docs.text:
You must make first contact with all seven families. The guest-wing corridor (prt_cas_q, around x 130–153) has a door to each family's room. Talk to Chamberlain Bell at any time and he lists the families you still need to visit. You can do them in any order.

Family What to do Quest log Heine Take the door at /navi prt_cas_q 130/32. Walk into the room (a scene plays near prt_cas_q 22/77), then talk to Kronecker G. Heine (/navi prt_cas_q 19/85). Visit the Heines Nerius Take the door at /navi prt_cas_q 130/56. Talk to Spica Nerius (/navi prt_cas_q 20/139). Visit the Nerius Richard Take the door at /navi prt_cas_q 153/143. Talk to the Butler for the Richards (/navi prt_cas_q 80/80), then to Po Richard (/navi prt_cas_q 93/74). The Royal Richard Walther Take the door at /navi prt_cas_q 130/80. Talk to Ian Walther (/navi prt_cas_q 20/184), then to Isenhonor Walther (/navi prt_cas_q 14/184). Look around the Walther Family, then In Search of the Guardian Knight Wigner Take the door at /navi prt_cas_q 153/119. Talk to Levuiere Wigner (/navi prt_cas_q 82/21), then to Jurgen Wigner (/navi prt_cas_q 95/9). To Jurgen, then To Levuiere and His Wife Roegenburg Take the door at /navi prt_cas_q 153/191. Talk to Maximilian Roegenburg (/navi prt_cas_q 90/186), then to Wolf Roegenburg (/navi prt_cas_q 96/186). To Wolf, then To Isaac Geoborg Take the door at /navi prt_cas_q 153/167. Walk in or talk to a bodyguard, then talk to the Queen (/navi prt_cas_q 93/129) and ask about the Geoborg family. The Geoborgs

When the last family is done, the quest log shows What Is the Next Thing on the Schedule ?.

  1. Return to Chamberlain Bell (/navi prt_cas_q 26/30). You receive 300,000 Base / 300,000 Job EXP and 10 Honor Token #6919. Quest: Participating in the Banquet.

Note

The second step of each family (for example Isenhonor's Guardian Knight errand, the Wigner and Roegenburg follow-ups, or the Geoborg whispers) starts that family's own side story. Only first contact is needed for the main story. See After the story.

docs.title: Chapter 3: The banquet
docs.text:
1. Go back to the castle's main hall. Walking through the corridor at /navi prt_cas 177/164 plays a scene with a suspicious guest. Quest: Suspicious Movement.
  2. In the banquet hall, talk to Spica Nerius (/navi prt_cas 106/240) or Skia Nerius (/navi prt_cas 104/240). After a long scene, Nyhill leaves the hall. Quest: Find Nyhill.
  3. Follow him. Step on the spot at /navi prt_cas 183/164 to see Skia chasing him. Quest: Where Is Nyhill?
  4. Go to the spot at /navi prt_cas 27/43 (west side of the castle). Skia and an unstable Nyhill appear. Talk to Skia Nerius (/navi prt_cas 25/35). Quest: Waiting for the Ritual.
  5. Go back to your guest room and talk to Chamberlain Bell (/navi prt_cas_q 26/30). Court Mage Nillem appears and warps you to the Royal Library (prt_lib). Quest: Attend the Ritual.

docs.title: Chapter 4: The ritual and the surprise attack
docs.text:
1. Mage Nillem (/navi prt_lib 91/85). As party leader, choose to create the Ritual of Blessing instance. Then enter it through the Room of Consciousness portal (/navi prt_lib 88/90).
  2. Watch the ritual inside the instance. After the intruders attack, talk to Kronecker G. Heine inside the instance. You are sent back to the library. Quest: Surprise Attack.
  3. Back in the library, walk to /navi prt_lib 88/80. The family heads gather. Talk to Ian Walther (/navi prt_lib 85/82) and defend yourself (Lady Nerius testifies for you).
  4. Mage Nillem (/navi prt_lib 91/85) proposes a look at the past. Quest: I'd Like to See that Too.
  5. Lindt the Librarian (/navi prt_lib 76/80).
  6. Mage Nillem again. Quest: Escape from the Past Memories of the Royal Family.
  7. Leave through the Guardian Knight (/navi prt_lib 56/61), who sends you to the Royal Prison area (prt_pri00). Talk to Overwatcher Terketh (/navi prt_pri00 58/128). Quest: What's Next?

docs.title: Chapter 5: The families' secret
docs.text:
1. Go back to your guest room and talk to Chamberlain Bell. Choose "I'll visit her now." Quest: Invitation from the Nerius.
  2. Take the Nerius door (/navi prt_cas_q 130/56) and talk to Spica Nerius (/navi prt_cas_q 18/136). Quest: Heine Now.
  3. Take the Heine door (/navi prt_cas_q 130/32) and talk to Kronecker G. Heine (/navi prt_cas_q 19/85). You receive 400,000 Base / 400,000 Job EXP and 20 Honor Token #6919. Quest: To the Past.
  4. Back in your guest room, talk to Chamberlain Bell. Nillem appears. Talk to Court Mage Nillem (/navi prt_cas_q 28/28) and agree to go. He warps you to the library.

docs.title: Chapter 6: Room of Consciousness
docs.text:
1. Mage Nillem (/navi prt_lib 91/85). He opens the Dimension Warper MkII (/navi prt_lib 94/82). Use it to go to the inner library (prt_lib_q). Quest: Once More!
  2. Nillem (/navi prt_lib_q 91/85). Talk once, then talk again as party leader to create the Room of Consciousness instance. Enter it through the Swaying Space (/navi prt_lib_q 88/90).
  3. Clear the instance. The Valkyrie takes Ymir's Heart, Fenrir pulls you out, and you are returned to prt_lib_q. Quest: Lost Imir Heart.
  4. Nillem (/navi prt_lib_q 91/85). Quest: Prontera at the Time.
  5. Take the warp at /navi prt_lib_q 9/25 into old Prontera (prt_q). Talk to Nillem (/navi prt_q 157/334). You can stay and explore old Prontera, or let him send you back to the library right away. If you stay, talk to him again when you want to leave. Quest: Who Knows the Truth.
  6. Kronecker G. Heine (/navi prt_lib 80/79, he appears when you step on prt_lib 88/80). Tell him what you saw. You receive 800,000 Base / 800,000 Job EXP and 30 Honor Token #6919. Quest: Nillem Is Not Almighty (a daily cooldown, reset at 04:00 server time, before your first repeat run).
  7. Friedrich S. Heine (/navi prt_cas_q 21/83, Heine room). He gives you free access to the Past Memories of the Royal Family. This completes the main story of 16.1.

Tip

After step 20, Court Mage Nillem can be summoned from your guest room through Chamberlain Bell ("Call Nillem"). He warps you straight to the library. Bell can also call a Kafra employee or a Giant Beast Manager, and fully heals you ("Please prepare some refreshments.").

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
Step Reward 1. Royal Messenger 1 Banquet Invitation Letter #6933 (taken back at step 3) 4. All families greeted 300,000 Base / 300,000 Job EXP, 10 Honor Token #6919 19. Kronecker (Heine Now) 400,000 Base / 400,000 Job EXP, 20 Honor Token #6919 26. Kronecker (Who Knows the Truth) 800,000 Base / 800,000 Job EXP, 30 Honor Token #6919 Total 1,500,000 Base / 1,500,000 Job EXP, 60 Honor Tokens

Finishing the main story unlocks:

  • Repeatable runs of the Room of Consciousness, handed out by Friedrich S. Heine.
  • Episode 16.2 (Terra Gloria). Its first scene triggers in your guest room once you finish step 19 of this page.

docs.title: After the story
docs.text:
• Room of Consciousness repeat: talk to Friedrich S. Heine (/navi prt_cas_q 21/83) to take Hope You Cannot Let Go (defeat Bijou #3450 once in the instance). Run it from Nillem (/navi prt_lib_q 91/85). Report back to Friedrich for 400,000 Base / 400,000 Job EXP and 10 Honor Token #6919. A daily cooldown follows (Nillem Is Not Almighty), which resets at 04:00 server time.
  • Royal kitchen: after step 3, the Royal Chef (/navi prt_cas 213/177) sends you to the Royal Head Chef (/navi prt_cas 309/200). His one-time chain gives 700,000 Base / 700,000 Job EXP and 10 Honor Token #6919. It then opens three daily chores that each give 4 Honor Tokens: sauce for the Royal Sauce Master (/navi prt_cas 319/211), washing 15 dishes for the Dishwasher (/navi prt_cas 302/205), and grilling the griffin at /navi prt_cas 358/124.
  • Family side stories: the Walther chain (Isenhonor sends you to Alberta, the Royal Prison and Veins) and the Roegenburg chain each end with 1,000,000 Base / 500,000 Job EXP and 10 Honor Token #6919. Agnes Roegenburg (/navi prt_cas_q 96/184) then has daily material requests worth 200,000 Base / 200,000 Job EXP and 4 Honor Tokens each. The Wigner and Geoborg families have their own investigations around the castle.

docs.title: Episode 16.2: Terra Gloria
docs.text:
Terra Gloria, the relic used in the royal ritual, has been stolen. Nyhill and the Nerius sisters send you after the thief through Lighthalzen. The trail leads to Einbroch and Einbech, where you need the help of the secret Rebellion hideout, a raid on the Heart Hunter war base, and the Werner Laboratory to get it back.

Level: Base Level 100 or higher (inherited from Episode 16.1). Starts at: your guest room in Prontera Castle, Nyhill M. Heine (/navi prt_cas_q 21/39).

docs.title: Before you start
docs.text:
Requirement Details Episode 16.1 You must have reached the "To the Past" stage of Episode 16.1, when Kronecker sends you to the Royal Library the second time (step 19 on that page). Before that, Nyhill does not react. Party Both story instances (Heart Hunter War Base and Werner Laboratory central room) must be created by a party leader. Do the story as the leader of your own party. Inventory Keep some free weight. Lazy in the Rebellion hideout needs at least 1,000 free weight before he talks to you.

Episode Skip NPC

The custom Episode Skip NPC in Prontera (/navi prontera 164/163) can skip 16.1 and 16.2 together for one Episode 16 Clear Ticket #1000282 (3rd class only). It marks 16.2 as finished and gives 13 Schwarz's Honor Token #25155.

docs.title: Chapter 1: The theft
docs.text:
1. Enter your guest room (/navi prt_cas_q 130/8 from the guest-wing corridor). A scene plays. Talk to Nyhill M. Heine (/navi prt_cas_q 21/39).
  2. Spica Nerius (/navi prt_cas_q 23/36) in the same room.
  3. Nyhill M. Heine again. The suspect, Bruno, is heading for Lighthalzen. Meet Crux and Skia at the Lighthalzen Airport. Quest: Secret Action.
  4. Crux at Lighthalzen Airport (/navi lhz_airport 189/39). Search the north and northeast parts of Lighthalzen and regroup in front of the department store. Quest: Searching the suspect.

docs.title: Chapter 2: Pursuit in Lighthalzen
docs.text:
1. In Lighthalzen, walk to /navi lighthalzen 186/293 (north side). You spot the suspect. Quest: Pursuit!
