  2. Chase him east to the Man at /navi lighthalzen 309/263 and talk to him. The suspicious mercenary is caught. Quest: Arrest.
  3. Return to your guest room in Prontera Castle and talk to Nyhill M. Heine (/navi prt_cas_q 21/39). He asks you to meet Crux at the Juno Airport. Quest: Secret Action 2.
  4. Crux at Juno Airport (/navi y_airport 168/41). He flies you back to Lighthalzen Airport. Spica is waiting in the Lighthalzen hotel. Quest: Small differences between sightseeing and secret bussiness.
  5. Go to the hotel room (lhz_in02, around /navi lhz_in02 239/145) and talk to Philopontess (/navi lhz_in02 239/148). Spica hands the rest of the job to you: meet the agent "Lazy" at the Einbroch train station. Quest: Together with Rebel.

docs.title: Chapter 3: Finding the Rebellion
docs.text:
1. Unusual person in Einbroch (/navi einbroch 239/269). Quest: To Einbech train station.
  2. Lazy next to the small hole (/navi einbroch 270/268). Then use the Very small hole (/navi einbroch 270/267) to reach Einbech.
  3. Lazy in Einbech (/navi einbech 46/208). Quest: Follow the trails.
  4. Follow the trail to the collapsed person and talk to Lazy (/navi einbech 76/131). Quest: Corner of Einbech.
  5. Lazy at the corner of Einbech (/navi einbech 217/82). He finds an entrance hidden in the wall by the beach. Quest: Invisible entrance.
  6. Walk into the wall at /navi einbech 215/84 to enter the hideout (rebel_in). Talk to Lazy (/navi rebel_in 21/45). Quest: A glass of tea gratitude.
  7. Lazy in the hideout's main hall (/navi rebel_in 86/61). He asks you to win over four Rebellion leaders on the second floor. Quest: Gentleman on second floor, Ladies on second floor, Hunter on second floor, Est on second floor, Convince the leaders.

docs.title: Chapter 4: Convince the leaders
docs.text:
There are two separate tasks. You can do them in any order.

A. The Hunter: Elena Volkova

  1. Elena Volkova (/navi rebel_in 70/78). She only listens to someone who beats her. Accept the fight. Quest: Fighting is the language of warmonger, Fair and equitable result.
  2. Talk to her again to go to the arena waiting room (rebel_in, around 184/28). Join the waiting-room chat of Ivan Ivanov (/navi rebel_in 177/28). When it is your turn, you are moved into the arena and Elena Bolkova #3630 spawns with 1,100,000 HP. Defeat her within 2 minutes. Sorita Doritas (/navi rebel_in 177/30) takes you out if you want to give up.
  3. Talk to Elena Volkova again. She agrees to cooperate. You receive 200,000 Base / 200,000 Job EXP and 10 Schwarz's Honor Token #25155. Quest: Hunter on second floor is completed.

Priests

If your base job is Priest, Elena refuses to fight a cleric. Keep insisting through her dialogue and she approves without a fight. You receive 10 Schwarz's Honor Token #25155 but no EXP.

B. The Gentleman, the Ladies and Est

  1. Rebellion leader in the square (/navi rebel_in 122/71). Tell him you saved Gonie and ask for cooperation. Quest: Doubt.
  2. Rebellion guard at the ladies' room door (/navi rebel_in 125/44). Say Rookie sent you and you are let in.
  3. Walk up to Dien (/navi rebel_in 164/88) and explain the situation. Then talk to her again. Quest: Ladies on second floor is completed.
  4. Go to the commander's room (warp at /navi rebel_in 88/80) and talk to the Special Force commander (/navi rebel_in 210/89). Quest: Est on second floor is completed.
  5. Rebellion leader (/navi rebel_in 122/71).
  6. Rebellion Guard leader next to him (/navi rebel_in 119/68).
  7. Rebellion leader again.
  8. Dien in the square (/navi rebel_in 121/69).
  9. Rebellion leader once more. You receive 200,000 Base / 200,000 Job EXP and 10 Schwarz's Honor Token #25155. Quest: Gentleman on second floor is completed.

Report back

  1. Lazy (/navi rebel_in 86/61). You receive 1,000,000 Base / 500,000 Job EXP and 10 Schwarz's Honor Token #25155. Quest: Between negotiation and deception.
  2. Rebellion Squadder at the hideout exit (/navi rebel_in 65/46). He can send you to Einbech. Quest: Next operation plan.

docs.title: Chapter 5: The Blessing Star
docs.text:
1. Go to the Einbroch inn (ein_in01) and talk to Nyhill (/navi ein_in01 269/285). The target is the operation spot in the northern field of Einbroch. Quest: Find Star of Blessing!
  2. In the Einbroch field (ein_fild04), talk to Julian (/navi ein_fild04 281/337). As party leader, create Heart Hunter War Base. Enter through the Striker Unit Commander (/navi ein_fild04 275/342). Quest: Heart Hunter Base occupation.
  3. Clear the base. Julian at the end gives you 10 Schwarz's Honor Token #25155 and sends you back to the field.
  4. Rookie (/navi ein_fild04 284/332) takes you to the Werner Laboratory entrance (que_swat). Go down into the laboratory (warp at /navi que_swat 155/61).
  5. Rookie inside the laboratory (/navi slabw01 236/91). Talk once, then talk again as party leader to create the Werner Laboratory central room. Enter through the portal at /navi slabw01 246/88.
  6. Clear the central room. At the end the party leader receives the Blessing Star #25179 and a Small Leather Bag #23087. Quest: Star of Blessing obtained.
  7. Bring the Blessing Star back to the Einbroch inn. Talk to Nyhill (/navi ein_in01 269/285) or Philopontess (/navi ein_in01 269/282). The star is taken, and you are sent to Prontera. Quest: Let's return.

The Blessing Star goes to the party leader, whose quest moves on. If you lose it, talk to Rookie in the Werner Laboratory (/navi slabw01 236/91) for a new one.

  1. Skia Nerius in your guest room (/navi prt_cas_q 18/37). You receive 500,000 Base / 500,000 Job EXP and 10 Honor Token #6919. She also tells you that Philopontess wants to see you at the Werner Laboratory entrance.
  2. Philopontess at the Werner Laboratory entrance (/navi que_swat 145/57). You receive 500,000 Base / 500,000 Job EXP and 10 Schwarz's Honor Token #25155. This completes Episode 16.2.

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
Step Reward 19. Elena Volkova 200,000 Base / 200,000 Job EXP, 10 Schwarz's Honor Token #25155 28. Rebellion leader 200,000 Base / 200,000 Job EXP, 10 Schwarz's Honor Token #25155 29. Lazy 1,000,000 Base / 500,000 Job EXP, 10 Schwarz's Honor Token #25155 33. Heart Hunter War Base 10 Schwarz's Honor Token #25155 36. Werner central room Blessing Star #25179 (quest item) and Small Leather Bag #23087 38. Skia Nerius 500,000 Base / 500,000 Job EXP, 10 Honor Token #6919 39. Philopontess 500,000 Base / 500,000 Job EXP, 10 Schwarz's Honor Token #25155 Total 2,400,000 Base / 1,900,000 Job EXP, 50 Schwarz's Honor Tokens, 10 Honor Tokens

The Rebellion members tell you to take your Schwarz's Honor Token #25155 to Strasse (/navi rebel_in 74/67). He trades them for Agenda Robe [1] #15163 or Consultation Robe [1] #15164 (1,000 each), Costume Combat Vestige #20456, Mercenary Ring Type A #28425 or Mercenary Ring Type B #28426 (1,500 each), and Republic Hat [1] #19115 (2,500).

Finishing the story unlocks:

  • Repeat runs of the Heart Hunter War Base (the second version, from Julian, once a day; the cooldown resets at 04:00 server time).
  • Repeat runs of the Werner Laboratory central room from Rookie inside the lab (/navi slabw01 236/91), while you hold Rookie's Sweeping the remnants daily (see below).
  • Episode 17.1 (Illusion), which starts in your guest room.

docs.title: After the story
docs.text:
• Rookie (/navi que_swat 150/58), Sweeping the remnants: defeat Pet Child #3621 in the central room. Reward: 200,000 Base / 200,000 Job EXP and 3 Schwarz's Honor Token #25155, then a daily cooldown that resets at 04:00 server time.
  • Philopontess (/navi que_swat 145/57), Hiding Researcher: find the researcher hiding in one of the cabinets in the laboratory (slabw01). Reward: 200,000 Base / 200,000 Job EXP and 3 Schwarz's Honor Token #25155, then a daily cooldown that resets at 04:00 server time.
  • Yuslan (/navi que_swat 161/53), Make Chimeras rest in peace: defeat 10 Human Kimera #3631 and 10 Material Kimera #3632. Reward: 300,000 Base / 300,000 Job EXP and 3 Schwarz's Honor Token #25155, then a daily cooldown that resets at 04:00 server time.
  • Elena Volkova offers a repeatable arena fight. The Rebellion ladies (Dien, Ridsh, Cotnes) have their own small requests. Arinoa and Arivero Yurhik (/navi rebel_in 82/68) start a longer side quest across Einbech, Lighthalzen, Juno and Einbroch that ends with 1,000,000 Base / 4,000,000 Job EXP and 10 Schwarz's Honor Token #25155.

docs.title: Episode 17.1: Illusion
docs.text:
With Terra Gloria back in royal hands, Nyhill sends you to Philopontess (Tes) and the Rebellion. Their new operation goes beyond the barrier in Rudus. From there the trail leads to an enterprise crisis at Regenschirm in Lighthalzen, a smuggling investigation, the old OS facility, and finally the occupied city of Cor, where the Rebellion moves to capture Elyumina.

Level: no extra level check beyond the earlier episodes (Base Level 100+). You need Base Level 130 at the very end to start Episode 17.2. Starts at: your guest room in Prontera Castle, Nyhill M. Heine (/navi prt_cas_q 21/39).

docs.title: Before you start
docs.text:
Requirement Details Episode 16.2 Episode 16.2 must be completed (you reported to Philopontess at the Werner Laboratory entrance). Party Three story instances (Regenschirm, Sealed OS, Cor Memorial) need a party, and the leader creates them. Combat One step asks you to defeat 30 monsters in Rudus (see step 6).

Episode Skip NPC

The custom Episode Skip NPC in Prontera (/navi prontera 164/163) can skip 17.1 and 17.2 together for one Episode 17 Clear Ticket #1000287 (3rd class only). It marks both as finished, opens Episode 18 and gives some of the story items (no EXP).

docs.title: Chapter 1: Beyond the barrier
docs.text:
1. Enter your guest room in Prontera Castle. A scene plays. Talk to Nyhill M. Heine (/navi prt_cas_q 21/39).
  2. Go to the Cat on Bullet pub in Einbroch (entrance at /navi einbroch 302/329). Talk to Philofontes (/navi pub_cat 93/105). Quest: New Operation. (Optional: the Rebellion Crew at the hidden hideout door in Einbech, /navi einbech 219/80, also points you to the pub. Talking to him is not required.)
  3. Go to the Rudus entrance in the Einbroch field and talk to the Rebellion Crew (/navi ein_fild05 156/288), who takes you into Rudus (sp_rudus). Talk to Elena Volkova (/navi sp_rudus 184/360). Quest: Beyond the Barrier.
  4. Rookie next to the barrier (/navi sp_rudus 193/284). Quest: Barrier Investigation.

  5. Investigate all three spots. The order does not matter:

    • Rebellion Crew (/navi sp_rudus 304/266), Wall on Barrier
    • Rebellion Crew (/navi sp_rudus 122/286), Watchtower
    • Small Hole (/navi sp_rudus 27/300), Small Hole

    Quest: Report to Lucky. 6. Rookie (/navi sp_rudus 193/284). Use the Firmly Closed Gate (/navi sp_rudus 197/282) to jump over the barrier, then defeat 10 Dolor #20361, 10 Venenum #20363 and 10 Twin Caput #20365 in Rudus. Quest: Investigate the Strange Sounds. 7. Elena Volkova (/navi sp_rudus 184/360). You receive 800,000 Base / 800,000 Job EXP and 15 Cor Core #25723. Quest: Report to Tes.

docs.title: Chapter 2: Enterprise crisis
docs.text:
1. Philofontes at the Cat on Bullet (/navi pub_cat 93/105). Quest: Unexpected Guest.
  2. Talk to the Retired Rebellion (/navi pub_cat 104/106) to enter the back room. Talk to Philofontes (/navi pub_cat 160/102), then to the Middle-Aged Man (/navi pub_cat 163/102). Quest: Enterprise Crisis.
  3. Republic Guard in western Lighthalzen (/navi lighthalzen 56/270). Quest: Reclaim Regenschirm.
  4. Rekenber Guard Oscar (/navi lighthalzen 55/278). As party leader, create and enter the Regenschirm instance and clear it.
  5. Philofontes at the Cat on Bullet (/navi pub_cat 93/105). You receive 800,000 Base / 800,000 Job EXP and 25 Mysterious Component #25669. Quest: Ventilation.

docs.title: Chapter 3: The smuggling investigation
docs.text:
1. In the pub's lower area, walk to /navi pub_cat 107/65 and talk to Lazy (/navi pub_cat 106/69). Quest: Meet with Father Bamph.
  2. Lazy (/navi pub_cat 105/58). Quest: Meet with Larjes.
  3. Kaya Tos (/navi pub_cat 109/71). Quest: Report to Father Bamph.
  4. Lazy (/navi pub_cat 105/58). You receive 300,000 Base / 300,000 Job EXP. Quest: Travel to Rachel.
  5. Lazy at the Einbroch airport area (/navi einbroch 42/208). He takes you to Lighthalzen. Quest: Travel to Veins.
  6. Lazy in Lighthalzen (/navi lighthalzen 259/215). He moves you to the slums. Quest: Frustrated Magistrate.
  7. Lazy in the slums (/navi lighthalzen 336/266). Quest: Interrogated Smugglers.
  8. Lazy outside the Rekenber headquarters (/navi lighthalzen 108/163). Quest: Written Orders.
  9. Inside the headquarters (lhz_in01), talk to the Staff (/navi lhz_in01 107/137). Quest: Investigating.
  10. Staff in the conference room (/navi lhz_in01 163/258). Quest: More Investigating.
  11. Go into the Regenschirm building (rgsr_in, through the gate at /navi lighthalzen 53/279). Talk to the Laboratory Staff (/navi rgsr_in 161/85). Quest: Further Investigations.
  12. Staff (Sammy) (/navi rgsr_in 12/46). Quest: Kurdi's Father.
  13. Back in the headquarters, talk to the Secretary in the office (/navi lhz_in01 80/210). Quest: Karyn's Boat.
  14. Staff in the document storage room (/navi lhz_in01 32/264). Quest: To the Island.
  15. Go to the McDonald Laboratory in the Einbroch field (ein_fild01). Walking near /navi ein_fild01 91/133 plays a scene. Talk to Kaya Tos (/navi ein_fild01 95/146). You receive 600,000 Base / 600,000 Job EXP and 20 Cor Core #25723. Quest: Investigating the Island.

docs.title: Chapter 4: Old memories
docs.text:
1. Philofontes at the Cat on Bullet (/navi pub_cat 93/105). Quest: Second Operation.
  2. Rebellion Crew in the Einbroch field (/navi ein_fild03 278/269). Quest: Old Memories.
  3. Visit the three memory spots in this order: /navi ein_fild03 347/219, then /navi ein_fild03 268/207, then /navi ein_fild03 218/266. Each one points you to the next.
  4. Rebellion Crew (/navi ein_fild03 278/269). Choose "I'm going inside." You receive 100,000 Base / 100,000 Job EXP.
  5. With the same NPC, as party leader, open the gate to the Sealed OS instance, enter and clear it.
  6. Rebellion Crew in the Rebellion hideout (/navi rebel_in 68/41). Dien is having tea in her room upstairs.
  7. Open the Ornament Box in Dien's room (/navi rebel_in 161/91). You take Dien's Precious Envelope #25665.
  8. Use the gate at /navi ein_fild03 288/270 to enter the OS area (sp_os). Find Dien (/navi sp_os 252/359) and hand over the picture. You receive 200,000 Base / 100,000 Job EXP, and you are moved to Cor (sp_cor).

docs.title: Chapter 5: Cor
docs.text:
1. Advance Squad member (/navi sp_cor 168/81). Quest: The Research Note.
  2. Kaya (/navi sp_cor 165/79). Quest: Regicide.
  3. Tes (/navi sp_cor 166/81). Quest: Reporting the King's Death.
  4. Tes at the safe place (/navi sp_cor 122/141). Quest: Status of patients.
  5. Aas (/navi sp_cor 135/147). You receive 300,000 Base / 300,000 Job EXP. Quest: Urgent situation.
  6. Elena Volkova (/navi sp_cor 110/130). Quest: Golden Troublemaker.
  7. Elena Volkova (/navi sp_cor 180/169). Quest: Operation of Elyumina.
  8. With the same Elena, as party leader, create and enter Cor Memorial. Overpower EL1-A17T inside.
  9. Talk to Elena Volkova (/navi sp_cor 180/169) again (Elyumina Secured), then talk to her once more. You receive a Base EXP lump equal to 10% of a level-110 level-up, 850,000 Job EXP, 1 Damaged Weapon #25668 and 5 Cor Core #25723. Quest: Pure Wicked.
  10. Goni (/navi sp_cor 136/210). Quest: Pure Violence.
  11. Rookie (/navi sp_cor 135/216). He points you to the waterway. Quest: Pure Facts.
  12. Rookie at the waterway (/navi sp_cor 255/285). You receive a Base EXP lump equal to 15% of a level-110 level-up and 1,200,000 Job EXP. This completes Episode 17.1.

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
Step Reward 7. Elena (Rudus) 800,000 Base / 800,000 Job EXP, 15 Cor Core #25723 12. Philofontes 800,000 Base / 800,000 Job EXP, 25 Mysterious Component #25669 16. Lazy 300,000 Base / 300,000 Job EXP 27. Kaya Tos 600,000 Base / 600,000 Job EXP, 20 Cor Core #25723 31. Rebellion Crew 100,000 Base / 100,000 Job EXP 35. Dien 200,000 Base / 100,000 Job EXP 40. Aas 300,000 Base / 300,000 Job EXP 44. Elena (Cor) 10% of a level-110 level-up in Base EXP, 850,000 Job EXP, Damaged Weapon #25668, 5 Cor Core #25723 47. Rookie 15% of a level-110 level-up in Base EXP, 1,200,000 Job EXP

Finishing the story unlocks:

  • Episode 17.2 (Sage's Legacy): the same Rookie (/navi sp_cor 255/285) offers it once you are Base Level 130.
  • Free access to Rudus beyond the barrier, the OS area and Cor, with their daily quests.

docs.title: After the story
docs.text:
• Morning in Rudus (/navi sp_rudus 130/200) asks for 10 of a random item for breakfast. Reward: 750,000 Base / 750,000 Job EXP, 5 Mysterious Component #25669 and 1 Cor Core #25723, then a daily cooldown that resets at 04:00 server time.
  • Aas in Cor (/navi sp_cor 135/147) offers a hunting request in Rudus (Rudus: 20 Dolor #20361). Bring back 10 Identification Bracelet #25666 for 200,000 Base / 200,000 Job EXP, 1 Cor Core #25723 and 5 Mysterious Component #25669, then a daily cooldown that resets at 04:00 server time.
  • Kaya Tos at the safe place (/navi sp_cor 137/146) and the Cor workers have more side requests. Kaya's chain ends with 600,000 Base / 600,000 Job EXP and 20 Cor Core #25723.

docs.title: Episode 17.2: Sage's Legacy
docs.text:
After the battle in Cor, Rookie takes you through the sewers into the Barmil mansion, the home of the late sage. You help the mansion's automatic dolls, track down a mysterious body and the records of a mercenary called "H", and hunt down Elyumina. The episode ends back in Prontera Castle.

Level: Base Level 130 or higher. Starts at: Rookie at the Cor waterway (/navi sp_cor 255/285).

docs.title: Before you start
docs.text:
Requirement Details Base Level 130 or higher. Rookie will not take you before that. Episode 17.1 Episode 17.1 must be completed (the last quest, Pure Facts, finished with this same Rookie). Items to bring 1 Yggdrasil Leaf #610 (step 3), 10 Broken Sword #7110 and 10 Fluorescent Liquid #7326 (step 31). Party The Twilight Garden instance needs a party, and the leader creates it.

Episode Skip NPC

The custom Episode Skip NPC in Prontera (/navi prontera 164/163) can skip 17.1 and 17.2 together for one Episode 17 Clear Ticket #1000287 (3rd class only). It also gives Mini Elly #400127 and opens Episode 18.

docs.title: Chapter 1: Into the mansion
docs.text:
1. Rookie at the Cor waterway (/navi sp_cor 255/285). Quest: Ready to enter.
  2. Talk to Rookie again and choose "Let's Go!". He sends you into the mansion sewer (ba_pw02). Quest: Mansion Sewer.
  3. Find the collapsed person, Dew (/navi ba_pw02 90/93). He is too weak to move. Quest: Sewer Pipe Straggler.
  4. Talk to him again with a Yggdrasil Leaf #610 in your inventory. The leaf is used.
  5. Go to /navi ba_pw01 14/115 in the upper sewer. A scene plays.
  6. Alp (/navi ba_pw01 87/290). He sends you into the mansion building (ba_in01).
  7. Lasis (/navi ba_in01 20/319).
  8. Tamarin in the mansion grounds (/navi ba_maison 70/145). You receive 401,075 Base EXP and 5 Barmil Ticket #1000103.

docs.title: Chapter 2: The repeaters
docs.text:
1. Mansion Manager (/navi ba_maison 74/150). Quest: Mansion's Guest.
  2. Talk to the Mansion Manager again. Quest: Repeater Confirmed: Restaurant.
  3. Tasty at the restaurant (/navi ba_maison 146/109). Quest: Parts of the repeater.
  4. Hunt Broken Beta #20630 until you have at least one Communication Chip of Automatic Doll #1000232. Bring it to Tasty. All the chips you carry are taken. You receive 300,000 Base EXP and 5 Barmil Ticket #1000103. Quest: Repeater Confirmed: Riverbank.
  5. Repeater at the riverbank (/navi ba_maison 334/143). You receive 300,000 Base EXP and 5 Barmil Ticket #1000103. Quest: Repeater Confirmed: Central Garden.
  6. Gabriel in the central garden (/navi ba_maison 245/206). You receive 300,000 Base EXP and 5 Barmil Ticket #1000103. Quest: Repeater confirmation complete.
  7. Mansion Manager (/navi ba_maison 74/150). You receive 900,000 Base EXP and 15 Barmil Ticket #1000103. Quest: Joining the company.

docs.title: Chapter 3: The story of the managers
docs.text:
1. Philofontes inside the mansion building (/navi ba_in01 206/106). Quest: I would like to know what it is.
  2. Dien (/navi ba_in01 203/103). She sends you to four mansion managers. Quest: The story of the managers (four entries).
  3. Talk to all four managers in the grounds. The order does not matter:
    • Yunas (/navi ba_maison 189/56)
    • Skippy (/navi ba_maison 318/169)
    • Adore (/navi ba_maison 249/161). She sends you on to the Cleaning Robot (/navi ba_maison 357/291), so talk to it too.
    • Nono (/navi ba_maison 232/310)
  4. Rookie (/navi ba_in01 202/108). Tell him about the mysterious body and hand over the data. The answer you pick (Enterprise, Government or Mercenaries) only changes the dialogue.
  5. Ridsh (/navi ba_in01 208/110).
  6. Kaya Toss (/navi ba_in01 207/102).
  7. Rookie (/navi ba_in01 202/108).
  8. Kaya Toss in the grounds (/navi ba_maison 103/92).
  9. Dien (/navi ba_maison 100/90).
  10. Kaya Toss (/navi ba_maison 103/92). You receive 900,000 Base EXP and 15 Barmil Ticket #1000103.
  11. Tatio (/navi ba_in01 205/109). You receive 900,000 Base EXP and 20 Barmil Ticket #1000103.

All of steps 16 to 26 show in the quest log as I would like to know what it is.

docs.title: Chapter 4: Tracking Elyumina
docs.text:
1. Walk to /navi ba_maison 106/65. A scene plays. Talk to Rookie (/navi ba_maison 116/67). Quest: Broken core collection.

  2. Search the broken dolls around the grounds and collect 5 Core of a Broken Doll #1000226. There are 10 bodies, and each one gives one core:

    ba_maison 150/47 ba_maison 208/87 ba_maison 221/193 ba_maison 314/146 ba_maison 338/267 ba_maison 275/313 ba_maison 207/276 ba_maison 131/197 ba_maison 64/187 ba_maison 70/256

    Quest: To the designated point. 29. Elena Bolkova (/navi ba_maison 303/141). The cores are taken. You receive 515,668 Base EXP and 10 Barmil Ticket #1000103. Quest: Unexpected big fish. 30. In the mansion building, the Rebellion guard (/navi ba_in01 35/142) lets you into the back room. Talk to Elena Bolkova (/navi ba_in01 20/145). Quest: Tracking Illusion. 31. Elyumina (/navi ba_in01 15/147). Bring 10 Broken Sword #7110 and 10 Fluorescent Liquid #7326. You receive an Elyumina Radar #1000092, 1,031,336 Base EXP and 10 Barmil Ticket #1000103. Quest: Strategy planning. 32. Est (/navi ba_in01 51/157). Quest: Pest Extermination. 33. With Est, as party leader, create and enter Twilight Garden. Defeat Sweety #20642 inside. 34. Talk to Est again. The radar is taken back. Quest: To the non-official lounge. 35. Smart Elly in the lounge (/navi ba_in01 26/266). You receive 1,547,004 Base EXP and 15 Barmil Ticket #1000103.

docs.title: Chapter 5: A guest at the palace
docs.text:
1. Walk to /navi ba_maison 33/220 and talk to Crux (/navi ba_maison 38/219). Agree to go and he takes you to Prontera Castle. If you decline, he waits at /navi ba_in01 48/146 to take you later. Quest: A guest.
  2. A scene plays when you arrive (prt_cas 138/342). Chamberlain Bell (/navi prt_cas 140/344) can let you out.
  3. Nyhill M. Heine (/navi prt_cas 325/263). This completes Episode 17.2. Quest: Greeting.

Episode 18

At Base Level 170 or higher, Smart Elly (/navi ba_in01 26/266) has more to say after step 35. She gives you Mini Elly #400127 and starts Episode 18 (Towards Rachel (1)). Keep the Mini Elly: Episode 18 needs it at the start and at the very end.

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
Step Reward 8. Tamarin 401,075 Base EXP, 5 Barmil Ticket #1000103 12. Tasty 300,000 Base EXP, 5 Barmil Ticket #1000103 13. Repeater 300,000 Base EXP, 5 Barmil Ticket #1000103 14. Gabriel 300,000 Base EXP, 5 Barmil Ticket #1000103 15. Mansion Manager 900,000 Base EXP, 15 Barmil Ticket #1000103 25. Kaya Toss 900,000 Base EXP, 15 Barmil Ticket #1000103 26. Tatio 900,000 Base EXP, 20 Barmil Ticket #1000103 29. Elena Bolkova 515,668 Base EXP, 10 Barmil Ticket #1000103 31. Elyumina 1,031,336 Base EXP, 10 Barmil Ticket #1000103, Elyumina Radar #1000092 (taken back at step 34) 35. Smart Elly 1,547,004 Base EXP, 15 Barmil Ticket #1000103 Total 7,095,083 Base EXP, 105 Barmil Tickets

Finishing the story unlocks Episode 18 (at Base Level 170, from Smart Elly) and the mansion's daily requests.

docs.title: After the story
docs.text:
• Mansion Manager (/navi ba_maison 74/150), Supply the spare parts: bring 10 Communication Chip of Automatic Doll #1000232 (dropped by Broken Beta #20630). Reward: 949,720 Base / 664,800 Job EXP and 2 Barmil Ticket #1000103, then a daily cooldown that resets at 04:00 server time.
  • Tamarin (/navi ba_maison 70/145) runs a library side quest (Be quiet in the Library!). After it, Tamarin offers a repeatable hunting request worth 500,000 Base / 300,000 Job EXP and 2 Barmil Ticket #1000103.

docs.title: Episode 18: Direction of Prayer
docs.text:
Elly's tablet leads you to Rachel, where a masked girl and a nervous priest pull you into a plot inside the Rachel Temple. Following the "gray children" through Rachel's market, you cross the Oz Labyrinth to the Gray Wolf Forest and its village, Wolfvill. There you earn the trust of the natives, trace the source of the weapons stirring up conflict, and finally uncover what was planned for the Rachel Temple.

Level: Base Level 170 or higher. Some repeatable content needs Base Level 200. Starts at: Smart Elly in the Barmil mansion (/navi ba_in01 26/266), then the Masked Girl in Rachel (/navi rachel 182/176).

docs.title: Before you start
docs.text:
Requirement Details Base Level 170 or higher. Smart Elly only starts the episode at 170, and the Wolves Gathering Place instance also checks for 170. Episode 17.2 Episode 17.2 must be finished up to Smart Elly (step 35 on that page). At Base Level 170 she gives you Mini Elly #400127 and the quest Towards Rachel (1). Mini Elly You need Mini Elly #400127 twice: worn on your head at the very first step (step 2), and in your inventory but not worn for the last two steps. The last step takes it from you. Wolfvill reputation Partway through, the story waits until you have 1,000 Wolfvill reputation (see step 37). Expect to do several Wolfvill side quests. Party Several instances need a party, and the leader creates them: Oz Labyrinth, Thor Military Base, Wolves Gathering Place, High Priest's Villa.

Episode Skip NPC

The custom Episode Skip NPC in Prontera (/navi prontera 164/163) can skip Episode 18 for one Episode 18 Clear Ticket #1000288 (3rd class only). It marks the story and its side quests as finished, sets Wolfvill reputation to the maximum, and gives Mini Elly #400127, 500 Amethyst Fragment #1000405 and a large amount of EXP.

docs.title: Chapter 1: Towards Rachel
docs.text:
1. Smart Elly (/navi ba_in01 26/266) at Base Level 170+. You receive Mini Elly #400127. Quest: Towards Rachel (1).
  2. Equip the Mini Elly on your head and talk to the Masked Girl in Rachel (/navi rachel 182/176). Quest: Towards Rachel (2).
  3. Nervous Priest (/navi rachel 183/170).
  4. Talk to the Nervous Priest again. You receive 18,252,408 Base / 2,000,000 Job EXP and 20 Amethyst Fragment #1000405.

docs.title: Chapter 2: The temple plot
docs.text:
1. Go to the Rachel Temple grounds (ra_temple). Walk to /navi ra_temple 118/30, then talk to the Nervous Priest (/navi ra_temple 72/54).
  2. Walk to /navi ra_temple 20/134. The priest, the temple guards and two Heart Hunters appear. Talk to the Nervous Priest (/navi ra_temple 30/142). Quest: Intruder of the Temple.
  3. Talk to the Nervous Priest again. You receive 18,252,408 Base / 2,000,000 Job EXP and 30 Amethyst Fragment #1000405. Quest: Staged Plot.
  4. Inside the temple (ra_temin), talk to Guard Dent (/navi ra_temin 173/40). Quest: Niren's Request (1).
  5. Guard Neil (/navi ra_temin 174/38).

docs.title: Episode 19: Issgard, Land of Snow Flowers
docs.text:
Maram has news from the north. The guardians of Issgard have sent an invitation, and Varmundt's airship takes you past the barrier to the Ice Castle. There the Iwins are fighting the snake-like Rgans, who are being experimented on by the Illusion scientists Juncea and Bagot. Disguised as a newborn Rgan, you sneak into the Snake's Nest and uncover what the two are doing.

  • Level: Base Level 200 or higher.
  • Starts at: the Grey Wolf Village, /navi wolfvill 223/83.
  • Main hub: the Ice Castle (icecastle and its interiors icas_in).

Which script is loaded

This page follows the combined quest file for Episode 19, which is the one the server loads. The split versions (separate main, misc, daily and side quest files) are switched off in the server config, so anything that exists only in them is not available here.

docs.title: Before you start
docs.text:
• Base Level 200. Below that, the Grey Wolf Villager only tells you there are quests for level 200 and up.
  • Episode 18 finished. The story only starts once the last step of the Episode 18 main quest is done.
  • Rgan Transformation Scroll. For most of the episode you have to look like a Rgan. Rgans in the Snake's Nest (and the scouts outside it) throw anyone in human form back to jor_back3. You get your first Rgan Transformation Scroll #101162 from the story (step 14). Each one lasts 20 minutes. More can be bought from Lunch at /navi jor_back2 250/30 for 2 Low-quality Rgan Magic Core #1000707 and 2,000 Zeny each.
  • Rgan cores. The story asks for Low-quality Rgan Magic Core #1000707 three times: 10, 10 and 20. They drop from the Rgans around jor_back3, jor_dun01 and jor_dun02 (Primitive Rgan, Lowest Rgan, Junior Rgan, Intermediate Rgan). Save some extra to buy scrolls.
  • Free weight. Several NPCs refuse to continue if you can't carry the reward, so keep your inventory light.
  • A party. Iwin Patrol, Bagot Laboratory and Confused Snake's Nest all need a party. A one-person party is enough.

Episode Skip NPC

The custom Episode Skip NPC in Prontera (/navi prontera 164/163) can mark Episode 19 as complete if you have an Episode 19 Pass Ticket (item 1001263), are a 3rd class or higher, and are under 50% weight. It gives the story's Snow Flowers, reputation and EXP plus a bonus. The catch: it only accepts characters that used the same NPC to skip Episode 18.

docs.title: Chapter 1: The invitation
docs.text:
1. Grey Wolf Villager, Grey Wolf Village, /navi wolfvill 223/83. Maram, Miriam and Suad appear and ask you to take them to Varmundt's Mansion. You can also talk to Maram (/navi wolfvill 220/85) once he has appeared. Quest: Guest from the North Wind 1.
  2. Walk into the main building of Varmundt's Mansion (/navi ba_in01 375/102). The group gathers there. Talk to Smart Ellie at /navi ba_in01 384/114. Quest: Guest from the North Wind 2.
  3. Talk to Crux (/navi ba_in01 386/110). He takes you to Prontera Castle. Walk inside and talk to Crux at /navi prt_cas 320/270. Quest: Guardian's Box and Invitation 1.
  4. Go into the king's room (the door at prt_cas 174/342) and talk to Nihil at /navi prt_cas 331/343. You receive a Guardian Invitation #1000607. Quest: Guardian's Box and Invitation 2.
  5. Go back to Varmundt's Mansion. A scene plays when you reach /navi ba_maison 186/251. Quest: Guardian's Box and Invitation 3.
  6. Talk to Navigator Ginger (/navi ba_in01 30/264) and board the airship.
  7. On the airship, give the invitation to Navigator Ginger (/navi air_if 46/71). Quest: Guardian's Box and Invitation 4.
  8. Talk to Lehar on the airship (/navi air_if 32/63). Quest: Guardian's Box and Invitation 5.
  9. Talk to Navigator Ginger again and choose to get off. You land at jor_tail. Talk to Lehar at /navi jor_tail 221/53. Quest: Into the Ice.

Note

From now on Navigator Ginger on the airship and at /navi jor_tail 216/51 flies you between Varmundt's Mansion and Issgard.

docs.title: Chapter 2: The Ice Castle
docs.text:
1. Head north through jor_back1 to the Ice Castle (the castle gate is at jor_back1 385/229). Lehar waits along the way at jor_back1 381/232. Inside, talk to Lehar at /navi icas_in 141/216 (castle entrance: icecastle 213/175). Quest: Encounter in the Ice Castle.
  2. Talk to Guardian Leon at /navi icas_in 138/220. You receive 40 Snow Flower #1000608. Leon also starts the Purification Saint side quest. Quests: Meet the Irwin Scouts. and Let's meet Voglinde.
  3. Outside, talk to the Captain of the Eagle Patrol (/navi icecastle 23/115) and sign the papers. Quest: Eagle Patrol.
  4. Make a party (one person is fine) and enter Iwin Patrol through the Captain. During the patrol, talk to The mysterious young man at 1@iwp 260/390, near the fourth checkpoint. Quest: Subject 210426 Encounter.
  5. Go to the Frozen Scale Plains and walk up to /navi jor_back2 250/30. The young man appears again. Talk to him. You receive a Rgan Transformation Scroll #101162 and 2 Snow Flower #1000608. Quests: Rgan Transformation Scroll and "[Standby] Lunch Menu Selection" (the young man, now called Lunch, becomes a daily quest NPC).
  6. Back at the Ice Castle, walk to /navi icecastle 27/126. Horuru appears. Talk to her. Quest: Accompany Reconnaissance Report.
  7. Go to the dining hall inside the castle (door at icas_in 83/233) and talk to Aurelie Petit at /navi icas_in 34/189. Quest: Reiji's Plan.

docs.title: Chapter 3: Into the Snake's Nest
docs.text:
Stay transformed

From here on, use a Rgan Transformation Scroll #101162 before you talk to anyone at the Rgan base or in the Snake's Nest. Without it the Rgans send you back to jor_back3 65/321.

  1. Go to the Rgan base at /navi jor_back3 99/318. Transform, then talk to Horuru. You receive 25 Snow Flower #1000608. Quest: Snake's Nest Infiltration.
  2. Enter the cave and talk to Miriam at /navi jor_dun02 263/170. You receive 25 Snow Flower #1000608.
  3. Follow the Rgans to the upper level (jor_dun02 exit at 18/31 leads to jor_nest). Talk to the Rgan Priest at /navi jor_nest 185/49.
  4. Talk to the Rgan Bishop at /navi jor_nest 196/202.
  5. Talk to the Rgan Bishop at /navi jor_nest 115/187.
  6. Talk to the Rgan Bishop at /navi jor_nest 53/244.
  7. Walk to /navi jor_nest 22/141 and talk to Juncea twice (health check, then her research). She asks for your eggshell.
  8. Go back to Miriam at /navi jor_dun02 263/170. She sends you to the higher-grade hatchery.
  9. Talk to the Rgan Priest at /navi jor_nest 23/58. You receive a Greater Rgan Eggshell #1000606.
  10. Bring the eggshell to Juncea (/navi jor_nest 22/141).
  11. Talk to Bagot next to her (/navi jor_nest 26/142).
  12. Talk to Juncea again. She gives you a Rgan name. Quest: Infiltration Interim Report.
  13. Walk outside to /navi jor_nest 82/163. Chime's robot finds you and Lazy.
  14. Go to the Illusion's airship at /navi jor_nest 24/252 and talk to Lazy.
  15. Go down to the lower level and talk to Rgan Security at /navi jor_dun02 153/239.
  16. Walk to /navi jor_dun02 150/269 and talk to Miriam. You find the humans held there.
  17. Return to the Ice Castle dining hall and talk to Aurelie Petit (/navi icas_in 34/189). You receive 50 Snow Flower #1000608, 119,725,365 Base EXP and 7,000,000 Job EXP. Quests: Aircraft Destruction Operation and Vulnerability Investigation. This unlocks Airship Destruction.

docs.title: Chapter 4: Gathering evidence
docs.text:
1. Back in the nest (transformed), talk to Lazy at /navi jor_nest 127/207. He gives you three places to investigate. Quests: Finding Clues - Jungkea's Lab, Finding Clues - Baggot's Lab, Finding Clues - Rgan Guard.

  2. Check all six spots. The order doesn't matter.

    • Juncea's lab: walk in (around jor_nest 43/141), then search the Pile of Papers at /navi jor_nest 21/195 and /navi jor_nest 19/142.
    • Bagot's lab: step on /navi jor_nest 66/260 to be moved to jor_dun03, then search the Pile of Papers at /navi jor_dun03 74/71 and /navi jor_dun03 49/80.
    • Rgan guards: walk to jor_nest 177/176, search the Pile of Papers at /navi jor_nest 181/173 (you get a Ledger #1000845) and listen to the Rgan Guard at /navi jor_nest 173/177.

    Quest when all six are done: Share the clues. 36. Report to Lazy (/navi jor_nest 127/207). The choices in this talk don't change anything. Quest: Whispering Silently. 37. Talk to Juncea at /navi jor_nest 31/140. She wants something sweet. 38. Go to the adventurers' dorm in the Ice Castle (/navi icas_in 245/197). Ask Jaerorong or Comfort for an Ice Cookie #1000846. 39. Give the cookie to Juncea (/navi jor_nest 31/140). 40. Juncea wants more: bring 1 Ice Cookie #1000846 or 10 Low-quality Rgan Magic Core #1000707. 41. Do it again: 1 Ice Cookie #1000846 or 10 Low-quality Rgan Magic Core #1000707. The Iwins only hand out cookies during step 38, so plan on bringing 10 cores each time. 42. Keep talking to Juncea. Show her the Ledger #1000845, then listen to Bagot. Quest: Accumulating Doubts. 43. Go back to the dorm and talk to Lazy (/navi icas_in 245/197), then Miriam (/navi icas_in 249/199). Quest: Intermittent difference. 44. In Juncea's lab (transformed), check the Unnoticed Box at /navi jor_nest 19/190. 45. Take a clean tube from the Empty Test Tube at /navi jor_nest 20/194. You receive a Juncea Test Tube #1000604. 46. Use it on the Unnoticed Box again. You get a Red Liquid Test Tube #1000605. 47. A Rgan stops you at /navi jor_nest 24/185 and sends you to Bagot's laboratory.

docs.title: Chapter 5: Bagot's laboratory
docs.text:
1. Step on /navi jor_nest 66/260 to reach jor_dun03 and talk to Juncea at /navi jor_dun03 57/63. She wants to talk to you alone.
  2. With a one-person party, talk to Juncea again to create and enter Bagot Laboratory. Talk to Juncea inside and defeat her transformed form. Then talk to her once more. You are sent back to the Ice Castle (icecastle 27/123).
  3. Talk to Horuru at /navi icecastle 27/126. Quest: Chaotic Snake Nest.
  4. Go to Horuru's house (door at icecastle 62/137) and talk to Horuru at /navi icas_in 247/116. She takes the Red Liquid Test Tube #1000605.
  5. Bring 20 Low-quality Rgan Magic Core #1000707 to Vellgunde (/navi icas_in 244/117). You receive 25 Snow Flower #1000608.
  6. Talk to Juncea (/navi icas_in 243/120).
  7. Talk to Aurelie (/navi icas_in 249/113).

docs.title: Chapter 6: The confused nest
docs.text:
Point of no return

Once you go through the warp below for the search, you can't enter the normal 2nd floor of the Snake's Nest until the operation is finished.

  1. Go to /navi jor_dun01 8/238 and step on the warp. An Iwin scout asks if you're ready. Say yes and you enter the nest under search (jor_que). Talk to the Iwin Recon at /navi jor_que 271/88. You receive 25 Snow Flower #1000608.
  2. Talk to Miriam at /navi jor_que 144/253.
  3. Talk to the Intermediate Rgan at /navi jor_que 131/148.
  4. Walk to /navi jor_que 36/38 and talk to Lehar (jor_que 32/37).
  5. Talk to Lehar again to create and enter Confused Snake's Nest (a party is required). Clear it. When it's over, take the warp portal Aurelie opens. It takes you to jor_back3. Quest: Those Who Vanished.
  6. Report to Aurelie Petit in the dining hall (/navi icas_in 34/189). You receive 50 Snow Flower #1000608. Episode 19 is complete.

Horuru 25 Snow Flower #1000608 18. Miriam 25 Snow Flower #1000608 33. Aurelie Petit 50 Snow Flower #1000608, 119,725,365 Base EXP, 7,000,000 Job EXP 52. Vellgunde 25 Snow Flower #1000608 55. What the story unlocks

  • After step 12: the Ice Castle dailies. Lunch's Select Menu for Lunch opens after step 14.

  • After step 33: Airship Destruction. Enter through the Rope at /navi jor_nest 22/255.

docs.text:
• Iwin Patrol: daily, through the Captain at /navi icecastle 23/115.
  • Finding an Underground Hideout: Horuru at /navi icecastle 27/126. Bury High-sensitivity Feelers at marked spots in jor_back2 and jor_back3. You need this quest to start Episode 20.

  • Snake's Nest dailies: Rgan NPCs at jor_nest 257/26, 239/244, 37/75, 235/57 and 34/79.
  • Side quests: Purification Saint (begins with step 11), Frozen Sea (Surr, icas_in 27/116), Preaching Doctrine (jor_nest 17/97), Curious Things (jor_nest 239/239) and In Need of Help (Lehar, icas_in 141/216, after the story).
  • Shops: Hoyoyo (icas_in 175/63) trades Snow Flowers and reputation goods. Maram (icas_in 180/61) sells supplies, Snow armor and Glacier weapons.

docs.title: Episode 20: Immortals
docs.text:
The Rgans hiding place is still sealed, so the search has to go wider: the Ancient Ice Gorge, the Rgans' Sacred Root under the Snake's Nest, and the drift ice of the Ice Sea. A white cat keeps turning up along the way, and Lasgand's plan to become immortal comes to a head in the Separated Sanctuary.

  • Level: Base Level 215 or higher.
  • Starts at: Horr, outside the Ice Castle, /navi icecastle 27/126.
  • Main hub: the Ice Castle (icecastle and its interiors icas_in and icas_in2).

docs.title: Before you start
docs.text:
• Episode 19 finished. Every step of the Episode 19 story has to be done.
  • Base Level 215. Horr only gives you the new exploration at level 215 or higher.
  • One run of Horr's hideout search. After Episode 19, talk to Horuru in the dining hall (/navi icas_in 32/184) and agree to help. Then talk to Horr outside (/navi icecastle 27/126). He gives you 10 High-sensitivity Feeler #1000842. Bury them at the 10 Marked places in jor_back2 (222/123, 49/175, 308/99, 113/235, 279/307) and jor_back3 (152/359, 328/277, 128/138, 264/133, 46/324). Each try works about half the time, and Horr hands out spares one at a time. Report back to Horr to finish the run.
  • Rgan Transformation Scrolls. Many NPCs in the Snake's Nest, the Sacred Root and the maze only talk to a Rgan. In human form they send you back to jor_nest 38/263. Bring several Rgan Transformation Scroll #101162. Lunch at /navi jor_back2 250/30 sells them.
  • A party. Canyon Exploration, Drift Ice Zone, Nest of Twigs and Separated Sanctuary need a party. A one-person party works.
  • Free weight. Most reward NPCs check that you can carry 10 to 30 Sacred Cat Whiskers #1001217 first.

At icecastle 27/126 only one NPC is shown. Once you have handed in the hideout search at least once and are Base Level 215, Horr stands there and starts Episode 20. You may need to step off the tile and walk back on after handing in.

Episode Skip NPC

The custom Episode Skip NPC in Prontera (/navi prontera 164/163) can complete Episode 20 for an Episode 20 Clear Ticket #1001214 at Base Level 215. It gives 180 Sacred Cat Whiskers #1001217 and reputation but no EXP. It only accepts characters that used the same NPC to skip Episode 19.

docs.title: Chapter 1: The Ancient Ice Gorge
docs.text:
1. Horr, /navi icecastle 27/126. Once the hideout search is handed in and you are level 215, ask him about the new search destination. Quest: New Explore.
  2. Go to the adventurers' dorm in the castle (/navi icas_in 258/196). Everyone gathers there. Talk to Leon (icas_in 262/202). Quest: Expansion of Exploration Scope.
  3. Travel through jor_back3 → jor_back4 (gate at jor_back3 159/365) → jor_back5 (gate at jor_back4 6/374). Walk to /navi jor_back5 353/73 and talk to Lehar. She takes you into the gorge. Talk to Lehar at /navi jor_safty1 64/328. Quest: Indigenous Peoples of the Ancient Ice Gorge.
  4. Talk to Lehar at /navi jor_safty1 195/327, next to the enchanted devices. Quest: Ancient Ice Gorge Exploration.
  5. Back in jor_back5, walk to /navi jor_back5 353/352 and talk to Miriam. She takes you to the next part of the gorge. Talk to Miriam at /navi jor_safty1 330/327. You are sent back to the Ice Castle. Quest: Evidence and return.
  6. Talk to Leon in the dorm (/navi icas_in 262/202). Quest: Suspicious Sense.

docs.title: Chapter 2: A spy in the castle
docs.text:
1. Walk to /navi icas_in 259/216 and talk to Horr (icas_in 259/219). He gives you three places to check, in any order:
    • Barracks (door at icecastle 186/222): Horr at /navi icas_in 113/41. Quest: Barracks Investigation.
    • Inn (door at icecastle 64/225): Charr at /navi icas_in 92/113. Quest: Investigate the Inn.
    • Back Alley at /navi icecastle 209/243. Quest: Exploring Back Alleys.
  2. Report to Horr (/navi icas_in 259/219). The answer you pick doesn't change anything. Quest: The Identity of the Suspicious Device.
  3. Talk to Vellgunde (/navi icas_in 260/205). Quest: Canyon Exploration.
  4. Make a one-person party and talk to Lehar at /navi icecastle 201/171 to create and enter Canyon Exploration. Follow Lehar and the cat through the canyon. At the end you are sent back to icecastle 22/123. Quest: Return to the Ice Castle.
  5. Talk to Miriam in the dorm (/navi icas_in 259/200). Quest: The story of the past.
  6. Talk to Lazy (/navi icas_in 263/200). Quests: The Cold War and the Age of Intelligence and More expert than any Irwin (this opens the dailies Spy search and Intelligence information collection).

docs.title: Chapter 3: The Sacred Root
docs.text:
1. In the Snake's Nest, walk to /navi jor_nest 38/268 and talk to Lazy (jor_nest 36/274) three times. You don't need to be transformed yet. Quest: Infiltrate the hideout of the Rgans.
  2. Transform and talk to Horr (/navi jor_nest 40/274). He opens the door to the snake god's root and you are moved to jor_root1.
  3. Talk to the Rgan Shaman right in front of you (/navi jor_root1 32/34). He sees through your disguise and attacks. Hunt: 5 Superior Rgan Warlocks (in jor_root1) and 5 Church Warlocks (in jor_root2; jor_root1 59/295 leads there).
  4. In jor_root2, step on /navi jor_root2 239/243 to reach the group's hiding spot in jor_safty2. Talk to Lazy (/navi jor_safty2 77/362).
  5. Talk to Miriam (/navi jor_safty2 81/359).
  6. Talk to Horr (/navi jor_safty2 81/362). Quest: Sacred and Sacred.
  7. Go to the Sacred Root (gate at jor_root2 25/291) and talk to the Rgan at /navi jor_sanct 162/86 twice. He wants 3 Bamberries.
  8. Dig them up at the red Callout spots around jor_root2, for example /navi jor_root2 43/63, 90/50, 118/104, 143/79 and 234/95. Each dig works about half the time, and a dug spot rests for a minute.
  9. Bring the berries to the Rgan (/navi jor_sanct 162/86).
  10. Talk to the Rgan at /navi jor_sanct 185/128. You receive a Horsepower Recovery Device.
  11. Bring it to the Rgan at /navi jor_sanct 42/105. Quest: Gaining the Trust of Rgans.

docs.title: Chapter 4: Gaining the Rgans' trust
docs.text:
1. Finish five small tasks for the Rgans of the Sacred Root, in any order. The chapter moves on once all five are done.

    • But think about it: talk to Gomiagand (/navi jor_sanct 215/84). Answer I think so too, then Tap Gamiravagand's shoulder. Other answers end the talk and you have to start over.
    • You are very angry: talk to Holesybigand (/navi jor_sanct 190/128) and answer I guess, then Pretend to be curious. Then bring him 30 Copo's Head Feathers (from Copo in jor_back5 and Armored Kopo in jor_back6).
    • A Silent Answer: talk to Pamosugand (/navi jor_sanct 257/115), then bring 20 Large Gray Feathers (from Grey Icewind in jor_back5) to Dorily Logand next to him (/navi jor_sanct 258/117).
    • I've come this far: talk to Narsioramigand (/navi jor_sanct 271/156), then find chores at the Puddle (/navi jor_sanct 48/159), the Tower (/navi jor_sanct 95/152), the Dump (/navi jor_safty2 195/355), the Mountain of Junk (/navi jor_safty2 303/349) and the Warehouse (/navi jor_safty2 318/254). You must be transformed.
    • I'm probably a lunch box: talk to Eriligand (/navi jor_sanct 101/138). Don't answer No or I don't think so. Those end the talk.

    Quest when all five are done: Trust in Rgan. 25. Talk to Sarekgand (/navi jor_sanct 157/171). Quest: Where the maze ends. 26. Talk to the Supervisor at the maze entrance (/navi jor_sanct 22/283). Hunt: 2 Jormungandr Guardian-P and 1 Jormungandr Guardian-Y. They live in jor_maze and jor_root1. 27. Report to the Supervisor. 28. In the maze (entrance at jor_sanct 28/291), step on /navi jor_maze 15/47. It moves you to a hidden room. Talk to Miriam (/navi jor_safty2 190/38). 29. Back in the maze, step on /navi jor_maze 17/153 and talk to Lehar in the next hidden room (/navi jor_safty2 310/43). 30. Walk to /navi jor_maze 140/68 and examine the Shaky Wall (jor_maze 140/72). Quest: An Unexpected Reunion. 31. Talk to the Shaky Wall again to create and enter Drift Ice Zone (party leader creates). Follow the white cat. The exit warp takes you to jor_back1 363/222. 32. Talk to Lehar (/navi jor_back1 365/226). Quest: Hideout Infiltration Report.

docs.title: Chapter 5: Over the ice sea
docs.text:
1. Talk to Lehar in the Ice Castle (/navi icas_in 226/255). Choice: It's okay, let's go now. moves on right away. Let's rest for a while. means you talk to Leon (/navi icas_in 233/252) and pick Let's go now when you're ready. Quest: Primordial Deep Sea.
  2. Outside, walk to /navi icecastle 146/206 and talk to Cororo (/navi icecastle 141/212). Hunt: 5 Ice Gangu, and bring 3 Frozen Insect Shell #1000832.
  3. Bring the shells to Cororo. Hunt: 5 Shining Seaweed, and bring 3 Shiny Seaweed Stem #1000831. Both monsters live in jor_tail and jor_back1.
  4. Bring the stems to Cororo. He flies you to jor_safty1. Talk to Cororo there (/navi jor_safty1 195/155). He takes you to the drift ice (jor_twice).
  5. Talk to Cororo at /navi jor_twice 235/111. Quest: What is hidden between the ice.
  6. Walk north past your companions and talk to Leon at /navi jor_twice 238/330.
  7. Talk to Leon at /navi jor_twice 158/243. Quest: Branch's Nest.
  8. With a one-person party, talk to Lehar (/navi jor_twice 164/244) to create and enter Nest of Twigs. At the end you land at jor_safty1 331/150. Quest: Beyond the Iceberg, Beyond the Ice Sea.
  9. Talk to Aurelie (/navi jor_safty1 328/150). She sends you back to the drift ice. Hunt: 5 Church Warlocks (in jor_root2).
  10. Report to Aurelie at /navi jor_twice 161/243. Quest: Deep Rooted Rgan.

docs.title: Chapter 6: Rumors in the maze
docs.text:
1. Take the warp at jor_twice 40/52 into the maze, walk to /navi jor_maze 140/74, transform and talk to Lehar (jor_maze 142/70). Quests: Rumors Collection Between Rgan 1/2/3 and The cat at the end of the maze.
  2. Listen to three pairs of Rgans, in any order:
    • Hoton Lokengand or Sohem Garungand at /navi jor_maze 53/238.
    • Naaryugand or Misugozengand at /navi jor_maze 155/243.
    • Hanaungand or Kenguntlgand at /navi jor_maze 282/190.
  3. Talk to Miriam at /navi jor_maze 150/33.
  4. Talk to Miriam at /navi jor_maze 197/34. She leads you to a hidden room in jor_safty2.
  5. Talk to Miriam there (/navi jor_safty2 300/148). After the scene you are sent to jor_back1. Quest: To the Ice Castle.
  6. Talk to Lazy at /navi jor_back1 368/222. The white cat (Nyar) next to him has an optional short talk.
  7. Talk to Leon in the Ice Castle (/navi icas_in 111/228). Quest: Finding Lehar...!

docs.title: Chapter 7: The Undying
docs.text:
1. Click the Marker at /navi jor_root1 32/75. It takes you to jor_safty2. Talk to Lehar there (/navi jor_safty2 75/258). Quest: Investigation, Investigation, Investigation.

  2. Follow Lehar's three marks in jor_root1. Click each first mark, then the mark it points to:

    • /navi jor_root1 69/128, then /navi jor_root1 25/145.
    • /navi jor_root1 35/211, then /navi jor_root1 17/194.
    • /navi jor_root1 254/66, then /navi jor_root1 278/74.

    Quest: It's bullshit. What's the next place? 52. Transform and click the Mark at /navi jor_sanct 133/86. You receive a Rgan Transformation Scroll #101162. Quest: Sacred Root Trend Investigation. 53. Talk to the Bishop at /navi jor_sanct 150/207. You are moved to jor_twig. Quest: Call of Nyar. 54. Talk to the White Cat at /navi jor_twig 187/198. 55. Talk to the White Cat at /navi jor_twig 180/123. 56. Talk to the White Cat at /navi jor_twig 142/153. 57. Talk to Leon (/navi jor_twig 138/157). Quest: Separate Sanctuary. 58. Talk to Aurelie (/navi jor_twig 138/152) to create and enter Separated Sanctuary (a party is required). Defeat Lasgand and talk to Aurelie inside. You receive the Corrupted Heart Fragment of Ymir. Quest: The Immortal. 59. Talk to Aurelie at jor_twig 138/152 again. She sends you to the Ice Castle. 60. The door at /navi icecastle 157/206 is now open. Go in and talk to Voglinde (/navi icas_in2 253/118). She takes the heart fragment. Episode 20 is complete.

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
Step Reward 6. Leon 20 Sacred Cat Whiskers #1001217, 204,917,939 Base EXP, 33,407,506 Job EXP 9. Vellgunde 20 Sacred Cat Whiskers #1001217, 204,917,939 Base EXP, 33,407,506 Job EXP 12. Lazy 20 Sacred Cat Whiskers #1001217, 273,223,919 Base EXP, 44,543,344 Job EXP 16. Lazy 10 Sacred Cat Whiskers #1001217, 136,611,959 Base EXP, 22,271,670 Job EXP 21. Rgan 68,305,979 Base EXP, 11,135,835 Job EXP 22. Rgan 68,305,979 Base EXP, 11,135,835 Job EXP 23. Rgan 20 Sacred Cat Whiskers #1001217, 68,305,979 Base EXP, 11,135,835 Job EXP 24. Gomiagand, Holesybigand, Eriligand 68,305,979 Base EXP and 11,135,835 Job EXP each 24. Dorily Logand 23,123,040 Base EXP, 10,790,760 Job EXP 24. Chores (Narsioramigand) 34,152,989 Base EXP, 4,283,013 Job EXP 27. Supervisor 10 Sacred Cat Whiskers #1001217, 136,611,959 Base EXP, 22,271,670 Job EXP 32. Lehar 20 Sacred Cat Whiskers #1001217, 204,917,939 Base EXP, 33,407,506 Job EXP 35. Cororo 15 Sacred Cat Whiskers #1001217, 136,611,959 Base EXP, 22,271,670 Job EXP 36. Cororo 15 Sacred Cat Whiskers #1001217, 136,611,959 Base EXP, 22,271,670 Job EXP 40. Nest of Twigs 10 Sacred Cat Whiskers #1001217, 136,611,959 Base EXP, 22,271,670 Job EXP 42. Aurelie 20 Sacred Cat Whiskers #1001217, 204,917,939 Base EXP, 33,407,506 Job EXP 45. Miriam 10 Sacred Cat Whiskers #1001217, 68,305,979 Base EXP, 11,135,835 Job EXP 52. Mark Rgan Transformation Scroll #101162, 10 Sacred Cat Whiskers #1001217, 68,305,979 Base EXP, 11,135,835 Job EXP 60. Voglinde 30 Sacred Cat Whiskers #1001217, 136,611,959 Base EXP, 22,271,670 Job EXP

In total that is 230 Sacred Cat Whiskers #1001217, about 2.52 billion Base EXP and 416 million Job EXP. Most reward steps also give Episode 20 reputation, about 1,000 points over the whole story.

What the story unlocks

  • After step 12: the dailies Spy search and Intelligence information collection.
  • After step 21: side quest B, which leads to the daily Taste of hobby (Nadyagand, icas_in2 30/121).
  • After step 24: the Sacred Root dailies from Pamosugand and Narsioramigand.
  • After step 33: the daily Where the maze ends from the Supervisor (jor_sanct 22/283).
  • After step 40: the daily Collect soft delicacies from Toryoryo (icas_in 243/66).
  • After step 60: Immortal at the Branches of the World Tree (/navi jor_twig 114/147), repeat runs of Separated Sanctuary through the White Cat (/navi jor_twig 142/153), and the dailies Uprooting Rgan (Cororo, jor_twice 235/111), Voglinde's Extermination Operation 1 and 2 (Voglinde, icas_in2 253/118) and Iwin's Iwin Worries.

docs.title: After the story
docs.text:
• Side quest A starts with the Iwin Courier at /navi icecastle 109/241. You need Base Level 215 and Episode 19 complete, but not this story. It leads to Sticky Sea and opens more dailies (Escargot!, Dangerous!, I hope they reconcile).
  • Side quest B starts with the Iwin Soldier at /navi icecastle 46/164 once you have finished step 21.
  • Hideout search: Horr's feeler daily from Episode 19 ends when you start Episode 20.

docs.title: Episode 21: Age of Heroes
docs.text:
A dimensional rift opens on Scale Island, and Nyar uses it to send you, Lehar and Nillem back to a time before Lasgand gained his power. In the past you join the Gaebolg Resistance in Lunaforma, earn the trust of the Richard Mercenaries, the Walter fleet in Alberta and the Wigner merchants, and sneak into the Jormungandr cult's temple at Gimli. The cult's plan to bring back Jormungandr leads to a final battle. After that, Nyar brings you home to settle things with Lasgand.

  • Level: Base Level 230 or higher.
  • Starts at: Diver Fapa, next to the airship landing in jor_tail, /navi jor_tail 233/41.
  • Main hub: Lunaforma (jor_mbase and its interior mbase_in), with Alberta (jor_albe and its interior jalbe_in) as the second town.

docs.title: Before you start
docs.text:
• Episode 20 finished. Diver Fapa only talks about the island once the last Episode 20 step (handing the heart fragment to Voglinde) is done.
  • Base Level 230. Below that, Diver Fapa only tells you the quest is for level 230 and up.
  • A party. Gimli Infiltration, Mysterious Ghost Ship, Final Battle, Secret Altar and Silent Sanctuary all need a party. The party leader creates each one.
  • Getting around. Boats link the maps of the past:
    • Walter Sailor at /navi jor_mbase 343/148 sails to Alberta. The Walter Sailor at /navi jor_albe 201/200 sails back.
    • Walter Sailor at /navi jor_mbase 161/343 sails to the Southern Raised Land (jor_raise2). The Hidden Boat at /navi jor_raise2 100/26 sails back. The north edge of jor_raise2 (118/414) leads to the Northern Raised Land (jor_raise1).
    • Small Boat at /navi jor_mbase 121/26 goes to Scale Island (jor_crk_p). The Small Boat at /navi jor_crk_p 75/57 comes back.
    • The Warper also lists Lunaforma, Alberta (Ep21) and the Raised Land fields.

docs.title: Chapter 1: Through the rift
docs.text:
1. Diver Fapa, /navi jor_tail 233/41. Nillem, Aurelie and Lehar join you. Pick I'll go now. to sail to Scale Island (jor_crk). If you pick I'll go later., talk to him again and choose Go to Scale Island. Quest: Detected Rift on the North.
  2. Talk to Nyar at /navi jor_crk 105/108. Nyar opens a rift to the past and you land on the Scale Island of the past (jor_crk_p). Quest: Rift on Scale Island.
  3. Talk to Nyar at /navi jor_crk_p 105/108. Quest: First Meeting.
  4. Walk to /navi jor_crk_p 100/95. Ivan and the resistance soldiers find you, and you are moved to luna_sf1. Quest: Lunaforma.
  5. Talk to Ivan (/navi luna_sf1 258/151). He takes you to Lunaforma (jor_mbase 38/152).

docs.title: Chapter 2: The Gaebolg Resistance
docs.text:
1. Talk to the Resistance Soldier (/navi jor_mbase 54/155). Quest: Gaebolg Resistance.
  2. Talk to Tris (/navi jor_mbase 56/152).
  3. Talk to the Resistance Soldier again.
  4. Talk to Tan (/navi jor_mbase 57/150). He sends you to the Richard Mercenary Group.
  5. Walk to /navi jor_mbase 313/106. Go into the mercenary building (door at jor_mbase 321/115). A short scene plays at mbase_in 289/124. Quest: Richard Mercenaries.
  6. Talk to ??? at /navi mbase_in 292/127 and say you came to see Richard. He sends you to Richard's room.
  7. Knock on Richard's door at /navi mbase_in 113/120. Nobody answers, so try the next door at /navi mbase_in 113/114. A stranger stops you there and takes you back to the office.
  8. Step back into the office (/navi mbase_in 289/124), then fill out the form at the Pile of Documents (/navi mbase_in 299/126).
  9. Talk to Valdaris (/navi mbase_in 302/123).
  10. Talk to Tan (/navi mbase_in 302/122).
  11. Valdaris shows you around Lunaforma. Walk to each spot in order: /navi jor_mbase 316/117, /navi jor_mbase 316/100, /navi jor_mbase 243/120, /navi jor_mbase 145/108 and /navi jor_mbase 135/108.
  12. The door at mbase_in 113/120 now leads into Richard's room. Talk to Valdaris (/navi mbase_in 167/128), then Richard (/navi mbase_in 168/126), then Lee (/navi mbase_in 166/124).
  13. The door at mbase_in 113/114 now opens too. Talk to Lee inside (/navi mbase_in 167/79).
  14. Walk to /navi jor_mbase 163/196. The resistance leaders are waiting.

docs.title: Chapter 3: Heine's errands
docs.text:
1. Talk to Tris (/navi jor_mbase 168/200) until she asks you to fetch something for Heine. This takes four talks. Quest: Calculating Profit and Loss. Hunt: 10 Skipskipper in the Southern Raised Land (jor_raise2), and bring 1 Bright Eye #1001641.
  2. Bring the Bright Eye to Tris. Heine now wants you in Alberta.
  3. Sail to Alberta and talk to Nillem (/navi jor_albe 192/209). Quest: Diligent Worker of Alberta.

  4. Talk to Yohan at the port (/navi jor_albe 239/115). Deliver his cargo to both places, in any order:

    • Walter Sailor at the market near the pier, /navi jor_albe 148/235.
    • Walter Sailor in the guild warehouse, /navi jalbe_in 22/63.

    Quest: Small Cargo Transportation. 24. Report to Yohan. When Nillem complains, pick Stop Nillem. If you pick Complain to Yohan. and then I'll take a good rest., he takes the job back and you have to ask him for work and redo the deliveries. Then clean the four Pile of Dirt spots: /navi jor_albe 151/210, /navi jor_albe 211/136, /navi jor_albe 167/139 and /navi jor_albe 190/175. Quest: Thorough Port Cleaning. 25. Report to Yohan. Quest: Walter Officer Visit. 26. Talk to Iana Operta in the guild building (/navi jalbe_in 67/95). Deliver her letters, in any order: - Patissier Edel, /navi jalbe_in 126/54. - Professor Sanguin, /navi jalbe_in 29/28.

    Quest: Unexpected Letter Delivery. 27. Report to Iana Operta. Maristella Walter is there too and suggests heading to Lunaforma. Quest: News From Lunaforma.

docs.title: Chapter 4: Ivan's soup kitchen
docs.text:
1. Back in Lunaforma, talk to Ivan (/navi jor_mbase 233/277) and ask about the ghost ship. Quest: Ivan Wigner's Joyful Missionary Life.
  2. Talk to Lehar at the soup kitchen (/navi jor_mbase 214/316) several times. You help serve the soup. When Lehar asks, talk to Ivan (/navi jor_mbase 212/311) and then Lehar again. Quests: Lehar's Fulfilling Relief Efforts (1), (2), The Cause of the Family's Ruin! and Lehar's Fulfilling Relief Efforts (3).
  3. Have a meal with Ivan (/navi jor_mbase 189/282). Quest: Ghostship Witness (1).
  4. Talk to Lyriq (/navi jor_mbase 185/311) twice. Quests: Ghostship Witness (2) and Ivan's Plan.
  5. Talk to Ivan (/navi jor_mbase 233/277). He asks you to take a package to his sister in Alberta. Quest: Errand for Ivan.
  6. Give the package to Lalaila Wigner (/navi jalbe_in 56/138). Quest: Ivan's Regret.
  7. Open the Dusty Box on the bookcase in the office next door (/navi jalbe_in 73/187). Lalaila gives you a letter for Captain Maristella Walter. Quest: The Receiver of the Letter.
  8. Give the letter to Maristella Walter (/navi jalbe_in 68/46). Quest: Ownerless Weapon.
  9. Report to Ivan in Lunaforma (/navi jor_mbase 233/277). Quest: Cult Infiltration.

docs.title: Chapter 5: Inside the Gimli temple
docs.text:
1. Go to the Northern Raised Land and step on /navi jor_raise1 323/71. You are moved to luna_sf1. Talk to Ivan (/navi luna_sf1 49/268).
  2. Enter the temple at /navi jor_raise1 152/323 (jor_tmple1). Step on /navi jor_tmple1 186/72 to reach the group's meeting room and talk to Ivan (/navi luna_sf2 113/257). The exit at luna_sf2 105/253 takes you back into the temple.
  3. Ask around the temple, in this order. Each spot moves you into a room in luna_sf2:
    • Step on /navi jor_tmple1 110/190, then talk to the Believer at /navi luna_sf2 45/152.
    • Step on /navi jor_tmple1 186/228, then talk to the Believer at /navi luna_sf2 118/265.
    • Step on /navi jor_tmple1 238/268, then talk to the Believer at /navi luna_sf2 196/257.
  4. Go back to the meeting room (jor_tmple1 186/72) and talk to Ivan (/navi luna_sf2 113/257). The group decides to come back better prepared. Quest: Recruiting Talent for Success.
  5. Talk to Tris in Lunaforma (/navi jor_mbase 143/272).
  6. Take the Small Boat to Scale Island and talk to Tan (/navi jor_crk_p 71/86).
  7. Talk to Ivan (/navi jor_crk_p 69/85).
  8. Back in Lunaforma, talk to Ivan (/navi jor_mbase 166/302). Quest: 2nd Floor Cult Infiltration.
  9. Step on jor_raise1 323/71 again and talk to Tan (/navi luna_sf1 51/267).
  10. Step on /navi jor_tmple1 238/268 and talk to Nadoyo (/navi luna_sf2 187/254).
  11. Talk to the Guard (/navi luna_sf2 198/263) to register. Talk to him again: the party leader picks Finalize the registration. to create Gimli Infiltration, then everyone picks Can we head in now? to enter. At the end you come out at jor_raise1 318/66.
  12. Step on jor_raise1 323/71 and talk to Nadoyo (/navi luna_sf1 48/265).

docs.title: Chapter 6: The ghost ship
docs.text:
1. Talk to Tris (/navi jor_mbase 143/272).
  2. In the central building (door at jor_mbase 204/196), the door at mbase_in 94/141 is now open. Talk to Wilhelm (/navi mbase_in 116/186).
  3. Talk to Reinhardt (/navi mbase_in 118/186). Quest: Ghost Ship Report.
  4. Sail to Alberta and talk to Maristella Walter (/navi jalbe_in 68/46). Quest: Mysterious Ghost Ship.
  5. Talk to Maristella Walter at the harbor (/navi jor_albe 190/186). The party leader picks Set coordinates. to create Mysterious Ghost Ship, then pick Investigate the Mysterious Ghost Ship. to enter. At the end you are back at jor_albe 191/182. Quest: Ghost Ship Identity.
  6. Talk to Maristella Walter again. Quest: Message from a Wizard.
  7. Talk to the Wigner Executive (/navi jor_albe 191/183). Quest: Return to Lunaforma.

docs.title: Chapter 7: Heine's tablet
docs.text:
1. Talk to Tris in the central building (/navi mbase_in 92/123) twice. Quest: Black-Haired Beast.
  2. Take the tablet to the room on the left (door at mbase_in 68/128) and talk to the Heine Tablet (/navi mbase_in 21/168). Heine asks for 2 Vellelopy #1001643. Velelling in the Northern Raised Land drop them.
  3. Bring them to the Heine Tablet and keep talking to it. After the third talk you receive Heine's Tablet #1001627.
  4. Talk to Tris (/navi mbase_in 92/123). News arrives and everyone runs outside.
  5. Talk to Nadoyo outside the central building (/navi jor_mbase 201/192). He saw a giant serpent. Quest: Gathering Eyewitness.

docs.title: Chapter 8: The giant serpent
docs.text:
1. Talk to three witnesses, in any order:

    • Exhausted Soldier, /navi jor_mbase 189/249. Quest: Eyewitness 1.
    • Cult Member Escapee, /navi jor_mbase 218/298. Quest: Eyewitness 2.
    • Wounded Soldier, /navi jor_mbase 60/196. Quest: Eyewitness 3.

    Quest when all three are done: Gathering Eyewitness Complete! 62. Report to Tris (/navi jor_mbase 204/193). Quest: Find Tan and Nadoyo. 63. Click the Rock Crevice at /navi jor_raise1 199/190 and talk to Nadoyo (/navi luna_sf1 253/257). Quest: Suspicion Location in the Temple. 64. Click the Decorative Door at /navi jor_raise1 128/326 and talk to the Cult Priest (/navi luna_sf2 270/162). Quest: Serpent's Lair? 65. Talk to Nadoyo (/navi luna_sf2 268/158). He sends you back to Lunaforma. 66. Report to Tris (/navi jor_mbase 204/193). You are told to stay out of the coming battle. Quest: Excluded from the Final Battle. 67. In the central building, click the Small Door (/navi mbase_in 85/141) and talk to Nyar (/navi mbase_in 64/184). Quest: I can't miss it! 68. Click the Decorative Door at jor_raise1 128/326 again, pick Go in now. and talk to Nadoyo (/navi luna_sf2 254/162). Quest: Join the Final Battle. 69. Go through the Door at /navi luna_sf2 252/164, walk to /navi luna_sf2 260/45 and talk to Heine (luna_sf2 260/46). Quest: Final Battle. 70. Talk to Heine again to create and enter Final Battle (the party leader creates it with Hopi-hop spacial jump., then everyone picks Begin the Final Battle). At the end you are moved to luna_sf2 252/147. Quest: Cat Led Adventures.

docs.title: Chapter 9: Back to the present
docs.text:
1. Talk to Nyar (/navi luna_sf2 254/150). Nyar drags you to a hidden room. Talk to Nyar there (/navi luna_sf2 258/257). Quest: Suspicious Book of Gimli.
  2. The party leader presses the Suspicious Book (/navi luna_sf2 255/257). This creates Secret Altar and a Shining Door appears. Quest: Shining Door.
  3. Enter through the Shining Door (/navi luna_sf2 250/257). Quest: Finally, A Real Mission!
  4. At the end of the altar you land at jor_crk_p 108/105. Quest: Successfully Blocked the Source.
  5. Talk to Nyar (/navi jor_crk_p 105/108). Heine asks you to swap his tablet for a new one hidden near the Lunaforma dock. Quest: Heine's Gift.
  6. Take the Small Boat to Lunaforma and search the Bushes at /navi jor_mbase 129/43. Your Heine's Tablet #1001627 is swapped for a Costume: Heine’s Tablet #410308 and you are sent back to jor_crk_p 79/69. Quest: Return to Scale Island.
  7. Talk to Nyar (/navi jor_crk_p 105/108) and pick Return to the original time. Back in jor_crk, step on /navi jor_crk 137/138. You are moved to jor_twig. Quest: Time to Confirm Casualty.
  8. Talk to the Nyar Clone (/navi jor_twig 122/164). Quest: Settling the Curse. This has a 10 minute wait.
  9. After the wait, talk to the Nyar Clone again. Quest: Lasgand?
  10. Talk to the Nyar Clone to create (Ok! Connect me to the 'Silent Sanctuary'!) and enter (Enter the 'Silent Sanctuary'!) Silent Sanctuary. At the end you are back at jor_twig 122/158. Quest: Butterfly Effect.
  11. Talk to the Nyar Clone. You are sent to jor_crk. Quest: End of the Heroes Era.
  12. Talk to Nyar (/navi jor_crk 105/108). Episode 21 is complete.

What the story unlocks

  • After step 21: Nyar at /navi jor_mbase 220/165 and /navi jor_albe 62/150 opens your storage for 500 Zeny. Counselor Wool (/navi jor_albe 160/137) and Volunteer Vallen Wok (/navi jor_mbase 213/280) start their quest lines, which lead to dailies.
  • After step 51: the Lugenburg Brothers side story (see below).
  • After step 55: Nillem at /navi jor_albe 195/179 offers repeat runs of Mysterious Ghost Ship (Old Walter Memory Fragments, once a day; the wait ends at 04:00).
  • After step 82:
    • Final Battle Normal from Heine (/navi luna_sf2 260/46), once a day (the wait ends at 04:00). Hard mode needs 1,000 reputation with all seven Episode 21 factions and can be run once every three days (ends at 04:00). Normal and Hard each have their own cooldown.
    • The Episode 21 shops in Lunaforma: Wigner Merchant Popo (/navi mbase_in 220/127), Mage Lobelia (/navi mbase_in 228/131, ticket exchange and Gaebolg enchants), Wigner Merchant Operator (/navi mbase_in 232/122) and Blacksmith Sansan (/navi mbase_in 232/125).
    • Yorscalp (jor_sklf1), through /navi jor_raise1 113/334.
    • Valdaris (/navi mbase_in 302/123) starts We're the Mercenaries, but..., which opens six mercenary dailies. Lee (/navi mbase_in 298/121) gives the Yorscalp dailies and weeklies at Base Level 240 and 250.
    • Mandel (/navi jor_mbase 217/172) starts Supply Procurement, which becomes a daily.
    • The Heine Tablet (/navi mbase_in 21/168) gives the daily Overlooked Efforts (3 Bright Eye #1001641).
    • Ivan (/navi jor_mbase 233/277) starts Unexpected Request, a short follow-up with Lalaila in Alberta.

Talk to Reinhardt (/navi mbase_in 118/186), Wilhelm (/navi jor_mbase 140/201), Reinhardt again, Tris (/navi jor_mbase 197/277), Reinhardt (/navi jor_mbase 194/279), Wilhelm (/navi jor_mbase 196/280) and finally Tris. It gives 10 Wigner Premium Exchange Ticket #1001618, 91,298,960 Base EXP and 59,995,050 Job EXP, and opens Wilhelm's dailies Safe Escape Route 1 and 2 (clear the Northern or Southern Raised Land) at jor_mbase 140/201.

docs.title: Abyssal Bloody Branch
docs.text:
The Abyssal Bloody Branch #30063 is the next tier of the normal Bloody Branch. Using it summons one random MVP from a list of 53 bosses next to you.

  • MVPs only. No mini bosses.
  • Field and dungeon MVPs only. Every boss on the list spawns on a normal map or an Illusion map. Instance and memorial dungeon bosses are not included.
  • No repeats from the normal Bloody Branch. Nothing that the normal Bloody Branch can summon is on this list.
  • Almost all of them drop a card. That includes the new Episode 21 and Chapter 1 MVPs.

docs.title: How to get it
docs.text: It is sold in the Cash Shop, under the Hot tab, for 1,000 Cash Points.

docs.title: Where you can use it
docs.text: It works on the same maps as a normal Bloody Branch. On maps that block branches, and on WoE, GvG and Battleground maps, the game refuses it and you keep the item.

docs.title: Tomb of the Fallen
docs.text: The Tomb of the Fallen (lhz_dun_n, the Nightmare Bio Laboratory) is full of the fallen heroes of the Bio Lab. Killing them wakes their stronger third-job versions, and putting all of those to rest summons one of the MVPs. It is a map-wide group goal: every player's kills count toward the same totals.

docs.title: How to get in
docs.text:
Use a Sentimental Fragment #22687. It warps you to a random spot in the Tomb. You can't use it while you're already inside.

  • Heimhunter in the Eden Group market (/navi paramk 71/15) sells it for 200,000 Zeny. The shop restocks 1 per day at midnight, for the whole server.
  • The monsters inside drop it, so regulars can keep a supply going.

Inside the map you can't teleport or save a memo point, and you can't @warp straight to it.

docs.title: 1. Regular heroes
docs.text:
Kill 110 of one regular hero, and its third-job version rises as a mini boss. Each of the 13 heroes counts separately.

The map announces it: "[Tomb of the Fallen] Guillotine Cross Eremes has risen from the dead!"

docs.title: 2. Mini bosses
docs.text:
Each of the 13 mini bosses must be killed 4 times. After each kill the count for its regular hero starts again from 0, so another 110 regular kills bring it back. Once a mini boss has reached 4 kills it stops coming back.

Each kill is announced with the progress: "Rune Knight Seyren defeated (2/4). Fallen heroes laid to rest: 5/13."

docs.title: 3. The MVP
docs.text:
When all 13 mini bosses have reached 4 kills, one random MVP appears at /navi lhz_dun_n 140/230. The whole server sees "[Tomb of the Fallen] … has appeared in the Tomb of the Fallen!"

After the MVP dies, kills don't count for 100 minutes. When the wait ends, the map announces "The dead are restless again" and the counting starts over from zero.

In numbers

One full cycle takes about 5,720 regular kills and 52 mini boss kills. That is a lot for a few players, so it pays to farm the map together.

A server restart resets everything

The counts are not saved. After a restart or a script reload, every hero starts again from 0.

docs.title: Cards
docs.text:
The True cards drop from the regular heroes, not from the mini bosses. Getting a True card doesn't mean a mini boss spawned. The mini bosses drop no cards. The MVP versions drop the third-job cards.
